links.title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight

evidence: Section 4.2 / Table 1: catch rises monotonically 0.765→0.970 while gold-clean FR rises 0.419→0.935; J peaks at L=2 (0.602) and collapses to 0.035 at L=8, with every judge peaking at L∈{1,2} in both domains.

Section 3.3: pre-registered direction-agnostic outcome map (RISING/DECAY/FLAT/INDETERMINATE) with a mandatory clean co-report; score-mode pass (Eq. 4-5) adds threshold-free AUC with per-length recalibration.

Section 4.3 / Appendix M: observation-provision intervention collapses retail FR climb (0.419→0.290 at L=8, slope difference 0.645, CI excludes 0) and recovers J(8) 0.035→0.490; AppWorld loses 38% of slope.

Appendix AF: minimum detectable effects 0.046-0.263 vs observed contrasts 0.075-0.567, design effects 1.00-1.48, and realized rejection rates at nominal 5% of .066/.054/.068 (item bootstrap), indicating calibrated inference.

Appendix AC: SHA-256 freeze manifest, append-only dated amendment chain, archived judgments, and byte-identical re-run of 44/45 analyses; closed judges regenerate from archived verdicts but floating model ids are disclosed as non-reproducible by re-query.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled, pre-registered measurement study of a deployment parameter (the unit of verification) for LLM monitors in agent oversight. Topic alignment is strong with top-weighted preferences: LLM verifiers across six judges, tool-using agent oversight (Agents & Tool Use), AI control/trusted monitoring (AI Safety), and LLM-as-judge evaluation methodology. The twin-prefix framework with matched clean twins and the catch-minus-FR informedness co-report is a genuinely novel instrument, and the core finding (longer windows buy rejection, not discrimination; J peaks at L=1-2 in all six cells) plus the observation-deprivation mechanism via intervention are non-obvious contributions. Rigor is exceptionally high: direction-agnostic frozen outcome map, paired item/cluster bootstraps with exact McNemar, score-mode AUC separating threshold drift from ranking loss, position sweep, inert-padding and predicted-observation controls, three-way defer probe, LoRA-trained monitor control, held-out recipe validation, jackknife, and a power/design-effect appendix. Evidence is strong and quantitatively dense (e.g., catch 0.765→0.970 vs FR 0.419→0.935; J(8) recovery 0.035→0.490 under observation replay), though scoped to non-adaptive injected errors, zero-shot monitors, two domains, L≤8, and a small retail clean set (n=31, disclosed). Reproducibility is outstanding (SHA-256 manifests, archived judgments, append-only amendment chain, byte-identical re-run 44/45), with the disclosed caveat that closed-weight judge ids are floating. Score slightly below the component average reflects that generalizability is deliberately scoped and the subject is a niche oversight parameter rather than a broadly applicable LLM methodology.

primary_link.title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight

papers.summary: Pre-execution oversight is core to trusted monitoring in AI control: a fallible LLM monitor vets planned actions before irreversible execution. Over-blocking forfeits usefulness and pressures deployers to disable it. Every protocol must fix a unit of verification: how many actions one call reviews. Existing designs take the unit as given; its effect on fallible monitors is unmeasured. Natural traces cannot isolate it: review length co-varies with error type and position. Catch alone misleads: re
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討AI控制中的執行前監督：在工具型代理執行不可逆動作之前，由可能出錯的LLM監控器審核其計畫。每個協定都必須設定「驗證單位」——每次驗證呼叫審核幾個動作，但此參數對易錯監控器的影響從未被量化，自然軌跡又讓長度與錯誤型態混淆，單看偵測率也會誤導。作者提出雙生前綴框架：對每個黃金計畫注入一筆環境可接受的錯誤寫入，配上僅差該筆寫入的乾淨孿生前綴，於五種嵌套長度L∈{1,2,3,5,8}下成對評估，以預註冊的Youden informedness（J=偵測率−誤拒率）計分，並強制同步報告乾淨側誤拒率。在零售與AppWorld兩領域、六個評審模型（Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen2.5-14B/72B、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.6 Sol）上，加長視窗雖提升偵測率，誤拒率卻同步攀升，J皆於L=1或2達到峰值；長視窗使零樣本監控器更傾向拒絕，而非更善區分。介入實驗指出主因是觀察剝奪：回放黃金觀察可將零售的J(8)由0.035回升至0.490。僅用短視窗訓練的LoRA監控器無法泛化到長視窗，而任何標籤盲策略（投票、路由、草稿訊號）皆未穩定勝過校準後的固定短單位。限制包括單一非自適應注入錯誤、僅兩領域且L≤8、零售乾淨樣本僅31筆。本文主張安全案例應明示驗證單位並共報乾淨序列，對可信監控的部署極具實務意義。
papers.title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight
papers.title_zh: 更傾向拒絕，而非更善辨別：執行前LLM監督的驗證單位

links.title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning

evidence: Abstract and §1: SRD routes candidates to discard/keep/refine only degraded suffixes 'without requiring a larger target model' with claimed 1.28-1.36x sample efficiency gain over rejection sampling.
§4.2: 'On MATH500 with LLaMA-3.1-8B, SRD achieves 0.544 accuracy at N=10 using only 2,166 output tokens, scaling to 0.640 at N=100 with 21,840 tokens (Table 2).'

§4.1: RSD (Liao et al. 2025) excluded from main comparison 'because it assumes access to a larger target model for regeneration'; baselines are Temperature Sampling, Best-of-N, and Speculative Rejection.
§4.3: measured p_H=0.525, p_M=0.148, ρ̂=1.0, giving efficiency gain 1.28; Appendix F Table 6 reports gains 1.28x-1.36x across N=10-30 on one model pair (Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B + AceMath-7B-RM).
Appendix G Table 7: coupled seeded-generation comparison shows Δ_n=+0.36 (N=10) to +1.29 (N=30) in mean R_max, with refinement success 78-100%.
§4.4.2 Table 4: Reroute (global) best on MATH500 (0.5444) while Self-compare best on GPQA (0.3243), showing refinement effectiveness depends on reward model calibration.
Limitations section: 'SRD currently relies on fixed routing thresholds and heuristic boundary selection' and effectiveness depends on reward model quality.
Appendix E: temperature 0.8, top-p 0.9, thresholds θ_low=0.3/θ_high=0.5, 8xA100 with vLLM; Appendix D provides prompt templates; no code or artifact release is mentioned.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM inference-time decoding paper squarely within the LLM and reasoning preferences: SRD routes reward-scored candidate trajectories to keep/refine/discard and regenerates only degraded suffixes, positioning itself between Best-of-N and speculative rejection (§1, §3). Novelty is moderate: the segment-level intervention without a larger target model is a genuine delta over BoN, speculative rejection, and RSD (§2, §4.1), but it is an incremental composition of known reward-guided search ideas. Rigor is mixed: theorems are stated with full proofs (Appendix C), but the efficiency-gain result is essentially a ratio of lower bounds, and quality improvement relies on a strong assumed stochastic dominance (Assumption 3.4) that nearly assumes the conclusion; some proofs contain minor sloppiness (e.g., Lemma C.2's (1-p)^N typo). Experiments are reasonably thorough: four benchmarks, ten generation-reward pairs (Table 1), threshold/policy/interval ablations (§4.4), runtime breakdown (Appendix B), and direct measurement of p_H, p_M, ρ̂ and R_max gaps (§4.3, Appendices F-G). Evidence supports token-efficiency claims, though main accuracy-compute results are largely in Figure 2 without confidence intervals, ρ̂=1.0 across all N is suspicious, and validation of the theory covers only one model/dataset pair. Generalizability is decent across math, science QA, multi-hop QA, and instruction following at 1.5B-8B scale, but fixed thresholds and reward-model dependence are acknowledged limitations. Reproducibility is fair: hyperparameters, prompts, hardware, and seeding are documented, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning

papers.summary: Inference-time decoding methods improve LLM reasoning by exploring multiple candidate trajectories, yet treat each trajectory as atomic: either retaining it whole or discarding it irreversibly. This wastes computation on partially promising candidates whose high-quality prefixes are abandoned alongside degraded suffixes. We introduce Selective Regenerative Decoding (SRD), which routes each candidate to discard, keep, or refine only the degraded portion of the suffix while preserving the useful p
papers.summary_zh: 推論時期的解碼方法如 Best-of-N 與 speculative rejection，皆把候選軌跡視為不可分割的整體：前者生成多條完整軌跡後挑選最佳，後者提前終止低分前綴，因而浪費前段優質、後段劣化候選的運算。本文提出選擇性再生解碼（SRD），將流程分為生成、路由與再生三階段：先取樣多條候選，再依排名正規化的獎勵分數導向保留、精煉或捨棄；可搶救的候選僅以較高溫度取樣重寫劣化後綴，保留有用前綴，且不需更大的目標模型。理論上，在溫和假設下，SRD 相較拒絕取樣有 1.28 至 1.36 倍樣本效率增益（公式為 1+ρ·p_M/p_H，隨候選池擴大成長），並具終止保證與弱單調性，最佳軌跡的期望品質亦嚴格較高。實驗橫跨 MATH500、GPQA Diamond、HotpotQA 與 AlpacaEval 及多組生成—獎勵模型配對，顯示 SRD 能以明顯較少的生成 token 達到與 Best-of-N 相當的準確率，並在低運算情境勝過 speculative rejection。消融研究指出精煉成效取決於獎勵模型校準：獎勵穩定時全域重排較佳，雜訊較大時局部自我比較更穩健。限制包括固定路由門檻、啟發式邊界選擇，以及對獎勵模型品質與偏差的依賴；重寫機制也可能放大獎勵偏誤。整體而言，SRD 以段落層級介入開啟準確率—運算權衡的新區域，僅需生成與獎勵模型，可與 speculative decoding 等技術疊加。
papers.title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 選擇性再生解碼：推論時期推理的軌跡層級介入

links.title: FABRICA: Agentic CUDA-to-CSL Translation and Optimization for Wafer-Scale Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'Fabrica raises success from 6/28 to 26/28; 22 successful programs match or beat their CSL references' and 'geometric-mean speedup is 3.75x on the SDK simulator and 3.47x on WSE-3 hardware'
Section V-B: 'full knowledge passes 7/15; removing retrieved Cerebras material passes 1/15, and also removing the CSL primer remains at 1/15' - the controlled knowledge ablation

Section III-A: '18 additions cover machine-learning operators and collectives. The additions were model-assisted but manually integrated and validated end to end, and are not treated as independent expert references' - benchmark construction weakness
Section VI: 'The 49-task coverage metric counts a task once if any scheduled workflow passes; three tasks use three seeded workflows and the remaining tasks use one' - optimistic coverage accounting
Section V-H: 'The SFT pilot reports SDK-free structural metrics rather than executable correctness; generated programs still require compilation, numerical checks, and device timing'

Section IV: 'Full prompts, candidates, checks, and measurements remain in the artifact' and 'The primary controlled, coverage, and optimization studies use Claude Opus 4.8 and SDK 1.4.0 simulation on fresh bundles' - reproducibility support without a public link

Section V-A: 'Opus 4.8 passes 26 tasks, Sonnet 4.6 passes 25, and Opus 4.6 passes 24; the best open-weight model, gpt-oss-120b, passes 2' on the identical 28-task core, from a single workflow per model-task pair (preliminary)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong match for agent/code/LLM preferences: an agentic LLM framework (six role-specific stages, reviewer-routed repair, tool execution against compiler, simulator, and WSE-3 hardware) for CUDA-to-CSL kernel translation, with a cross-model LLM study (Claude Opus/Sonnet vs gpt-oss, Gemma, Qwen) and a LoRA SFT pilot. Not a pure domain application; methodology is squarely LLM-agent code generation. Novelty is moderate: the benchmark (first paired CUDA-CSL suite) and target domain are new, but components assemble known techniques (DocPrompting, Reflexion, self-debug, MetaGPT-style roles). Rigor is good: controlled single-attempt vs full workflow (6/28 to 26/28), knowledge ablation (7/15 vs 1/15), feedback modes A-D/T, formal validity gates, and integrity checks; weakened by small denominators (28 core tasks), a single-run preliminary model study, and 18 of 49 benchmark tasks being model-assisted rather than independent expert references. Evidence is solid with hardware replay on WSE-3 (27 pairs, 3.47x geometric-mean speedup) and honest limitation reporting, but the SFT pilot uses proxy metrics without executable validation and the coverage metric counts a task once if any workflow passes. Generalizability is limited by Cerebras-specific knowledge and tooling, though the findings (target knowledge dominates; correctness-gated optimization) plausibly transfer to other cross-architecture translation. Reproducibility is partially supported: SDK versions, budgets, and protocols are specified and an artifact is claimed, but no verifiable public link and WSE-3 access is required.

primary_link.title: FABRICA: Agentic CUDA-to-CSL Translation and Optimization for Wafer-Scale Systems

papers.summary: Porting GPU kernels across architectures requires architectural remapping, not syntax substitution. CUDA encodes decomposition, locality, and synchronization through threads, blocks, and memory accesses; the Cerebras Software Language (CSL) requires explicit placement, distributed SRAM, fabric communication, event-driven tasks, and host/device contracts. We present FABRICA-Bench, 49 paired CUDA-to-CSL tasks, and FABRICA, an agentic framework combining target knowledge, execution, failure-directe
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討將 CUDA 核心移植到 Cerebras 晶圓級引擎(WSE)的挑戰:這並非語法替換,而是架構重映射。CUDA 以 threads、blocks 與記憶體階層表達分解與同步;CSL 則要求明確的 PE 擺放、分散式 SRAM、fabric 路由與事件驅動任務,而公開 CSL 資源稀缺,現有 coding agent 幾乎缺乏目標知識,也無基準可衡量跨架構轉譯。作者提出 Fabrica-Bench,含 49 個成對 CUDA/CSL 任務,以編譯、執行、介面契約與數值檢驗計分,並以防火牆隔離參考解答與隱藏輸入;另提出 Fabrica 代理式框架,依序進行分析、架構設計、實作、審查與正確性閘門控管的最佳化,並檢索 SDK 文件、教學與技能筆記組成的知識庫補足模型缺乏的 CSL 慣用法。結果顯示:在固定 28 個 Level 1–3 核心任務上,單次生成僅 6 個通過,Fabrica 搭配 Claude Opus 4.8 達 26/28,其中 22 個等同或超越 CSL 參考;49 任務涵蓋評估有 38 個產生正確程式,最後三個任務在三種子下通過 8/9;27 組可計時配對的幾何平均加速為模擬器 3.75×、WSE-3 硬體 3.47×。消融實驗指出檢索 Cerebras 知識是最強單一因素(1/15 升至 7/15),最佳開源模型僅通過 2/28,凸顯商用與開源落差。限制包括結果綁定特定模型與 SDK 版本、涵蓋率指標計數較寬鬆,離線 SFT 試驗僅採結構代理指標,生成程式仍需完整執行驗證;需要跨 PE 運算元遞送的共設計案例仍是系統邊界。此研究為晶圓級跨架構核心生成提供首個可執行基準,指出目標知識、執行回饋與同標的量測是關鍵要素,產生的執行軌跡亦可供後續後訓練運用。
papers.title: FABRICA: Agentic CUDA-to-CSL Translation and Optimization for Wafer-Scale Systems
papers.title_zh: FABRICA:針對晶圓級系統的代理式 CUDA 至 CSL 轉譯與最佳化

links.title: Beyond Confidence: Test-Time Scaling for Multi-Turn Search Agents via Retrieval Grounding

evidence: Abstract and §6/Table 1: RGV best in all 20 benchmark×model cells, up to +5.4% accuracy over DeepConf (BrowseComp-Plus Tongyi 71.1 vs 65.7) and +35% on minority-correct questions

§3 Motivation: copy tokens have mean logprob +0.50 nats higher than non-copy tokens (730k tokens); DeepConf within-question variance share shrinks 0.39→0.20 as copy fraction grows; median rollout copies 93% of content tokens
§6.2: on the 122 minority-correct (1-2/8) questions of BrowseComp-Plus/Tongyi, RGV scores 84.4% vs DeepConf 49.2% (+35.2%)
§6.3/Fig. 4: RGV at N=4 (65.9%) matches DeepConf at N=8 (65.7%), halving rollout budget; ~0.3 ms per rollout on one CPU thread
§6.1: rollout-level ROC AUC 0.908 (RGV) vs 0.837 (DeepConf); RGV correlates with gold-document recall r=0.57 vs 0.36; rare-entity tokens carry the C-W gap (digits 0.145, capitalised entities 0.092)

Appendix I: masking copied tokens restores within-question variance (up to 2.4x) but AUC falls in 9/10 cells; teacher-forced doc removal drops copied-token logprobs about twice as much as non-copy (−0.221 vs −0.106)
Appendix B: 3-fold split variance is self-described as a coarse estimator used as a stability indicator, not for hypothesis tests; some cells have large std (Kimi BrowseComp ±7.8)
§5/Appendix M: single judge Qwen3-32B at temperature 0 with official BrowseComp-Plus template; verbatim system, force-final, verbalised-confidence, and judge prompts provided
Appendix O: code (GitHub) and data (HuggingFace) released with trajectories, per-token logprobs, judge outputs; GAIA and HLE redistribution restrictions handled via question identifiers

Limitations: grounded-but-wrong residual 26/616 (4.2%); entity-only answers reduce RGV to matching DeepConf (Appendix J); English only; adversarially poisoned corpus would inflate copy-based scores; HLE margin only +0.7% (Appendix L)
Appendix C: DC+RGV/Verb+RGV combination weight alpha is selected per cell from a grid to maximise voting accuracy, an overfitting risk not addressed with held-out data
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agents/test-time-scaling paper, squarely in scope (multi-turn search agents, weighted voting over rollouts, retrieval grounding). The copy-inflation diagnosis is a genuinely new mechanistic finding, backed by correlational and interventional evidence; however, the method itself (lexical prose-recall as a voting weight) is an acknowledged reuse of long-standing grounding/faithfulness primitives, applied at a new layer. Rigor is strong: 20 benchmark-model cells, DeepConf grid sweep, overlap-metric ablations, doc-reduction ablations, null controls, prompt/format sensitivity, selection-vs-voting, and two causal interventions. Evidence is weakened by small per-cell samples (150 questions, minority-correct claim from 122 questions on one model-benchmark pair), a single LLM judge (Qwen3-32B) for all correctness labels, per-cell alpha tuning in the signal-combination appendix, and coarse 3-fold uncertainty. Generalizability is explicitly bounded: search-agent scope, English only, gains shrink on reasoning-heavy HLE (+0.7%), and short-answer formats collapse the advantage. Reproducibility is high: code, trajectories, per-token logprobs, and judge outputs released; verbatim prompts and per-model parameters given, though API-served models and live-web search introduce drift.

primary_link.title: Beyond Confidence: Test-Time Scaling for Multi-Turn Search Agents via Retrieval Grounding

papers.summary: Confidence-based voting aggregates parallel LLM rollouts by weighting each with internal signals such as token log probabilities, and has been actively studied for single-turn reasoning. However, modern LLMs increasingly act as multi-turn search agents that retrieve and condition on external documents. In this paper, we show that confidence-based voting transfers poorly to this multi-turn setting, and identify the underlying failure reason as copy inflation: when retrieved documents are appended
papers.summary_zh: 多輪搜尋代理會將檢索到的文件附加進上下文,使以 token 對數機率為權重的信心投票(如 DeepConf)失效。論文診斷出「複製膨脹」(copy inflation)機制:自檢索文件複製的 token 平均獲得高出 0.50 nats 的對數機率,壓平同題各 rollout 間的信心差距,使加權投票退化為簡單多數決;而模型約 93% 的內容 token 皆複製自檢索文件,問題幾乎遍及全部評測。作者據此提出檢索依據投票(Retrieval-Grounded Voting, RGV):以最終答案文字與該 rollout 實際檢索文件間的詞彙重疊(答案側 recall,取最相符文件的最大值)作為投票權重,訊號在受污染上下文之外計算,不需 logprobs、微調或額外 LLM 呼叫,成本僅約每次 rollout 0.3 毫秒。在 BrowseComp-Plus、BrowseComp、GAIA、FRAMES 四個基準與五個 LLM 上,RGV 於全部 20 個組合皆最佳,較 DeepConf 最高提升 5.4% 準確率,在少數正確題(8 個 rollout 僅 1-2 個正確)提升達 35%,並以 4 個 rollout 達到 DeepConf 用 8 個的準確率。跨題洗牌、隨機 token 對照與 gold 文件召回相關(r=0.57)等對照實驗佐證訊號確實反映檢索品質;遮罩複製 token 雖能恢復同題內分數離散度,卻無法恢復鑑別力。限制包括:效果受檢索品質上限拘束、存在「有依據但錯誤」的殘餘失敗(4.2%)、過短答案會削弱訊號、推理密集任務增益較小,且對惡意污染的語料庫仍脆弱。本文的意義在於指出:當上下文被檢索證據污染,任何消費 token 層級信心的機制(如提前停止、路由、棄答、報酬塑形)都會繼承同樣的污染,取自環境紀錄的訊號反而更可靠。
papers.title: Beyond Confidence: Test-Time Scaling for Multi-Turn Search Agents via Retrieval Grounding
papers.title_zh: 超越信心:以檢索依據實現多輪搜尋代理的測試時間擴展

links.title: Evidence Blindness in Direct Corpus Interaction: Persistent Navigation with AtlasNav

evidence: Section 5.2 / Table 1: AtlasNav 92.05% strict accuracy vs 84.58% for DR-DCI (DeepSeek) with 30.21% lower recorded online cost; gains of 3.98–21.57 points across four backbones.

Section 3.2: formalizes Evidence Blindness as a monotone funnel H_C ⊇ H_S ⊇ H_O ⊇ H_L with EB_Any/EB_Mean/EB_All measures; Section 3.3 introduces a fragment-level Qrel over the full BrowseComp-Plus evaluation set.
Appendix B.2 / Table 5: frozen Qrel with 830 questions, 889 slots, 1,753 accepted spans; only 2 questions required manual adjudication; no LLM judge used for Locate (Appendix B.3).

Appendix F.1 / Table 10: exhaustive six-way parent/child view-assignment ablation; selected Topic+Identity/Episode+Relation hierarchy is Pareto-best (95.78% accuracy, lowest cost) including a role-reversal comparison.
Appendix D.2: exact McNemar tests, fixed-seed bootstrap CIs, BH-corrected permutation tests; no best-of-N selection or correctness-conditioned reruns.

Appendix G.1–G.3: boundary results honestly limiting claims — no significant accuracy gain on 2Wiki-Global (p=0.388), no Loose/Strict gain on FanOutQA, and higher online cost on TREC-COVID (CNY 17.22 vs 4.68).
Appendix A Limitations and Appendix I.5: offline construction cost (253.55M tokens, 20,039 requests) reported separately from online inference rather than amortized.

Reproducibility statement: anonymized supplementary package with implementation, frozen configs, Qrel, and trajectories promised; 'code, releaseable data, and trajectories will be made public' — not yet available.
Section 5.4 / Table 4: EnterpriseRAG-Bench comparison is explicitly 'for context rather than controlled comparison' against a public leaderboard snapshot.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-preference work on LLM agentic search/RAG interfaces (Agents & Tool Use w2.5, RAG w1.8), not an out-of-scope domain application. Contribution is twofold: a stage-wise 'Evidence Blindness' diagnosis (Construction/Surface/Open/Locate with a frozen fragment-level Qrel) and AtlasNav, a persistent multi-view corpus atlas with query-adaptive RRF routing. Novelty is moderate-good: multi-view structured corpora echo RAPTOR/HippoRAG/GraphRAG, but persistent (not per-query) organization plus process-level evidence realization metrics is a fresh angle. Rigor is strong: same-agent comparisons across four backbones, frozen trajectory prefixes with no backfilling, McNemar/bootstrap statistics, a six-variant hierarchy ablation, and honest boundary experiments (2Wiki saturation, FanOutQA no accuracy gain, TREC-COVID higher cost) that bound claims. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent but relies on unverifiable future backbones, self-reproduced DR-DCI baselines, and a non-controlled leaderboard snapshot on EnterpriseRAG-Bench; headline numbers (92.05% strict accuracy, 96.51% reference) cannot be externally validated. Generalizability is supported across three corpora and 10K–1M scaling, though all settings remain agentic QA/retrieval. Reproducibility is promising (frozen configs, hyperparameters, Qrel statistics, promised code/data release) but nothing is public at review time.

primary_link.title: Evidence Blindness in Direct Corpus Interaction: Persistent Navigation with AtlasNav

papers.summary: Large language model agents are moving beyond conventional retrieval-augmented generation toward direct interaction with external corpora. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) keeps the full corpus accessible, yet reachable evidence can remain unusable under finite interaction budgets. Required evidence may fail to surface, a surfaced supporting document may remain unopened, or an opened document may fail to expose its decisive fragment. We call this progressive silent loss Evidence Blindness and qua
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理正從傳統 RAG 轉向直接與外部語料庫互動(Direct Corpus Interaction, DCI),但在有限互動預算下,可觸及的證據未必可用:必要證據可能未浮現、相關文件可能未被開啟、開啟後關鍵片段也可能未被定位,且過程缺乏明確失敗訊號。論文將此現象形式化為 Evidence Blindness(證據盲區),以 Construction、Surface、Open、Locate 四階段衡量證據實現,並為 BrowseComp-Plus 全測試集建立片段級 Qrel,使定位可被直接觀測。診斷顯示先前動態工作區最佳方法 DR-DCI 有 77.34% 的錯誤在完整定位前即遺失證據。據此提出 AtlasNav:離線一次性將語料組織成結合主題、身份、事件、關係四種語意視角的持久 Corpus Atlas;查詢時由輕量路由器對各視角與 BM25 進行加權 RRF 融合,以導航取代重建搜尋空間。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上,AtlasNav 以 DeepSeek 骨幹達 92.05% 嚴格準確率,較 DR-DCI 高 7.47 個百分點,記錄線上推論成本降低 30.21%,各階段盲區一致下降,並更快逼近證據供給的經驗參考;於 PhantomWiki 10K 至 1M 規模及 EnterpriseRAG-Bench 異質企業資料的轉移測試上亦具競爭力。限制包括:離線建構成本需視部署情境攤提;在高召回情境(2Wiki-Global)效益主要來自效率;FanOutQA 顯示多答案聚合瓶頸仍在;TREC-COVID 品質提升伴隨較高成本。核心訊息是語料表示應被視為代理介面的一等公民,可重用結構能將有限互動從反覆探索化為有效導航。

links.title: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments

evidence: Section 3.3: benchmark built on AndroidWorld, augmented from 116 to 236 tasks with manual verification of solvability; dynamic trap injection preserves task solvability.
Section 3.4: human validation across ten subcategories reports 91% of tasks satisfy solvability, preserved solvability, and trap-validity criteria.
Section 4.2: universal performance degradation reported, e.g., Claude-Sonnet-4.6 drops from 74.2% to 66.5% and GUI-Owl-1.5-32B-Think from 69.5% to 62.4% under traps.
Section 4.2: thinking models show comparable or larger degradation than instruct counterparts (Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking drops 6.1 points vs. 5.8 for Instruct).
Section 5.3: AnTrap-GRPO yields +8.1~11.0% on S-layer and up to +8.5% on A-layer, but negligible R-layer gains (<+3.0%, Loop strictly below +1.0%).
Appendix D (Table 7): mixed-trap GRPO gains are diluted to roughly original-environment GRPO levels, supporting subcategory-specific adversarial exposure.

Appendix A.2: fixed task-initialization seed 30 and trap seed 42, vLLM serving with tensor-parallel 4, Pixel 6 emulator on API 33; GRPO hyperparameters in Table 6 (LR 1e-6, clip 0.2, 600 training tasks).
Limitations: only 236 base tasks, no adversarial SFT explored due to budget, and the work is intentionally evaluation-focused rather than a training solution.
Code availability claim: 'Our code will be available at https://github.com/gguogan/AnTrap' (abstract footnote), not yet verified as released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A GUI-agent robustness benchmark squarely matching the top-weight Agents & Tool Use preference (agent recovery, computer use, agentic robustness), plus strong overlap with AI Safety (adversarial perturbations) and Red Teaming & Evaluation (benchmark construction). Novelty is solid but incremental: it extends AndroidWorld with a 4-layer/10-subcategory dynamic trap taxonomy and injection pipeline, distinguishing it from static robustness suites (e.g., SMAN-Bench), though computer-use robustness benchmarks already exist. Rigor is above average: 16 evaluated models, human validation (91% pass on Section 3.4 criteria), controlled GRPO comparisons in original vs. adversarial environments, ten per-subcategory specialist runs, and a mixed-trap ablation (Appendix D); weaknesses include author-annotated pilot study (Appendix B), no statistical significance testing, and small human baselines. Evidence is quantitatively supported (e.g., Claude-Sonnet-4.6 drop 74.2%→66.5% in Section 4.2; S-layer GRPO gains +8.1~11.0% vs. Loop <1.0% in Section 5.3), though causal attributions are hypotheses. Generalizability is limited to Android with only two trained models, acknowledged in Limitations (236 tasks, no SFT). Reproducibility is strong: fixed seeds (30/42), full trap-operator parameters (Table 5), GRPO hyperparameters (Table 6), and prompts (Figures 4-9), but code is only promised as available. Well within scope: LLM/VLM-based agents with language-methodology analysis, not pure vision.

primary_link.title: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments

papers.summary: GUI agents often encounter dynamic anomalies when deployed on Android devices, from unexpected pop-ups to action misuse, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of agent robustness against runtime anomalies. We introduce AnTrap, a comprehensive benchmark that injects dynamic perturbations into agent execution trajectories. We propose a taxonomy organizing real-world anomalies into four layers (State, Thinking, Action and Round) with ten fine-grained subcategories, and develop a construction pipeline that preserves task solvability while introducing realistic adversarial conditions. Evaluating 16 leading GUI models, we reveal universal vulnerability to dynamic anomalies, with even the strongest models suffering significant performance degradation. Furthermore, we conduct GRPO training in both original and adversarial environments to validate our benchmark, separating environment-learnable anomalies from reasoning-bottlenecked ones. Our findings show that while single-step traps at state and action layers are largely addressable through adversarial reinforcement learning, deep contextual traps, like state deadlock, expose intrinsic limitations that cannot be resolved by training in environments with traps alone.
papers.summary_zh: GUI 代理人在 Android 裝置上執行時，會遭遇彈出視窗等外部環境擾動，也會產生視覺幻覺、座標偏移等內部錯誤，但既有基準缺乏對此類執行時異常的系統性評估。本文提出 AnTrap 基準，以 AndroidWorld 為基礎擴增為 236 項任務，並在代理人動態執行時即時注入陷阱。作者依執行迴圈提出 STAR 分類法，將異常分為 State、Thinking、Action、Round 四層共十個子類別，注入時保留任務可解性，使效能退化可歸因於穩健性不足。評估 16 個模型顯示，各模型在陷阱環境下皆普遍脆弱：最強的 Claude-Sonnet-4.6 成功率由 74.2% 降至 66.5%，人類基準為 93.4%；跨步驟的 Round 層情境陷阱最難克服，且具推理能力的模型未必更穩健。作者在原始與對抗環境分別進行 GRPO 訓練，發現對抗式強化學習能大幅改善 State 與 Action 層的單步異常（提升約 8% 至 11%），Thinking 層僅獲中等改善，但 Round 層的深層情境陷阱（如狀態死結與迴圈）幾乎無法透過訓練克服，顯示其屬推理瓶頸，需要長程自我監控能力。研究限制包括任務數僅 236 項、未探索對抗式 SFT，且重心在診斷而非訓練方案。整體而言，AnTrap 為 GUI 代理人穩健性評估提供系統性基礎，並釐清環境可學習與推理瓶頸問題的界線。
papers.title: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments
papers.title_zh: Android GUI 代理人能否抵禦執行時異常？AnTrap：於動態對抗環境中評估代理人

links.title: ADeptS-Bench: Measuring the Trustworthiness of Computer Use Agents Across Devices

evidence: Abstract: 'no model consistently exceeds 80% task success while staying below 30% attack success; every model clicks Checkout on a $25K order without hesitation' - headline empirical finding
Sec 3.2: safety stream has 1,718 task instances (358 mobile pairs + 501 desktop pairs) across 10 threat categories with paired benign/malicious screenshots embedding visual threats
Sec 3.1/App K: risk taxonomy grounded in expert workshops and a MaxDiff survey (n=1,300 US participants); top outcomes identity theft 80.2%, account compromise 77.5%

Table 3 / Sec 4.2: removing the refusal tool raises ASR by +22.0pp for Gemini 3.1 Pro, +10.3-10.7pp for Claude/GPT-5.4, and ~0pp for Qwen, yielding the 'tool-dependent / partially tool-dependent / no mechanism' taxonomy
Table 2 / Sec 4.1: seven models, 10 runs at temperature 0.1 with 95% CIs; best ADeptS-Bench Score 76.0 (Gemini 3.1 Pro desktop)
Sec 4.5: LLM judge validated on 338 decisions, 96.1% human agreement (kappa=0.92); consequence overestimation in 42-62% of matched items across all models
Sec 4.4 / Fig 3: L1-L4 threat detectability spectrum; L4 (10.8%) including $25K checkout and 'Optimize'-labeled factory reset missed by all models

App P: GPT-5.4 scores 6% unsafe on OS-Harm overt requests but 36% on ADeptS malicious desktop tasks (43% when jailbreak-wrapped), arguing the benchmark measures a distinct, complementary threat presentation

Sec 5 / App H: limitations acknowledged - per-model harness differences (GPT-5.4 downscaled to 768px, Claude 1280x720), English-only tasks, US-based survey, and the disambiguation LLM judge also being an evaluated model
Conclusion/App N: data, evaluation code, and analysis tools to be released 'upon publication' under CC BY-NC 4.0; GitHub link provided but availability not yet verifiable
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark paper squarely in-scope: it evaluates LLM/VLM-powered computer use agents for safety (attack success, false refusal, prompt injection, jailbreak) and disambiguation, matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, LLMs, Multimodal). Novelty is good but largely combinatorial: paired benign/malicious visual threats, offline single-step evaluation, a disambiguation stream, and a user-grounded taxonomy (MaxDiff n=1,300) are individually grounded in prior work (SafeArena, MobileSafetyBench, AmbiBench); Table 1/App. I substantiate the claim of being the first to combine these across mobile+desktop. Rigor is above average: 10 runs with 95% CIs (Table 2), validated LLM judge (96.1% agreement, kappa=0.92, Sec 4.5), refusal-tool ablation isolating three safety architectures (Table 3), margin sensitivity (App C), and an intent analysis ruling out grounding artifacts for GPT-5.4 (App B). Evidence strength is strong, including external corroboration via OS-Harm (App P: GPT-5.4 6% misuse on overt requests vs 36% interface-embedded compliance, 43% when jailbreak-wrapped). Deductions: per-model harnesses differ (resolution downscaling for GPT-5.4/Claude, acknowledged in Sec 5/App H), the disambiguation judge (Gemini 3.1 Pro) is also an evaluated model, low Krippendorff's alpha in annotation (App G), and single-step static screenshots limit ecological validity - the authors position it as 'necessary but not sufficient'. Generalizability is constrained (English-only, US-centric survey, 7 models from 4 families). Reproducibility is promising (GitHub link, datasheet, full prompts, CC BY-NC release) but data/code are only promised 'upon publication', not verifiably available. Overall a rigorous, highly relevant evaluation contribution with honest limitations.

primary_link.title: ADeptS-Bench: Measuring the Trustworthiness of Computer Use Agents Across Devices

papers.summary: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed to navigate mobile and desktop applications on behalf of users, yet no benchmark comprehensively evaluates whether they can safely interact with visual interfaces while handling ambiguous instructions. We introduce ADeptS-Bench, a dual-stream trustworthiness benchmark, grounded in the ADEPTS capability framework and general population user studies. The Safety stream provides paired benign/malicious tasks with threats embedded in the visual int
papers.summary_zh: 電腦使用代理（Computer Use Agents, CUAs）已逐漸為使用者操作行動與桌面應用程式，但尚無基準全面評估其能否在處理模糊指令時安全地與視覺介面互動。本文提出 ADeptS-Bench，依據 ADEPTS 能力框架與一般大眾使用者研究（MaxDiff 問卷，n=1,300）建立雙流可信度基準：Safety 流設計成對的良性／惡意任務，將釣魚覆蓋層、誤導按鈕與提示注入等威脅嵌入截圖中；Disambiguation 流則評估代理在決策點模糊時是否主動請求釐清，並以明顯度與後果兩軸計分。基準共 2,462 個任務，涵蓋行動與桌面平台，評測七個模型後發現：沒有模型能在保持攻擊成功率（ASR）低於 30% 的同時穩定超過 80% 的任務成功率（TSR），每個模型都會毫不猶豫地對 2.5 萬美元訂單點擊「結帳」，也無人察覺被誤標為「最佳化」的恢復原廠設定按鈕。消融實驗揭示三種安全架構：工具依賴型（移除拒絕工具後 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 ASR 上升 22 個百分點）、部分工具依賴型（Claude、GPT-5.4）與無安全機制型（Qwen）。在消歧方面，所有模型普遍高估後果嚴重度，呼應安全流中過度拒絕的偏差。限制包括僅評估單步決策、僅涵蓋英文與 Android、Windows/Mac/Linux 平台。此基準為改善 CUA 可信度提供具體方向，並強調可信度需要多維度、跨平台的評估。

Appendix A.3: Inspect AI 0.3.241, vLLM 0.21.0, RDKit 2026.03.3, public Hugging Face checkpoints, and 'Redistributable frozen benchmark inputs and prompt templates accompany the paper', though 'restricted AMIE HPI input... are not redistributed'
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation-methodology paper squarely within scope: it evaluates four LLMs (Qwen3.6, GLM-4.7, DeepSeek-V4) across benchmark tasks including agentic repository repair, code bug finding, and retrieval-based evidence search, directly matching the LLM/evaluation/agents/code/RAG preference profile. Novelty is solid though not groundbreaking: VTC formalizes finite-budget coverage of distinct validated outcomes, well positioned against pass@k, NoveltyBench, HypoSpace, and Shypula et al., but the core idea (counting distinct useful outcomes across k draws) is a natural formalization. Rigor is strong: an unbiased subset-counting estimator (Appendix A.2, Eq. 3), 24 matched model-inference configurations, full per-configuration tables, a granularity sensitivity analysis (Appendix D.3), and 10,000-resample paired instance bootstrap for headline claims (Appendix D.5). Evidence for the central claims is quantitative and consistent: quality-based selection incurs 12.1% task-macro VTC regret with 10/25 Top-5 agreement, temperature raises VTC in 38/40 matched comparisons (36 with intervals above zero). Key weaknesses: VTC's usefulness hinges on heuristic task-specific outcome mappings (scaffolds, modified-function sets, UMLS CUIs) whose validity is asserted rather than human-validated; bootstrap covers instance resampling only, not generation stochasticity; only four models; medical/clinical and frozen-reference dependencies make absolute coverage reference-relative. Reproducibility is good: public GitHub link, pinned checkpoints, software versions, and redistributable frozen benchmark inputs, though AMIE clinical inputs are withheld. Generalizability of the metric requires constructing new deterministic mappings per task, which the authors honestly flag in Section 7.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Multiple LLM Generations with Validated Task Coverage

papers.summary: Many LLM applications are most useful when they provide several candidate outputs for comparison, validation, or combination. Predominant evaluation settings, however, still focus on individual outputs or reduce multiple samples to a single success or selected answer. This can miss whether the outputs include several genuinely different useful results. We introduce VTC-Bench, a five-domain benchmark for this setting, together with Validated Task Coverage (VTC) as its core evaluation quantity. Th
papers.summary_zh: 許多 LLM 應用需要提供多個候選輸出供比較或組合，但主流評測仍聚焦單一輸出品質，或把多次取樣縮減為單一成功事件（如 pass@k、self-consistency），無法衡量模型能否累積多個真正不同且有用的結果。本文提出 VTC-Bench 與 Validated Task Coverage（VTC）：統計 k 次嘗試後驗證通過且對應相異有用結果的數量。基準涵蓋五個領域——分子設計（以 Bemis–Murcko 骨架為單位）、軟體儲存庫修復（以通過測試的修改函式集合為單位）、程式錯誤查找（以行為錯誤類別為單位）、鑑別診斷（對映至 UMLS 概念）與證據搜尋（BRIGHT-Pro 推理面向），全部採自動驗證與確定性計分，不依賴模型裁判。針對四個模型與溫度、思考模式的 24 種組合實驗顯示：單次抽用品質最高的設定不必然擁有最佳覆蓋率，以品質選出的前五名平均相對覆蓋率損失達 12.1%；表面多樣性也無法可靠反映任務相關覆蓋率。提高溫度在 40 組配對比較中有 38 組提升覆蓋率，即使單次品質下降；思考模式與鏈結生成（明確要求多樣性）的效果則隨任務而異。限制在於 VTC 依賴任務特定的結果映射，且覆蓋率相對於凍結的參考目標。此工作證明有限候選集合本身即是值得直接評測的對象，能揭示傳統逐輸出評估看不到的行為差異。

papers.summary_zh: 激活導引（activation steering）可在不改動模型權重下改變行為，但僅憑行為改變無法證明效果確實源自目標概念。本文提出 SteerCheck，一項預註冊的歸因審計：在匹配非目標 KL 的功能預算下，比較觀測向量與三族空對照——各向同性隨機方向、PCA 子空間方向與符號隨機化方向，並把均值、受保護尾部、極性、遷移與語義宣告分開檢驗。對 960 個 Qwen3-14B 干預的精確重放顯示兩種對照的互補侷限：各向同性方向落在近正交區域，而符號隨機化方向卻常保留大量目標對齊（餘弦標準差 .577，25.3% 的抽樣餘弦超過 .5），且族內效果與帶符號餘弦高度相關（Spearman ρ=.94）；作者導出診斷量 A 預測此對齊洩漏，並在 21 個儲存構造單元驗證（r=.979）。凍結的 Qwen 完整閘門仍為陰性：均值未通過符號隨機化比較，保護尾部三族皆未通過。前瞻性正向控制證明閘門可通過，但對 Γ=1.10 敏感性包絡脆弱。獨立資料上連續邊際僅在 Qwen 遷移，準確率皆不遷移；人工評分支持 DeepSeek 的事實修正而非 Qwen，自動裁判校準失敗（macro-F1 .562）。限制包括單一行為、單一層、兩個相關 Qwen 系列，且對齊-效果剖面為事後描述性分析。此工作使導引歸因審計的條件與混合結論可被稽核。

links.title: Bolt-on, Verifiable Provenance for LLM-Powered Data Processing

evidence: Section 1, Table 1: retrieval (RAG-10%) reproduces answers at only 0.32-0.78 accuracy across five workloads and LLM self-reported provenance averages ~0.65/0.74/0.53 for gpt-4o-mini/gpt-4o/gemini-2-flash, motivating verifiable provenance.

Section 3.3.1, Theorems 2-3: refinement strategies are proven to return minimal provenance for any task without monotonicity assumptions; Theorem 6 plus Table 3 (SM ~88-94%, WM ~96.7-98.7%) link minimality to strict minimality empirically.

Section 5.2 Experiment 5, Table 11: only ground-truth evaluation shows BLIP R=1 and eR 0.96-0.98 on Movie/Restaurant TableQA vs RAG-EXACT eR 0.32-0.68; accuracy=1 is by construction of the verification loop.
Section 2.1, Table 2: LLM-as-judge equivalence check validated on 2000 GLUE pairs at ~90.4-96.8% accuracy, qualifying the 'guaranteed' reproduction claim (spurious-provenance caveat in Section 2.5).

Section 5.2, Tables 6/8/10: two-phase strategies yield size ratios ~3.3-12% at cost ratios ~0.9-1.4 and latencies ~3-10s on gpt-4o-mini, replicated on gemini-2-flash in Table 10; skew experiments (Figure 8) validate adaptive strategy choice.

PVLDB Artifact Availability plus Sections 3.1-3.2 and 5.1: code/data at github.com/yiminl18/BLIP.git; prompts (LLM-Provenance-Prompt, LLM-Ranker-Prompt, Top-k-Eval-Prompt) and setup (m=20 blocks, all-mpnet-base-v2, Mistral 7B ranker, 500 QA pairs per workload) are specified.
Section 5.3, Table 12: user study with 8 participants, 12 scenarios; BLIP H_q 4.1-5.0 vs RAG 2.8-3.3, supporting usefulness claims though the study is small.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: defines verifiable, minimal provenance for black-box LLM data processing, with RAG and LLM-generated provenance as baselines, LLM-as-a-judge for equivalence, embedding/LLM rankers, and KV-cache cost optimization. Preference relevance is strong (LLM core, RAG/grounding/attribution, interpretability-adjacent, inference efficiency) though not centered on reasoning, agents, or alignment. Novelty is moderate-good: the verifiability-plus-minimality formalization and monotonicity connection to classical provenance are new, but the mechanics (relevance-ranked pruning plus greedy ablation refinement) are intuitive and adjacent to ContextCite-style ablation attribution. Rigor is solid — formal definitions, proofs (Thms 2-6), empirical validation of judge accuracy (Table 2), determinism (Table 4), and monotonicity prevalence (Table 3) — but the headline 'guaranteed 100% accuracy' metric is near-circular since the algorithm verifies reproduction by construction, and the guarantee is conditioned on a judge measured at only ~90-97% accuracy; true-provenance ground truth exists only for the two synthetic TableQA workloads. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (size ratios 3.3-12%, cost ratios ~0.9-1.4, cross-model replication in Table 10, small 8-participant user study), generalizability is decent (bolt-on to any LLM, 7 workloads) with acknowledged limits for negation/aggregation tasks, ambiguous questions, and provenance-size-dependent cost. Reproducibility is good: code/artifact link, explicit prompts, and concrete setup (m=20, all-mpnet-base-v2, Mistral 7B ranker).

  existing heuristics (such as embedding similarity or directly asking an LLM) could provide some hints for where the answer was derived, they provide no guarantees
  that the answer can b
papers.summary_zh: LLM 廣泛用於資料萃取、清理與問答等資料處理任務，但其回覆如同黑箱，難以判斷答案從何而來、是否可信。現有啟發式（如嵌入相似度檢索或直接要求 LLM 指出相關句子）無法保證所提供的溯源足以重現答案：實驗顯示 RAG 檢索 10% 內文時重現率低於 0.8，gpt-4o 自我標註的溯源僅約 74% 可重現答案。本文提出可驗證溯源（verifiable provenance）概念：輸入文字的子序列，在同一 LLM 上能重現相同或語義等價的答案，並進一步要求最小性（移除任一句子即無法重現）。BLIP 是外掛式框架，採兩階段法：第一階段以四種策略（嵌入或 LLM 排序、自底向上或自頂向下掃描）積極縮小候選；第二階段以 sequential-greedy 或 exponential-greedy 精煉成最小溯源，每種組合皆有理論保證，並以 KV-cache 降低成本；另提供自適應策略與 top-k 相異最小溯源演算法。在七個資料集上，BLIP 重現率為 100%，比最佳基準高出逾 30%，成本與原始查詢相當；TableQA 工作負載中對真實溯源的完全恢復率超過 96%，使用者研究亦顯示其溯源被評為更實用。限制包括大型溯源的精煉成本、排序器品質的影響，以及需要 SQL 處理的邏輯運算任務不在範圍內。此工作將資料庫溯源概念帶入 LLM 資料處理，為人類驗證答案提供可靠且精簡的證據。

links.title: D^3-MOPD: Adaptive Dynamic Domain ScheDuling for Efficient Multi-Teacher Distillation

evidence: Abstract/Sec 4.3: D3-MOPD closes 97% of student-to-teacher gap vs 63% for vanilla MOPD and reaches baseline peak in 47 vs 143 rollout steps (~3x faster) on a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B student with four domain teachers
Table 1 (Sec 4.4): ablations over vanilla baseline range from +0.05 (w/o velocity, 61.41) to +0.98 (full method, 62.34), with no variance or significance reported
Appendix C, Table 6: at single best-average checkpoints normalized scores drop from 0.97 to 0.73 (D3-MOPD) and 0.63 to 0.48 (vanilla), partially deflating the headline peak-aggregated claim
Appendix D, Table 7: replication on Qwen3.5-4B student shows normalized score 1.01 vs 0.86 and best-checkpoint 40 steps earlier (119 vs 159), supporting cross-scale generalization

Appendix B, Tables 3-5: full scheduler hyperparameters (T=0.5, eps=0.10, eta=0.30, R=3, W=10) and infrastructure (slime, Megatron, SGLang, 7 GPU nodes) are specified; no code, data, or teacher-checkpoint release is mentioned
Appendix E, Proposition 1: greedy-allocation justification derived under an exponential-decay model, explicitly acknowledged as a simplifying assumption rather than a requirement

Sec 4.2: evaluation on seven benchmarks (AIME 2025 avg@64, HMMT avg@32, LiveCodeBench avg@6, OJBench, IFBench, IFEval, BFCL v3) with transparent per-benchmark normalization but no seeds, confidence intervals, or repeated runs
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM training-methodology paper: dynamic domain-mixture scheduling for multi-teacher on-policy distillation of an LLM student, matching LLM (2.5), Training & Optimization, and Scaling & Efficiency preferences, with secondary relevance via math/code/tool-use benchmarks. The contribution is a sensible but incremental heuristic (remaining-gap x descent-velocity composite signal, softmax-floor mapping, batch jitter); adaptive data-mixture/curriculum ideas are well explored and no comparison to alternative adaptive schedulers (e.g., bandit-style or DoReMi-like reweighting) is provided. Rigor is moderate: motivation experiments (Sec 2), four ablations (Table 1), a second model scale (Appendix D), and a theory appendix (Appendix E, acknowledged exponential-decay simplification) are present, but results are single-run with no seeds/error bars, and headline '97% vs 63% gap closure' relies on per-benchmark peak aggregation; the honest single-checkpoint comparison (Appendix C, Table 6) narrows this to 0.73 vs 0.48, still favorable but less dramatic. Evidence includes concrete tables and a throughput-overhead check (2.1%), yet gains on some benchmarks are small (+0.2 AIME25) and no code or data release is claimed anywhere. Generalizability is supported by two scales (35B-A3B and 4B) and a framework-agnostic data-path design, but only one model family, one training framework, and self-produced GRPO teachers. Reproducibility benefits from unusually detailed hyperparameter tables (Appendix B) but lacks released artifacts.

primary_link.title: D^3-MOPD: Adaptive Dynamic Domain ScheDuling for Efficient Multi-Teacher Distillation

papers.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) distills several domain-expert teachers into a single student by minimizing per-domain reverse-KL divergence on the student's own rollouts. Existing approaches typically fix the per-domain data mixture before training, overlooking the fact that different domains converge at substantially different rates: some plateau early while others continue to improve throughout the training budget. A fixed mixture therefore wastes compute on fast-converging domains and undertrains slower-converging ones. To address this, we propose D^3-MOPD (Dynamic Domain ScheDuling for MOPD), a zero-overhead scheduler that repurposes the per-domain reverse-KL signal already produced during training to adapt the domain mixture online. Running asynchronously outside the training process, an off-process watcher periodically tracks each domain's KL trajectory, estimates remaining headroom and current improvement rate, and accordingly adjusts the domain sampling ratios without altering the core training loop. Our D^3-MOPD scales naturally to arbitrary numbers of domains, and the expected benefit grows as more domains introduce more diverse convergence patterns for the scheduler to exploit. On a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B student distilled from four domain-expert teachers, D^3-MOPD closes 97% of the average student-to-teacher performance gap, compared with 63% for vanilla MOPD, reaches the same peak performance with an approximately 3times reduction in rollout steps, and surpasses the specialist teachers on three of seven benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: 多教師 on-policy 蒸餾（MOPD）將多個領域專家教師蒸餾到單一學生模型，透過在學生自身 rollout 上最小化各領域的 reverse-KL。現有做法通常在訓練前固定各領域資料混合，忽略不同領域收斂速率差異巨大：部分領域早早停滯，部分則持續進步，固定混合因此浪費算力並造成訓練不足。本文提出 D³-MOPD，一個零額外開銷的排程器：非同步的 off-process watcher 定期追蹤各領域 KL 軌跡，將「剩餘差距」與「下降速度」合成複合訊號，經溫度控制的 softmax 加每領域下限映射為新的取樣比例，再由分層資料來源套用，完全不修改核心訓練迴路。以 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 為學生、四位領域專家教師（數學、程式、指令遵循、工具使用）實驗：D³-MOPD 將學生與教師的平均效能差距縮小 97%（vanilla MOPD 僅 63%），以約 3 分之 1 的 rollout 步數（47 步 vs 143 步）達到基線峰值，並在七個基準中的三個超越專家教師。消融證實複合訊號、批次抖動與速度平滑各有貢獻；軌跡分析顯示排程器浮現隱式課程，把預算集中於仍在進步的領域。在 Qwen3.5-4B 學生上的複製實驗確認方法可跨規模泛化。限制在於指數衰減模型僅為簡化假設，理論分析屬設計依據而非必要條件。此方法將訓練迴路既有的 reverse-KL 訊號轉化為動態課程，同時提升峰值品質與訓練效率。
papers.title: D^3-MOPD: Adaptive Dynamic Domain ScheDuling for Efficient Multi-Teacher Distillation
papers.title_zh: D³-MOPD:高效能多教師蒸餾之自適應動態領域排程

links.title: PeakBench: Benchmarking Resource-Aware Tool Invocation in LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: introduces PeakBench, 'a benchmark of executable multi-tool workflows with execution-grounded dependency annotations and measured resource profiles', with a two-part evaluation disentangling logical planning from physical scheduling; code link provided.

Decoupled Evaluation Protocol: Dimension I uses GED and Edge F1 against execution-grounded structure; Dimension II fixes verified structure and uses Scheduling Latency, CVA, and strict MRU (Eqs. 4-8).
Human Quality Audit: manual audit of ~100 sampled workflows, 'About 94% of the audited samples match the optimal structure', with ~4-5 min per workflow.
Table 2: GPT-5 best on Dimension I (GED 0.42, Edge F1 0.839); Baseline earliest-ready row shows SL 8.62s but CVA 5.865, supporting the resource-blind scheduling regime claim.
Table 4: RASC vs no-profile deltas show most models reduce CVA (e.g., GLM-5 -1.457) but DeepSeek-V4-Flash increases CVA (+0.034), evidencing model-dependence.

Appendix F.5 input ablation: duration-only context yields zero feasible-rate gain; CPU+memory profiles yield +12.7 feasible delta and 48.5% violation reduction, isolating capacity awareness as the mechanism.
Appendix C: 'We do not claim that the workflow set reproduces the full distribution of real user requests', limiting generalizability of the 300-workflow benchmark.
Appendix B: resource profiles measured from only three LLM-generated inputs per tool in an instrumented sandbox, with cold/warm-start distinction; a narrow sampling basis for the telemetry claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic for Agents & Tool Use and LLM evaluation: a benchmark for resource-aware tool invocation in LLM agents, evaluated on eight frontier API models. The decoupled protocol (logical dependency planning vs. physical scheduling under measured resource profiles) is a genuinely fresh evaluation angle relative to accuracy-centric tool benchmarks like ToolBench/API-Bank and the closest prior TPS-Bench, and the 'peak load' failure mode is well formalized (Eq. 1-9). Rigor is solid but not exhaustive: 300 workflows, a ~100-sample human audit (94% match), classical scheduling baselines, noise-robustness and input ablations, but no variance/significance reporting, single-run API evaluations, and resource profiles estimated from only three inputs per tool. Quantitative tables concretely support the headline claims (planning-scheduling decoupling with weak case-level correlations, Table 7; RASC gains that are model-dependent, with DeepSeek-V4-Flash increasing CVA, Table 4). Generalizability is capped by the synthetic, benchmark-seeded workflow distribution, which the authors explicitly do not claim reflects real user traffic. Code release and detailed protocol appendices (B, D, E) support reproducibility.

This missing scheduling dimension creates a practical failure mode: serial execution is safe but slow, while resource-agnostic parallel
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理日益透過多工具呼叫解決任務，平行執行對低延遲至關重要，但資源無知的盲目平行可能觸發資源溢出。現有代理基準多聚焦工具選擇、參數生成與序列執行下的端到端成功率，忽略有效平行化與資源受限排程。本文提出 PeakBench：300 個可執行的多工具工作流，具備以沙箱執行擾動標註的依賴與並發結構，以及實測的工具資源輪廓（CPU、記憶體、GPU、網路、磁碟 I/O），並以約 1.2K 個 MCP 工具建構。評測解耦為兩個維度：維度 I 要求代理作為依賴分析器恢復工作流的前置條件結構（以 GED 與 Edge F1 計分）；維度 II 提供已驗證結構，要求代理在有限機器容量下指派執行時間戳，以排程延遲、容量違規面積（CVA）與 strict MRU 計分，從而可歸因失敗來源。評測八個前沿模型顯示：強邏輯規劃不代表安全排程，案例層級相關性極弱；無資源資訊的模型常以保守延遲降低違規但拉高延遲。提出的 RASC 基線在排程前揭露資源後設資料，多數模型能藉此降低 CVA 並提升 strict MRU，接近最佳規則式排程器的違規水準，但效益因模型而異；消融顯示增益主要來自 CPU 與記憶體資訊，而非一般延遲感知。此基準為診斷資源感知代理行為提供了可測量、可歸因的測試場。

links.title: EMRB: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning over Raw Electromagnetic Signals

evidence: Abstract: 'Scores range from 24.1% to 78.9%, with the mean dropping from 84.9% on basic measurement to 21.2% on system design'; 'ReconPilot raises the overall score by 3.8 to 17.6 points and improves 13 of 15 backbone-level combinations tested.'

Section 6.3 / Table 1: oracle replay scores 100.0 at all five levels; union of 14 models reaches 98.8-99.8% at L1-L4 but only 53.2% at L5; ~1000-line classical DSP reference solver scores 75.7 on L5 versus best model 39.8.
Section 6.5 / Table 2: ReconPilot overall gains of +14.0 (DeepSeek V4 Flash), +17.6 (Gemini 3.5 Flash), +3.8 (GPT-5.5), with declines only where free-form already exceeded 91%.

Section 8 (Limitations): 'EMRB is a controlled synthetic benchmark covering 11 signal types, so its results do not establish model performance on real field measurements'; 'We have no human expert baseline.'

Appendix A (Distribution/Utility): dataset, generation scripts, verifiers, and harness released on GitHub under CC BY 4.0 (data) and MIT (code); seed-based pipeline 'can produce fresh, valid problems from unused seeds without manual authoring'.
Appendix F.2: rationale-content criteria total 11 of 100 L2 points (2.2% of benchmark), with bounded assertion-only exposure of at most 2.2 points stated explicitly.

Appendix J: audit of L5 extraction-filter sub-question shows 527 of 560 attempts score zero, decomposed into perceptual limit, constraint omission, and absent self-evaluation, with per-deficit counts (e.g., 390 merged-source reports).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic LLM/agent evaluation work: a code-execution benchmark testing 14 LLMs on raw I/Q signal analysis, plus ReconPilot, a three-stage agent pipeline (fixed reconnaissance, guided analysis, self-verification). Not a pure domain application since it evaluates general-purpose LLMs with an agentic methodology rather than training domain encoders. Novelty is solid: schemaless raw physical-layer data as LLM benchmark input is genuinely new versus RadioML/DA-Bench-style predecessors, though ReconPilot scaffolding is a straightforward reconnaissance+verification design. Rigor is high: deterministic no-LLM-judge scoring, oracle replay (100.0 at all levels), union-of-models headroom analysis, a reference DSP solver for L5 (75.7 vs best model 39.8), stage ablation showing sub-additivity, and honest quantification of prompt-answerable L1 points. Evidence is detailed (per-model/per-level/per-type tables, 527/560-attempt failure audits, paired case studies), though single-run temperature-0 evaluations lack variance estimates. Generalizability is limited and candidly acknowledged: synthetic AWGN-only signals, 11 types, no hardware impairments, no human expert baseline. Reproducibility is excellent: seed-deterministic generation, released data/code/verifiers, versioned scorers, full prompts and rubrics in appendices, contamination-resistant seed expansion.

EMRB contains 200 problems across five difficulty levels and 27 question types, from signal detection to OFDM design, generated f
papers.summary_zh: LLM 日益作為程式碼代理從事科學與工程分析，但其分析原始物理層測量資料的能力尚未被系統評估。本文提出 EMRB，評估 LLM 能否撰寫並執行程式碼來分析原始 I/Q 電磁訊號。基準含 200 道題目、五個難度層級（基礎測量、訊號處理方法、通訊理論、多訊號分析、系統設計）、27 種題型，由 11 種訊號類型（數位調變、類比調變、OFDM、LFM 啁啾）以固定種子程式化生成，附已驗證的 ground truth。模型須在最多 15 回合的互動中以 Python 沙箱分析原始檔案，評分採確定性驗證器、無 LLM 裁判。評測 14 個 LLM 顯示分數介於 24.1% 到 78.9%，且由基礎測量的 84.9% 驟降至系統設計的 21.2%；瓶頸不在領域知識，而在多訊號場景下把每個測量值綁定到正確實體的能力，L5 的 560 次嘗試中有 527 次在萃取濾波器題得零分，可分解為感知極限、約束遺漏與缺乏自我評估三類。作者另提出 ReconPilot，以固定偵察、目標分析與自我驗證三階段分離場景發現與解題，在三個骨幹上提升總分 3.8 至 17.6 分。題庫可達性以 oracle 重放、模型聯集與參考解法器（L5 得 75.7 分）驗證。限制為僅涵蓋合成訊號與 AWGN 通道、無人類專家基線。此基準為原始訊號分析能力提供可重現、可擴充的驗收測試。

links.title: EviGraph: Towards Verifiable Evidence Construction for Information-Seeking Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'a Qwen3-8B EviGraph agent achieves 35.9% accuracy under a matched interaction budget, compared with 26.9% for the same dual-role architecture without reinforcement learning and 2.7% for a monolithic agent, while generating fewer tokens per rollout'.

Section 5.5 / Table 6: same-backbone ablation on BrowseComp-Plus under 'a 50-turn budget' — single-agent 2.7% (3.7 searches, 3245 tokens), dual-role no-RL 26.9% (12.9 searches, 1878 tokens), dual-role+RL 35.9% (13.2 searches, 1689 tokens); the paper concedes the first margin 'reflects role decomposition together with the resulting stopping behavior rather than role decomposition in isolation'.

Section 3.4: deterministic validator checks include '(i) the cited span occurs in the referenced observation' and canonical evidence signatures 'converting exact duplicates into zero-reward no-ops'; the reachability-invariant paragraph admits 'This does not prove that a source is true or that a span semantically entails a claim'.

Section 4.2: coverage shaping is potential-based 'gamma*Phi(G') - Phi(G)' citing Ng et al. [26]; a per-candidate-tag-polarity acceptance-bonus cap mitigates reward farming, with the caveat 'we do not claim they eliminate every possible exploit'.

Section 5.4 / Table 4: LiveVQA 78.0% with pretrained Qwen3-VL-8B 'without any additional fine-tuning'; the paper treats the 0.4-point margin over Vision-DeepResearch-30B-A3B (77.6%) as 'competitive with rather than superior to'.

Section 5.2: training details given (AdamW lr 1e-6, 1,200 steps, 8x H20 GPUs, N_r=8 rollouts, two-phase GRPO with no SFT cold-start); BrowseComp-Plus is a three-seed mean 'with standard deviation below 0.5 points' while 'the remaining benchmarks are evaluated once per configuration'; no code or model release statement appears anywhere in the document.

Section 5.3 / Table 3: EviGraph (Qwen3-32B) at 36.6% remains 'below the strongest closed and specialized systems' (Tongyi DeepResearch 44.5%), and the paper states the comparison is 'a parameter-efficient open-model result rather than a state-of-the-art claim'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core language-agent methodology paper: agentic web search (Agents & Tool Use, 2.5), grounding/evidence and RAG (1.8), process-reward GRPO training (Alignment/RL), multi-step reasoning, with an LLM backbone (Qwen3). Novelty is solid but incremental: evidence graphs exist for verification (GEAR, MedCEG, AutoGraph-R1) and process-rewarded search agents exist (Search-R1, StepSearch); the contribution is the online span-anchored graph used jointly as working memory and dense reward source, with anti-reward-farming safeguards. Rigor is above average: matched 50-turn same-backbone ablation (2.7 -> 26.9 -> 35.9 on 830 questions, 3 seeds, std <0.5), token/search controls, hyperparameter tables, and unusually honest confound acknowledgment (the architecture gain is confounded with emergent search persistence; the 0.4-point LiveVQA margin is not claimed as superiority). Deductions: no direct measurement of evidence-graph quality (span fidelity/polarity precision) despite 'verifiability' being the headline claim; LLM-judge scoring throughout; most benchmarks evaluated once; possible compute asymmetry from the frozen verifier in the dual-role system is not fully analyzed. Evidence strength is good (multi-benchmark tables, training dynamics, error analysis) but rests on judge-based accuracy rather than grounded-quality metrics. Generalizability is demonstrated across 5 benchmarks, 8B/32B scales, and zero-shot multimodal transfer. Reproducibility is middling: detailed configs but no code/data/model release statement, reliance on Serper API, GPT-4.1 judge, and an unspecified 'DeepSeek-V4-Flash' scorer.

primary_link.title: EviGraph: Towards Verifiable Evidence Construction for Information-Seeking Agents

papers.summary: Agentic Web search can retrieve relevant information without establishing that the retrieved content actually supports the claims used in an answer. Existing agents typically keep search and evidence recording in a linear interaction trace and optimize primarily for final-answer correctness, providing limited supervision for intermediate grounding. We present EviGraph, a deep-search framework that separates search execution from evidence recording while using a shared policy for the trainable ro
papers.summary_zh: 代理式網頁搜尋能檢索相關資訊，卻未必能證明檢索內容確實支持答案所用的主張；現有代理把搜尋與證據記錄混在線性軌跡中，且主要最佳化最終答案正確性。本文提出 EviGraph，將代理搜尋重構為證據建構：以異質 DAG 圖將原子主張與答案候選透過逐字片段與極性標籤（support/conflict）的證據邊錨定到來源文件。架構分離搜尋執行與證據記錄，兩個可訓練角色共享同一策略模型：executor 規劃精簡查詢，證據提案角色決定 add/support 圖請求；凍結的證據驗證器檢查頁面並回傳極性標註的證據項目，確定性結構驗證器僅檢查語法與圖不變量，保證每條被記錄的信念皆可對實際觀察審計。圖同時作為持久工作記憶與密集過程獎勵來源，使 RL 能直接監督證據建構而非僅最終答案；設計包括勢函數差分獎勵、正則化證據簽章與每三元組接受獎勵上限以防獎勵鑽營。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，Qwen3-8B 的 EviGraph 代理達 35.9% 準確率，高於同架構無 RL 的 26.9% 與單體代理的 2.7%，且每次 rollout 生成更少 token；在 BrowseComp、GAIA、XBench 與多模態 LiveVQA（78.0%）亦有增益。限制包括擴展至大型約束集需要候選剪枝與階層式圖摘要，且整體表現受凍結驗證器品質影響。此工作顯示顯式結構化證據記錄能實質改善代理式搜尋。
papers.title: EviGraph: Towards Verifiable Evidence Construction for Information-Seeking Agents
papers.title_zh: EviGraph:邁向資訊搜尋代理的可驗證證據建構

links.title: ResiSpec: Enhancing Multi-Candidate Speculative Sampling via Residual Distribution Shaping

evidence: Abstract: proposes ResiSpec to mitigate Residual Drift in multi-candidate speculative decoding, claims up to 1.92x speedup over state-of-the-art multi-candidate methods with output exactness, and states code is available at github.com/Czzzk/Resispec.

Figure 1 (Limitation section): shows sequential candidate acceptance rates on CNN/DM with Llama-2-7B and Vicuna-7B targets and Llama-68M draft drop sharply after the first candidate at T in {0.6, 1.0}, motivating the Residual Drift claim.

Appendix Table 5: with depth fixed at 4, increasing candidates N from 1 to 8 raises EAL only from 1.89 to 2.76 while efficiency score eta drops from 0.280 to 0.070, quantifying scaling inefficiency of standard multi-candidate verification.

Method section, Algorithm 1 and Definitions 1-2: proxy distribution k(x)=p(x)-r(x)+s(x) with disjoint support constraint and Local Alignment k(x_i)=q(x_i); Proposition 1 (mass identity) and Proposition 2 (capacity bound Z <= min p/q) are stated with proofs in the main text.

Table 1 (Main Results): ResiSpec vs SpecInfer on Llama-2-7B with JF68M, 3-branch depth-5 tree, averaged over 200 runs, accepted length gains up to 1.86x and throughput gains up to 1.68x across CNN/DM, OpenWebText, C4 at T=1.0 and T=0.6.
Table 2 (Compatibility): ResiSpec as add-on improves Sequoia accepted length 3.07 to 4.32 (1.31x speedup) and EAGLE 3.12 to 3.85 (1.15x speedup) at T=1.0 under matched decoding settings.
Table 3 (Ablation): under comparable verification budgets, speedup over SpecInfer ranges from 1.92x (d7b2) to 1.17x (d3b11), with larger gains on deeper narrower trees.

Table 4 (Empirical Validation): KL divergence between ResiSpec sampling distribution and target model is on the order of 1e-10 to 1e-9 across datasets and temperatures, comparable to SpecInfer, attributed to floating-point noise.
Appendix A.1, Theorem 1: full proof that the marginal output distribution equals the target p(x) given Local Alignment, via acceptance-path and rejection-path decomposition.

Appendix C (Reproducibility Details): specifies Docker environment, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES binding, fixed per-prompt seed schedule, deterministic cuDNN, dataset order, tree configs (d5b3, M=384 for Sequoia, total_token=60/depth=5 for EAGLE), and separation of profiling from throughput runs.

Appendix D, Table 6: ablation over four target-draft pairs (Llama-2-7B/JF68M, Sheared-LLaMA-2.7B with Sheared-LLaMA-1.3B, TinyLlama-1.1B, Tiny-Vicuna-1B) across two tree shapes, three datasets, and two temperatures, consistently favoring ResiSpec over SpecInfer.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methods paper on LLM inference acceleration via speculative decoding, squarely within the LLM/efficiency/serving preference cluster (not a pure domain application, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply). The core contribution—formalizing 'Residual Drift' in multi-candidate verification and reshaping the rejection residual via a proxy distribution k(x) with a slack-mass budget—is a genuinely new angle on the verification side of tree speculation, though it builds on established speculative sampling machinery (SpecInfer, Sequoia, EAGLE). Rigor is solid: exactness is proven (Appendix A.1 Theorem 1), monotonicity of the shaping loss is proven (Appendix A.2 Theorem 2), and exactness is empirically corroborated via KL divergence on the order of 1e-10 (Table 4). Evidence is quantified and multi-configuration (Table 1: up to 1.86x accepted length and 1.68x throughput vs SpecInfer; Table 3: 1.92x on d7b2 under iso-compute; Table 6: many target-draft pairs), but the primary head-to-head baseline is only SpecInfer, with Sequoia/EAGLE shown only as add-ons (Table 2, EAGLE gain a modest 1.15x), and experiments use a single RTX 3090 with generic text corpora (no downstream tasks). Generalizability is supported across model pairs, temperatures, and tree shapes but untested on larger models or batched serving. Reproducibility is strong: public code link plus an unusually detailed Appendix C (Docker pinning, seed schedule, decoding configs, protocol separation of profiling vs throughput).

primary_link.title: ResiSpec: Enhancing Multi-Candidate Speculative Sampling via Residual Distribution Shaping

papers.summary: The efficiency of Large Language Model (LLM) serving is fundamentally limited by the sequential nature of autoregressive decoding. Speculative Decoding (SD) mitigates this by using a lightweight draft model to speculate future tokens, which are then validated by the LLM in a single parallel forward pass. To further boost efficiency, multi-candidate schemes propose diverse candidate sets to increase the likelihood of token acceptance. However, we show that these schemes are bottlenecked by Residu
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）的自迴歸解碼本質上逐詞元產生，效率受限於記憶體存取瓶頸。投機解碼（Speculative Decoding）以輕量草稿模型預測候選詞元，再由目標模型單次平行驗證，已成為無損加速的主流方法，而樹狀或多候選驗證更進一步擴大搜尋空間。本文指出此類方法的關鍵瓶頸為「殘差漂移」（Residual Drift）：當第一個候選被拒絕後，驗證準則轉向殘差分布，其質量集中於草稿模型的「盲區」，導致後續預先取樣的候選幾乎必然失效，迫使系統昂貴地重新取樣，邊際效益迅速遞減。作者提出 ResiSpec，在驗證階段引入輔助代理分布 k(x)，將拒絕後的殘差質量重新對齊至草稿模型的高密度區域，使既有候選在整段驗證鏈中持續可用。理論上，本文證明該塑形程序維持零偏差取樣，輸出分布與目標模型完全一致，實測 KL 散度僅約 10⁻¹⁰。實驗以 Llama-2-7B 為目標模型、Llama-68M 為草稿，在 CNN/DM、OpenWebText 與 C4 上，ResiSpec 相對 SpecInfer 將接受長度提升至多 1.86 倍、吞吐量提升至多 1.68 倍；作為外掛亦可增強 Sequoia（1.31 倍）與 EAGLE（1.15 倍），在較深且較窄的樹狀配置下最高達 1.92 倍加速。限制在於代理分布建構帶來少量分布層級的運算開銷，且成效依賴驗證階段的候選序列結構。整體而言，本文將多候選投機解碼的擴展瓶頸轉化為分布塑形問題，對高效 LLM 推論系統具直接價值。
papers.title: ResiSpec: Enhancing Multi-Candidate Speculative Sampling via Residual Distribution Shaping
papers.title_zh: ResiSpec：透過殘差分布塑形強化多候選投機取樣

links.title: Tunable Tool-Call Rates in LLM Agents via Representation Steering

evidence: Abstract: adding the direction 'moves the call rate monotonically from near 0% to over 90%' and with live tool execution 'nearly doubles open-domain QA accuracy (0.29→0.56)'.
§3.2: 'Accuracy rises from 0.29 with no searches to 0.56 at about 1.1 searches per question'; combined with a search-heavy prompt reaches 0.58.
§3.3/Fig. 3: baseline call rates span 0.07 (Qwen3-4B) to 0.83 (30B MoE); α=−2 suppresses every model to 0.00 and α=+2 raises four of five to 1.00.
§4 Table 1: multi-tool direction beats each held-out tool's own vector on 5 of 6 tools and is within 12% for SQL at α=−2.
§4 Table 3: clamping is weaker than additive steering for the under-user (Qwen3-4B rises only to 0.16 vs 0.82 with additive steering) — an honestly reported limitation.

§3.1: evaluation uses 200 questions per dataset (600 total) and PopQA is drawn from 'the ten percent of questions with the lowest entity popularity', biasing the headline accuracy gain toward search-dependent questions.
§3.1: held-out tool queries are 'generated from LLM-generated templates' and 'do not need to be natural or verifiable'.
Appendix D: generation at temperature 0.7, top-p 0.8, ≤384 new tokens; α grids and contrastive-pool construction (top/bottom 10% by propensity) are specified.
Abstract/availability: 'Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/YuqiChen4188/Steering-Tool-Use-Propensity'.
§6 limitations: the method controls whether a tool is called but not execution quality; reasoning spans must be bypassed; strong positive steering corrupts call format.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agents + interpretability work squarely matching top-weighted preferences (LLM agents & tool use, LLMs, interpretability): a training-free difference-of-means steering direction in the residual stream that monotonically tunes whether an agent emits tool calls, bidirectionally, across five models (dense, MoE, multimodal). Rigor is solid: multi-tool extraction harness, held-out tool transfer vs per-tool vectors, layer×α map, clamping/ablation controls, 3 seeds for the live-search frontier, and candid limitations (malformed calls at high α, reasoning bypass, clamping recovering only 0.16 vs additive 0.82 on Qwen3-4B). Novelty is moderate: the DIM/steering machinery is standard and Wu et al. (2026, cited in §1) already showed tool calling is linearly readable and steerable; the increment is the whether-to-call propensity dial plus knowledge-selectivity and Pareto results. Evidence is strong but with caveats: the headline 0.29→0.58 PopQA gain is measured on the lowest-10% popularity subset (§3.1), which inflates gains; held-out-tool queries are LLM-generated templates admittedly 'not natural' (§3.1); no statistical tests; 200 questions per dataset. Generalizability across model families is well demonstrated; small/medium models only. Code, prompts, tool schemas, and hyperparameters are released, giving high reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Tunable Tool-Call Rates in LLM Agents via Representation Steering

papers.summary: Deciding whether to call a tool is a core competence of an LLM agent, and a costly one to get wrong: needless calls add latency, accrue cost, and may trigger irreversible side effects, while missing calls leave the model confidently wrong on questions it could only answer through tool-calls. Models manage this balance poorly, both over-using and under-using tools. Existing methods such as post-training and prompt engineering are expensive and difficult to modify at inference time. We show that w
papers.summary_zh: LLM agent 決定是否呼叫工具，直接影響成本與可靠性：過度呼叫增加延遲與風險，漏呼則讓模型在只能靠工具解答的問題上自信地答錯。現有做法如 fine-tuning 或提示工程成本高昂，且難以在推論時調整。本文證明，指令微調後的模型是否呼叫工具，可由殘差流中的單一線性方向控制：作者以差值平均法從模型自身的工具使用傾向訊號萃取該方向，無需任何訓練，並在推論時以強度 α 加回特定層，即可讓呼叫率由近 0% 單調上升至 90% 以上，且呼叫格式保持良構。該方向具三項特性：具知識選擇性，新增的呼叫集中於模型無法自行作答的長尾問題；具工具通用性，自多工具環境萃取的方向，對翻譯、天氣、SQL 等六個未見工具的抑制強度與各工具自身向量相當；且只改變「是否呼叫」，不干擾「選擇哪個工具」。結合實際工具執行，掃描 α 可描繪成本─準確率的 Pareto 前沿，使 PopQA 開放域問答準確率近乎翻倍（0.29 提升至 0.56），約每題 1.1 次搜尋。相同流程在涵蓋稠密、MoE 與多模態架構的五個模型上皆可重現。限制包括強正向引導可能破壞呼叫格式、方法無法提升工具執行品質，且推論型模型須先繞過推理段落才能讀取決策訊號。此方法為控制 agent 成本與可靠性提供輕量的推論時手段，兼具實用性與可遷移性。
papers.title: Tunable Tool-Call Rates in LLM Agents via Representation Steering
papers.title_zh: 以表徵引導實現 LLM Agent 可調控的工具呼叫率

links.title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing

evidence: Abstract: claims highest average accuracy among open-weight guard models, performance comparable to GPT-5.4, 77.3% mean ASR reduction on AgentDojo/AgentDyn with 2.8-point utility drop.
Section 6.2.1 / Table 1: StepGuard (4B) reaches 83.0/83.3 trajectory-level and 84.8/84.1 step-level Acc/F1, e.g., TS-Bench-Dojo 95.7/93.0 vs TS-Guard 91.7/83.5.
Section 6.2.2: AgentHarm malicious score reduced 22.8 -> 3.4 but task completion drops 70.9 -> 52.8; paper admits no method achieves a clearly favorable trade-off there.

Section 6.3 / Table 4: Balance-GRPO reduces safe-unsafe accuracy gap from 13.0 (GRPO) to 8.0 and raises AgentDojo utility 85.3 -> 90.7 and AgentDyn 60.0 -> 66.7 with only +0.3 ASR; Table 3 shows 74.9/78.1 on six held-out ATBench risk sources vs backbone 49.6/35.6.
Appendix A.3 / Table 8: on 100 human-verified Nemotron-AIQ traces, Balance-GRPO improves Acc/F1 from 75.0/76.6 to 82.0/83.0, raising both Safe (68->76) and Unsafe (82->88) accuracy.

Appendix C.2 / Table 12: instruction-only nearest-neighbor p99 <= 0.885 against all benchmarks; Appendix B.2 / Table 11 shows tool-overlap-filtered retraining (2,814 examples) gives macro 80.9/81.1 vs 79.2/80.9, arguing against schema-overlap contamination.

Section 9 Limitations: acknowledges synthetic-data/annotation bias from teacher model, benchmark-limited evaluation (no open-ended ecosystems, multi-agent, or adaptive adversaries), and that the guard is not a formal safety guarantee.

Appendix F: full hyperparameters for SFT (AdamW, lr 2e-5, 2 epochs, seq 16,384) and RL (GRPO, lr 5e-7, lambda=2.0, deadband 0.02), 4x H200, ~8 GPU-hours; GitHub URLs given but no verified release statement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: LLM-agent guardrails, tool-call safety, prompt-injection defense, and RL-based (GRPO) calibration sit at the intersection of the highest-weighted topics (agents/tool use, LLMs, AI safety, alignment). Methodological novelty is moderate: step-level guarding exists (TS-Guard), synthetic agent-safety data exists (AuraGen), and Balance-GRPO is an incremental class-wise advantage reweighting on top of standard GRPO; the prefix-aligned contrastive branching with benign tool-reuse is the most original piece. Rigor and evidence are strong: five static benchmarks, three guarded-agent environments, ablations of both StepGen components and Balance-GRPO against simpler balancing strategies, a human-verified held-out set, repeated-evaluation variance reporting, an embedding-based leakage analysis plus a tool-overlap retraining control, and an honest error analysis of all 575 mistakes. Headline numbers are internally consistent (mean ASR 25.1/21.2 -> 1.2/9.3 = 77.3% reduction; utility drop 2.8). Weaknesses: repeats vary the evaluation, not training seeds; teacher-dependent synthetic supervision (GPT-5.4/GLM-5.1 on an internal endpoint) limits verification; AgentHarm trade-off is unfavorable and adaptive adversaries/multi-agent settings are untested; GitHub links are asserted but actual release of code/data/checkpoints is not verified in the document.

primary_link.title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing

papers.summary: LLM-based agents can interact with external environments through tool invocation, but this capability also introduces security risks such as file modification, information leakage, and unauthorized actions. Existing guardrails often evaluate completed trajectories, leaving pre-execution monitoring of step-level actions underexplored. We propose StepGuard, a step-level guard model that can audit completed agent trajectories and check tool actions before they are executed. To train StepGuard, we i
papers.summary_zh: LLM agent 可透過工具呼叫與外部環境互動，但也帶來檔案修改、資訊洩漏等風險。現有防護欄多在軌跡完成後才評估，執行前的步階層級監控仍待補足，且常見防護偏差：部分模型過度封鎖良性動作，部分則漏放危險動作。本文提出步階層級防護模型 StepGuard，可在候選工具動作執行前審查，亦能稽核已完成軌跡。訓練分兩階段：其一為資料引擎 StepGen，以風險錨點建構前綴對齊的安全與不安全軌跡組，包含拒絕與風險意識兩種安全分支，以及重用相同工具的良性軌跡，避免模型把工具身分當成安全訊號；其二為 Balance-GRPO，依 rollout 批次中安全與不安全類的觀測準確率差距動態重加權優勢，縮小防護偏差而不改提示或原始獎勵。實驗顯示，4B 的 StepGuard 在五項靜態基準上取得開源權重防護模型的最佳平均成績，與 GPT-5.4 相當；部署於 AgentDojo 與 AgentDyn 時，相較無防護設定平均降低攻擊成功率（ASR）77.3%，效用僅下降 2.8 點。消融實驗證明 Balance-GRPO 將安全─不安全準確率差距自 13.0 降至 8.0，並提升受防護 agent 的效用至多 6.7 點。限制包括合成資料可能繼承教師模型的偏誤，且 AgentHarm 等高度對抗情境下的安全─效用權衡仍具挑戰。本文對可實際部署的 agent 安全防護具重要意義。
papers.title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing
papers.title_zh: StepGuard：以可擴充監督與安全—效用平衡學習步階層級防護欄

links.title: Algorithmic Impact Reveals the Hidden Social Choice Structure of Alignment

evidence: Abstract: alignment reformulated as linear optimization over a convex impact space, applied to show voting-by-issues and random-dictatorship are strategyproof and unanimous
Section 4, Theorem 1: the feasible impact set is an origin-symmetric zonotope generated by deployment queries, and the impact map is a C-infinity diffeomorphism on the deployment subspace

Section 5, Theorems 2-3 and Propositions 2-4: voting-by-issues strategyproofness, random dictatorship compiled into a single model parameter, and anonymous RLHF impact equals the per-query label-frequency identity
Appendix C, Corollary 5: finite-temperature RLHF is manipulable since utility strictly increases with report scaling
Section 6, Theorem 4 with Corollaries 2-4: constrained alignment characterized by LP duality multipliers, yielding harm floors, public-spirit, and participation-externality bounds

Section 7 and Appendix E.1: empirical illustrations on kidney allocation, food rescue, Moral Machine, and Community Alignment (N=2387 annotators, K=15 interpretable features); code at github.com/michelleeesi/hiddenstructure; food-rescue data not public
Section 8 Limitations: reliance on linear preference representation and on a central planner broadcasting selection probabilities

Appendix E, Figures 2-10: welfare distributions, dispersion vs choice precision beta, and bootstrap comparisons across four datasets are reported in figures with qualitative text descriptions rather than tabulated numbers
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory paper on RLHF alignment as social choice: it proves alignment with linear utilities reduces to linear optimization over an 'impact' zonotope, characterizes strategyproof voting-by-issues/random-dictatorship mechanisms (showing RLHF is impact-equivalent to a random-labeler protocol), and derives harm-bounded/externality-constrained alignment via LP duality. Highly relevant to Alignment & RLHF and AI Safety preferences (RLHF, DPO, preference aggregation, pluralistic alignment), with one of four empirical domains being LLM response preferences. Proofs are complete and careful (convex analysis, Legendre duality, LP duality, distortion bounds), and limitations of the linear-utility assumption are explicitly acknowledged. Weaknesses: the linearity assumption limits direct applicability to real high-dimensional LLM alignment; experiments are illustrative rather than comparative, with mostly qualitative reporting of figures and no external baselines beyond the mechanisms themselves; one dataset is not publicly available.

primary_link.title: Algorithmic Impact Reveals the Hidden Social Choice Structure of Alignment

papers.summary: When an AI algorithm makes decisions that affect more than one person, aligning it becomes a problem of social choice: how should people's divergent preferences about system behavior be reconciled and aggregated into a single coherent model? The standard approach to aligning frontier AI models$\unicode{x2013}$reinforcement learning from human feedback$\unicode{x2013}$largely sidesteps this question and has poor social choice guarantees. However, it remains unclear what alternative should replace
papers.summary_zh: 當 AI 決策影響多人時，對齊本質上是社會選擇問題，但標準的 RLHF 匿名彙整人類回饋，缺乏良好的社會選擇保證，例如低估少數群體。本文的核心洞見是：在線性效用假設下，模型對個體福利的影響可由單一「影響向量」ψ(θ) 概括，其與偏好 θn 位於同一空間，福利為內積而呈線性。據此，對齊可重構為凸「影響空間」上的線性最佳化，可行影響集為由部署查詢生成的 zonotope。此轉換使福利經濟學與機制設計工具得以直接套用：本文證明逐查詢投票的 voting-by-issues 機制與隨機獨裁機制皆具策略防操縱性與一致性；後者更可編譯成單一模型參數，無需部署時逐一取樣個人化模型。作者亦證明匿名 RLHF 的部署影響等價於「隨機標註者協定」，並在確定性標註極限下收斂至策略防操縱的 voting-by-issues。反向應用上，影響空間使傷害上限、公共精神與參與外部性等約束化為線性限制式，可透過拉格朗日乘數得到封閉形式解。實證以腎臟分配、食物救援、Moral Machine 電車難題與 Community Alignment 的 LLM 回應偏好為例，顯示效用最佳化、RLHF 與策略防操縱機制下皆有個體受損，而傷害受限對齊可移除受損左尾，代價是平均福利略降。限制在於線性效用假設與查詢分布假設在實務上未必成立。本文為異質偏好下的對齊提供統一的幾何框架。
papers.title: Algorithmic Impact Reveals the Hidden Social Choice Structure of Alignment
papers.title_zh: 演算法影響揭示對齊背後的隱藏社會選擇結構

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic LLM safety evaluation work: an evidence-grounded benchmark extending guardrail evaluation to LRM reasoning traces, directly matching AI safety, red-teaming/evaluation, and LLM preferences. Novelty is solid but incremental—reasoning-trace safety risks are previously noted (cited SafeChain, R1 risk work); the main new contributions are verbatim-evidence annotation and full-pipeline coverage. Rigor is good: majority-vote LLM annotation with substring verification and human escalation, 18 guardrail models, F1/FPR/FNR/precision/recall plus TokenF1, language/attack/LRM-family breakdowns; however, annotation relies on three LLM judges and only 1,000 of 5,000 instances were human-verified (Kappa 0.84), and no significance testing is reported. Evidence is strong (detailed tables, worst-case IE attack analysis, case studies) though TokenF1 bag-of-tokens is a coarse attribution metric. Generalizability is limited: two languages (EN/ZH), only four generating LRMs (Qwen3-8B/Gemma-4-E4B and abliterated variants), and prompts drawn from S-Eval/WildChat taxonomies.
