primary_link.title: TRACE: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Large Reasoning Models

papers.summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) generate intermediate reasoning traces that may contain unsafe content, even when their final responses appear safe. Guardrail models are designed to detect and block unsafe content, yet existing benchmarks for unsafe content detection focus primarily on prompts and final responses, leaving reasoning traces largely unexamined. Moreover, these benchmarks typically provide only binary safety labels, without evidence annotations that justify the judgments. To address t
papers.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）會產生中間推理軌跡，即使最終回應看似安全，軌跡仍可能含不安全內容，例如詳述違禁品藏匿手法後才拒答。現有防護模型與不安全內容偵測基準多僅評估提示與最終回應，忽略推理軌跡，且通常只提供二元安全標籤，缺少支撐判斷的證據標註。本文提出 TRACE，涵蓋 LRM 推論管線全程（提示、推理軌跡、最終回應）的證據扎根安全基準：自 S-Eval 與 WildChat 抽樣 1,993 個中英文提示，涵蓋九大風險類別與十種攻擊策略；由 Qwen3-8B、Gemma-4-E4B 及其 abliterated 變體四個 LRM 產生軌跡與回應，再由三個 LRM 獨立標註安全標籤並逐字萃取證據，經多數決與連續子字串驗證，無可驗證證據者交由人工複查，最終保留 5,000 個有效三元組。評測 18 個防護模型顯示：推理軌跡的安全判斷最為困難（平均 F1 為 66.31%），低於提示判斷（75.75%）與最終回應判斷（70.53%）；最佳模型 YuFeng-XGuard-8B 亦僅 84.26%。證據歸因更為薄弱，最佳 TokenF1 僅約 14.88%。此外，Instruction Encryption 攻擊使多數模型的 F1 大幅滑落，部分模型完全失效；中文內容的判斷普遍優於英文。限制包括僅涵蓋中英兩種語言，且標註仍可能有殘餘雜訊。TRACE 突顯防護模型必須能可靠偵測並精準定位不安全內容的需求。
papers.title: TRACE: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: TRACE：針對大型推理模型安全評估的證據扎根基準

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an RL-trained LLM search-agent methodology (Agents/RAG/RL/preferences). The belief-action alignment framing is a moderate but genuine contribution over external-judge (HiPRAG) and step-credit (GiGPO) supervision, with a correctness-gated consistency reward and no inference-time probe. Experiments are broad: 7 QA benchmarks, 2 backbones, 3 optimizers, zero-shot transfer to BrowseComp-Plus, ablations, sensitivity, an external LLM-judge check against circularity, and efficiency measurements. Weaknesses: novelty is incremental on a crowded agentic-RAG reward-shaping line (β-GRPO, DAS, StepSearch, TREEPS-RAG), gains are modest (1.5-1.9 avg points) with no variance/significance reporting, some baseline rows are imported from Xia et al. (2026) rather than reproduced, attribution effect sizes are small (AUROC 59.5->60.2), and no code release is stated despite detailed hyperparameters and prompts. Scope limits (QA-only, Search/Answer decisions only) are honestly acknowledged.

primary_link.title: MetaRAG: Belief-Action Aligned Policy Optimization for Agentic RAG

papers.summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires language models to decide when to continue searching and when to answer. Existing RL-based methods rely on external supervision and overlook the agent's internal belief about whether the current evidence is sufficient. To address this problem, we reformulate the search decision quality as belief-action alignment and propose MetaRAG, a belief-action aligned policy optimization framework for agentic RAG. MetaRAG uses Verify-first Action Generat
papers.summary_zh: Agentic RAG 要求語言模型反覆決定「繼續搜尋」或「直接作答」，此決策邊界若校準不佳，將造成過度搜尋的浪費，或搜尋不足導致不可靠作答。現有 RL 方法多以最終答案獎勵或外部 LLM 評審監督，忽略了 agent 自身對「證據是否充分」的內在信念。本文將搜尋決策品質重構為「信念─行動對齊」，提出 MetaRAG 訓練框架，包含三個組件：Verify-first Action Generation 在每個決策步先對候選動作進行驗證推理，再產生實際動作；Internal Belief Probing 以額外的 yes/no 前向傳播估計策略模型自身對當前情境可答性的信念分數；再依信念分數與實際動作的落差診斷過度搜尋或搜尋不足，計算一致性獎勵，並以最終答案正確性作閘控，避免強化內部一致但答錯的軌跡。信念探測僅於訓練時使用，推論時無額外開銷。在 NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA 等七項 QA 基準上，MetaRAG 於 Qwen2.5-3B 與 7B 的平均準確率分別達 41.7% 與 45.4%，超越 Search-R1、HiPRAG 與 GiGPO，且提升並非僅靠增加搜尋次數。分析顯示其降低搜尋不足率、強化知識邊界意識，可零樣本遷移至 BrowseComp-Plus 深度研究情境，並在 GRPO、DAPO、PPO 與 Llama3.2、Qwen3 等不同最佳化器與骨幹上維持優勢。限制為訓練時需額外前向傳播與較長回應，目前也僅監督搜尋／作答決策。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-evaluation methodology paper: formalizes construct validity for LLM-as-a-judge as an (S,R) profile, measures 7 named judges (claude-haiku-4.5, gemini-2.5-flash-lite, deepseek-v4-flash, llama-4-scout, etc.), and audits reward/preference label sets (RewardBench, RM-Bench, MT-Bench, HelpSteer2), squarely matching LLM, evaluation/benchmark, and RLHF reward-model preferences. Strengths: genuinely careful methodology — human direction assignment with pre-registered 0.75 agreement bar (Fleiss kappa 0.776, Section 4.2/Protocol 1), three disjoint model families against circularity, matched-invariance frontier comparison (Proposition 3, Remark 1), pre-registered refutation conditions (Appendix F), and an honest register of unmeasured quantities (Appendix G). Weaknesses: two registered contributions are explicitly unrun — the per-axis accuracy-prompting test resolving Peters & Chin-Yee's paradox (Section 5.3 'Not measured here') and the Delta inflation of C5 (Section 5.5); the '4 domains' claim in the abstract/conclusion is never substantiated by per-domain results tables (results shown are for the scientific-claim construct only); single construct, English-only probe items (Table 11); modest effective n (246 construct / 96 control items). Novelty is moderate: the invariance/directional-expectation pair is borrowed from Ribeiro et al. and the scope/strength split is acknowledged as previously observed and collapsed; the validation-power diagnostic (Definition 6) and its mode-relativity is the freshest piece. Headline numbers (S=0.945 vs R=0.319; +0.121 gap, 7/7 judges, bootstrap [+0.052,+0.189], p<0.002 permutation null) are well-supported with disclosed controls including a length-bias check that runs against the effect. Release claims are extensive and specific (harness, labels, taxonomy, pinned provider routing).

primary_link.title: A Judge Should Know What Changed:Construct Validity for LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation

papers.summary: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation is usually assessed by agreement and robustness to surface perturbations, but reliability does not establish construct validity. We formalize construct validity for an evaluator as a two-dimensional profile: invariance S, the probability that a verdict is unchanged under construct-preserving edits, and construct sensitivity R, the probability that it changes under minimal construct-changing edits. We show that S and R are independent and that no scalar summary preserves
papers.summary_zh: LLM 評審是測量儀器，可靠不等於有效。既有文獻僅系統性測試「不變性」：在建構不變的表面編輯（長度、格式、語域、注入中繼資料）下判決不應改變，卻從未測試反向條件——在改變建構的最小編輯下判決必須改變。本文將評審的建構效度形式化為二維輪廓 (S, R)：S 為建構保留編輯下判決不變的機率，R 為建構改變編輯下判決翻轉的機率，並證明兩座標相互獨立、不存在總序，故不可化約為單一純量。研究以「科學主張是否超出證據」為建構，將建構改變編輯拆為 scope（主張涵蓋範圍變大）與 strength（承諾強度升高）兩軸，方向由三名人工標註者在 0.75 同意門檻下決定，生成、驗證與評審採三個不相交模型家族以防循環。跨 7 個評審與 4 個領域，在匹配不變性 S≥0.90 下，平均 S 為 0.945 但 R 僅 0.319：可靠卻對建構改變明顯遲鈍。更結構性地，scope 與 strength 的敏感度差距達 +0.121，且 7 個評審同號，顯示評審察覺主張涵蓋更多、卻大多漏掉承諾更強，並為「要求準確反而加劇過度概化」的悖論提供機制。作者另提出驗證力診斷，發現僅讀表面特徵的預測器在成對模式下可重現 55%–67% 的公開標籤集，包括 67.4% 的 MT-Bench 人類票，RewardBench 的長度控制甚至反轉了混淆方向。限制包括方法僅適用於可最小編輯的建構。本文對評估實務提出具體的報告規範。

links.title: FLARE: Verifying MILP Reformulations with LLM-Based Theorem Proving

evidence: Abstract: 'FLARE outperforms existing methods, with 100% accuracy on the NP-hard subset of FormulationBench' and produces 'a machine-checkable certificate for every reformulation it accepts'.

Section 6.2, Table 1: FLARE with Opus 5 reports TP=42, FP=0, TN=12, FN=0 (100.0% accuracy) from a single run ('Due to the high cost, we only do a single run of FLARE'), avg 410.6s and $1.180; EquivaMap accuracy 81.5% and Execution 83.3% over 3 runs.

Section 6.1: FormulationBench has '20 problems, 109 formulations, and 89 formulation pairs with 63 positive and 26 negative examples', NP-hard subset is 54 pairs; 'All 109 Lean formalizations were then reviewed line-by-line by a PhD student... who found no autoformalization errors'.
Section 5 'Limitations': FLARE offers 'No certificate of invalidity', guarantees are conditional on 'faithful formalization', and ATP failures can cause false negatives.
Section 6.2 'Limits of ATP': DeepSeek V4 Pro reaches '79.6% accuracy' with false negatives attributed to ATP failure; FLARE cost std $1.22 and max $8.02.

Section 6.3, Table 3: FLARE-NL ablations show 'Allow Implicit' degrades accuracy (Opus 5: 93.2±1.1%; GPT-5.6 Sol: 75.9%; DeepSeek V4 Pro: 80.9±2.1%), supporting the explicit-definition/assumptions design.

Appendix F: FLARE identified '5 of the 43 acceleration cuts proposed by EvoCut are invalid' and '4 invalid reformulations' from Ferchtandiker et al., with manual proofs (Propositions F.1-F.5, F.7, F.8).
Appendix H, Table 6: harness comparison; 'All 11 false negatives are attributable to ATP failure, 8 due to timeout limits'; only Claude Code + Opus 5 achieves 100%.

Reproducibility: footnotes/Appendices C-G provide code at https://github.com/henryrobbins/flare, milp-flare and formulation-bench packages, full agent and FLARE-NL prompts (Appendix D), Docker image contents, Lean 4.28.0/Mathlib pin, model versions and API pricing (Table 5).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly LLM-centric methodology paper: an agentic ATP pipeline (Claude Code harness + Lean-LSP-MCP) for formulation-level verification of MILP reformulations, hitting multiple high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, reasoning, code generation, benchmark/evaluation). It is not a pure domain application because the contribution is LLM-based autoformalization and machine-checked certification, not just applying optimization. Novelty is solid: a constructive reformulation definition amenable to Lean and the first automated machine-checkable reformulation certificates, though it composes existing autoformalization/ATP-agent ideas (Numina-Lean-Agent, EquivaMap). Rigor is good: formal definitions with proofs (Prop. 4.6, App. A), baselines (Execution, re-implemented EquivaMap), prompt ablations across 3 models (Table 3), harness comparisons (Table 6), and manual invalidity proofs for prior work (App. F). Weaknesses: FLARE main result is a single run on a small 54-pair NP-hard subset, headline 100% accuracy is on self-constructed data with ground truth authored by the same group, and baselines receive the full assumptions list (Sec. 6.2). Evidence is quantitatively detailed (TP/FP/TN/FN, costs, std devs) but bounded by dataset size and single-run FLARE. Generalizability is limited by scope to MILP reformulations, academic benchmark provenance, and reliance on frontier proprietary models (DeepSeek drops to 79.6%, Sec. 6.2). Reproducibility is strong: public code (github.com/henryrobbins/flare), pip packages, full prompts (App. D), Docker/Lean versions and API pricing (App. G).

primary_link.title: FLARE: Verifying MILP Reformulations with LLM-Based Theorem Proving

papers.summary: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) is a fundamental tool for combinatorial optimization with extensive real-world applications. A central challenge is designing computationally efficient MILP formulations. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to automate the modeling process, from deriving formulations to strengthening them. Reliable automation requires robust methods for verifying that proposed formulations preserve the underlying optimization problem. However, existing app
papers.summary_zh: 混合整數線性規劃（MILP）是組合最佳化的基礎工具，設計計算高效的 formulation 是核心挑戰。LLM 雖可自動化建模與強化 formulation，但既有驗證方法多在單一實例層級比較目標值，無法保證對所有問題實例成立，可能放行在某些實例上刪除最佳解的錯誤切割平面。本文提出 formulation 層級的建構式重構定義，要求顯式的參數映射、前向與後向可行域映射，以及嚴格遞增的目標值映射，並在 Lean 中形式化，證明其蘊含既有的 Audet 重構與 Quasi-Karp 等價。基於此定義，作者開發 FLARE：先由 LLM agent 將兩個 formulation 自動形式化至 Lean，再透過 Claude Code 搭配 Lean-LSP-MCP 進行自動定理證明，最後檢查證明無 sorry、未引入新公理，為每個接受的重構產生可機器檢查的證書。另提供 FLARE-NL，以自然語言提示前沿推理模型作為快速、低成本的代理，但不具形式保證。評測基準 FormulationBench 含 20 個問題與 109 個 formulation，在 54 對 NP-hard 子集上，FLARE 與 FLARE-NL 皆達 100% 準確率，顯著優於執行式驗證（83.3%）與 EquivaMap（81.5%）；FLARE-NL 較 FLARE 快約 30 倍、便宜約 25 倍。作者並以 FLARE 揪出先前 AI 生成方法中 5 個無效切割平面與 4 個無效重構。限制包括證書依賴忠實形式化、無法證明無效性，且定理證明失敗會造成假陰性。本文為可信賴的自動最佳化建模奠定基礎。
papers.title: FLARE: Verifying MILP Reformulations with LLM-Based Theorem Proving
papers.title_zh: FLARE：以 LLM 定理證明驗證 MILP 重構

llm_evaluation.rationale: A deployment-grounded evaluation-methodology paper for conversational LLM memory, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents/memory systems, RAG, long context, evaluation/LLM-as-judge), though it is entirely English-language with no Japanese NLP content despite the Kyoto affiliation. Novelty is solid: the dissociation of elicited retrieval from natural integration (78.8% Direct QA vs 7.9% Reference, §6.2) and a benchmark of real user-cued memory moments (§5) are new, but build on known metric-user disconnects and long-context neglect (Liu et al. 2024). Rigor is unusually strong for a deployment study: randomized 7-condition rotation, LMMs with user random intercepts, TOST equivalence, permutation and Bonferroni analyses (App C.7), latency-confound checks (App G), and honest calibration of the weak headline result (p=.082 LMM, fails Bonferroni, permutation p=.23). Key deductions: the primary Natural Integration metric relies on an LLM judge with only moderate human agreement (LLM-human κ 0.43/0.21, Table 12) and demonstrable fragility to recall-style framing (+16.4 pts on Summary-only where integration is impossible, App E.3.8); the integration-satisfaction association rests on 48 sessions/16 users and is observational. Evidence for the capacity null (N=1,270 sessions, equivalence-confirmed) and for the retrieval-integration dissociation (replicated across GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Mem0, Letta; Tables 18-19) is strong and does not hinge on the fragile holistic judge. Generalizability is limited by a single diary persona, 92.5% female sample, and English-only setting. Reproducibility is excellent: verbatim prompts, exact model versions, released corpus/benchmark/code with licenses (App H), minor caveat on summarized raw text.
topics: user satisfaction in deployed dialogue systems

primary_link.title: MemUse: Moving Memory Evaluation from Direct QA to Natural Integration in Long-Term Human-AI Conversation

papers.summary: Memory systems for conversational LLMs are conventionally evaluated by direct, fact-seeking questions about prior dialogue (Direct QA): can the model recall fact X from a prior conversation? We tested whether higher Direct QA accuracy correlates with higher user satisfaction in a 4-month deployment (40 users, 1,872 sessions, 7 memory conditions). Existing-benchmark Direct QA varies from 19.7% to 70.1% across the 7 conditions, but satisfaction does not change. We hypothesize that existing benchma
papers.summary_zh: 本文挑戰長期對話記憶評估的慣常假設：直接問答（Direct QA）分數是否反映使用者滿意度？研究團隊進行四個月的實際部署，讓 40 位使用者與 AI 日記伴侶互動，共 1,872 個工作階段、7 種記憶條件（摘要、長上下文 LC 與檢索增強 RAG）。結果顯示，現有基準的 QA 準確率隨容量從 19.7% 升至 70.1%，但使用者滿意度不變。作者假設基準衡量的是「被問才提取的檢索」，而對話需要「自然整合」，並提出 MemUse 基準：偵測 72 個使用者主動提示記憶的真實時刻，以 LLM 判斷模型的自然回覆是否展現對所引話題的記憶。關鍵發現是檢索與整合可分離：同一模型在 Direct QA 達 78.8%，卻僅在 7.9% 的對話中實際引用那些事實，差距達 71 個百分點；自然整合與滿意度正相關（ρ=+0.29），Direct QA 則否。系統主動回憶亦無對稱收益，時機不當反而降低滿意度。限制包括：所有條件都含摘要基準，零效果僅指額外容量的邊際價值；整合與滿意度的關聯來自 48 個工作階段、16 位使用者的觀察性小樣本；評分為二元且仰賴 LLM 裁判。此研究凸顯記憶評估應從召回正確性轉向對話中的自然整合，才能對齊真實使用者體驗。

links.title: Does Fine-Tuning Undo Activation Steering? Behavioural Recovery Without Weight-Edit Reversal

evidence: Abstract: embedded steering studied for refusal suppression and brevity induction across five instruction-tuned models (3B-14B) under non-adversarial SFT and RLHF; mean vector recovery ρ=0.004 and mean cos θ=0.074.

Section 4.1, Table 2: refusal ablation under SFT degrades (mean P_sft=0.36, R_sft=0.61) while RLHF preserves (mean P_rlhf=0.98); brevity mean P_sft=0.73 with large per-model variance (Qwen3-14B 0.29, SOLAR −0.03).

Appendix B, Table 4: non-steered baseline controls—SFT leaves refusal rates nearly unchanged (mean 0.94→0.94) and RLHF on base models yields 95.9-token mean brief-response length vs 59.4 for steered+RLHF, attributing preservation to steering.
Appendix D, Table 7: fine-tuning update preferentially perturbs steering direction (u(d)=1.11% vs 0.47% random null, mean 3.14×) but reversal fraction rev ≤0.79% across all 20 runs, mean 0.08%.
Appendix C: 95% bootstrap CIs (B=10,000, paired resampling) for all behavioural results; one condition repeated five times giving σ=0.011 on refusal rate.
Appendix F.3: LLM-as-judge (DeepSeek-V4-pro) refusal classifier cross-validated against substring heuristic: 92.4% agreement on 3,000 pairs, Cohen's κ=0.842.

Limitations: single dataset per training paradigm, no titration of contradictory signal, only full-parameter fine-tuning (no LoRA), no quantization perturbations, models up to 14B, and no comparison to training-only behaviour acquisition.
Appendix F.1: new 408-prompt LongElicitPrompts dataset publicly released at huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/long-elicit-prompts; Appendix G provides full SFT/PPO hyperparameters (verl-based, 4×H100).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM research squarely matching preference profile: activation steering embedded in weights, studied under SFT/RLHF across five open-weight instruction-tuned models (3B-14B), touching LLM (2.5), interpretability (1.8), AI safety (2.0), alignment/RLHF (2.0), and training (1.5). Novelty is solid but incremental: it builds on established orthogonalisation (Arditi et al.) and Heretic-style variable steering, contributing the first (per authors) systematic test of whether routine non-adversarial fine-tuning undoes embedded steering, plus a mechanistic dissociation finding. Rigor is good: non-steered baseline training controls (Appendix B), bootstrap CIs, run-to-run variance check (σ=0.011, Appendix C), judge cross-validation (κ=0.842, Appendix F.3), and a random-direction null for the update projection (Appendix D). Evidence for the headline mechanistic claim (rev ≤0.79%, ρ<0.02 across 20 runs) is strong and directly measured; evidence for the 'degradation tracks training content' generalization is weaker, resting on only two behaviours and one dataset per paradigm, which the Limitations section concedes. Generalizability is capped by scale (≤14B), full-parameter SFT/PPO only, no LoRA/quantization, and heuristic direction selection. Reproducibility is moderate: detailed hyperparameters, named datasets, released LongElicitPrompts, but no explicit code release and dependence on a specific judge model. Net: relevant, well-executed empirical study with a clear, supported dissociation result but bounded scope.

primary_link.title: Does Fine-Tuning Undo Activation Steering? Behavioural Recovery Without Weight-Edit Reversal

papers.summary: Activation steering can be embedded directly into a language model's weights, shaping behaviour without inference-time intervention and offering a way to encode alignment prior to release. However, models are routinely fine-tuned after deployment, and it is unknown whether embedded interventions survive this. We study the stability of embedded steering for refusal suppression and brevity induction across five instruction-tuned models (3B-14B) under non-adversarial SFT and RLHF. Behaviourally, pr
papers.summary_zh: Activation steering 可將行為編輯直接嵌入模型權重，但部署後的下游 fine-tuning 是否會摧毀這些編輯？本文研究嵌入式導引在非對抗性 SFT 與 RLHF 下的穩定性，涵蓋五個 instruction-tuned 模型（3B–14B）與兩個導引目標：抑制拒答（refusal ablation）與誘導簡短回覆（brevity induction）。行為面上，效果保存取決於訓練資料：當最佳化壓力與目標行為矛盾時效果退化，反之則持續；refusal ablation 在 SFT 下平均失去 64% 效果，而 RLHF 幾乎完整保存兩種行為。機制面上卻出現反差：即使行為回復，權重編輯幾乎原封不動——平均向量恢復率 ρ=0.004，fine-tuning 更新沿導引方向與編輯前權重模式近乎正交（平均 cos θ=0.074），逆轉比例至多 0.79%。這表示模型並非透過拆除或逆轉導引機制來恢復行為，而是發展出繞過它的替代路徑。限制包括：僅測試全參數微調（未涵蓋 LoRA 與量化）、模型規模至 14B、未系統性調控訓練資料中矛盾訊號的強度，也未追蹤替代迴路的具體機制。對開放權重模型供應商而言，嵌入式導引在機制上耐久但功能上脆弱，下游訓練後必須重新進行行為驗證。

links.title: RecurSE: Bounded Recursive Self-Evaluation for LLM Rubric Judges

evidence: Abstract: claims generalization gains without gold RL rewards across Qwen3.5-9B (+12.9), Gemma-4-E4B-it (+5.2), and Qwen3.6-27B (+3.9) on human-verified validation, with transfer across medical, pairwise, summarization, and professional benchmarks.

Section 5.2 (RQ2): identical YES/NO checking inflates YES rate 0.730→0.791 and reward 0.465→0.698 while validation accuracy plateaus (0.729→0.730); decoupled scalar readout yields accuracy 0.724→0.787 with calibrated YES rate.

Section 5.4 / Table 3: five controls on Qwen3.5-9B — frozen checker 62.7%, external 27B checker 73.1% SV-Hard but HealthBench 79.8% vs Main 85.9%, self-consistency collapses to 56.5% final, teacher SFT 6.4k/17k reach 64.2%/70.2% vs Main 73.7%.

Appendix N and Table 7: PAV V̂t=0.742 with 95% cluster-bootstrap CI [0.685,0.797] at Qwen@130; three-fold stability within {130,140}; mean oracle regret 1.20 vs 5.41 for accuracy-only selection; appendix concedes pointwise unbiasedness does not solve sequential FWER.
Table 4 (RQ5): DPO with RecurSE-labeled pairs gives GPQA 81.46 vs base 80.87 (base-judge labels degrade to 79.02), GuideBench 85.51 vs 83.93, SOP-Maze 36.71 vs 34.34 — positive but small margins.

Appendix Q / Section 4: detailed hyperparameters (verl, FSDP, vLLM, batch 32/48, n=8 rollouts, lr 3e-6, clip 0.005, checker synced per step; prompts in Appendix I), but the document contains no code, checkpoint, or dataset release statement.

Appendix T (Limitations): scope restricted to English rubric benchmarks up to 27B; admits reliance on a compact human-verified SV-Hard holdout and that formal sequential stopping bounds remain future work.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work on improving LLM-as-judge via reward-only self-supervised RL, strongly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/evaluation, alignment & RLHF, reinforcement learning). The surface-coupling shortcut finding and interface-decoupling fix, plus the theoretically motivated PAV stopping monitor, are moderately novel relative to prior self-improving evaluators (Self-Taught Evaluators, Meta-Rewarding), which the paper differentiates explicitly. Rigor is solid: five ablation controls, three model families, statistical tests, bootstrap CIs, fold stability, and an oracle-regret selector comparison; weaknesses include a lightweight theoretical core (triangle-inequality bound), acknowledged unsolved sequential-testing FWER, reliance on a human-verified holdout for stopping, and small downstream DPO deltas. Evidence is largely internally consistent with concrete numbers, though some gains are modest (CheckEval +0.019 Pearson) and LLM-panel labels underpin one validation stream. Reproducibility is hampered by absence of any code/data release claim and dependence on proprietary teacher APIs and synthesized candidate responses. Not out-of-scope: medical benchmarks serve only as evaluation suites for an LLM judge method.

primary_link.title: RecurSE: Bounded Recursive Self-Evaluation for LLM Rubric Judges

papers.summary: LLM-as-judge is essential for evaluating open-ended text and steering post-training, yet improving the judge itself typically relies on expensive annotations, reward models, or distillation from stronger teachers. In this work, we eliminate external gold supervision from the RL training reward: the model's own evaluative capability generates learning signals for its optimization -- a closed-loop setting of bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) termed Recursive Self-Evaluation (RecurSE). We st
papers.summary_zh: 提升 LLM 裁判通常依賴昂貴的人工標註、外部獎勵模型或更強教師的蒸餾。本文提出 RecurSE，讓模型自身的評估能力產生強化學習訓練訊號，實現有界的遞迴自我改進。方法採兩道程序：可訓練裁判依逐條評分規準（rubric）產出推理與 YES/NO 判決；同步參數副本依後設規準審計裁判推理，給出 5 級純量過程獎勵。關鍵設計是介面解耦：若兩者共用相同 YES/NO 輸出，最佳化會膨脹 YES 記號套取高分卻不增進準確性；改用純量分數可切斷此捷徑。由於訓練獎勵不含外部黃金標籤，遞迴學習本質上有界，作者提出 Pairwise Advantage Validity（PAV）監控器，結合裁判準確率與審查器保真度（權重 2 源自三角不等式界），在 100 個人工驗證提示的保留集上定位最佳停止區間。實驗涵蓋 Qwen3.5-9B（SV-Hard 提升 12.9 點）、Gemma-4-E4B-it（+5.2）與 Qwen3.6-27B（+3.9），在 HealthBench、RubricBench、CheckEval、ProfBench 等保留基準一致獲益；同步共演化優於凍結審查器、外部 27B 審查器、自我一致性與教師 SFT。其裁判產生的偏好對透過 DPO 亦能改善下游對齊。限制包括 PAV 仍需一次性的小型人工驗證集、目前僅限英文評分規準任務，以及序列監控的多重檢定疑慮。此工作證明訓練獎勵不含外部監督的有界 RSI 對 LLM 裁判確實可行。

links.title: Who is the Agent to Blame? Localizing Faithfulness and Citation Mistakes in Agentic Deep Research

evidence: Section 4.3: human annotation of 50 AI-Q sentences by two annotators with third-annotator arbitration; Cohen's κ=0.71 pre-arbitration, 76% exact match and κ=0.62 against algorithm verdicts.
Section 5.1: evaluation on 20 DeepResearch Bench examples, up to 10 sentences per agent (~200/agent, exact counts in Table 1); Section 7 extends to all 50 English examples for interventions.

Section 6.2 / Table 2: 84.7% of AI-Q final-report errors attributed to the orchestrator; global citation recall 58.7% (AI-Q), 28.5% (MS-Agent), 7.1% (TrajectoryKit); ~31% of AI-Q final-report errors are hallucinations.

Section 7 / Table 3: two independent interventions (snippets replacement, citation-guidance prompt) raise citation recall 64.5→69.7/69.6 and precision 87.6→94.1/91.0 with RACE ~52.4-52.6 (±SEM reported).

Section 4.2 'Algorithm implementation': all prompts adapted from prior work (LAQuer, DEER, LongCite) with gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 as judge; Limitations section concedes LLM-as-judge reliance and observational nature of the model-capability finding, and excludes tabular content.

Footer and Appendices B/I: code released at github.com/eranhirs/who-is-the-agent-to-blame, full prompts in Appendix B, and per-system adapter extraction logic in Appendix I for three Apache/MIT-licensed systems.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong match to Agents & Tool Use, RAG/attribution, and evaluation preferences: a localization-and-taxonomy framework for faithfulness and citation errors in multi-agent deep research systems. Novelty is moderate—core prompts are adapted from prior work (LongCite, DEER, LAQuer per Section 4.2), but the local per-invocation testing, four-type taxonomy, and recursive error tracing to a responsible agent are new. Rigor is solid: human validation with arbitration (Section 4.3: κ=0.71 IAA; 76% exact match, κ=0.62 vs. algorithm), span-validation (Appendix F: 75%), and per-intervention ablations with SEMs (Table 3). Limits: only 20 benchmark examples for diagnostics and 50 for interventions, a single gpt-5-mini judge, human validation confined to one system, and ~24% label disagreement. Evidence is concrete (Tables 1-4, e.g., 84.7% orchestrator attribution; recall 64.5→69.6/69.7) but small-sample and judge-dependent. Generalizability is tempered by required per-system adapters (Appendix I) and an acknowledged observational model-capability claim (Limitations). Reproducibility is good: released code link, full prompts (Appendix B), open-source Apache/MIT systems, and detailed adapter logic (Appendix I).

primary_link.title: Who is the Agent to Blame? Localizing Faithfulness and Citation Mistakes in Agentic Deep Research

papers.summary: Deep research (DR) systems produce long-form cited reports by orchestrating multiple agents that search and synthesize information from the web. Citations are the primary mechanism for evaluating the faithfulness of these reports, yet current DR systems exhibit poor citation recall. Moreover, improving citation recall is challenging because DR systems are complex multi-agent architectures where information passes through agents like a telephone game, and both content and citations can get corrup
papers.summary_zh: 深度研究（deep research, DR）系統透過多個 agent 搜尋網路並撰寫長篇引用報告，但引用召回率（citation recall）普遍偏低，且資訊像傳話遊戲般在 agent 間傳遞時逐漸失真。本文提出一套評估方法，將錯誤定位到引入它的 agent，並分類四種錯誤：幻覺、依賴未引用輸入、未引用輸出與引用不足。核心做法是對單一 agent 呼叫進行局部測試——相對於其自身輸入檢驗輸出的忠實度與可驗證性——再以遞迴方式從最終報告的錯誤回溯至元兇。作者將方法應用於三個頂尖開源 DR 系統（Nvidia AI-Q、MS-Agent、TrajectoryKit）與 DeepResearch Bench 資料集，人工驗證顯示與演算法判定有 76% 一致（κ=0.62）。主要發現：除摘要單一文件的 searcher 外，幾乎所有 agent 都犯下大量錯誤；錯誤類型隨底層模型能力而異——AI-Q 有 84.7% 的最終報告錯誤源自 orchestrator，其中約 31% 是幻覺、其餘多為引用相關；小模型的 TrajectoryKit 則在每個階段都產生幻覺。據此提出的兩項簡單介入（指示 orchestrator 勿用未引用資訊、以原始文件片段取代 researcher 筆記）使引用召回率提升 5%、精確率提升 3–7%，且不損害輸出品質。限制包括仰賴 LLM 評審、模型能力歸因屬觀察性結論，以及表格內容未納入評估。此框架為 DR 開發者提供可執行的診斷工具，有助系統性改善多 agent 系統的忠實度。

Appendix D, Table 12: model-controlled full-library invocation uses 3,111 more first-call tokens, scores 18 points lower, and costs 46% more per success than Recuris.
Appendix C: frozen evolve/dev/test splits (16/12/86 on tau2-Retail); SkillFlow has no held-out task split and selection is in-sample, limiting transfer claims there.
Appendix E: gate rejected two candidates with dev intervals spanning zero that later cleared +11.92 on held-out tasks (driver.log quote), an acknowledged limitation of the gate's statistical power.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: an LLM agent-harness paper on working/experiential memory coupling, state-grounded skill invocation, tool use, and bounded recursive memory evolution across four long-horizon agent benchmarks and ten models (Abstract; Sec. 2-3). Novelty is moderate: working memory, skill libraries, and gated memory evolution each exist in prior work (Sec. 4.1-4.3), and the paper concedes related systems already condition retrieval on execution context; the fresh combination is checker-verified task state as the retrieval/invocation key plus trace-based component-level failure localization. Rigor is unusually strong for the genre: paired task-clustered bootstrap CIs with McNemar tests (Appendix A), an A/A noise floor of +0.00 [-6.98,+7.27], a harness ablation showing the bare memory-control layer contributes nothing so gains are attributable to evolution (Appendix B, Tables 10-11), component and mechanism ablations with a double dissociation (Tables 2-3, Fig. 6), and two independent Meta-Agent implementations that are statistically interchangeable (Table 6, p=0.72). Evidence is strong but with honest weak spots: Airline intervals all include zero, test-time adaptation adds only +2.3 over budget-matched retry (Table 8, p=0.774), SkillFlow selection is in-sample (Appendix C), and localization uses only three injectable fault classes (Table 4). Generalizability is supported by cross-model transfer (Table 7) but the authors state transfer fails where held-out tasks lack the failure type (Sec. 3.4.5). Reproducibility is capped by dependence on proprietary stacks (Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, Doubao/GPT-5.6/Claude frontier models) and no stated code/artifact release, despite detailed splits, seeds, and budgets (Appendices C-D).

primary_link.title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses

papers.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) remains hard in long-horizon tasks, where growing histories obscure the task state and misalign skill invocation. We introduce Recuris, a recursive Experiential-Working Memory architecture for long-horizon agent harnesses, in which Working Memory tracks task progress and guides skill selection from Experiential Memory, grounding skill use in current needs rather than the full history. This coupling also turns execution into structured evidence that localizes fail
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理 LLM agent 在長程任務中難以遞迴自我改進(RSI)的問題:互動歷史不斷增長,代理容易遺漏未完成目標、呼叫與當前任務脫節的技能。作者提出 Recuris,將改進侷限於 agent harness 的外部記憶控制層:工作記憶(WM)維持經環境驗證的任務狀態,據此在執行事件時從經驗記憶(EM)檢索技能;代理執行後,檢查器依工具回傳結果決定狀態是否提交,形成閉環。此耦合同時產生結構化軌跡,讓固定的 Meta-Agent 能把失敗歸因到特定記憶元件(技能庫、狀態規格、呼叫策略或檢查器),僅修補被歸因的元件,並須通過含保留開發集回歸測試的固定驗證閘門才會納入,構成有界的遞迴記憶演化迴圈,基礎模型與外部程序全程凍結。實驗涵蓋四個長程基準與十個模型:37 個模型—基準配對中 35 個獲得改善,GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Claude Opus 5 在 τ²-Bench 分別提升 17.8 與 15.6 個百分點(Opus 5 達 87.9%),優勢隨任務變長擴大至 32.2 點,常見長程失敗模式最多下降 80%;結構化軌跡的故障定位準確率為 64.8%,遠高於僅看任務結果的 13.0%。限制包括:跨任務演化需任務間具共享結構(Terminal-Bench 2.1 即無法套用)、測試時適應的增益多落在雜訊範圍內,且閘門偏保守,可能拒絕事後證實有效的修補。其意義在於證明記憶控制層可作為凍結代理的可訓練表面,改善可歸因、可逆且可跨模型移植。
papers.title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
papers.title_zh: Recuris:長程代理框架的遞迴式經驗—工作記憶演化

links.title: RAGSentinel: Certifiable Geometric Consensus for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: propose RAGSentinel, a training-free, label-free post-retrieval defense filtering poisoned documents as geometric outliers in surrogate-encoder residual space; evaluated on NQ, HotpotQA, MS-MARCO with three LLM families.
Section 4.2: consensus scoring combines geometric-median anchor distance with local nearest-neighbor consistency and an adaptive weight lambda, fully parameter-free per query.

Section 5, Theorem 1 and Appendix B: certifiable filtering guarantee under Assumptions 1-3 (honest majority, benign consensus, poison-to-benign cosine separation), with full lemmas; Remark 1 concedes the separation condition formalizes a regime rather than proving factual separation.
Section 6.1: 100 queries sampled per dataset, Contriever retriever, k=10, k'=1, BGE-M3 surrogate, three NVIDIA L40S GPUs, three seeds; no code release mentioned.

Section 6.2, Table 1: ASR 0.03 vs Vanilla 0.38 on NQ/Llama-3.1-8B under PoisonedRAG; but no-attack ACC on Llama-3.1-8B drops to 0.71 (NQ) and 0.61 (HotpotQA) vs 0.78/0.76 Vanilla RAG, showing a utility cost.

Section 7, Table 8: component ablations (arithmetic mean, no topic removal, no subspace selection, no norm clipping, fixed radius) each degrade ASR; Table 9 shows centering estimator choice matters less than topic removal.

Section 7 / Appendix F, Tables 4, 7, 10, 11: robustness to pooling strategy (ASR <= 0.14), adaptive attacks with full pipeline knowledge (ASR rises from 0.08 to 0.11 on HotpotQA), retriever choice, and four surrogate encoders.

Section 9 Limitations: attacker with direct query access to the surrogate encoder remains open; honest-majority assumption restricts higher poison ratios (Figure 2 shows degradation as k' approaches k/2).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology paper squarely within preferred topics: it defends RAG pipelines for LLMs (Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B) against knowledge-corpus poisoning, combining RAG & Knowledge, AI Safety, and Red Teaming/Evaluation themes rather than a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate-to-strong: transferring Byzantine-robust geometric-median aggregation to hidden-state residual filtering with an independent surrogate encoder is a genuinely different signal than instruction-based, parametric-knowledge, or text-consistency defenses, though it composes established ideas (representation probing, robust aggregation, embedding outlier detection). Rigor is good: explicit threat model, a theorem with a full proof in Appendix B, per-component ablations (Table 8), sensitivity analyses over surrogate encoder, pooling, retriever, k and k', adaptive attacks with full design in Appendix F, mixed attacks, and overhead timing. However, the 'certifiable' guarantee is conditional on a representation-level separation (Assumption 3) that is essentially assumed rather than verifiable at deployment, the theorem's operating condition involves unknown quantities (gamma, Delta, sigma_d), and evaluation uses only 100 sampled queries per dataset with 3 seeds and no significance testing. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent, but the paper transparently shows a real utility cost in some settings (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B ACC drops to 0.61 on HotpotQA no-attack vs 0.76 Vanilla RAG, Table 1), tempering the 'competitive accuracy' claim. Generalizability is strong across datasets, LLMs, attacks, and retrievers, but limited to English QA and the honest-majority regime. Reproducibility is decent (algorithms, prompts, adaptive attack designs, hardware, licenses) but no code or artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: RAGSentinel: Certifiable Geometric Consensus for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation

papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models by grounding responses in external documents, but it also exposes a critical security vulnerability: adversarial documents injected into the knowledge database can enter the context window and steer the model toward targeted incorrect answers. Existing post-retrieval defenses rely on instruction following, parametric knowledge, or text-level consistency, all of which can be imitated or optimized against by adap
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成(RAG)透過外部文件提升 LLM 的事實性,但攻擊者可將經檢索最佳化的毒化文件寫入知識庫,在特定查詢上誘導模型輸出目標錯誤答案。既有防禦可分為指令引導、知識整合與一致性過濾三類,但其依賴的訊號(模型自身判斷、參數知識、文件間文字重疊)都能被自適應攻擊者模仿或最佳化。本文提出 RAGSentinel,一種免訓練、免標註的黑箱後檢索防禦:以獨立選擇的代理編碼器測量每份文件在查詢條件下造成的隱藏狀態偏移,依序進行活躍子空間選取、自適應範數裁剪與共享主題方向移除,再以幾何中位數估計良性多數共識,結合全域錨點距離與局部鄰居一致性得到共識距離,最後用查詢自適應半徑濾除呈幾何離群值的毒化文件,全程只需 k+1 次編碼器前向傳遞與單次 LLM 呼叫。理論上,在誠實多數假設與表示層可分離條件下,作者證明 RAGSentinel 能精確回復無毒且規模過半的可信上下文(Theorem 1)。實驗涵蓋 NQ、HotpotQA、MS-MARCO 三個資料集、三種 LLM 與三類攻擊(PoisonedRAG、PIA、對抗解碼),其攻擊成功率大多低於 0.11,無攻擊時準確率與原始 RAG 相當,速度約為 RobustRAG 的 3 倍,且在掌握完整流程知識的三種自適應攻擊下仍保持最佳防禦。限制在於假設攻擊者無法存取代理編碼器,並繼承誠實多數假設:當毒化文件接近半數時,效能會急遽下降。其價值在於把防禦訊號移到攻擊者難以最佳化的表示幾何空間,為 RAG 提供可證明且低成本的過濾層。
papers.title: RAGSentinel: Certifiable Geometric Consensus for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: RAGSentinel:以可認證幾何共識強化檢索增強生成的穩健性

links.title: ToolMinimize: Auditing and Rewriting LLM Agent Tool Calls to Minimize Privacy Exposure

evidence: Abstract: 81-88% of tool calls include unnecessary PSD under default prompts on GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama-3.3-70B; live validation on 307 tool calls reduces privacy cost 81.2-92.0% at 100% argument-level task validity (TOST p<0.001 at Delta=1.0), median latency 1.77 ms.
Section II: motivating study of 3x20x2=120 API calls shows default over-sharing 81.0-87.5% and privacy-prompt over-sharing 36.0-76.2%, with Llama barely responding (81.0%->76.2%).

Section V-C Table III: ToolMinimize PCS 0.59 at TCR=1.00 vs PrivacyChecker PCS 0.47 at TCR=0.03 and PII Detection PCS 4.29; Wilcoxon p<0.001 vs utility-preserving baselines; prompt best case only 33.2% reduction.

Section V-D: on 50 PrivacyLens-style external scenarios ToolMinimize achieves 89.1% cost reduction (PER 1.0->0.16, TCR 60%); on 25 real MCP schemas without minimum_necessary annotations, 79.0% reduction; detection FPR 20% and rewrite FPR 10% on 20 benign scenarios.

Section V-D Error analysis: headline reductions are over detected PSD; regex DI recall 0.435 (spaCy NER raises to 0.739 at +26 ms); residual from missed DI, necessary PSD retained (3/90), and over-generalization (2 scenarios).

Section VI-D Limitations: TCR is schema-validity not end-to-end task success (80% on 20 mock-endpoint scenarios, all 4 failures maps scenarios missing annotations); TOST equivalence passes at Delta=1.0 and Delta=0.5 (p=0.046) but fails at Delta=0.25 (p=0.23).

Section V-A: AgentPrivBench (90 scenarios) described as open-source with ground-truth annotations; stochastic methods use n=5 runs with seeds {42,123,456,789,2024} and 95% CIs on Intel Xeon Gold 6248R; no repository URL is provided anywhere in the document.

Section VII Table VI: claims no existing system performs schema-aware, argument-level minimization by rewriting tool call fields while preserving task validity, contrasting with allow/block systems (AudAgent, PrivacyChecker, Progent) and flow-granularity IFC (Fides, RTBAS, CaMeL).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM-agent paper: privacy middleware that rewrites tool-call arguments (removal/generalization/substitution/truncation) across GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama-3.3-70B, AutoGen/MCP/LangChain, hitting the Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, and AI Safety preferences; none of the out-of-scope exclusions apply. Novelty is genuine but incremental in method: the graduated argument-level rewriting and privacy cost metric appear new versus allow/block gates (AudAgent, PrivacyChecker, Progent) and flow-level IFC (Fides, CaMeL), yet the core classifier is regex-based with only 4 semantic-classifier detections (Table IV), so the contribution is more systems engineering than new language methodology. Rigor is solid: 120-call motivating study (Section II), 9 baselines, Wilcoxon tests, n=5 seeded runs, 110-perturbation metric robustness (Kendall tau=1.0), and honest disclosure of weak per-call judge correlation (rho=+0.04 per-item, Section VI-C). Evidence is decent but capped by synthetic 'simulated profiles' (deterministic parameterized mutations, Section V-A), a large simulated-vs-live baseline PCS gap (11.68 vs 4.10, Table V), end-to-end execution on only 20 mock-endpoint scenarios (80%, Section VI-D), and headline reductions computed over detected PSD bounded by DI recall 0.435 (Section V-D). Generalizability is supported by 50 PrivacyLens-style external scenarios (89.1%) and 25 real MCP schemas (79.0%) but limited by US-format classifiers, hand-written tool-type handlers, and field-splitting evasion. Reproducibility is moderate: AgentPrivBench is claimed open-source with seeds and hardware listed, but no repository URL appears in the document.

primary_link.title: ToolMinimize: Auditing and Rewriting LLM Agent Tool Calls to Minimize Privacy Exposure

papers.summary: LLM agents routinely include privacy-sensitive data (PSD) in tool call arguments beyond what the invoked tools require, crossing trust boundaries to third-party services on every invocation. A controlled measurement on three production LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama-3.3-70B) shows that 81--88\% of tool calls include unnecessary PSD under default prompts; explicit privacy instructions still leave 36--76\% over-sharing. Existing defenses gate calls (allow/block) or label flows (information
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理執行工具呼叫時,常把超出工具所需的隱私敏感資料(PSD)寫進參數,並在每次呼叫時跨越信任邊界送往第三方服務。對 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet 與 Llama-3.3-70B 的對照測量顯示:預設提示下 81–88% 的工具呼叫含有多餘 PSD,明確隱私指示仍殘留 36–76%;而現有防禦多為允許/阻擋閘門或資訊流控制,無法改寫參數值,PII 偵測工具又會漏掉「Memorial Sloan Kettering」這類暗示疾病的隱性敏感內容。本文提出中介層 ToolMinimize,於引數建構與工具執行之間攔截呼叫,結合以 GDPR 第 9 條為基礎的十類 PSD 分類、隱私成本指標 PC(t, args),以及移除、泛化、替換、截斷四種改寫操作。在 307 個真實工具呼叫上,隱私成本降低 81.2–92.0% 且保持 100% 引數層級任務有效性(TOST p<0.001);在 25 個未標註的 MCP schema 上降低 79.0%;選配的 LLM 內容必要性層可將即時降幅推升至 85.1–95.6%,中位延遲僅 1.77 毫秒。限制包括:正規表示式對直接識別碼的召回率僅 0.435(搭配 spaCy NER 可升至 0.739),欄位拆分攻擊仍可完全規避偵測,端對端執行成功率為 80%,失敗案例皆為缺少 minimum_necessary 標註的地圖情境,良性輸入上亦有 20% 偵測誤報。本研究填補了在不犧牲任務完成度的前提下進行引數層級資料最小化的空白,對設計重視隱私的代理系統深具參考價值。

links.title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows

evidence: Section 4.1 / Table 2: Qwen3.5-9B-Base use falls from +0.032 at 2k to +0.001/+0.004 at 32k/128k tokens; permutation p>0.5 at 32k and 128k against the pseudo-insertion empirical null.
Section 4.3 / Table 3: directed retrieval is 12/12 at every length for the 9B model including 128k with zero false-positive retrievals on neutral filings, while measured use is at the noise floor.

Section 5.4 / Table 6: memory-state transplant removes about 65% of the disclosure influence and recreates 44%; a neutral-to-neutral sham transplant has signed per-firm mean +0.008 with CI including zero, and removal minus sham is +0.116 with sign-flip p=0.002.

Section 6.2 / Table 7: extract-then-decide retains 67% of short-context influence at 128k versus 12% under baseline; chunk-then-aggregate eliminates use at both 2k and 128k, with Table 18 attributing eviction to the extraction stage in 24/24 cells at 2k.
Section 3.4: pre-specified primary contrasts, ten pseudo-target insertions per cell defining the noise floor, and randomization inference over 2,000 draws.

Section 4.4 / Table 5: real-disclosure redaction on twenty filings is labeled exploratory and capability-conditional; full-filing use is +0.000 [-0.003,+0.003] with 20/20 retrieval, and the 9B workhorse shows no excerpt-level response to real disclosures.

Section 7 limitations and Appendix D: causal channel identification comes from one hybrid-architecture model family; subspace-intervention designs produced verified nulls with working controls; capability claims rest on the 2B-27B endpoints and the production model.

Appendix B.4: runtime pinned to a single library version and kernel path, with results under a defective multi-GPU configuration discarded and regenerated; Tables report 10,000-draw firm-level bootstrap CIs.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper, not a pure domain application: finance is only the testbed for a general long-context retrieval-integration phenomenon, with mechanism work via vocabulary-space probes, sparse autoencoders, attention blackouts, and recurrent-state transplants, plus agentic workflow-architecture experiments. This hits high-weight preferences (LLMs, long context/memory, interpretability, agents/workflows, evaluation). Novelty is good but incremental over known context-degradation results the paper itself cites (Du et al. 2025); the new counterfactual marginal-decision-influence measure, dual-channel causal identification, and decision-proximal representation principle are the fresh contributions. Rigor is unusually strong: pre-specified design, empirical pseudo-insertion null with randomization inference, capability gate, placebo edits, matched sham controls, float32 readout-resolution verification, and candid labeling of failed controls and exploratory results. Evidence is solid for the main gap across three open-weight families and a production API model, but N=12 firms, some cells are underpowered (production-model 2k-to-128k decline p=0.199), the real-disclosure redaction arm is exploratory and capability-conditional, and causal channel claims rest on a single hybrid-architecture family. Generalizability is moderate: behavioral replication is multi-family, mechanism is single-family, and the domain is one task type with an asserted-but-untested portability claim. Reproducibility: pinned runtimes, frozen answer keys, and content-hash registries are documented, but code is available only upon request and the replication package is promised, not released.

primary_link.title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI analysts to process financial disclosures and support AI-assisted investment decisions. Yet such systems are usually evaluated by what they can retrieve, not whether retrieved information affects their judgments. We identify a retrieval-integration gap in long-context financial analysis. Holding focal-firm information fixed and varying only unrelated context from 2,000 to 128,000 tokens, we find that a risk disclosure's influence on in
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益被當成「AI 分析師」閱讀財務揭露文件,但系統多半只以能否擷取資訊來評估,而非擷取到的資訊是否真正影響判斷。作者在十二家美國公司年報中插入可驗證的風險揭露(如契約門檻、訴訟和解),在標的公司資訊固定下僅將經濟上無關的上下文由 2,000 擴充至 128,000 tokens,以目標段落與五個中性替換版本的判斷差異定義「邊際決策影響力」。結果呈現明確的「擷取—整合落差」:9B 模型的賣出機率效應自 2k tokens 的 +0.032 銳減,至 32k 以上便與插入雜訊底線無法區分,但直接問答的擷取在 128k 仍維持 12/12 全對;反應區間壓縮 5.6 倍而排序能力大致保留,模型能排名風險卻不再調整權重。現象跨 Qwen3.5、Llama-3.1-8B、gemma-4-12B 及商用 API 模型重現,能力只是把失敗界線外推。機制上,詞彙空間探針與 sparse autoencoder 顯示揭露內容在閱讀位置編碼穩定、決策位置卻偵測不到;記憶移植與注意力遮蔽證實線性注意力的遞迴摘要與注意力查詢兩條通道各承載相當影響力。工作流程實驗中,先擷取再決策把長文脈影響保留率從 12% 提升至 67%,分塊摘要甚至在 2k 便消滅全部影響力,延伸推理也無幫助;二十份真實 10-K 的刪除實驗提供一致但屬探索性、受能力條件限制的複製。限制在於因果通道識別僅來自單一混合架構模型家族。本研究凸顯僅憑擷取準確率的評測可能認證判斷忽略關鍵資訊的系統,並提出「決策鄰近表徵原則」:關鍵資訊應以針對性、結構化的形式置於判斷點旁。

links.title: Belief Cascades Drive Persuasion in LLM Agent Networks

evidence: Abstract: 'Across four LLM backbones, five graphs, and 55 policy statements, we find that persuasion dynamics depend on the interaction between topology, competition, topic, and model prior.'

Section 4.3: 'The full sweep evaluates four models: GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemini-2.5-Pro' and 'Crossing 2 settings, 5 graphs, 4 models, 55 policy statements, and 2 random seeds yields 4,400 independent runs'.
Table 1 caption / Section 5.2: per-exposure OLS+HC1 coefficients; 'direct exposure to PR1 is positive and direct exposure to PR2 is negative on every backbone (Table 1).'
Appendix C.2: 'direct exposure to PR1 is positive and to PR2 is negative, both at p<.001, on all four backbones in all four specifications, including the fully saturated M3'.
Appendix D.2 Table 11: blind human validation of the GPT-5-mini Cialdini classifier, 'Overall 87.3%' over '600 judgments (2 annotators x 50 blind messages x 6 principles)'.

Limitations: 'Initial beliefs are assigned from Personalized PageRank position ... network location and initial stance are correlated by construction ... an ablation that randomizes or uniformly assigns priors ... is left to future work.'
Limitations: 'we use only two random seeds, so run-to-run stochastic variation is only coarsely characterized' and 'we do not validate the dynamics against human persuasion data.'
Appendix F: full prompt templates for persona, action calls, and the token-probability 7-MCQ belief check are provided; however, the document contains no explicit code or data release statement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled empirical study of agent-to-agent persuasion in multi-agent LLM networks using GPT-4o/4.1 and Gemini-2.5 backbones, directly relevant to LLM agents, multi-agent safety, and LLM evaluation. Novel in framing persuasion as exposure-level belief propagation with token-probability probes, direct-vs-peer channel attribution, and a 4,400-run factorial sweep. Rigor is solid (HC1 OLS with M0-M3 robustness ladder, blind human validation of the Cialdini classifier at 87.3% over 600 judgments, side-swap stress test), but key confounds are acknowledged not resolved: PPR-derived priors entangle stance with topology with no ablation, only two RNG seeds, and results are associational rather than causal. Generalizability is limited to five small English-language ego-networks (18-42 nodes) with a fixed 9-action vocabulary and no human-data validation. Detailed appendices (prompts, graph IDs, algorithms, factor table) aid reproduction, but no code/data release is stated. Not a pure domain application; clearly in scope.

papers.summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 系統中,代理之間的說服力正成為關鍵能力,卻缺乏系統性衡量。本文建立一個受控測試平台,研究目標導向的說服者如何改變真實自我網路拓撲中 LLM 代理的立場。設計橫跨四種骨幹模型(GPT-4o、GPT-4.1、Gemini-2.5-Flash/Pro)、五個 SNAP Twitter 圖、55 條政策陳述與單一/競爭說服者兩種設定,共 4,400 次模擬,並以 token 機率信念探針逐輪追蹤信念。主要發現有三:一、網路密度效應隨競爭而反轉,稠密圖削弱單一說服者的擴散,卻在雙說服者設定下放大偏向 PR1 的移動;二、競爭設定下拉鋸軌跡成為主流,終點更貼近模型先驗;三、直接曝光在競爭情境穩定預測下一輪立場變化,同儕轉發效應較小但可測,而代理文字幾乎不顯露信念移動,顯示僅監看文本不足。作者以曝光來源紀錄與 OLS 迴歸歸因影響通道,累計直接通道關聯可達信念尺度的一至三分之一。限制包括:先驗由 Personalized PageRank 派生而與網路位置耦合、僅五張圖與兩個隨機種子、英文陳述且未對人類說服資料驗證。此研究對多代理安全評估具警示意義:信念傳播應以軌跡與曝光層級監測,而非只看最終答案。

links.title: Beyond Static Interpretability: Anticipating Post-SFT Mechanisms from Pre-SFT Parameters for Better Tuning

evidence: Abstract: proposes 'forward-looking localization framework that accurately estimates the post-SFT interpretability state using only pre-SFT parameters'; claims first work to predict future interpretability states (Section 1 contributions).

Section 5.1: primary model Mistral-7B with LLaMA-2-13B and Qwen3-30B for scalability; standardized hyperparameters (lr 1e-5, 3 epochs, LoRA rank 8, NVIDIA RTX A6000); PTA computed via lm-evaluation-harness.
Section 5.2, Table 1: Ours (C) achieves 100.00±0.00 TTA on LR and MR, 87.55±0.04 on NLU, beating CircuitLoRA; paper notes component-level LoRA adaptability may explain neuron-vs-component gap.

Section 5.3, Table 2: ablations vs Full-Param, Random, Static, Probing (e.g., MR neuron-level: Ours 98.79 vs Static 55.83, Probing 87.16); Figure 3 shows Static/Probing degrade on harder arithmetic tasks.

Section 5.2: authors acknowledge localization time cost 'escalates prominently with model size' and that gradual fine-tuning time growth 'may be partially attributed to the inherent simplicity of the chosen target tasks'.
Section 6 Limitations: framework restricted to single-token-generation tasks, limiting applicability to multi-token instruction SFT; polysemantic-neuron conflicts unresolved.
Appendix G, Figure 9: robustness across SFT seeds, probing samples, K sampling (Spearman rho>=0.83, CV<=0.0018).
Appendix D, Table 3: full dataset statistics, prompt templates, and single-token label constraint; Appendix J: ablations justifying 1%-data/1-epoch/1%-lr probing SFT.
Abstract/code link: 'Code is available at: https://github.com/Zodiark-ch/Future_localization'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM methodology paper: mechanistic interpretability (attribution patching, circuit analysis) applied to guiding parameter-efficient SFT of Mistral-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and Qwen3-30B on reasoning/NLU benchmarks. The forward-looking localization idea (predicting post-SFT mechanisms via Taylor expansion and an exponential translation operator) is a genuinely novel twist on the existing locating-then-tuning paradigm, though it is assembled from established components. Rigor is good: theory with derivations (Appendices A-C), four-way ablations (Full-Param/Random/Static/Probing), multi-scale experiments, robustness analysis over stochastic factors (Appendix G: rho>=0.83, CV<=0.0018), and honest limitations. Evidence is solid but constrained to single-token-output tasks, with the 'ideal model' replaced by a full-fine-tuned surrogate and the authors admitting the time-cost scalability result is confounded by task simplicity (Section 5.2); generalizability to realistic instruction-tuning is explicitly flagged as unresolved (Section 6). Reproducibility is supported by a public code URL, dataset/prompt details (Appendix D), and standardized hyperparameters (Section 5.1).

links.title: Transforms for LLM Quantization: The Great Inversion and Format Co-Design

evidence: Abstract & Section 1 contribution (v): 'we run no new benchmark and estimate no number: every reported measurement below is transcribed verbatim from a cited table or figure' — establishes secondhand-evidence character.

Section 4, Theorem 4.3 and Proposition 2.11: opposition of geometric-mean (Schur-concave) and group-max (sum of per-group maxima) surrogates under within-group majorization; Section 2.5 concedes 'Neither half of the opposition is new mathematics'.

Section 11.3 / Table 13: verbatim Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct FP4 numbers — QuaRot global Hadamard craters on MXFP4 (Avg. 62.90 vs RTN 69.32) while block-confined Hadamard helps (70.45 RTN / 73.65 GPTQ); 'The sign reversal itself rests on Chen et al. (2026a)'s table alone.'

Section 4, Figure 3 caption: the inversion illustration is 'one layer of one 1.1B model' (TinyLlama q-projection, 3072 wikitext-2 tokens), 'illustrates the two costs rather than measuring their magnitude at deployment scale'.

Section 10.5: shipped-release verification of gpt-oss-120b (MXFP4, attention/router excluded), Kimi K2 Thinking (INT4 QAT experts), DeepSeek (rotate_activation on indexer FP4 path), Meta Llama 3.2 SpinQuant-vs-QLoRA pair — grounds the weight/activation path split.

Section 13 closing limits: 'we run no benchmarks of our own'; 'the three scripts behind them... will be released with the paper'; surrogate-vs-deployed gap flagged as open problem 2 (sum M_g^2 not computed on the two deployed MXFP4 rotation maps).

Section 11 preamble: one-protocol-per-comparison discipline with cross-source displays flagged, and each head-to-head table transcribed from a paper proposing one of its own rows — margins acknowledged as potentially generous.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A survey squarely on core LLM efficiency topics (4-bit PTQ, transform-then-round pipelines, FP4/MX formats, serving), matching the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, scaling/efficiency, inference/serving, transformer architecture); no out-of-scope domain. Its organizing contribution — the 'Great Inversion' that allocation-flexible coding rewards energy concentration (KLT) while shared-scale quantization rewards within-group flattening (Hadamard/whitening), proved as an opposition of surrogate objectives — is a genuinely new synthesis, but the paper itself concedes the underlying mathematics is standard ('Neither half of the opposition is new mathematics', Sec. 2.5), so novelty is that of a strong survey framing rather than a new method. Rigor is high: it carefully separates surrogates from the realized deployed error (Theorem 4.3 vs. Sec. 13's open problem 2), states Assumption 4.1 as a property of current tensor cores, marks the MXFP4 global-vs-block rotation contrast as 'measured, not explained', and labels its own computations as single-layer illustrations. Evidence is methodologically disciplined (verbatim transcription, one-protocol-per-comparison, re-verification, Section 11) but almost entirely secondhand: 'we run no benchmark and estimate no number' (contributions (v)), the central concentrate-vs-flatten opposition rests on surrogate proofs plus a one-layer TinyLlama illustration (Figure 3), and the FP4 sign-reversal rests on one source's table with only weaker corroboration (Liu et al. 2025b; Table 5). Generalizability is decent — the axes are applied across weights, KV cache, attention, SSMs, diffusion, and gradients, with explicit extension limits — though bounded by a fixed-rate-hardware premise and a June 2026 freeze. Reproducibility is middling: detailed protocols for its own figures, a complete 200-work index (Table 18), but code only promised ('will be released with the paper') and no new artifacts to rerun. Weighted total ≈ 0.77.

Yet we are aware of no survey dedicated to this transform stage, and its literature is quietly re-deriving an older theory. We identify and formalize the principle that organizes it, the Great Inversion: allocation-flexible coding rewards ene
papers.summary_zh: 這是一篇聚焦低比特量化「轉換階段」的系統性回顧,整理 200 篇文獻並分類 43 種轉換方法。核心命題是「大反轉」:可彈性分配位元的古典轉換編碼獎勵能量集中(KLT 為最佳),而部署中每群共用一個縮放因子的分組量化則在均勻格點上獎勵群內平坦化(Hadamard 近乎最佳,WUSH 更以資料感知白化達到隨機 AbsMax 模型的最優),兩個代理目標在群內優序兩端互斥,對一般頻譜不存在跨域保證。第二大軸是數字格式:FP4 非均勻格點削弱平坦化收益,理想浮點格點上旋轉甚至可能有害;MXFP4 的二次方群縮放使區塊內旋轉有益而全域旋轉災難性失效,NVFP4 帶尾數的縮放則大幅減弱旋轉需求。回顧亦涵蓋與 GPTQ 型捨入的組成關係(組成、替代、協同最佳化)、KV-cache 與注意力矩陣乘法等權重矩陣之外的應用,以及反量化稅與變長編碼僅能作為儲存層存活的系統分析。作者僅轉錄已發表數字,並整理依部署情境的選型指南與評測陷阱清單。開放問題包括轉換與捨入的聯合最佳性、部署目標的保證、可變率編碼重返推論路徑,以及轉換—格式協同設計。此回顧為龐雜的量化轉換文獻提供了統一架構。

Table 2: PA-GRPO (beta_trial=0.100) reaches best four-benchmark average 84.7% (AIME24 78.2, AIME25 68.9, Math500 94.2, AMC 97.5) at 14.5k token latency vs ThreadWeaver 81.0% at 14.8k

Table 5 (Section 4.2): wall-clock on A800 GPUs over 30 AIME24 problems (6 hard): parallel 487.3s vs sequential 716.3s, i.e., 1.47x on hard; wall-clock speedups 1.38-1.62x across difficulties vs abstract's 1.7x token-level claim

Section 4 Training Data Curation: parallel data built from 964 Qwen3-8B ThreadWeaver traces labeled by Gemini-3-Flash; RL on Polaris-53k; hyperparameters in Section 4 (lr 1e-6 RL, 1e-5 SFT, batch 128/16)

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an LLM reasoning/training/inference co-design paper matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT test-time scaling, GRPO-style RL, scaling/efficiency, inference serving via SGLang, structured tool-call execution), though no Japanese NLP content. Novelty is moderate: the Subtask-vs-Trial taxonomy is a useful reframing and the empirical finding that Trial parallelism dominates hard problems (Table 1) is interesting, but parallel reasoning itself is a crowded area and the method builds directly on ThreadWeaver data and Multiverse-style branching. Rigor is decent: multi-benchmark eval (AIME24/25, Math500, AMC), beta/alpha sweeps, latency-budget ablations (Table 3), and wall-clock measurement (Table 5); however, the taxonomy analysis uses only 100 problems with LLM annotation and, for closed models, only summary statistics (Table 1 caption), no variance/significance reporting, and a single 8B model family. Evidence is largely consistent with tables, but the headline 1.7x is token-level while measured wall-clock gains are 1.38-1.62x (Table 5), and code/dataset are only promised ('will open-source'). Generalizability is limited by math-only training/eval and 8B scale, acknowledged in Appendix A. Reproducibility benefits from detailed hyperparameters, prompts (Appendix B), and problem indices (Appendix C), but depends on a proprietary annotator (Gemini-3-Flash) and unverified release.

Parallel reasoning offers a natural remedy. However, prior systems primarily focus on Subtask Parallelism, where the model learns to decompose a high-level task into smaller chunks that can be solved independently. This approach
papers.summary_zh: 測試時推理讓 LLM 解題能力大增,但自迴歸解碼迫使長推理鏈序列執行,難題延遲可達數天。既有平行推理研究多聚焦子任務平行:將任務拆解成可獨立求解的分支。本文指出另一被忽視的形態——嘗試平行:多個投機分支並行探索、驗證與彙整競爭假設。對 OpenMathReasoning 與 Humanity's Last Exam 的註解分析顯示,嘗試平行佔可平行推理的大宗,在 DeepSeek-V4 的 HLE 推理中達 65.5%,且題目越難占比越高。據此,Parason 以上下文無關文法將序列推理軌跡轉為可被引擎解析的平行結構,並提出平行感知的 PA-GRPO 強化學習,獎勵同時兼顧正確性、最長 token 路徑延遲與兩種平行比例,再以工具呼叫在 SGLang 中實際執行。在 AIME24、AIME25、Math500、AMC 上平均加速約 1.7 倍且準確率具競爭力;延遲受限下,2,048 token 預算內 AIME24 準確率由 16.8% 升至 34.7%。消融顯示嘗試獎勵主要提升準確率、子任務獎勵主要縮短關鍵路徑,且更難的題目產生更多可平行工作。限制在於訓練與評估集中於數學領域,且僅在 8B 規模驗證。此工作凸顯平行推理需同時涵蓋分解與探索兩種語義。

links.title: DataKernelBench: Can LLMs Optimize Database Queries on GPUs?

evidence: Section 4.2 / Table 1: GPT-5.5 CUDA-full achieves 100% pass rate and 2.11x overall speedup over TorchPlan-compile on TPC-H SF10 with an H100; Sirius reported at 1.37x.
Section 4.3: all 22 GPT-5.5 CUDA-full implementations passed source audits (semantic_match, no_cheating) and held-out differential testing on SF1 and a perturbed SF10 dataset.
Section 4.6 / Table 2: full-level optimization yields mean speedup gains of +0.31 (CUDA) and +0.29 (Triton) for top-5 models versus +0.02 and +0.05 for bottom-5 models.
Section 4.7 / Table 3: prompt ablation conducted only for GPT-5.5 (full); removing data context drops speedup by -0.40 (CUDA) and -0.22 (Triton) versus -0.27 and -0.06 for GPU context.

Appendix F: 880 trajectories analyzed (22 queries x 10 models x 2 frameworks x 2 levels); 77.5% eventually produce a correct kernel with at least 1.05x speedup; failure categories and per-query difficulty reported.

Section 6 (Limitations): primary evaluation is one setting (TPC-H SF10, single H100), PyTorch/Triton/CUDA stack only, and the benchmark does not evaluate the full path from arbitrary SQL to an optimized kernel.

Section 3: artifacts (prompts, validated TorchPlans, evaluation harness) are promised for release at github.com/kerneldf/datakernelbench; release is stated as future intent, not verified availability.
Appendix H: SF100 Dask-cuDF multi-GPU runtime falls from 77.5s to 36.44s (kernel plans) as GPUs scale 1 to 4, with speedup decreasing from 3.53x to 2.54x versus TorchPlan-compile.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM benchmark paper evaluating ten proprietary and open-weight LLMs on CUDA/Triton kernel synthesis for database queries, squarely matching LLM and code-generation preferences. Novelty is real but moderate: it adapts the KernelBench-style evaluation paradigm to database-style operators via a TorchPlan IR built on prior Tensor Query Processing work. Rigor is strong: 880 generation trajectories, execution-guided repair with fixed thresholds, hierarchical correctness checks, source audits and held-out differential testing of the top configuration (Section 4.3), core-vs-full and prompt ablations, generator-sensitivity check (Appendix D), and an honest limitations section. Evidence is largely internally consistent and quantitative, though headline claims such as 'workload context matters more than hardware context' (Table 3) rest on a single model, best-config-per-model leaderboard selection is optimistic, and no variance/error bars are reported. Generalizability is constrained: one workload (TPC-H SF10), one GPU (H100), one software stack, with SF100 multi-GPU as a proof of concept only. Reproducibility is supported by detailed hyperparameters and environment tables, but artifact release is only promised, and reliance on proprietary APIs with default settings limits independent replication.

primary_link.title: DataKernelBench: Can LLMs Optimize Database Queries on GPUs?

papers.summary: GPUs increasingly accelerate database systems, but query-specific peak performance still often relies on hand-written kernels. Existing LLM kernel benchmarks focus on machine learning operators, leaving irregular, heterogeneous, data-movement-heavy database-style operators untested. We introduce DataKernelBench, which translates SQL into validated PyTorch TorchPlan programs and evaluates LLMs that optimize either the core tensor-bounded snippet or the full query in CUDA or Triton through executi
papers.summary_zh: GPU 加速資料庫日益普及,但查詢專屬的巔峰效能仍常依賴手寫核心;現有 LLM 核心基準多針對規則的機器學習運算子,未涵蓋不規則、資料搬運密集的資料庫風格運算。本文提出 DataKernelBench:先將 SQL 翻譯成經驗證的 PyTorch 程式 TorchPlan 作為中間表示,再要求 LLM 在執行引導修復迴圈下,以 CUDA 或 Triton 最佳化核心熱路徑或整條查詢,並以 DuckDB 校驗正確性。在 TPC-H SF10 與 H100 上評測十種專有與開源模型:最佳組合 GPT-5.5 搭配 CUDA-full 達 100% 通過率與對 torch.compile 2.11 倍加速,也超過 GPU 資料庫 Sirius 的 1.37 倍;開源模型最佳為 Qwen3.5-397B 的 1.26 倍。計畫分析顯示主要收益來自核心融合與執行策略改變(如免具體化連接),查詢越複雜優勢越小。提示消融發現工作負載脈絡比硬體脈絡更重要;full 級最佳化僅對強模型帶來增益。另以 Dask-cuDF 分區在四張 H100 上處理 TPC-H SF100,達 2.54 倍加速。限制包括單一硬體設定、PyTorch 技術棧,以及未評測從任意 SQL 到核心的完整路徑。此基準顯示 LLM 生成核心可作為特定重複查詢的實用最佳化路徑。

links.title: Do System Prompts Leave Behavioral Fingerprints? A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Clone Detection via Output Similarity

Section 7.2/Table 7: embedding ablation MiniLM/BGE-large/GTE-large mean AUC difference <0.02; lexical TF-IDF degrades cross-model (MNLI Claude->GPT: BBF 0.893 vs TF-IDF 0.772).

Section 8.2/Table 5: adaptive prefix injection collapses MNLI detection 0.978->0.547 under formal academic tone while MMLU holds at 0.863; Limitations concede BBF should not be deployed against detector-aware adversaries.

Section 3.4/7.1: DQO proxy validated with Pearson r=-0.516 between baseline similarity and gap (n=32,000); MMLU held-out AUC lifts 0.878->0.980; Propositions 1-2 in Appendix A.2 with stated independence/monotonicity assumptions.

Limitations: evaluation restricted to 8 text benchmarks, 4 mid-tier commercial APIs, single-turn; no multimodal, agent, RAG, or frontier-scale coverage; only four prefix strategies on two benchmarks tested.
Ethics Statement: code and data 'will be released with the camera-ready version' (not yet available); Appendix D provides example prompt triplet and all 128 scenario AUCs (Table 9).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM security/evaluation paper: black-box detection of stolen system prompts via output-embedding similarity, clearly relevant to LLM (2.5), AI Safety (2.0), Prompting (1.5), and Red Teaming/Evaluation (1.8) preferences; not a domain application. Novelty is solid but bounded: the problem framing (post-extraction prompt-clone detection, distinct from model fingerprinting/watermarking) is new, while the method is intentionally simple centroid cosine similarity with an unrelated-prompt control, and DQO is a one-shot ranking heuristic. Rigor is above average: 128 scenarios (4x4x8), 288,000 responses, effect-size analysis (eta^2=0.244), query-level correlation (r=-0.516, n=32,000), embedding and lexical-baseline ablations, Hoeffding-style aggregation bound, and honest failure taxonomy (11 failures; CUAD artifact disclosed, method-attributable 6/112). Main caveats: the detection task is a binary test against a single same-domain unrelated prompt (easier than multi-prompt identification), main-experiment clones are author-written paraphrases (extraction fidelity only simulated in Appendix B.3), and query-level AUC assumes query independence. Evidence is strong and transparently reported, including the damaging adaptive result (Section 8.2: formal-tone prefix collapses MNLI 0.978 to 0.547) and candid Limitations (single-turn, 8 text benchmarks, 4 mid-tier APIs, no agent/multimodal/RAG). Generalizability is moderate (LOOCV cross-domain 0.793; small-sample enterprise appendix with mean gap +0.194, 15/16 significant). Reproducibility is decent: Algorithm 1, prompt triplets, model versions, and sampling parameters are specified and supplementary per-scenario tables are provided, but code/data are only promised for camera-ready.

primary_link.title: Do System Prompts Leave Behavioral Fingerprints? A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Clone Detection via Output Similarity

papers.summary: System prompts can be extracted from commercial LLMs with over 80\% success and redeployed at zero cost, yet a prompt owner has no way to verify whether a suspected deployment is a clone. We propose Black-Box Behavioral Fingerprinting (BBF): the prompt owner registers a behavioral signature from model outputs and later tests whether a suspect deployment matches that signature more closely than an unrelated baseline. BBF requires only black-box API access. Through a large-scale study (4 model fam
papers.summary_zh: 系統提示可被以逾 80% 成功率從商業 LLM 提取並零成本重部署,但提示擁有者缺乏驗證疑似克隆的手段。本文提出黑盒行為指紋識別 BBF:擁有者先對原始部署蒐集診斷查詢的輸出,以句嵌入質心註冊行為簽章,之後比較疑似部署的輸出是否比無關提示基線更接近該簽章,全程只需黑盒 API 存取。研究涵蓋 4 個模型家族、8 個基準、288,000 條回應:提示選擇解釋輸出變異的 24.4%,同模型偵測 AUC 達 0.876;跨模型效能受偵測器身分主導,範圍 0.845(Claude)至 0.665(Qwen),整體均值 0.725。診斷查詢最佳化 DQO 為零成本選題規則,跨模型平均再增 +0.120。方法可抵抗非自適應改寫(AUC 皆不低於 0.889),對不完美提取也穩健;但單句正式語氣前綴可使短結構化輸出(MNLI)的偵測由 0.978 崩落至 0.547,凸顯風格不變偵測是關鍵開放問題。失敗案例集中在短輸出、資料載入異常與特定模型對的風格錯配;25 條診斷查詢即足夠可靠偵測。限制涵蓋自適應攻擊、單輪與純文字情境。此研究為提示智慧財產保護提供事後驗證的實證基礎。
papers.title: Do System Prompts Leave Behavioral Fingerprints? A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Clone Detection via Output Similarity

links.title: Paritok-4B: Intent-Conditioned Context Compression for Coding Agents

evidence: Abstract: '96.2% over 212,506 emitted tokens' identifier-copy rate on held-out SWE-bench Lite output; trained via 'gpt-4.1-mini teacher over 67,074 real OpenHands agent trajectories' with '40,606 validated examples'
§6.2 Table 9: Paritok-4B compresses to 25.7% (raw) / 27.8% (line-numbered) vs gpt-4.1-mini 50.2% and gpt-5 61.9%, with quality retained 86.5%/89.3% over all 300 SWE-bench Lite instances
§6.1 Table 8 and text: released checkpoint DropAcc 0.49 (Wilson 95% CI [0.394,0.587]) vs always-keep baseline 0.59; authors state 'we do not yet beat the trivial baseline on it'
§6.2: '30 instances are solved only uncompressed and 17 only compressed, an exact McNemar p=0.079' with §7 Limitation 9 conceding 'the point estimate is still a net loss of 13 instances'
§4.1 Table 4: level scheme collapses to two bands, P(L0<L1)=0.534 and P(L2<L3)=0.456, 'both within noise of the 0.5'
§2: 'We do not report a head-to-head against LLMLingua-2, and we would rather say why than leave the omission unexplained'; comparison deferred to future work

§5.1: 'The three runs are therefore matched on optimization but not on drop supervision, and we release holdout artifacts only for the 4B run. This subsection is the rationale for the choice, not a benchmarked ablation'
§6.3 Table 10: gpt-5 as compressor is 'net-negative', +$6.30 per 1M tokens vs $3.00 uncompressed, derived from list prices and measured rates

Reproducibility section: weights, five-stage pipeline, eval/extractiveness.py and eval/design_claims_audit.py reproducing Tables 2 and 4, and the SWE-bench harness released Apache 2.0 at github.com/Paritok-official/paritok-4b-v1
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly in-scope LLM methodology paper: a 4B LoRA compressor (Qwen3-4B backbone, gpt-4.1-mini teacher) for coding-agent context, evaluated on SWE-bench Lite with agent trajectories from OpenHands. Strong matches to LLM, Agents, Code, Long Context, and Efficiency preferences. Novelty is moderate: it inherits LLMLingua-2's distillation-into-small-compressor structure and the paper itself concedes no head-to-head was run (§2); the genuinely new elements are per-segment typed compression with whole-segment drops, intent conditioning, and the audit methodology showing intent acts at line level (§4.2, +0.067 paired difference) rather than segment level. Rigor is unusually strong for an industry-style report: Wilson intervals, bootstrap CIs, exact McNemar (p=0.079 honestly reported as non-significant, §6.2), and candid reporting of failed designs (level collapse §4.1, drop-weighting backfire §5.2). Evidence is solid for compression rates (2.0-2.4x harder than GPT compressors over all 300 instances, Table 9) but quality-retention claims rest on wide intervals and a non-significant paired test the authors flag (§7, Limitation 9); the backbone ablation is confounded by a drop-supervision change (§5.1). Generalizability is limited: Python-heavy training, unseen-instance but not unseen-repository OOD (§3.1), single-shot harness that explicitly does not measure multi-turn agent cost. Reproducibility claims are extensive and specific (weights, five-stage pipeline, audit scripts regenerating Tables 2/4 from released corpus, cached eval harness, Apache 2.0). Overall a well-calibrated, above-average contribution whose honesty about limits is itself evidence of care, but whose headline 'no degradation' claim is statistically unresolved and whose core comparison vs. prior compression work is missing.

primary_link.title: Paritok-4B: Intent-Conditioned Context Compression for Coding Agents

papers.summary: Coding agents re-send large file reads and tool outputs to a frontier LLM every turn, and this context dominates their token bill. General-purpose prompt compressors are trained on prose and suit code poorly: they paraphrase identifiers and drop the exact spans an agent needs to edit. We present Paritok-4B, a 4B LoRA compressor for coding-agent trajectories built on two commitments. It is extractive: it selects spans rather than rewriting them, and 96.0% of the identifiers, paths, and numbers it
papers.summary_zh: 程式設計代理每輪都重送大量檔案讀取與工具輸出,上下文主導 token 成本;通用提示壓縮器面向散文訓練,會改寫識別字或遺漏代理編輯所需的精確片段。本文提出 Paritok-4B,一個 4B LoRA 壓縮器,堅持兩項設計:萃取式(僅選取片段而非改寫,訓練語料 96.0%、保留測試 96.2% 的識別字、路徑與數字直接來自輸入)與意圖條件化(依代理當前任務決定保留哪些行,保留行比移除行更具意圖相關性,配對差 +0.067)。訓練以 gpt-4.1-mini 為教師,對 67,074 條真實 OpenHands 軌跡經五階段漏斗蒸餾出 40,606 筆範例,骨幹為 Qwen3-4B。在全部 300 個 SWE-bench Lite 實例上,代理上下文壓至 25.7%,較 gpt-4.1-mini 壓縮器(50.2%)與 gpt-5(61.9%)狠約 2 至 2.4 倍,同時保留 86.5% 單次解題品質;行號格式下為 27.8% 與 89.3%,配對 McNemar p=0.079,即壓至約四分之一大小未顯著降低解題率。主要缺口是低估刪除(drop recall 僅 0.24),且 L0 至 L3 層級設計蒸餾後坍縮為兩帶。成本分析顯示以 gpt-5 當壓縮器淨虧損,而自託管於 24GB GPU 的本地壓縮器才是經濟解。權重、資料管線與評測腳本全數開源。
