links.title: Preference Data Selection for Mitigating the Alignment Tax in Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'we propose BALIGN, a balanced data selection strategy' using 'the reference model's log-probability margin, the token length difference... and the TF–IDF similarity' to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.

Method – Theoretical Analysis, Eq. (13): margin decomposed as m_θ = r̄·Δℓ + (r̄_w − r̄_l)·ℓ̄, motivating the length-difference risk score; analysis is informal with no stated assumptions or formal theorem.

Method – Empirical Analysis, Table 1: bucket experiment on HH-RLHF with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct shows forgetting F rising from 0.08 (lowest-risk bucket) to 3.48 (highest) for the reference-margin score, and alignment gain R dropping to 1.67 for the TF-IDF score.

Table 2 / Table 4: BALIGN achieves forgetting 0.86 vs 5.35 (Full) and 0.38 vs 2.31 (Qwen helpfulness) while alignment gain 4.61/3.39 is comparable to PD (4.61/3.46), at a default 5% sampling ratio following 'prior LLM data selection studies'.

Table 3 (Ablation): removing s_Δp_ref or s_Δℓ worsens forgetting (1.68/1.27 vs 0.86 on Llama helpfulness); removing s_τ cuts alignment gain to 2.39 vs 4.61, supporting complementarity of the three scores.

Experiments – Datasets & Appendix A: alignment uses only HH-RLHF (43,835 helpfulness / 42,537 harmlessness training samples); training details given (batch 128, lr 5e-6 cosine, 3 epochs, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, bfloat16, RTX A6000) but no code or artifact availability claim appears anywhere in the document.
Experiments – Metrics: alignment quality is 'preference accuracy' via log-probability comparison (Eq. 5), a proxy metric; no human evaluation or win-rate assessment is reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment paper squarely within scope (LLMs weight 2.5, Alignment/RLHF 2.0, Training 1.5, Data 0.8): BALIGN selects low-risk preference pairs before DPO to reduce the alignment tax. Preference relevance is near-maximal. Novelty is moderate: preference-data selection for alignment already exists (Selective DPO, BeeS, PD are cited and compared), and the contribution is a lightweight recombination of known signals (reference log-prob margin, length-difference bias — long noted in DPO length exploitation literature — and TF-IDF similarity à la DSIR) under a stability-plasticity framing rather than a new mechanism. Rigor is decent: gradient decomposition motivating the features (Eqs. 9-14), bucket validation (Table 1), 2 models × 2 objectives × 5 benchmarks, 11 baselines at fixed 5% budget, component ablations (Table 3), and compute-time comparison (Fig. 4); but the 'theory' is heuristic (no formal theorem, TF-IDF-to-gradient-orthogonality argument is loose), pinball-score hyperparameters α, γ are tuned empirically, and no significance testing is reported. Evidence is solid within its scope but the alignment metric is log-prob preference accuracy (a weak proxy, no human/win-rate evaluation), only HH-RLHF is tested, and alignment gains are sometimes marginally below specialist baselines (e.g., Qwen helpfulness R=3.39 vs PD 3.46), with the advantage concentrated on forgetting reduction (0.86 vs 5.35 for Full). Generalizability is limited by one dataset, one alignment objective (DPO), 7-8B instruction-tuned models only, and no RLHF/other-preference-source validation. Reproducibility is good on training details (batch 128, lr 5e-6, 3 epochs, ZeRO-3, bfloat16, hardware) but no code or artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Preference Data Selection for Mitigating the Alignment Tax in Large Language Models

papers.summary: Aligning large language models to human preferences is crucial for real-world deployment but frequently incurs an alignment tax, leading to the catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained general capabilities. While previous works primarily frame this problem as an optimization or architectural challenge, the inherent characteristics of preference data that drive this degradation remain largely underexplored. In this paper, we propose BALIGN, a balanced data selection strategy that explicitly mitigat
papers.summary_zh: 將 LLM 對齊人類偏好常伴隨對齊稅:災難性遺忘侵蝕預訓練的通用能力。既有工作多從最佳化或架構切入,資料本身的特性則少被檢視。本文由偏好最佳化梯度出發,理論與實證指出三個決定參數漂移的資料特徵:參考模型的對數機率邊際(reference margin)、選中與拒絕回應的 token 長度差,以及與通用能力語料的 TF-IDF 相似度。前兩者對應穩定性——極端邊際或嚴重長度不對稱的樣本會放大漂移、損害通用能力;後者對應可塑性——與通用語料詞彙高度重疊的樣容易與既有知識梯度干涉,削弱對齊收益。BALIGN 將三個正規化風險分數加權合成複合風險分數,依預算比例篩除高風險樣本後進行 DPO。在 HH-RLHF 資料集、以 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 與 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 為基底的實驗中,僅用 5% 資料即幾乎消除遺忘(如 Llama 有用性遺忘 0.86 對全量 5.35),同時對齊增益與全量訓練相當,並持續佔據帕雷托前緣;消融證明三個分數互補缺一不可,計算開銷僅需一次前向傳播,遠低於梯度式基線。限制在於框架以 DPO 為主、僅在 7 至 8B 模型與 HH-RLHF 上驗證。對需兼顧通用能力與對齊的部署而言,這是低成本的資料層解方。
papers.title: Preference Data Selection for Mitigating the Alignment Tax in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 以偏好資料選擇減輕大型語言模型的對齊稅

links.title: StarHarness: Evolving Harnesses with Stratified Search for Enterprise Environments

evidence: Section 4.2: gains over GEPA (Pi) of +13.8/+22.3/+17.6 pp on ITBench/EnterpriseOps-Gym/AutomationBench, with the authors noting 'The comparison is descriptive... it does not isolate a single causal component.'
Table 1 (Sec. 4.3): frozen harness improves all 12 model-benchmark pairs without re-evolution, e.g., ITBench Qwen3.5-27B 25.6%→70.0% (+44.4 pp).
Table 2 (Sec. 4.4): held-out generalization gains of +31.7, +15.1, +29.3 pp across the three benchmarks for GPT-5.4.
Section 5: 21 accepted patches (4/12/5 across benchmarks); authors state 'We cannot isolate the causal contribution of individual patches from the paired comparisons.'
Section 3.4: guardrails forbid branching on task IDs, verifier content in prompts, and ground-truth/hidden-state access; validator checks scope, imports, and smoke tests.

Section 4.1: headline comparison is in Figure 2 (figure, not table); baselines are default Stirrup, standalone Pi, Codex, and GEPA on Pi; no variance, seeds, or significance testing reported anywhere in the text.

Abstract/Sec. 6: code availability claimed at https://github.com/ServiceNow/StarHarness; Sec. 4.1 links public ITBench dataset; Sec. 4.1 admits AutomationBench setup 'differs from the benchmark paper's default setup, so scores are not directly comparable.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic for LLM agents and tool use: a frozen-weight harness-evolution framework (prompts, tool schemas, MCP providers, subagents) evaluated on three stateful enterprise agent benchmarks with GPT/Qwen models. Methodological novelty is moderate: LLM-driven scaffold evolution exists (GEPA, AFlow, Meta-Harness are cited), and the real contribution is a stricter protocol—failure-mode-stratified task pools, proposer-hidden selection sets, and held-out generalization plus explicit anti-leakage guardrails (Sec. 3.2, 3.4). Rigor is decent but limited: no seeds, variance, or significance tests; the GEPA (Pi) comparison is acknowledged as confounded and 'descriptive' (Sec. 4.2); the tree-vs-hill-climbing comparison is explicitly non-causal (Sec. 3.3); patch-category contributions cannot be isolated (Sec. 5). Evidence is concrete (Tables 1-5 with per-benchmark deltas, e.g., ITBench 40.0%→75.0%, guardrail violations 33→4) but the headline full-benchmark comparison lives in a figure without textual numbers, and single-run results invite overfitting doubts that the held-out design only partially answers. Generalizability is supported by frozen cross-model transfer to Qwen and held-out gains, though all settings are enterprise tool-use with programmatic verifiers. Reproducibility benefits from a claimed GitHub repo and public benchmarks, but relies on a proprietary GPT-5.4 proposer and stochastic LLM search.

primary_link.title: StarHarness: Evolving Harnesses with Stratified Search for Enterprise Environments

papers.summary: We present StarHarness, a framework for evolving environment-specific agent harnesses while keeping model weights fixed. The evolved harness can include prompt and task framing, tool interfaces, skills, MCP-backed providers, subagent structure, and agent-loop configuration. StarHarness constructs a compact evolution pool by stratifying tasks according to baseline failure behavior, separates proposer-visible search tasks from proposer-hidden selection tasks, and reserves held-out tasks for evalua
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理透過框架（harness）決定如何使用工具與解讀環境狀態，但模型與企業環境之間常存在持久錯配。StarHarness 提出在模型權重完全不動的前提下，演化出環境專屬的代理框架，可編輯範圍涵蓋提示與任務框架、工具定義與綱要、技能、MCP 提供者、子代理結構與代理迴圈設定。其做法是先依基線失敗模式將任務分層，取約半數任務組成演化池，並將提案者可見的搜尋任務與提案者不可見的選擇任務分離，另保留 held-out 任務衡量泛化；每個候選修補須通過範圍與洩漏檢查及單任務煙霧測試，再以隱藏選擇集評分，僅保留真正的改進。在 ITBench SRE、EnterpriseOps-Gym ITSM 與 AutomationBench Finance 三個企業基準上，完整基準分數提升 20 至 35 個百分點，明顯超過 GEPA 提示最佳化；演化集外任務的泛化增益達 +15.1 至 +31.7 pp，且同一演化成果可跨 GPT 與 Qwen 模型族免重訓轉移，並同時降低每任務推論成本 17% 至 53%。軌跡分析顯示學得的修補集中在介面修復、環境慣例顯性化，以及壓縮搜尋的作業知識。限制為與 GEPA 的比較屬描述性、無法隔離單一元件的因果貢獻。整體而言，框架演化為有狀態的企業任務提供模型擴展之外的務實互補路線。

links.title: Knowing When to Ask for Help: Bayesian Self-Escalation in Hierarchical LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract/Version note (v1.1): 'adds a first execution of that protocol on a Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B→7B code cascade (Section 8), confirming two of its three predictions; ... the constant-threshold instantiation tested does not exercise the optimal-stopping dynamic program'

Section 10 Limitations: 'Assumption 1 (conditional-i.i.d. signals) is false for real token streams' and 'the option-value contribution over classical sequential testing is not yet exercised empirically'
Reproducibility section: 'All are released with this paper... permanently archived at DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21330787; the full code... is at github.com/nadeem-shaikh/llm-self-escalation'
Section 2 Related Work: candid that 'the stopping mathematics is not new' and positions novelty as formulation plus estimated-likelihood analysis and systems instantiation
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM agent/cascade paper squarely in scope (hierarchical delegation, inference efficiency, calibration), with genuinely careful theory: closed-form myopic threshold, FOSD-based threshold-structure proof avoiding concavity and monotone-likelihood assumptions, a miscalibration-regret bound, and a finite-sample plug-in guarantee. Notably honest: retracts two earlier false claims (Remarks 4-5), labels the simulation as assumption-true by construction, and scopes real-model claims narrowly. Novelty is moderate: the stopping mathematics is classical (SPRT/optimal stopping, acknowledged in Section 2), and the contribution is the formulation of sequential intra-generation deferral plus the calibration-as-binding-constraint message. Empirical evidence is real but narrow: one benchmark (MBPP, 257 tasks), one model pair, greedy decoding, single seed, constant-threshold policy that does not exercise the optimal-stopping DP, and prediction (c) untested; no significance testing. Generalizability is limited by logit-access requirements and untested reasoning/commonsense datasets. Reproducibility is strong: archived scripts, fixed seeds, released real-model pipeline.

primary_link.title: Knowing When to Ask for Help: Bayesian Self-Escalation in Hierarchical LLM Agents

papers.summary: Current LLM agent systems decide delegation before reasoning begins (a router picks a model) or after a response is complete (a verifier scores it and may retry). We study a third regime: an agent that recognises, during its own reasoning, that it is unlikely to succeed and transfers control to a stronger model. We formulate intra-generation delegation as a Bayesian optimal-stopping problem over a learned competence posterior -- an online estimate of the agent's eventual task success whose suffi
papers.summary_zh: 現有的模型路由與串接多在推論前或整段回應完成後才決定是否改用更強模型，缺乏生成中途的原則性判斷。本文將「自我升級」形式化為貝氏最佳停止問題：初階代理對自身最終成功率維護一個由標註軌跡學得的能力後驗，以每步 token 熵、下一 token 邊際等訊號作為證據逐步更新，當繼續計算的期望成本超過升級（交給更強模型）的期望成本時即停止並交接文字層級的脈絡。理論上，作者閉式導出短視升級門檻，以動態規劃刻劃最佳策略，並僅憑單調性（不需凹性或單調概似假設）證明最佳策略為對能力後驗的時變門檻；另給出切諾夫資訊速率的信念分離結果與有限樣本遺憾保證。核心訊息是：額外成本由後驗校準品質決定，「自信地錯」是關鍵失敗模式，改善校準比改善決策規則更重要。模擬研究確認理論各項預測；在 Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B→7B 程式碼串接的預註冊實測中，三項預測有兩項獲得證實：串流升級的成本—準確率前緣在同等算力下優於事後路由（達 75% 準確率省 30.2% 算力），且累積信念的鑑別力隨生成推進近乎單調上升。限制包括條件獨立假設在真實 token 流不成立、實測僅涵蓋單一程式碼基準與常數門檻策略，最佳停止動態規劃尚未在真實系統上驗證。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Centrally an agent-evaluation/assurance paper: it audits whether simulator verdicts for LLM-driven agents (ReAct and planner-executor loops, Hermes harness, gpt-oss/deepseek-r1 configurations in Table 2) survive physical smart-home deployment, aligning strongly with Agents & Tool Use and Red Teaming & Evaluation, moderately with AI Safety (false clearance as oversight failure) and LLMs (agents are LLM-based, but no LLM methodology is advanced). primary_link.title: SimVerity: When Does Simulated Agent Success Survive Physical Deployment?

papers.summary: Simulated evaluation is widely used to benchmark AI agents, yet how much evidence a simulated pass provides about physical deployment has not been systematically quantified. We present SimVerity, a verdict-transfer assurance framework: it replays matched scenarios on target smart home deployments and cross-validates agent execution against independently qualified physical witnesses. Our evaluation highlights that deployment success is a real-world process, not a static property in simulation: co
papers.summary_zh: 模擬評測廣泛用於 AI 代理基準，但模擬通過究竟為實體部署提供多少證據，長期缺乏系統量化。SimVerity 提出判決轉移保證框架：在目標智慧家庭部署上重放相同情境，並以經資格認證的實體見證（如相機）交叉驗證代理執行，輸出含風險、覆蓋率與「通過／棄權／升級」三種處置的判決轉移卡，合約以雜湊鎖定並在測試前凍結。關鍵發現是部署成功是「過程」而非模擬中的靜態屬性：同一執行內，完成回報、回報狀態、可觀察效果與穩定結果可能分歧——先進模擬器在 240 個燈光試驗全部通過，相機卻捕捉到 42 次穩定狀態檢查看不見的亞秒級失敗。錯誤放行（false clearance）亦屬可預測：評測前即鎖定的風險輪廓，在從未實體測過的路徑上預測失敗，於兩個世代共十一個 held-out 會話全部勝過屬性盲基準。代理可稽核性同樣可測且取決於組態：更換某 ReAct 迴圈的模型—客戶端／服務組態，其情境匹配率從 52–88% 恢復至 100%。此外，第二個合格模擬器從未與首個分歧，僅實體測量能暴露兩者共同的盲點。限制為預測證據僅來自一戶家庭與單一 held-out 配對，風險輪廓屬估計而非認證。此框架將判決轉移變成部署前的明確決策，對模擬評測可信度具指標意義。

links.title: Apples to Apples? Towards Comparable Crosslingual Language Model Evaluation

evidence: Abstract: 'several widely used normalized metrics introduce crosslinguistic biases rooted in tokenization, encoding, and orthographic differences'; Sent-NLL over semantically equivalent sequences is the recommended metric.

Section 4, Table 1: Spearman correlations between metrics and confounds show rho=-0.94 (p<0.001) for BPB vs bytes, rho=-0.93 for PPL vs CTC, rho=0.89 for MRR vs CTC, while Sent-NLL shows no significant correlation (rho between -0.38 and 0.19, p>=0.19).
Section 4: 50 GPT2-small models (10 languages x 5 vocab sizes) on Parallel-10 plus 6 GPT2-medium models on Parallel-3; evaluated on FLORES-200, in-domain test split, and PUD.

Section 5, Figure 3: replication of Poelman & de Lhoneux (2026) using WMT2019 EN-DE translation pairs only (DE1, DE2, DE_lowest, DE_highest) shows Sent-NLL rankings are consistent across translation variants; sampling experiment with 15 seeds shows rankings stabilize around 500 sentences.

Section 6, Figure 4: for BLOOM-7B/1B, Chinese ranks worst under BPB/BPC despite 18.3% of training data and Russian ranks best under PPL/Token-NLL despite ~0%, while only Sent-NLL matches expected rankings from training data composition (Table 7).

Appendix E, Tables 5-6: English-only GPT-2 gets better PPL on Russian (9.45) than English (49.77), contradicting MultiBLiMP accuracy (0.97 English vs 0.43 Russian), while Sent-NLL correctly ranks English best.

Limitations section: 'Our evaluation only covers 10 languages'; translation-variant experiments limited to English-German; approach 'relies on high-quality parallel sentences' limiting low-resource applicability.

Footnote 1: code released at github.com/xiulinyang/multilingual-eval and models at huggingface.co/parallelm; Table 4 reports full training hyperparameters (10 epochs, lr 5e-4, batch 128, context 128).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled empirical study of fair crosslingual evaluation metrics for language models, squarely relevant to LLM/NLP evaluation methodology (LLM weight 2.5, evaluation/benchmark 1.8, NLP 1.5), though not Japanese-specific and lacking ties to agents, reasoning, or safety. Novelty is moderate: the bias arguments (byte/length premium, tokenizer fertility) build on prior theory and Poelman & de Lhoneux (2026), but the paper claims and delivers the first systematic empirical validation across six metrics, 50+ controlled monolingual models, and nine multilingual LLMs, with a clear three-criterion framework. Rigor is strong: parallel-data monolingual models isolate metric effects from model confounds, three datasets, Spearman correlation tests, seed-based sample-size analysis, and replication of the prior conflicting result. Evidence is direct and quantitative (Table 1 correlations rho>0.8 for confounded metrics vs. non-significant for Sent-NLL; Appendix E shows English-only GPT-2 getting PPL 9.45 on Russian vs 49.77 on English). Generalizability is limited by the 10-language sample, EN-DE-only translation-variant test, and dependence on parallel data, though the metric-bias argument is mathematical and validated at scale. Reproducibility is excellent: code, models, hyperparameters, and corpus details are released.

primary_link.title: Apples to Apples? Towards Comparable Crosslingual Language Model Evaluation

papers.summary: Crosslingual evaluation of language models that enables fair comparisons remains a fundamental challenge in multilingual NLP. Existing studies adopt a variety of downstream tasks and intrinsic metrics with different theoretical justifications, yet there has been little empirical investigation into whether these approaches yield meaningful crosslingual conclusions. We systematically examine crosslingual evaluation approaches using controlled monolingual language models trained on parallel data wi
papers.summary_zh: 跨語言公平比較語言模型是多語 NLP 的根本挑戰，但各研究採用的內在指標理論依據不一，其跨語言結論是否可靠缺乏系統實證。本文以 50 個在平行語料上訓練、涵蓋五種詞彙表大小的單語 GPT-2 模型，系統比較六種內在指標，並在 BLOOM、mGPT、XGLM、Qwen、Llama 等多語模型上驗證。作者提出公平指標三準則：不受工程選擇（分詞、編碼、文字系統）驅動、對語義等價的翻譯變體穩健、且同時適用單語與多語模型。結果顯示六種指標中五種至少違反一項：perplexity 與 Token-NLL 對分詞高度敏感，模型未見過的語言因過度切分反而得到較佳分數；BPB 與 BPC 受位元組數與字元數的系統性偏誤，常低估中文等文字系統；MRR 則依賴固定的詞彙表大小。只有對語義等價序列計算的句子級 NLL（Sent-NLL）滿足三項準則：與字元數、位元組數或 token 數的相關不顯著，跨翻譯替代版本排名一致，且在多語模型上重現訓練資料組成的預期排序。作者另討論翻譯基準、文化特定與語言特定任務在下游評測的挑戰，並坦承 Sent-NLL 仍殘留語言內在複雜度的混雜，但已是常用內在指標中偏誤最小者。此結論對多語評測實務與資源配置具直接指導意義。

links.title: Linear Probing Provides Robust and Efficient Detection of Machine-Generated Text

evidence: Abstract/§1: probes improve OOD detection by +11 AUC and need <100 training samples to reach near-peak performance
§5.2 Table 1: in-domain AUC across 16 settings (DetectRL, MultiSocial, RAID, TSM) with gains of +0.04 to +18.85 over the strongest of 16 baselines
§5.3 Table 2: OOD mean AUC improvements over training-based detectors of +0.39 to +11.89, with full transfer matrix in Appendix Figure 10
§5.4 Figure 4: pairwise cosine similarities of layer-16 probing vectors show high within-benchmark and moderate cross-benchmark alignment, supporting a shared latent MGT direction
§3.2 Figure 3: MGT representations show lower entropy, effective rank, and intrinsic dimensionality but higher anisotropy than HWT, offered as the explanation for linear separability

Appendix D Tables 7-9: ablations over pooling, layer selection, model family/size (Llama, Qwen 0.6B-32B), regularization C, and PCA components; Tables 8/10 show PCA vs no-PCA differences are near-zero

§5.6 Figure 6: probe projection scores correlate with APT-Eval edit-strength metrics (Pearson r reported), and Appendix Table 5 gives three-way human/AI-edited/AI-generated classification accuracy 0.848-0.854
Limitations: probes require access to model internals, so applicability is limited to open-source models; no claim of a universal MGT direction is made
Appendix B.4: probe training including activation extraction and inference takes 1-3 minutes on an A100 40GB; code release on GitHub is claimed in the Abstract
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM/NLP interpretability paper: it studies the linear separability of machine- vs human-written text in LLM latent space using linear probes, the Linear Representation Hypothesis, and representation-quality metrics, directly matching the Interpretability (linear probing, probing vectors), LLM (Llama-3-8B/Qwen backbones), and NLP/detection preferences. Methodological novelty is moderate: linear probes and PCA directions for MGT detection exist (RepreGuard, TextFluoroscopy, ID), but the representation-geometry explanation of linearity, cross-layer probe variants, shared-direction analysis, sample-efficiency findings, and the continuous 'machineness'/AI-edit-strength correlation are genuine contributions. Rigor is strong: 4 benchmarks, 16 baselines, ID+OOD protocols, extensive ablations (pooling, layers, model family/size, regularization, PCA k, text length, calibration), and an honest Limitations section, though DetectRL saturation limits headroom and significance testing is limited to seed variance. Evidence is quantitative and consistent with the tables (up to +18.85 ID and +11.89 OOD AUC; Pearson correlations for edit strength). Generalizability is well explored across domains, languages, generators, and model families, but the method requires white-box hidden-state access, acknowledged as a limitation. Reproducibility is good: public benchmarks, stated hyperparameters, and a code-release claim, though no exact repository URL is given in the text.

primary_link.title: Linear Probing Provides Robust and Efficient Detection of Machine-Generated Text

papers.summary: Distinguishing machine-generated text (MGT) from human-written text (HWT) becomes increasingly important due to potential misuse. However, most supervised detectors often degrade out-of-domain (OOD) and require large, diverse training sets. In this work, we analyze the linearity and quality of MGT representations and show that simple linear probes outperform a wide range of detectors while being substantially more sample-efficient. We first show that MGT and HWT latent representations are linear
papers.summary_zh: 監督式機器生成文字（MGT）偵測器常在領域外退化且需要大量訓練資料。本文從潛在空間幾何出發，發現人寫文字（HWT）與 MGT 的隱藏狀態表徵在低維空間中線性可分：以遞增非線性的 MLP 探測時，領域內與領域外表現反而隨複雜度下降，支持線性決策邊界；表徵品質分析進一步顯示 MGT 的表示更壓縮、更各向異性、內在維度更低，而 HWT 更豐富多元，解釋了單一超平面即可有效分離。據此，作者訓練兩種簡單線性探測器：逐層平均的 LLP 與跨層串接的 CLP，在 PCA 降至約 2.4% 原始維度後以正規化邏輯迴歸訓練，並以投影分數進行偵測。以 Llama-3-8B 為骨幹，在 DetectRL、MultiSocial、RAID 與 TSM 四基準、16 個評測設定對比 16 個基線：領域內最多提升 18 AUC，領域外平均提升約 11 AUC；僅需 10 至 100 筆樣本即近峰值，抽樣不確定性也低於微調 RoBERTa 等基線。探測向量在各資料集間高度對齊，指向共享且可轉移的 MGT 線性方向；投影分數更與 AI 編輯強度指標（餘弦相似度、編輯距離）強相關，可刻劃連續的「機器性」光譜，支援對 AI 潤飾文字的細粒度估計。限制包括需存取模型內部（僅適用開源模型）、未系統研究規模效應，且結果不必然證明存在普適的 MGT 方向。

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 1,296 controlled synthetic episodes, matched direct-handoff controls preserve every blocker' and 'normal handoff compression produces 100.0% deactivation and 54.2% forbidden action' — the headline quantitative results.

Section 5 / Table 2: controls P0, S0, C0, E0 all show P=100.0, D=0.0, Unsafe=0.0, establishing that degradation is attributable to the transformation conditional on correct upstream identification (all 1,296 episodes satisfy Dup=1, Sec. 4.2).

Section 6.2 / Table 3: restoring all four fields raises P to 100.0% and unsafe to 0.0%; leave-one-field-out shows only label omission reintroduces 7.0% forbidden action, with field-necessity ranking explicitly left inconclusive.

Section 6.3 / Appendix E.2: endpoint verification (hard auth, permission lookup, human approval) reduces forbidden action from 85.2% to 0.0% while P stays fixed at 4.7%, cleanly separating preservation from containment.
Appendix C / Table 11: worst-case label flips keep the deactivation contrast identified-positive at 20% but make the endpoint contrast inconclusive at 15-20%, an honest evidence-scope limitation.

Appendix F / Tables 16-18: blind five-judge audit recovers an 88.84-point deactivation gap (overall actionability kappa=0.887, macro F1 0.916), but owner-field concordance is only 65.25% (macro F1 0.636), narrowing claims about the authority component.

Appendix G / Table 19: model-level heterogeneity is large (deactivation 2.9% for GPT-5.4 non-thinking vs 70.4% for DS-V4-Pro non-thinking), so transport is confined to the 13 measured variants; framework-transfer checks use only n=8 per condition (Table 21).

Section 4 / Table 1 and Appendix H: the five transformation families and handoff artifacts are constructed by the experimental harness rather than harvested from real workflow traces; the paper itself states production prevalence and other binding-state classes are 'outside estimand' (Table 12), and no code or data availability statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic for LLM agent safety and orchestration (multi-agent handoffs, agent misbehavior, unsafe endpoint actions), matching the highest-weight preferences. The core idea—separating 'semantic availability' from 'operational preservation' of binding state across handoff artifacts—is a well-articulated middle-layer estimand, but it is an incremental isolation of one transition within the cited constraint-drift program (Li et al., arXiv:2605.10481, Related Work), so novelty is moderate. Rigor is high for a controlled-synthetic design: matched direct-preservation controls, task-cluster bootstrap CIs, leave-one-domain/model-out slices, blind five-judge audit (kappa 0.887), and a label-flip evidence-state ledger. Evidence is strong for the internal claims but all experiments use synthetic enterprise tasks with abstract, non-operational actions, and the five transformation families (Table 1) are experimenter-designed operations, raising the question of whether degradation reflects emergent model behavior or constructed artifacts; the label-flip analysis itself downgrades the endpoint contrast to inconclusive at 15-20% error. Generalizability is honestly and explicitly scoped to the controlled blocker family, with only tiny framework-transfer checks (n=8 per condition in LangGraph/AutoGen). Reproducibility is moderately supported by detailed coding rules (Appendix Table 5) and per-model accounting (Tables 19-20), but no code, data, or artifact release is stated anywhere in the document.

primary_link.title: When "Must" Becomes "Maybe": Constraint Weakening in LLM Agent Workflows

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate complex tasks through multi-role and multi-stage workflows. Upstream state is repeatedly transformed into intermediate language artifacts, such as summaries, plans, tickets, memories, and handoff notes, from which downstream components act. For action-constraining state, topical retention is insufficient: an artifact may mention an unresolved condition while changing it from a requirement that must be resolved before execution into information that ma
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理工作流常將上游狀態改寫成摘要、計畫、工單、記憶或交接筆記等中間語言產物，供下游據以行動。本文指出，對具行動約束力的狀態而言，僅保留內容並不足夠：一條未解決條件可能在傳遞中從「執行前必須解決」弱化為「僅供參考」。作者將此定義為操作狀態保存問題，以安全阻斷器（含停止狀態、未解決前置條件、負責權責與可行後備四個欄位）使之可測量，並在 1,296 個受控合成情境中，以上游正確識別為前提、僅改變交接轉換來識別退化。結果顯示：匹配的直接交接對照 100% 保存所有阻斷器且無違規行動；而壓縮、計畫同化、收斂框架、權責下放與先例替換反覆把具約束力的狀態變成附帶條件——僅產物級壓縮探針即達 100% 去活化與 54.2% 禁止行動。修復實驗顯示，還原全部四個欄位可將保存率回升至 100%、禁止行動歸零；但在固定產物下，下游驗證（如權限查核）雖能消除禁止行動，產物去活化仍維持 95.3%，證明「保存」與「遏制」是互補且獨立的系統功能。多模型盲審佐證了測量的可移植性；限制為結論限於受控任務族與此阻斷器類別，生產環境盛行率屬另類估計目標。核心啟示：語義可得不等於操作保存，交接轉換值得成為工作流可靠性的獨立估計單位。

links.title: Meta$^n$: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth

Appendix E.3: emergent-role analysis annotated by LLM raters (GPT-5.2 and Kimi-K2.6) over 596 emissions; mean Cohen's kappa 0.59, weakest on tactical primitives (0.37) and compositional architectures (0.30), a methodological weakness for the 'emergent roles' claim.

Appendix C Tables 5-6 and Appendix D: per-benchmark hyperparameters, token spend, sandboxing/static-analysis safeguards, and seed policy disclosed; Sec 3.1 Setup admits deviations (TB2 stdevs across categories, single-seed GPT-5.2 TB2, no held-out split for AE Math/AlgoTune/SR), which weakens the archive-best estimator on those benchmarks.
Sec 4 Limitations: same model at base solver and Omega invocations is acknowledged as untested in heterogeneous settings; observed depth range 3-6 with convergence-based stopping.
Abstract/availability: code at github.com/minnesotanlp/meta-n claimed; full Omega prompt template not included (only depth-2 pre-process output in Appendix F).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent architecture paper (self-improving agents with a fixed meta-operation applied recursively) squarely within Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, and Code preferences. Novelty is solid: the taxonomy of meta-improvement paradigms (fixed meta-depth ~2.5 in prior self-referential agents) and the 'recurse on input, freeze the operator' design with emergent layer roles is a genuine reframing, though the mechanism is still iterative LLM code/prompt scaffolding close to OpenEvolve/ADAS-style search. Rigor is above average: two backbones, three seeds with stdevs, component ablations (Table 3: outer-context removal -0.094, recursion removal -0.131/-0.158), compute-parity capping against OpenEvolve (S2D 0.732 vs 0.718 at capped budget), a 10x budget escalation against Godel Agent (0.502->0.628), and a consolidation study with a compute-matched control and CI. Evidence strength is dented by real inconsistencies: the abstract/intro claim that on ARC-AGI-2 'it alone scores above zero' and 'both OpenEvolve and Godel Agent solve none' contradicts Table 2 (OE 0.003, GA 0.054 on dev), and no held-out ARC-AGI-2 baseline numbers are actually reported; the archive-best estimator is per-task max selection and is used on benchmarks without held-out splits (AlphaEvolve Math, AlgoTune, SR), inviting selection inflation; the emergent-role analysis rests on LLM raters with mean Cohen's kappa 0.59 and 0.30-0.37 on the most abstract categories (Appendix E.3). Generalizability is reasonably argued (failure-mode diversity analysis, explicit negative cases AlgoTune/SWE-Bench), but the method is LLM-scaffolding-specific. Reproducibility benefits from a GitHub link, per-benchmark hyperparameters (Table 5), token costs (Table 6), and the full depth-2 injection (Appendix F), but depends on closed/proprietary models and partially specified prompts. Overall a strong, on-topic agent paper with noteworthy but not disqualifying evidentiary overreach.

primary_link.title: Meta$^n$: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth

papers.summary: Self-improving LLM agents refine answers, not the process that produces those answers. Systems that add a meta-level hold that level fixed, and those that edit themselves must leave part of their own editing machinery untouched to stay stable, capping the meta-depth they realize at roughly two. We present Meta$^n$, which keeps the meta-operation fixed and recurses on its input instead. That operation, $Ω$, is applied repeatedly to its own products, reading the traces of the solver stack below to
papers.summary_zh: 現有自我改進的 LLM 代理多半只改進答案，而非改進產生答案的過程；即使加入中介層，自我修改系統為維持穩定必須凍結部分驅動機制，使實現的中介深度（meta-depth）上限約為 2.5。Metaⁿ 提出第三種典範：保持單一固定的中介操作 Ω 不變，改為對其輸入遞迴——每次呼叫讀取下方求解器堆疊的執行軌跡與產生這些軌跡的程式碼，寫出下一層的策略性前置處理與可呼叫輔助函式庫。因為 Ω 永不改動故不會破壞系統，而其輸入嚴格遞增，每層得以從更高的視角推理；深度由收斂決定，演化式檔案庫在層鏈之間搜尋，並以整併模式保證不回歸。在兩個骨幹（Gemma 4 31B-IT 與 GPT-5.2）、八個基準族（CO-Bench、Symptom2Disease、LawBench、TerminalBench 2.0、AlphaEvolve Math、符號迴歸、AlgoTune、ARC-AGI-2）上，Metaⁿ 全面超越 Gödel Agent 與 OpenEvolve；最顯著的是設計來抵抗技能記憶的 ARC-AGI-2，Metaⁿ 是唯一得分高於零的系統（0.331）。消融顯示遞迴增益主要來自層間傳遞的條件化脈絡（約 72%），程式碼庫轉移約占 15%；儘管無提示指定，各層角色隨深度湧現，如回滾行為在深度 3 才出現。限制為各層使用同一模型，尚未測試以更強模型擔任 Ω 的部署情境。
papers.title: Meta$^n$: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth
papers.title_zh: Metaⁿ：透過湧現深度達成遞迴自我改進

links.title: Unsupervised Post-Training of Foundation Models: A Survey

evidence: Abstract: catalogs 80 strict UPT methods grouped by internal update object (prediction statistic, sample relation, self-generated target, internal evaluator).
Sec 2: UPT definition with boundary checks B1-B4; frozen inventory of 94 method records from 91 papers (80 strict, 8 adjacent, 6 prose-only).
Appendix A: frozen query templates for ACL Anthology, arXiv API, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar with screening-flow notes, enabling reconstruction.
Sec 7: representative mechanism-matched results with numbers (TTRL AIME 2024 12.9->40.2 and MATH-500 46.7->83.4; Quiet-STaR GSM8K 5.9->10.9; CoNL AIME 60.0->76.5).
Sec 10/Limitations: inventory frozen May 2026, no pooled effect-size estimation, safeguards organized but not evaluated for effectiveness.
Sec 3/Table 1: 26 Family I methods; family counts 26+22+22+10 reconcile with Table 7 cross-section totals (80 strict rows).
Appendix B: broken table references ('Tables and provide the empirical and task-structure detail') weaken evidence presentation.
Sec 4.3: multimodal extension claims with cited numbers (TTRV: InternVL3-8B 99.31% on ImageNet vs GPT-4o 98.30%).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological survey squarely inside scope: it organizes 80 unsupervised post-training methods for LLMs/MLLMs (TTRL, EMPO, R-Zero, Self-Rewarding LM, CPT/TTT lines) by the internal object supplying the update signal, matching core preferences (LLMs, reasoning, RL/DPO, training, evaluation). Novelty is moderate: the four-family update-object taxonomy, the B1-B4 boundary protocol, and the Input Visibility x Update Persistence view are genuinely fresh organizing lenses versus prior self-improvement/TTA/reasoning surveys (Appendix E), but the underlying content is derivative. Rigor is above average for a survey: frozen search templates and counts (94 records/80 strict; tables sum 26+22+22+10=80, consistent with Table 7), explicit inclusion/exclusion, boundary-decision rationales (Appendix D), and acknowledged limitations. Evidence strength is capped by single representative results per family, broken appendix table references (Appendix B text shows blank 'Tables and' markers), reliance on unverifiable 2026-dated citations, and no pooled synthesis. Generalizability is decent (modality-agnostic claim, deployment-regime mapping) with stated scope limits; reproducibility benefits from query templates and a companion machine-readable inventory, though no visible URL. Not a domain application; no penalty applies.

primary_link.title: Unsupervised Post-Training of Foundation Models: A Survey

papers.summary: Foundation-model post-training usually relies on human labels, preference data, stronger teachers, or executable verifiers. We study Unsupervised Post-Training (UPT): update-bearing adaptation on unlabeled inputs whose learning signal is derived from same-lineage model artifacts rather than an external oracle. We catalog 80 strict UPT methods and organize them by the object that supplies the update signal: a prediction statistic, a sample relation, a self-generated target, or an internal evaluat
papers.summary_zh: 基礎模型的後訓練通常依賴人類標註、偏好資料、更強教師或可執行驗證器。這篇調查聚焦無監督後訓練（UPT）：在無標註輸入上進行帶有更新的調適，學習訊號完全取自同源模型產物，並以四項邊界檢查（明確更新、僅用無標註輸入與同源訊號、無外部監督、評判者同源）界定範圍，凍結盤點收錄 80 種嚴格 UPT 方法。分類軸是「提供更新訊號的內部物件」，分為四族：預測統計量最佳化（如持續預訓練、熵最小化與信心最大化）、樣本關係監督（如 TTRL 以多數票作偽標籤進行 GRPO）、自生成標的引導（如 Self-Improve 與 R-Zero 的自學推理軌跡與課程）、內部評估者引導（如 Self-Rewarding LM 的自我評判 DPO）。另一正交視角以輸入可見性 × 更新持久性刻劃部署情境，涵蓋離線語料、全群體轉導、少樣本、串流持續、測試時實例與序列內調適。核心洞見是一條共同的錯誤鏈：不完美的代理指標選擇或獎勵輸出，更新使模型集中於其上，下一輪讀到更偏的代理指標；語義表達力越強、回饋路徑越長，越需要一致性、多樣性與留出驗證等防護，並應在代理指標進入更新之處設置檢查。限制包括盤點凍結於 2026 年 5 月、不做合併效應量估計，且無外部評分時靜默退化仍難察覺。
papers.title: Unsupervised Post-Training of Foundation Models: A Survey
papers.title_zh: 基礎模型的無監督後訓練：一篇調查

links.title: SkillForge: Evolving Verifiable Skills for Reinforcement Learning Agents

evidence: Abstract: claims SkillForge 'improves over SkillRL by 6.3% on average' without cold-start initialization, evaluated on ALFWorld, WebShop, AppWorld.
Section 3.2 / Eq. (3)-(5): agent emits <skill_call> tags as part of generated tokens; GRPO objective jointly optimizes environment actions and skill invocations.
Section 3.3 / Eq. (7)-(8): per-skill EMA success rate and underperformance score conf(s)=(1-p_hat_s)*(1-0.5^(n_s/h)) drive reflexion-based keep/revise verification.
Table 1 (Section 4.3): same-backbone comparison vs SkillRL: ALFWorld 93.6 vs 89.9, WebShop success 83.0 vs 72.7, AppWorld TGC/SGC 23.8/14.3 vs 19.0/5.36 (Qwen2.5-7B).
Table 2 (Section 4.4): ablations on Qwen3-4B show ALFWorld drops 87.9→77.9 (w/o explicit calling) and 87.9→79.3 (w/o skill bank); AppWorld TGC 44.6→38.7 (w/o deduplication).
Section A.7 / Table 7: teacher sensitivity - self-teacher (4B) still beats no-teacher GRPO (85.0 vs 79.3 ALFWorld), partially isolating framework contribution from teacher capability.
Section A.8 / Table 8: skill-related overhead <10% wall-clock (4.18%-9.48%); SkillForge trains faster than SkillRL on all three benchmarks (Table 6).
Limitations section: acknowledges dependence on external teacher LLM, unbounded bank growth/retrieval overhead, and increased token/inference cost from skill calling.

Section 4.2 / Table 4 / A.3: full hyperparameters (lr 1e-6, G=8, KL 1e-3, I=5, EMA α=0.1, h=20), VeRL framework, 8×H20 GPUs, Qwen3-Max teacher, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B retrieval; prompts in A.10; however no code/data release is mentioned anywhere in the document.

Table 1: several baseline entries missing (e.g., Mem0 AppWorld '–', RLOO AppWorld '–'), and '∗' results are replicated from Feng et al. 2025 rather than independently rerun; no error bars or seeds reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent RL paper squarely matching the highest-weight preferences (agents & tool use, LLMs, RL): explicit skill calling optimized jointly with actions via GRPO, evidence-based skill verification, and multi-pathway induction. Novelty is moderate-incremental: it directly extends SkillRL (append-only bank) with per-skill credit assignment and a verification loop rather than a fundamentally new paradigm. Rigor is solid: three benchmarks, broad baseline taxonomy, component ablations (Table 2), teacher sensitivity (Table 7), and efficiency breakdown (A.8); however, results appear single-run with no variance or significance testing, and several baseline cells are missing ('–' in Table 1). Evidence for the headline claims is strong and internally consistent (e.g., AppWorld SGC 5.36→14.3, Table 6 shows faster training than SkillRL), but the +6.3% average claim is only verifiable per-benchmark. Generalizability is supported by three diverse environments, three model scales, and cross-model skill transfer (Table 3), though the framework depends on a strong teacher LLM and binary-reward environments. Reproducibility is above average for detail (hyperparameters Table 4, prompts Figs 10-13, Algorithm 1) but no code or artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: SkillForge: Evolving Verifiable Skills for Reinforcement Learning Agents

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are trained with reinforcement learning (RL) for complex decision-making tasks. However, most RL-trained agents remain episodic and cannot accumulate reusable knowledge across episodes. Recent skill-based approaches, such as SkillRL, attempt to address this issue by extracting skills from raw trajectories, but treat the skill bank as an append-only repository without verifying whether stored skills remain effective. In this paper, we propose SkillForge, a framew
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理人常以強化學習（RL）訓練以處理複雜決策任務，但多數訓練結果仍具情境性，無法跨回合累積可重複使用的知識。既有技能導向方法（如 SkillRL）雖從原始軌跡萃取技能，卻將技能庫視為只增不減的儲存庫，未驗證技能是否仍然有效。SkillForge 提出持續技能演化框架：讓代理人以結構化標籤顯式呼叫技能，使技能使用在軌跡中可觀察、可歸因，RL 因而能同時最佳化環境動作與技能呼叫決策；並導入基於證據的技能驗證，追蹤各技能的成功率與使用次數，對低效技能進行 reflexion 修訂，另以成功、失敗與對比分析等多路徑歸納持續生成新技能。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 與 AppWorld 上，SkillForge 在無冷啟動初始化下平均超越 SkillRL 6.3%，且技能相關開銷低於 10%。限制包括技能歸納與驗證依賴外部教師模型的能力、技能庫可能隨訓練成長而增加檢索負擔，以及顯式呼叫增加提示長度與推論成本。此研究顯示，技能應被視為可持續驗證與修訂的動態能力，而非靜態記憶。
papers.title: SkillForge: Evolving Verifiable Skills for Reinforcement Learning Agents
papers.title_zh: SkillForge：為強化學習代理人演化可驗證技能

links.title: When Do Supervised UQ Ensembles Improve LLM Hallucination Detection? A Robustness Study

evidence: Abstract: 'supervised ensembles outperform the best individual scorer in 30 of 32 settings, with gains realized from as few as 100 labeled instances'
§4.1: 'two human annotators independently labeled a stratified sample of 400 short-form responses... Human-human agreement was 97.5% (Cohen's κ=0.95), and LLM-human agreement was 98.8% (κ=0.97)'
§4.4: 'The black-box ensemble outperforms the best black-box scorer in 19 of 20 settings... The white-box ensemble outperforms the best white-box scorer in just 11 of 20 settings'
Table 2 caption: 'AUROC values with 95% confidence intervals over 25 random train/test splits'

§4.1: 'Gemini-2.5-Flash is used as the grading model for short-form and long-form questions... chosen for its strong performance at low cost' (grader overlaps an evaluated LLM; bias checked in Appendix D)
Limitations: 'Our study evaluates four LLMs from two providers (Google and OpenAI), all of which are closed-source. Results may not generalize to open-weight models'
Limitations: 'Code generation experiments use Python exclusively on competitive programming problems from LiveCodeBench' and 'cross-domain transfer... and cross-LLM transfer... remain unexplored'
Ethical Considerations: 'We do not redistribute the full benchmark-derived data, and release only synthetic schema-compatible files for code smoke testing'
§2/§1: framework builds directly on 'Bouchard and Chauhan (2025)' weighted-average ensembling; this work adds combination-strategy comparison, transfer, and new regimes
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper on supervised UQ ensembles for closed-book hallucination detection across GPT-4o/Gemini models, covering QA, math, code, and long-form regimes. Strong preference match (LLMs, hallucination/factuality, evaluation, code generation). Novelty is moderate: the ensembling framework is inherited from prior work by overlapping authors (Bouchard & Chauhan 2025); the contribution is a systematic robustness analysis (sample efficiency, in-domain transfer, regime dependence) plus access-constrained ablations, using standard classifiers (logistic regression, RF, GBM, weighted average). Rigor is high: 25 stratified splits with 95% CIs, human validation of the LLM grader (400 samples, κ=0.93-0.97, self-grading bias check), documented hyperparameters (Appendix E), and an explicitly acknowledged optimistic test-set-selected baseline. Evidence is extensive (Tables 2, 8-15 give full AUROC/ECE per scorer/LLM/dataset) and headline counts (30/32 AUROC, 23/28 transfer, 19/20 black-box) are consistent with the tables. Generalizability is limited by the authors' own admission: only two closed-weight providers, two narrow factoid long-form domains, Python-only competitive code, no cross-domain or cross-LLM transfer. Reproducibility is moderate: public benchmarks, released scorer package (uqlm), hyperparameters and prompts, but benchmark-derived data is not redistributed ('release only synthetic schema-compatible files') and results depend on closed API versions.

primary_link.title: When Do Supervised UQ Ensembles Improve LLM Hallucination Detection? A Robustness Study

papers.summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods are widely used for hallucination detection in large language models (LLMs) in closed-book settings where ground-truth evidence is unavailable at inference time. Prior work has proposed combining UQ signals via learned ensembles, but empirical investigations into the robustness of these ensembles are limited. We study a supervised ensembling framework that trains a classifier over heterogeneous UQ-based scorer outputs on a small, domain-specific dataset of
papers.summary_zh: 在無法檢索外部證據的封閉書本場景中，不確定性量化（UQ）是偵測大型語言模型（LLM）幻覺的主要手段。先前研究雖提出以監督式學習整合多個 UQ 訊號，但對其穩健性的實證分析有限。本文在四個 LLM、九個資料集與三種生成情境（短問答、長文生成、程式碼生成）上，系統性檢視監督式 UQ 集成在樣本效率、同域資料轉移與生成情境依賴三個軸向的表現。結果顯示，集成方法在 32 個設定中的 30 個以 AUROC 勝過最佳單一評分器，且僅需約 100 筆標註資料即可獲益；在同域分布轉移下，集成在 28 個轉移設定中的 23 個仍優於最佳非集成方法，校準誤差（ECE）亦多數最低。僅用黑箱取樣式評分器的集成效果接近完整集成，而僅用單次生成白箱評分器的集成獲益有限；logistic regression 在效能與穩定性間取得最佳平衡。限制在於僅評測四個封閉權重模型、長文與程式碼情境範圍有限，且未探討跨域或跨模型轉移。此研究為實務部署提供具體指引：只要有少量標註資料，監督式集成即是可靠且低成本的幻覺偵測預設方案。

links.title: Poisoning Agentic Alpha: Adversarial Vulnerabilities Across Roles and Architectures in Multi-Agent Trading Systems

evidence: Abstract: code and data claimed available at https://github.com/cwna97/multi_agent_trading_attack
Section 3 (Task Formulation): black-box targeted attack restricted to external data sources and prompt content, with ASR defined over attackable days only (Eq. 1)
Table 1 / Section 5: Jailbreaking reaches 95.5% (SELL) and 98.9% (BUY) ASR, significantly higher than all other attacks (p<0.001 per Appendix C.4 Table 15)
Table 3 / Section 6.3: GPT-4.1 SELL-targeted Market (A1) ASR rises monotonically 0.3% (Dec.) to 55.7% (Cen.), but ordering weakens or reverses for BUY-targeted attacks
Appendix C.5 Table 16: pooled APS-ASR Spearman rho is only ~0.183 across 240 runs; architecture-mean n=4 correlations acknowledged as statistically unpowered
Section 4 / Appendix B.3: two backbones (gpt-4.1/gpt-4.1-mini, Qwen3-235B-A22B/Qwen3-30B-A3B), temperature 0, 2026 Q1 post-cutoff data, 305 asset-days per configuration, ~3-4x10^4 LLM calls
Limitations: role-axis evaluation uses a single backbone, five large-cap assets only, and daily-close backtest omits execution timing, transaction costs, and slippage (also Appendix D.1)
Section 6.2: APS = 1/(1+k)*(1-p) is explicitly presented as a post-hoc first-order interpretive lens, not a predictive model
Table 2 / Section 5: decision-flip success does not track financial harm (jailbreaking median $0 per success; objective hijacking mean +$40 but median -$85)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A black-box adversarial study of LLM multi-agent trading pipelines that sits squarely on high-weight preferences: LLM backbones (GPT-4.1, Qwen3-235B-A22B), agentic systems with role-specialized agents and communication topologies, AI safety/red-teaming (data poisoning, indirect prompt injection, objective hijacking, jailbreaking), and prompt-level attacks. It is in-scope rather than a pure finance application because the contribution is agent-system security methodology instantiated on a trading pipeline. Novelty is moderate: individual attack classes and topology-safety results exist (NetSafe, TradeTrap, AutoRedTrader are cited), so the contribution is a finance-specific systematic combination plus a very simple post-hoc APS heuristic (1/(1+k) with a voting indicator) rather than a new attack or defense. Rigor is comparatively strong: careful ASR denominators over attackable days, 5 assets x 61 post-cutoff days, two target directions, poison-ratio ablation, single-agent baseline, pairwise z-tests cross-checked with Fisher's exact (Table 15), and an honest appendix admitting the pooled APS-ASR correlation is weak (rho~0.183, Table 16) and arch-mean n=4 has no meaningful CI. Evidence strength is decent but diluted by heavy direction-, asset- and backbone-dependence (e.g., APS ordering reverses for BUY-targeted attacks, Qwen shows inconsistent ordering), small denominators (MSFT 100% on N=3), and a nearly trivial 95-99% jailbreak result that mostly confirms terminal-node compromise is easy. Generalizability is limited by one quarter, five large-cap assets, one backbone for the role axis, and no transaction costs; the conceptual findings (terminal safety node as single point of failure, thresholded voting robustness) transfer more readily than the numbers. Reproducibility is good: full prompts and payloads verbatim (Appendix A), backtest rules in Appendix D, temperature 0, and a public code/data link, though per-call cost logs were not retained and API models may drift.

primary_link.title: Poisoning Agentic Alpha: Adversarial Vulnerabilities Across Roles and Architectures in Multi-Agent Trading Systems

papers.summary: LLM-based multi-agent trading systems, in which specialized agents collaborate through structured communication to produce trading decisions, are moving rapidly from research prototypes to live deployments that control real assets. The same inter-agent communication that makes them effective also exposes them: a corrupted signal can propagate to the final decision and translate into realized financial loss. Unlike prior attacks that presume privileged access to system internals, we restrict the
papers.summary_zh: 基於 LLM 的多代理人交易系統正從原型走向實際部署，但代理人間的通訊管道也成為攻擊面：遭污染的訊號可沿拓撲傳播至最終決策，造成實際財務損失。本文是首個針對金融領域的系統性實證研究，限制攻擊者只能接觸來源資料與提示，形成低門檻的民主化威脅模型。在角色軸上，作者將交易流程拆解為分析師、研究員、交易員與風險經理四種角色，並為各角色設計對應攻擊（資料下毒、間接提示注入、說服性對手、目標劫持與越獄）；在結構軸上，比較線性、集中式、去中心化與混合四種通訊拓撲，並以對抗訊號保留分數（APS）作為事後分析透鏡。跨五種資產、兩個骨幹模型與買賣兩個目標的實驗顯示：直接越獄終端風險經理的成功率高達約 98.9%，遠高於其他攻擊；攻擊成功率（ASR）與實際財務損失並不一致；且沒有任何架構天然穩健，多數投票僅在攻擊者居於少數時提供門檻式保護。限制包括角色軸僅用單一骨幹、資產覆蓋有限，以及回測未納入交易成本與執行細節。此研究指出安全須來自刻意設計的驗證與聚合機制，而非僅靠多代理人架構。

evidence: Abstract: reports mean IoU 0.743, AUROC 0.956, and TPR 0.934 at FPR 0.067 across ten agent configurations.
§5.2 Table 1: localization mIoU ranges 0.692 (Gemma2-9B, MCPTox) to 0.858 (Phi-4†, MCPTox); adjudication AUROC 0.927–0.989.
§5.2 Table 2: AttnLocate TPR>0.910 with FPR<0.070 vs. MindGuard (FPR 0.094–0.151) and TracLLM (FPR 0.129–0.174) on three MCPTox settings.
§5.3 Table 3: zero-shot transfer from Qwen3-8B† yields mIoU 0.736 on DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-14B† and 0.658 on Phi-4† without retraining.
§5.3 Fig. 6: without sink-aware regularization TPR 0.946 but FPR 0.417; β=10 achieves mIoU 0.774 with FPR reduced.
§5.3 Fig. 4: mIoU falls from 0.8105 (≤256 tokens) to 0.6951 (>2048 tokens), a stated limitation for long contexts.

§5.1 Training and calibration: separate detector trained per model–dataset pair; depth-4 1-D U-Net with μ=2L/3, σ=L/6, β=10, α_sink=3; but no training-set size, split, or ground-truth annotation procedure given.

Abstract vs. §5.1: inconsistency — 'five LLM families' in Abstract vs. six families (Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, LLaMA, Mistral, Gemma) in §5.1 and conclusion; no code or data availability statement anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM agent security paper: indirect prompt injection and tool poisoning defense via attention-based span localization plus authority-policy adjudication. The object-detection framing (1-D U-Net + FCOS head over attention features) and sink-aware regularization are a reasonable step beyond coarse-grained attribution baselines (MindGuard, TracLLM), though attention-as-attribution is an established direction. Evaluation is broad (ten agent configurations, six model families, two benchmarks) with baselines, ablations (Gaussian center, sink weight, context length), zero-shot transfer, and policy adaptation. Weaknesses: internal inconsistencies (Abstract says five LLM families vs. six in §5.1; C3 mislabeled as C2 in the design summary), ground-truth construction of behavior-guiding spans is not described, no code/data release claim, no variance or significance reporting, and results degrade monotonically with context length while requiring white-box attention access.

Existing defenses focus on static detection or isolation of malicious content at the input/output level, remains insufficient for detecting such dynamic inducements that arise during
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理人整合外部資源後能力大增，但統一的自然語言上下文通道也使其易受注入攻擊：不可信的外部內容可能在推論時被解讀為行為引導指令，進而顛覆決策。既有防禦多依賴靜態掃描或隔離明顯惡意內容，無法辨識看似無害、實際上卻主導模型決策的上下文片段。AttnLocate 提出執行時期細粒度定位框架：先以多頭、多層注意力聚合（配合高斯層加權）建構 token 級特徵，將定位問題轉化為注意力矩陣上的目標偵測任務，部署一維 U-Net 搭配無錨點偵測頭預測變長片段邊界，並以 sink 感知正則化抑制注意力雜訊；最後依片段來源提供者的權限與可配置政策，裁決呼叫是否未經授權。在涵蓋六個模型家族、十種代理人設定的 MCPTox 工具下毒與 InjecAgent 間接提示注入情境中，平均 mIoU 達 0.743，平均 AUROC 0.956，FPR 0.067 時 TPR 達 0.934，並可零樣本遷移至未見模型、免重訓即可調整授權政策。限制包括需白箱存取注意力矩陣，且長上下文會稀釋訊號而降低表現。此研究凸顯定位真正引導決策的指令，是實現可稽核、來源感知政策執行的關鍵。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed controlled comparison of three test-time reasoning operators (iterative refinement, decomposition, self-consistency) against a CoT baseline across 14 model×benchmark cells with a paired scoring protocol. Highly relevant to core LLM reasoning/evaluation preferences, though the 'agentic' framing is thin (no tools or environments, just recursive model calls). Novelty is modest and honestly disclosed: Section 6.1 states 'Branch is self-consistency' and novelty is claimed for none of the three algorithms; the genuinely new contributions are the truncation-recovery mechanism finding (r=0.72) and the paired-evaluation methodology with negative results on operator routing. Rigor is above average due to shared prompts/budgets/graders, explicit dedup/exclusion/pairing rules, and per-cell attrition reporting, but is capped by the absence of significance tests (Section 6.3 admits ±7 point intervals on 200-item cells), one missing cell (Omni-MATH on Qwen3.6-plus), a strict-lower-bound HLE grader, and an unexplained tension: the shared solve primitive's finalization retry apparently does not prevent a 51.2% baseline empty rate on HLE, and its success rate is never reported. The mechanistic claim rests on a 14-point correlation without controlling for benchmark difficulty/headroom, though the Qwen3.6-plus no-truncation negative case strengthens it. Generalizability is limited to reasoning models with hidden deliberation under finite token budgets, with fixed N=5 unweighted voting. Reproducibility is decent on paper (per-item records retained for all 49,327 items, single-figure script, pseudocode in Appendix B) but no public artifact or code link is stated and models ran through an internal proxy.

primary_link.title: Recursive Agentic Reasoning

papers.summary: Test-time reasoning methods such as iterative refinement, decomposition, and repeated sampling are often evaluated in isolation, making their gains difficult to compare across models, benchmarks, and evaluation pipelines. We introduce a unified view of these methods as recursion operators over an agent's reasoning trace: GROW, which deepens a single reasoning path; PRUNE, which decomposes and recomposes the problem; and BRANCH, which samples alternative reasoning paths and selects among them. We
papers.summary_zh: 測試時推理方法長期各自發展：迭代精煉、問題分解與重複取樣分別在不同基準、模型與評分器上驗證，難以公平比較。本文將它們重構為作用於代理人推理軌跡上的遞迴運算元——Grow（深化單一路徑）、Prune（分解再重組）與 Branch（取樣多個解並投票），在共用框架、相同提示與運算預算下，於五個基準與三個前沿模型共 14 個模型×基準組合、49,327 個評分項目上進行受控比較，並採用配對評分協定（所有運算元只在彼此皆完成的項目上計分）。結果顯示 Branch 在全部 14 個組合皆提升準確率（平均 +5.98 分），於 12 個組合嚴格最佳；Grow 平均 +2.18 但在兩個組合為負，Prune 平均僅 +0.94。核心分析發現：Branch 的優勢不僅來自路徑邊緣化，更來自截斷復原——其增益與基線的空輸出率高度相關（r=0.72），因空答案無法贏得多數投票而被自動捨棄。此結果削弱了依任務選擇運算元的路由假說。作者也示範未配對評分與將基礎設施失誤計為模型錯誤，足以翻轉結論。限制包括 Branch 僅用未加權投票、未做統計檢定，且僅涵蓋會輸出隱藏推理的模型。此研究主張配對評分應成為測試時運算比較研究的標準實務。

links.title: Evaluating Language Models on Cross-Language Code Functional Equivalence

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: introduces PolyHuman from CodeContests to test intra- and inter-language equivalence detection, claiming first systematic cross-language study on human-written code
Section 2.1/Table 1: dataset construction filtering to correct/incorrect solutions in CPP, Java, Python yielding 5,035 problems and four pair categories
Table 3/Section 3.1: accuracy matrices for 9 models across EquiBench, SeqCoBench, and PolyHuman, e.g., GPT-o4-mini 0.97 on SeqCoBench vs. 0.80 on Python Pass-vs-Pass
Section 3.3/Table 6: logistic regression (n=2,969, Pseudo R²=0.429) with difficulty×NEQ interaction β=0.804 p<0.001 and CodeBLEU β=0.212 p<0.001

Section 3.4: manual analysis pipeline 900→162 unstable→81 systematic disagreements; thematic saturation criterion (16 consecutive instances with no new categories); 17 ground-truth issues (C.1/C.2) identified
Section 5 Threats to Validity: authors acknowledge test-coverage label noise, likely data contamination, competitive-programming external validity limits, and absence of Cohen's Kappa
Front-matter supplement footnote: replication package DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21800077; Section 2.2 notes temperature=0 for all models except GPT-o4-mini, whose temperature cannot be set
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM capability study: evaluates 9 proprietary/open-weight LLMs (GPT-o4-mini, GPT-OSS-20B, Llama, Mistral, Qwen-Coder, CodeLlama, plus Claude/Gemini on a subset) on cross-language code functional equivalence judgment, with CoT reasoning analysis and a new human-written benchmark (PolyHuman). Strongly aligned with LLM, reasoning/CoT, code, and evaluation preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: equivalence-checking benchmarks exist (EquiBench, SeqCoBench); the genuinely new elements are the cross-language, human-written setting and the two-tier (knowledge vs. abstraction-level) failure taxonomy. Rigor is solid but not exemplary: GQM framing, statistical tests (Wilcoxon, Friedman) and a logistic regression (Table 6, Pseudo R²=0.429) support the claims, yet ground truth rests on online-judge test suites, the authors themselves uncovered 17 label errors among 81 analyzed failures, no inter-rater reliability was computed, and cross-model significance tests use only n=9 models (acknowledged as underpowered). Evidence for headline findings (difficulty×label interaction, Python-specific conservativeness β=-0.450 p=0.001, similarity shortcut β=0.212) is quantitatively well documented. Generalizability is limited to competitive-programming code in three languages with open-weight models capped at ~20B plus one proprietary model. Reproducibility benefits from a public Zenodo replication package and released prompts, but GPT-o4-mini's unsettable temperature and qualitative coding subjectivity weaken exact replication.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Language Models on Cross-Language Code Functional Equivalence

papers.summary: Background: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a variety of code-understanding tasks, leading many to believe that they can reason about program semantics. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on single-language settings or rely on synthetically generated code, raising concerns about whether current results reflect true semantic understanding. Aims: We investigate whether LLMs can accurately judge functional equivalence across different programming
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）在程式碼理解任務上表現亮眼，使許多人相信其具備語意推理能力，而判斷程式功能等價性正是此能力的根本檢驗。然而既有基準多聚焦單一語言或依賴合成轉換的程式，等價性常可由表面相似性推得。本文引入 PolyHuman，一個由競程平台人寫解答構成、涵蓋 CPP、Java 與 Python 的資料集，系統評估九個 LLM 在同語言與跨語言等價判斷上的表現，並對 81 個系統性錯誤案例進行人工分析。結果顯示：在合成資料上準確率近乎完美的 GPT-o4-mini，於人寫程式上顯著下滑；難度越高，模型越易將不等價程式誤判為等價；各模型呈現系統性且互異的判斷偏誤，部分過度拒絕等價、部分過度接受，顯示模型選擇與集成比語言本身更關鍵；回歸分析亦顯示 CodeBLEU 等相似度訊號仍殘留影響。質性分析將失敗分為知識缺失與抽象層次推理失敗（含過早結論、語意誤解與實作細節錯誤），另有少數為資料標註問題。限制包括測試涵蓋度、競程程式碼的領域侷限與潛在資料污染。此研究證明現有 LLM 尚未能可靠掌握功能等價性，凸顯建構更真實基準與人機協作審核的必要性。

evidence: Table 1: AIG with Opus-5 reaches 55.20% step / 71.20% agent accuracy on Algorithm-Generated partition, surpassing prior best 51.60% (RAFFLES, Sonnet-4); footnote notes n=125 due to one content-filtered log.
Table 2 (Section 4.2): representation ladder on Opus-5 — raw log 46.40, structured log 48.80, Influence Graph 52.00, adaptive graph read single-call 50.40, full agentic AIG 55.20 step accuracy.
Section 4.1: on Hand-Crafted partition AIG matches 29.31% step accuracy (tied with A2P/CHIEF) but agent accuracy 63.79% remains below CHIEF's 72.41%.
Section 5.1: paired Sonnet-4 analysis — exact accuracy on failures at step ≥5 rises from 10.8% (raw log) to 40.5% (AIG).
Table 5 (Section 5.3): reader behavior — 86.5% multi-step investigation, only 1.6% commit from the graph alone.
Limitations: transfer beyond Who&When untested; graphs validated only via critic and downstream accuracy, not against gold annotations; build stage adds token cost.

Section 3.3: implementation via Strands Agents SDK v1.37 and Amazon Bedrock Converse API, training-free, no fine-tuning; Opus-5/GPT-5.6-sol run at unsettable defaults (nondeterminism not addressed); no code or prompt release stated.
Appendix D (Tables 9-10): ladder ordering (raw < structured < IG < AIG) holds for Sonnet-4 (20.63→48.41→49.60→53.97) and DS-V3.2 (19.84→45.24→51.20→53.17).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-LLM methodology paper: multi-agent failure attribution via a two-stage build-read pipeline (agentic graph builder + tool-using reader), squarely matching high-weight preferences for Agents & Tool Use and LLMs. Strengths: a clean representation-ladder ablation isolating structure vs. traversal (Table 2: 46.40→48.80→52.00→55.20 on Opus-5), consistency across four backbones (Tables 1, 9, 10), matched-model baseline reruns (CHIEF with authors' code), and informative analyses of graph properties and reader behavior (Tables 4-5). Weaknesses: single benchmark (Who&When) with small samples (n=125 for Opus-5; Hand-Crafted ~n=58), no significance testing or variance over runs despite a 3.6pp SOTA margin (~4-5 traces), weaker Hand-Crafted results where agent accuracy trails CHIEF (63.79 vs 72.41), and no code/prompt release, limiting reproducibility. Novelty is real but incremental over existing structured-trace methods (CHIEF, CDC-MAS, FAMAS), with adaptivity and agent-directed traversal as the main new levers.

Instead, observability tools organize traces around components, actions, and dependencies to support targeted navigation. We hypothesize that modern LLMs can benefit from
papers.summary_zh: 多代理人 LLM 系統的失敗歸因——找出導致任務失敗的關鍵代理與錯誤步驟——目前仍多依賴人工除錯。既有方法多直接在原始日誌上推理，或以預先定義的結構重組軌跡。本文假設失敗歸因部分是介面設計問題：不僅取決於診斷模型，也取決於軌跡如何被呈現與遍歷。作者提出自適應影響圖（AIGs）兩階段框架：建構代理以互動工具將失敗軌跡轉為以步驟為基礎的型別化節點圖，附帶標註繼承邊（記錄下游重用了什麼、如何出錯），並由 critic–refiner 迴圈審核結構與語意一致性；閱讀代理則沿繼承邊回溯導航，並對照原始日誌驗證圖中主張後提出歸因。在 Who&When 基準的 Algorithm-Generated 分割上，以 Opus-5 達成 55.20% 步驟準確率與 71.20% 代理準確率，創下新紀錄，且在 Sonnet-4、DS-V3.2 與 GPT-5.6-sol 上結果一致；介面階梯消融顯示結構化日誌、影響圖與代理式遍歷逐層貢獻增益，增益集中於軌跡後段的失敗。限制包括僅在 Who&When 上評測、建構階段增加 token 成本，且缺乏節點粒度的黃金標註。此研究的啟示在於：可觀測性設計可從人類工程師延伸至自動化歸因。
