links.title: RePolicy: Reinforcement Learning for Safety-Policy Invocation in Agent Safeguards

evidence: Section 5.2/Table 1: RePolicy-4B reports 88.15 Overall Unsafe F1 vs 84.17 for the strongest external baseline (Claude Sonnet 4.6) and ranks first on four of six benchmarks (Obs 1-2).

Section 5.5/Table 2 caption: '† marks provisional values that must be replaced with the final ablation run before submission' — the 'w/o policy invocation' and 'w/o policy-context perturbation' rows are explicitly provisional, weakening ablation-based claims (Obs 8).

Appendix B.1/Table 3: AgentHazard split contains 2,653 unsafe and 0 safe examples (100% unsafe rate); the paper concedes it 'does not measure false-positive control' yet it contributes one-sixth of the Overall score (Appendix B.4 Eq. 9).

Section 4.2: GRPO uses three rule-based rewards (format 0.1, policy invocation 0.3, accuracy 0.6 per Appendix B.5 Table 8) plus policy-context perturbation resampling distractors/decoys and shuffling library order (15-35 policies, ≥2 decoys each).
Section 5.3/Figure 3 (Obs 3-4): correct policy invocation rises from ~94.4% to 98.5% during GRPO while decoy selection stays below 1%; Appendix D reports wrong-policy invocation falling 8.7%→1.4%.
Section 5.4 (Obs 5-6): library-size sensitivity shows macro F1 86.1@10 → 88.1@40 → 87.9@50 with R_pol dropping 99.4%→97.1%, an acknowledged selection-cost trade-off.

Section 7 Limitations: one governing policy per trajectory, added inference overhead from the invocation step, single backbone scale, offline binary-label benchmarks, and rewards that 'do not fully guarantee that every statement in the generated rationale is faithful'.

Reproducibility statement + Appendix B.5/Table 8: releases code, PolicyTraj-20K training splits, 30-policy/358-clause library, reward functions, SFT/GRPO scripts, RePolicy-4B checkpoint, and full hyperparameters (LR 1e-6, 8×H20, vLLM rollouts, FSDP, seed 42).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope: an LLM agent safeguard trained with GRPO to treat safety policies as callable tools, evaluated across six agent-safety benchmarks with rule-based verifiable rewards. The method is a competent combination of established agentic-RL techniques (Search-R1/ReTool-style tool invocation, GRPO) with a genuinely useful twist — policy-context perturbation with decoy libraries and an explicit invocation reward — making novelty moderate rather than high. Rigor and evidence are materially weakened by the Table 2 '†' note admitting provisional ablation values, absence of seeds/significance testing, a single 4B backbone, and an AgentHazard split that is 100% unsafe (2,653/0), which inflates the unweighted Overall average; the paper honestly flags these (Obs 5-7, Limitations), and the evaluation-protocol appendix is unusually thorough (19 baselines, per-model parsing/truncation rules, completeness checks). Reproducibility claims are strong: code, dataset splits, 30-policy library, reward functions, hyperparameters, and the trained checkpoint are all stated as released. Net: a solid, well-documented in-scope contribution whose headline gains are plausible but rest partly on unverifiable baseline results and incomplete final ablations.

primary_link.title: RePolicy: Reinforcement Learning for Safety-Policy Invocation in Agent Safeguards

papers.summary: Safeguarding language model agents requires assessing complete execution trajectories under context-dependent safety policies. Existing policy-aware safeguards mainly rely on prompting or supervised fine-tuning, limiting their ability to adapt to unseen trajectories and changing policy contexts. We propose RePolicy, an agent safeguard that learns safety-policy invocation through reinforcement learning. Given an agent trajectory and a dynamic policy library, RePolicy invokes the applicable policy
papers.summary_zh: 保護 LLM 代理人安全需在情境相依的安全政策下評估完整執行軌跡，但既有政策感知防護多依賴提示工程或監督式微調，難以適應未見軌跡與變動的政策情境。RePolicy 將安全政策視為可呼叫的能力，以強化學習學習政策叫用：給定軌跡與動態政策庫，模型先選出適用政策並取得其內容，再據此產生有政策依據的推理與安全判斷。作者建構含逾 20,000 筆政策標註軌跡的 PolicyTraj-20K 資料集，先以冷啟動 SFT 建立基本能力，再以 GRPO 搭配可驗證獎勵（格式、政策叫用正確性、安全預測）與政策情境擾動（加入無關與誘餌政策）進行最佳化。在 ATBench、R-Judge、OpenAgentSafety、ASSEBench、HINTBench 與 AgentHazard 六個基準上，僅 4B 參數的 RePolicy-4B 達到 88.15 的整體 Unsafe F1，於六項中四項排名第一，正確政策叫用率由約 94.4% 升至 98.5%，誘餌選取率始終低於 1%。限制包括假設政策庫內存在適用且精確的政策、每條軌跡僅對應單一主導政策、政策叫用增加推論負擔，且僅在單一骨幹規模上評測。此研究顯示，將政策叫用明確化有助打造更可調適且可稽核的代理人防護。
papers.title: RePolicy: Reinforcement Learning for Safety-Policy Invocation in Agent Safeguards
papers.title_zh: RePolicy：以強化學習進行代理人防護中的安全政策叫用

links.title: Hydra: Phase-Aware Workload Characterization of LLM Inference across Edge SoC Generations, Backends, and Quantization Levels

evidence: Abstract + §IV: evaluates three edge SoC generations (AGX Xavier, Orin, Thor), 13 instruction-tuned LLMs from seven families, five execution formats (bf16, F16, Q8_0, Q6_K, Q4_K_M), yielding ~107K per-prompt records released at GitHub/Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21844843

§III Validation: prefill times agree within 0.1 ms and per-token generation times differ by 0.06-0.08 ms versus llama.cpp internal counters, attributed to logit-read/argmax cost; CUDA synchronization used to avoid measuring async kernel launch
§IV-A Table III: quantization quality controlled via WikiText-2 PPL and zero-shot Winogrande/HellaSwag with lm-eval-harness; Q4_K_M worst case within ~1 PPL point and ~2.4 accuracy points of F16

§V-A: phase attribution shows QW-7B on Thor under HuggingFace has 33.0 ms generation vs 63.5 ms ITL (de-tokenization/orchestration overhead) while llama.cpp ITL 58.6 ms nearly matches generation 58.5 ms, explaining backend latency differences

§V-C Tables VI-VII: Q4_K_M consistently lowest mJ/token; Q6_K draws more power and runs hotter than Q8_0 despite fewer bits; input length raises energy 11-34% while output length scales energy 5.1-5.4x
§VI Limitations: single-stream batch-size-one scope, Jetson-only instantiation, weight-only GGUF formats only, dense 1-8B models only, platform-specific power rails without clean DR-only sensor

Artifact Appendix A.4-A.6: Evaluation I reproduces all computational results deterministically on any Linux/macOS machine with sha256/manifest verification of 107,110 records; Evaluation II re-measures on real boards with three binding qualitative invariants and a ±15% guidance band
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems-level workload characterization of LLM inference (13 instruction-tuned LLMs, 3 Jetson SoC generations, 5 execution formats) that aligns strongly with LLM, Inference & Serving, and Scaling & Efficiency preferences via its focus on quantization, latency, energy/token, and edge deployment, though it contributes no language-methodology advance (no modeling, reasoning, prompting, or training contribution), capping relevance below the top tier. Novelty is moderate: the integrated dual-backend (HuggingFace + llama.cpp) phase-aware schema with fused telemetry is a useful combination, but phase-aware prefill/decode analysis is established in serving literature (Splitwise, DistServe, TokenPowerBench) and prior edge benchmarks (PalmBench, MELT) overlap substantially; the contribution is breadth of integration, not a new technique. Rigor is strong: a disambiguating 195-cell experimental matrix, fixed 500-token decode budgets, quantization quality control via lm-eval-harness, timing validation against llama.cpp internal counters (0.1 ms prefill agreement), and explicit threats-to-validity discussion. Evidence is concrete (tables with mean/std for latency, utilization, power, mJ/token) and the key non-obvious findings (Q6_K power non-monotonicity, Q4_K_M lowest energy/token, llama.cpp runtime-overhead advantage) are quantitatively grounded. Generalizability is limited by design: single-stream batch-1, Jetson-only telemetry, weight-only GGUF, dense 1-8B models, all acknowledged. Reproducibility is exceptional: 107,110-record open corpus, Zenodo DOI, deterministic analysis pipeline with checksum verification, and a two-part artifact evaluation including hardware re-measurement with defined invariants.

primary_link.title: Hydra: Phase-Aware Workload Characterization of LLM Inference across Edge SoC Generations, Backends, and Quantization Levels

papers.summary: Edge LLM deployment is shaped by more than model size and precision: inference backend, hardware platform, memory traffic, and power management all affect latency and efficiency. We present Hydra, a common-schema, phase-aware workload characterization framework for LLM inference on edge SoCs. Hydra instruments HuggingFace Transformers and llama.cpp with a shared per-prompt timing schema and fuses those records with hardware telemetry, enabling a multi-dimensional characterization of performance,
papers.summary_zh: 邊緣裝置上的LLM部署效能不只取決於模型規模與精度，還受推論後端、硬體平台、記憶體流量與電源管理影響。本文提出Hydra，一套共通結構、相位感知的工作負載特性分析框架：它對HuggingFace Transformers與llama.cpp兩種後端施加共通的每提示詞計時結構，記錄tokenization、prefill、逐token生成與de-tokenization，並融合tegrastats與NVML硬體遙測，將效能、資源使用與能耗歸因於prefill與decode相位。研究評測三代NVIDIA Jetson（AGX Xavier、Orin、Thor）、七個家族共13個模型、五種執行格式與輸入輸出長度掃描，累積約十萬七千筆記錄。主要發現：後端結構改變延遲的來源，llama.cpp透過降低CPU編排開銷改善端到端延遲；量化降低記憶體流量與每token能耗（Q4_K_M最低），但功耗不隨位元寬度單調，Q6_K反而比Q8_0更耗電；Thor平台功耗較高但每token焦耳更低。限制包括僅涵蓋Jetson、weight-only量化、批次為一的單流推論與1至8B密集模型。此研究顯示邊緣LLM部署需要相位感知與平台感知的可觀測性，聚合延遲不足以指導決策。
papers.title: Hydra: Phase-Aware Workload Characterization of LLM Inference across Edge SoC Generations, Backends, and Quantization Levels
papers.title_zh: Hydra：跨邊緣SoC世代、後端與量化層級之LLM推論的相位感知工作負載特性分析

links.title: ReproAgent: Contract-Guided Paper-to-Code Reproduction

evidence: Abstract + footnote 1: 'On PaperBench Code-Dev..., ReproAgent reaches the highest mean score among same-backbone scaffolds under both Claude-Sonnet-4.5 and Gemini-3-Flash'; 'Code and experimental artifacts are publicly available' (github.com/kernel-14/ReproAgent)

Section 5.1: full-suite mean 73.7 vs PaperCoder 45.1, AutoP2C 49.2, Deep-Reproducer 63.2, and 'edges past the concurrent state-of-the-art DeepCode at 73.5' - a 0.2-point margin with no error bars on their runs
Section 5.2 / Table 2: same-backbone Gemini-3-Flash comparison, ReproAgent 39.7 vs BasicAgent 19.3, IterAgent 20.6, AiScientist 30.5

Section 5.3 / Table 3: channel ablations over all 20 papers; removing reference evidence drops mean by 18.1 and implementation requirements by 14.1; 'The full setting beats both ablations on every one of the 20 targets'

Section 4.3: '20 papers x 4 ReproAgent settings = 80 reproduction runs, one run per (paper, setting) pair'; repair budget 'three attempts... five rounds, uniformly' across settings - single-seed design
Appendix B / Table 4 footnote: external rows 'differ in scaffold, model, runtime budget, and reporting protocol... contextual reported scores rather than a primary controlled comparison'

Appendix G / Table 7: token, time, and call diagnostics reported (e.g., Claude run 12.9M judge tokens, 17.8M pipeline tokens, 9.3 hours), explicitly 'to make the process auditable rather than to compare deployment cost'

Section 7 Limitations: 'ReproAgent targets repository-level reproduction... Extending the approach to other reproduction settings, modalities, and evaluation protocols is a natural direction for future work'
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent methodology paper: a coding-agent pipeline (Prepare-Plan-Generate-Repair) for paper-to-code reproduction, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLM preferences. Novelty is moderate: the persistent two-channel implementation contract (paper obligations + retrieved repository evidence) bound to work packages and file-level contracts is a plausible increment over PaperCoder/AutoReproduce/RePro, and the paper articulates the split-specification problem clearly, but the mechanism is prompt/schema engineering rather than a fundamentally new capability. Rigor is solid but not airtight: full 20-paper benchmark coverage, two backbones, a controlled same-backbone comparison, and channel ablations held at fixed repair budgets; however, each (paper, setting) uses a single run with no variance reported, and the headline full-suite SOTA margin over DeepCode is only 0.2 points (73.7 vs 73.5), which is within noise and properly hedged as 'same-backbone scaffolds'. Evidence strength benefits from ablations dropping 18.1/14.1 points with the full contract beating both ablations on all 20 targets, plus per-paper case traces and token/time diagnostics; external baseline rows are heterogeneous and self-acknowledged as context only, and all grading relies on the PaperBench LLM judge. Generalizability is limited by evaluation on a single benchmark (20 ICML 2024 ML papers) with future-work extension acknowledged. Reproducibility is good: public code/artifacts link, released prompt schemas, algorithms, stage tables, and usage metadata. Overall a competent, well-evidenced agent-systems contribution with a weak absolute SOTA claim.

primary_link.title: ReproAgent: Contract-Guided Paper-to-Code Reproduction

papers.summary: Paper-to-code reproduction asks scientific AI agents to turn research papers into executable repositories that preserve the paper's method, protocol and artifacts. This is difficult because the specification is split: explicit paper content such as algorithms, metrics and artifacts is often lost across long agent trajectories, while implicit details such as framework defaults and conventions inherited from related work are absent from the paper. We introduce ReproAgent, a four-stage Prepare--Pla
papers.summary_zh: 論文到程式碼再現要求AI代理將研究論文轉為可執行且忠實的儲存庫，但規格是分裂的：論文明示的演算法、指標與產物常在漫長代理軌跡中遺失，而框架預設與慣例等隱含細節則根本不在論文中，導致「能執行但不忠實」的常見失敗。本文提出ReproAgent，以持續存在的實作契約為核心，架構為Prepare–Plan–Generate–Repair四階段流程。契約含兩通道：實作需求通道將論文片段轉為具生命週期與覆蓋不變式的程式碼義務；參考證據通道從相關儲存庫檢索內容與結構證據。兩者綁定至工作套件並投射為檔案級契約，供生成與修復共同稽核，修復失敗被報告為違反的論文義務而非僅是崩潰。在PaperBench Code-Dev二十篇論文上，以Claude-Sonnet-4.5達73.7分超越DeepCode的73.5，以Gemini-3-Flash達39.7分勝過AiScientist的30.5；消融顯示移除參考證據平均掉18.1分、移除實作需求掉14.1分，個案分析佐證兩通道互補。限制為僅針對儲存庫層級再現，工程成本尚未最佳化。此工作把「論文義務須在整個流程中存活」形式化，對改善科學重現性具實務意義。
papers.title: ReproAgent: Contract-Guided Paper-to-Code Reproduction
papers.title_zh: ReproAgent：以契約引導的論文到程式碼再現

links.title: NeuronGuard: Robust LLM Safety Alignment via Ablation-Aware Safety Signal Redistribution

evidence: Abstract: 'experiments across three LLMs, six state-of-the-art attack strategies, and multimodal settings confirm near-zero ASR while maintaining task accuracy, including against white-box adaptive adversaries'

Section 6.1: models are Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Falcon3-7B-Instruct; LoRA r=32, lr 1e-5, probe sets of 750/750 from BeaverTails, StrongREJECT for ASR; 'averages over 10 different random seeds' on two H100s
Table 2 (Sec 6.2): NeuroStrike ASR on Llama/SST2 drops from 0.89 (No defense) to 0.04 (NeuronGuard); all NeuronGuard ASRs 0.00-0.04

Section 5, Assumptions 1-5 and Theorem 1: guarantee conditioned on linear separability, bounded attack support in S_l, Lipschitz output head, bounded KL, and 'independent per-neuron exploitation' — Assumption 5 makes P_ours vs P_nl comparison largely definitional
Section 4.3, Eq. 8: projection removes opposing gradient component with randomized ordering; no citation to PCGrad or prior multi-task gradient surgery work
Section 7 / Table 10: adaptive attacks IP (ASR 0.09) and NE (ASR 0.05) evaluated only on Llama/SST2; Section 7/Table 12 shows static identification degrades NeuroStrike ASR from 0.04 to 0.29
Section 9 (Limitations): defense 'assumes that the defender has full control over the training pipeline' and does not cover black-box/inference-time settings
Section 6.1: seeds averaged but no standard deviations or significance tests reported anywhere; ASR judged only via Llama-Guard-3-8B
Appendix C lists model/dataset licenses; no code or artifact availability statement appears in the paper
Section 5 and Appendix B.2 refer to 'Lemma 21' when Lemma 2 is meant, indicating proof-editing errors
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM safety-alignment defense paper squarely within scope (LLMs, AI safety, alignment, interpretability, red-team evaluation), with no out-of-scope domain application. Contributions: dynamic per-layer linear probes to identify safety-critical neurons, deliberate ablation during fine-tuning to redistribute safety signals, KL consistency, and randomized gradient conflict projection. Strengths: broad evaluation (3 LLM families, 4 tasks, 6 attacks incl. NeuroStrike, 7 baselines, 10 seeds; Table 1/Table 2), ablations (Tables 6-9, 12-13), adaptive attacks (Table 10), multimodal extension (Table 11), stated limitations. Weaknesses under strict review: the 'formal guarantee' (Theorem 1) rests on heavily idealized assumptions (linear separability, attacker restricted to S_l, Lipschitz head, independent per-neuron exploitation per Assumptions 1-5) making the bound close to definitional; the Eq. 8 gradient projection is PCGrad-style and uncited; near-uniform near-zero ASR (0.00-0.04) is reported without variance/significance testing despite 10 seeds (Sec 6.1); ASR judged solely by Llama-Guard without human verification; adaptive attacks tested on one model only (Sec 7, Table 10); editorial sloppiness ('Lemma 21' references in Sec 5 and Appendix B.2); no code or artifact release despite detailed hyperparameters and license listing (Appendix C). Solid incremental work over SafeNeuron (dynamic vs. static identification, Table 12), not a fundamental advance.

primary_link.title: NeuronGuard: Robust LLM Safety Alignment via Ablation-Aware Safety Signal Redistribution

papers.summary: Safety alignment in large language models (LLMs) remains brittle against a growing spectrum of attacks. Jailbreak attacks bypass safety mechanisms through crafted prompts, while neuron-level attacks directly prune safety-critical neurons post-deployment. Both exploit a common weakness: safety-relevant information concentrates in a sparse neuron subset. We present NeuronGuard, a fine-tuning-stage defense that simultaneously hardens LLMs against both attack classes by redistributing safety signals
papers.summary_zh: LLM的安全對齊易受兩類攻擊：以提示操弄繞過防護的越獄攻擊，以及部署後直接剪除安全關鍵神經元的神經元層級攻擊；兩者的共同弱點是安全資訊集中在稀疏神經元子集。既有防禦多屬提示層過濾或靜態凍結神經元，無法處理根因。本文提出NeuronGuard，一種微調階段防禦：以每層輕量線性分類器定期重訓，動態辨識當下的安全關鍵神經元；訓練時刻意消融這些神經元，要求模型在缺少它們時仍能拒答，迫使安全表示擴散到更廣的神經元集；再以KL散度正則維持消融前後輸出一致，並以隨機梯度投影化解防禦與下游任務目標的梯度衝突。理論上，作者證明在可測量條件下NeuronGuard嚴格降低攻擊成功率（ASR）上界。實驗涵蓋三個LLM、六種攻擊與多模態設定，ASR降至近零且保持任務準確率，對具完整防禦知識的自適應攻擊者仍穩健；消融顯示各元件缺一不可，改用靜態辨識會使NeuroStrike下ASR升至0.29。限制是需在微調階段完全掌控訓練管線，僅有API存取的部署情境需另配推論時防禦。此工作直指對齊脆弱性的根因，對開放權重模型的長期安全深具意義。
papers.title: NeuronGuard: Robust LLM Safety Alignment via Ablation-Aware Safety Signal Redistribution
papers.title_zh: NeuronGuard：透過消融感知之安全訊號重分配強化LLM安全對齊

links.title: Not All Tokens Are Equal: Region-Aware Consistency Repair of Backdoors in MLLMs

evidence: Abstract: reports Racer reduces average ASR to 1.1% with 0% in 32 of 36 settings across three MLLMs and image/text/multimodal triggers, preserving clean-task utility.

Section V-B / Table I: full per-setting ASR, VQA, and CIDEr results for Racer and five baselines (Fine-Tuning, Quantization, Pruning, Fine-Pruning, LC-Uniform) across 36 model-attack-objective settings; only four settings retain nonzero ASR (e.g., 20.4% Blended MI on LLaVA-1.5-7B).

Section V-D / Table III: component ablation built on LC-Uniform showing deep-window + region-wise aggregation alone leaves 83.5%/48.7%/81.3% TR ASR, and adding modality weighting (w_t>1) reduces TR ASR to 0.0%/0.0%/0.1%.
Section V-C / Table II: applying Racer to clean models changes VQA accuracy by -2.5, -2.5, and -2.6 points on the three MLLMs, supporting the no-backdoor-knowledge threat model.

Section V-E / Figs. 7-8: sensitivity analyses over textual weight w_t (adopted 4 and 3), inner-loop budget K in {15,20,25}, and seven window-start positions, with adopted configs within stable low-ASR regions.

Section VI (Limitations): admits two backbone-specific configurations require manual selection and that evaluation is restricted to 7B-scale open-source MLLMs, with larger backbones left as future work.

Section III / Fig. 2: 250 paired clean/backdoor inputs show the inconsistency gap concentrates in the trigger modality region (visual for image triggers, textual for text triggers) and mainly in deeper layers.

Appendix A (Implementation Details): documents region-mask extraction (LLaVA 576-token span; Qwen vision_start/vision_end markers), fused-embedding perturbation pathway, and memory handling; however, numeric values for epsilon, alpha, epochs, and learning rate are not provided in the document, and no artifact release is claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope AI-safety work on repairing backdoored multimodal LLMs (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2-VL-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B), strongly matching AI Safety, LLM, Multimodal AI, and Interpretability preferences via its layer-wise inconsistency analysis of hidden representations. Novelty is moderate: the modality-dependent localization of the layer-wise inconsistency anomaly (Section III) is a genuinely new observation, but the repair machinery (PGD worst-case perturbation plus adversarial fine-tuning, deep-layer window) is an assembly of standard techniques extending the unimodal CROW consistency-repair baseline. Rigor is good: a clearly stated threat model, 36 attack settings, five model-level baselines, component ablations (Table III), sensitivity analyses over w_t, K, and window start (Figs. 7-8), and a clean-model control (Table II). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent with the headline claims (mean ASR 98.6%->1.1%, 0% in 32/36), though single-dataset (LLaVA-Instruct-150K), a single 15% poisoning rate, no variance/seeds, and only a theoretical discussion of adaptive attacks temper confidence. Generalizability is limited to 7B-scale white-box models with model-specific region-mask handling, acknowledged in Section VI. Reproducibility is partial: Algorithm 1 and Appendices A-B give region-mask mechanics, trigger parameters, and per-backbone window/weight settings, but numeric values for the perturbation budget epsilon, weight alpha, epochs, and learning rate are not stated, and no code release is claimed.

primary_link.title: Not All Tokens Are Equal: Region-Aware Consistency Repair of Backdoors in MLLMs

papers.summary: MLLMs are increasingly deployed in user-facing applications, yet they inherit backdoor risks from the pipelines used to construct them: triggers may reside in images, texts, or both. Existing model-level backdoor removal methods, largely designed for conventional classifiers, show limited effectiveness on MLLMs, while MLLM-specific defenses mainly operate at inference time, filtering suspicious inputs without removing the backdoor embedded in the model. To address this gap and eliminate latent b
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）因訓練管線含不可信元件而繼承後門風險，觸發器可能藏於圖像、文字或兩者；既有模型級移除方法多為傳統分類器設計，MLLM專用防禦則多在推論時過濾輸入，未移除植入的後門。本文的關鍵觀察是：後門會造成隱藏表示層間演化的「層級不一致異常」，且此異常具模態依賴性——集中在編碼觸發器特徵的token區域，並在深層更顯著。據此提出Racer：將融合表示分解為視覺與文字token區域，各自區域內正規化，再以模態感知權重在深層視窗重組為區域感知不一致目標；透過min-max最佳化，內層以PGD合成最壞情況擾動，外層對此擾動進行對抗微調，並以自迴歸損失錨定乾淨效用。方法僅需100筆乾淨樣本，不需觸發器、攻擊目標甚至後門存在與否的知識。在三個MLLM、六種攻擊與兩種目標共36個設定中，平均ASR從98.6%降至1.1%，32個設定歸零，乾淨效用近似不變；消融顯示深層視窗與區域聚合是主要結構增益，模態加權進一步壓低殘餘ASR。限制為視窗起點與文字權重需手動設定，評測僅涵蓋7B級模型。這是首個針對MLLM的系統性模型級後門移除框架。
papers.title: Not All Tokens Are Equal: Region-Aware Consistency Repair of Backdoors in MLLMs
papers.title_zh: 並非所有token皆平等：多模態大型語言模型後門的區域感知一致性修復

Reproducibility statement: code, generator, edit suite and per-cell readout logs released at github.com/lyj20071013/Shortcut-Before-Circuit
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic-interpretability study of 26M-parameter transformers on a synthetic in-context assignment task, not an LLM paper, so it misses the heaviest-weighted preferences (LLM, Japanese NLP, reasoning, agents) but squarely hits Interpretability (mechanistic attribution, circuits, causal edits), In-Context Learning, and knowledge-conflict/RAG motivation, plus transformer training dynamics. Novelty is high: the exact aliasing construction (recency/rarity coextensive by Equation 1) yielding a criterion for when mechanism attribution is determined by the corpus, rather than a phase map, goes beyond the cited behavioral-conflict and ICL-phase work (Reddy 2024; Park et al. 2025; Meloux et al. 2025). Rigor is exceptional: measured generator invariants on 1500 docs/cell (App A.1), bit-identical reruns, filler-slot control edits within 0.015 nats (App C), three seeds x 25 cells, closed-form positional ceiling verified to within 2% (Table 7), multiple confound-breaking arms (App G), and an honestly reported failed geometry measurement (App I). Evidence within the synthetic setting is strong (0.879 cross-seed range vs 0.025 SE; within-run checkpoint SD 0.303; budget-sensitivity 0.55), with limitations explicitly bounding scope. Generalizability is the weak point: one task family, one architecture, no non-aliased control, and the claim is conditional on coextensiveness (Sec 8). Reproducibility is strong with full specification, released code, and deterministic reruns.

primary_link.title: Shortcut Before Circuit: Document Statistics Time In-Context Conflict Resolution

papers.summary: When a context asserts two values for one fact, a model commits to a cue -- recency, repetition, position -- but natural data rarely makes these disagree, so behavior cannot reveal which. We train 26M-parameter transformers on a synthetic language where recency and rarity are exactly coextensive, and separate them with a minimal causal edit that inverts one cue while holding the truth, token count and answer position fixed. All 75 runs reach accuracy >= 0.999, including where the trivial heurist
papers.summary_zh: 當文件對同一事實給出兩個值，模型必須選擇線索——新近性、重複次數或位置——但自然資料中這些線索幾乎不會分歧，行為因此無法揭示模型使用何者。本文以26M參數transformer訓練一種合成語言，使新近性與稀有性在訓練分布上精確等值，再以最小因果編輯反轉重複次數線索、固定真值與token數來分離兩規則。75次訓練全部達到準確率≥0.999，任何held-in評測都無法區分；但介入下每格讀數不重現：25格中13格跨三個seed的符號比例差逾0.3，最大0.879，遠超0.025的標準誤，而建構本身即預測此變異——等值規則使目標函式對兩者漠不關心，變異規模隨各比較釋放的最佳化量排序。可重現的是時序：逃離具閉式上限之位置捷徑的時點隨冗餘度單調變化；在電路形成前施測，32/75次運行的歸因在準確率不變下反號。作者據此提出準則：唯有當目標函式對候選規則不漠然時，機制方可歸因於語料統計；語料決定機制「何時」出現，而非「哪一個」。對機制可解釋性研究而言，這是關於解釋何時可判定的重要方法學警示，並揭示單seed歸因實驗的風險。限制包括單一架構家族與單一任務家族。

links.title: LifePlanner: Evaluating LLM Agents for Geo-spatial Planning with Social Media Data

evidence: Abstract: 'frontier LLMs perform well on simple retrieval but degrade sharply on complex planning, with the Pass Rate dropping to 40.2%'
Table 3: average PR@0.9 drops 89.4 (L0) → 57.7 (L1) → 40.2 (L2) while Token Usage rises 24.6k → 251.1k; Information Grounding 64.6 and Tool Efficiency 44.6 on L2
Section 3.1: environment covers ~10 km² with over 3,600 locations and ~200,000 RedNote notes/comments, accessed via an MCP server; distilled dynamic memory fields withheld from evaluated agents
Section 4.1: every model receives the same system prompt, MCP tools, output schema, and 30-tool-call budget to isolate model-level differences
Appendix B.2: judge ensemble (GPT-5.4, Claude Haiku 4.5, GLM-5.1) selected by comparing against human reference scores on 100 highest-variance cases; no agreement coefficients reported
Section 1: 'we will open-source all data-collection tools and publicly release the processed, anonymized benchmark data' — availability claim is future-tense, not verified in-document
Limitations: temporally concentrated single social-media snapshot, synthetic queries more explicit than natural requests, single-turn planning only
Table 1: comparison table claiming LifePlanner is the only listed benchmark combining environment, toolbox, social media, multi-task, and multi-difficulty dimensions
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark paper squarely on-topic for LLM agents: it evaluates 10 frontier LLMs (Claude-Sonnet-4.6, GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview, Qwen3.6-Plus, GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.6, etc.) on tool-using, multi-step geo-spatial planning over an MCP server with noisy social-media evidence. Strong agent/tool-use and evaluation preference match, moderate reasoning relevance. Novelty is incremental: geo-spatial/travel planning benchmarks exist (TravelPlanner, ChinaTravel, CityBench); the differentiators are the RedNote social-media evidence layer and 3-level difficulty stratification. Rigor is solid but not exceptional: 667 LLM-synthesized, manually verified cases, standardized scaffold with 30-tool-call budget, and a human-calibrated LLM-judge ensemble, though no quantitative judge-agreement statistics are reported and results are single-region (≈10 km², Wuhan), single-platform, single-turn. Quantitative claims are well supported (PR@0.9 falls 89.4→40.2 L0→L2; Information Grounding 64.6, Tool Efficiency 44.6 on L2) and the failure analysis (imprecise queries, incomplete evidence acquisition, weak constraint integration rather than hallucination) is backed by concrete metrics and case studies. Generalizability is limited by one region, one social-media snapshot, and synthetic queries — limitations the authors acknowledge. Reproducibility is promised (open-sourcing tools and data) but is future-tense and depends on commercial APIs (AMap, RedNote, proprietary LLMs); detailed tool schemas, prompts, and hyperparameters partially offset this. Not a pure domain application; falls within agents/evaluation scope.

primary_link.title: LifePlanner: Evaluating LLM Agents for Geo-spatial Planning with Social Media Data

papers.summary: Geo-spatial planning, like trip design, is a realistic testbed for LLM agents because it requires grounded tool use, noisy evidence retrieval, and multi-constraint reasoning. Most benchmarks, however, only provide clean geospatial data and tools, missing the open-ended social signals that people use in daily planning. We introduce LifePlanner, a benchmark that enriches map data with large-scale local social media posts and provides access through an MCP toolset. LifePlanner provides an evaluatio
papers.summary_zh: 地理空間規劃是評測LLM代理的現實場域，需要接地工具使用、嘈雜證據檢索與多約束推理，但既有基準多提供乾淨的地理資料與工具，缺乏真實使用者依賴的開放式社群訊號。LifePlanner以約十平方公里城市區域、逾三千六百個地點與約二十萬則社群媒體貼文及留言（RedNote）擴充地圖資料，透過MCP工具集提供檢索與基礎空間分析，並設計四類任務（地點感知、附近探索、路徑規劃、行程設計）與三級難度，共667個查詢，同時評分最終答案與工具使用軌跡。評測十個前沿與開源模型顯示：簡單檢索表現良好，但最難層級L2的平均Pass Rate僅40.2%；過程指標指出失敗主要來自大型多模態資料庫中證據蒐集不全（資訊接地降至64.6%）、工具查詢不精確造成空結果與冗餘呼叫（工具效率44.6%），以及約束整合薄弱，而非嚴重幻覺；擴大模型規模或延長推理皆不足以彌補。限制包括單一時點的社群語料、合成查詢與單輪設定。此基準將評測推向貼近真實生活的規劃，指出未來代理需要更有效的證據分析與約束聚合能力，而非僅靠規模。

links.title: Learning Mixtures of Plackett-Luce Models for Multi-Objective Alignment

evidence: Section 1: 'The code for replicating these empirical findings is available at https://github.com/VirtuosoResearch/MoPLEx-implementation'
Section 3, Proposition 3.1: 'For a mixture of k PL models defined over m-way rankings, when m ≤ 2k−1, the model is non-identifiable' (Slightly adapted from Zhao et al. (2016))
Section 5.1 'Datasets and models': UltraFeedback with m=4, k=4 (3,612 training rankings) and Persona with m=2, k=12 (1,905 training rankings); 'We use Qwen-3-0.6B as the base language model'
Table 3: MoPLEx clustering accuracy 70.9±2.3 (UltraFeedback) and 57.1±0.5 (Persona) vs EM-DPO 26.9±2.1 and 18.3±0.5; ranking accuracy 75.0±2.9 and 76.4±0.6
Table 4 ablations: 'w/o gradient estimation' 75.6±2.3 vs full MoPLEx 75.0±2.9 ranking accuracy on UltraFeedback, and 'w/o mixture models' 65.5±1.8
Table 1 and Appendix Table 5: relative approximation error 0.1%-5.4% across Qwen-0.6B to CodeLlama-34B on UltraFeedback and HelpSteer2, grouped by embedding distance buckets
Section 4.1: 'Over 81% of the generated responses score below existing responses, and none is ranked in the top two positions'
Limitations and Future Works: 'our algorithm treats generated responses ranked lower than existing responses in the dataset as an approximation'
Appendix B.4: 'For the Persona dataset, setting k=12 results in 40.5% additional parameters' via LoRA adapters
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment/preference-optimization methodology (mixtures of Plackett-Luce models over multiway rankings, DPO-parameterized scores, LoRA adapters), matching the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, Alignment & RLHF). Novelty is moderate: the non-identifiability threshold is 'slightly adapted from Zhao et al. (2016)' (Proposition 3.1), and the first-order gradient approximation builds on the authors' own prior work (Zhang et al. 2025c; Li et al. 2024b/2025b); the ranking-augmentation trick with an identifiability proof (Prop 4.1) and its EM integration are the genuinely new pieces. Rigor is solid: proofs in Appendices A.3-A.4, synthetic validation of unidentifiability (Fig. 4, Fig. 6), three seeds with std devs, five baselines (DPO, LiPO, MiCRo, MaxMin-RLHF, EM-DPO), and component ablations (Table 4). Evidence is decent but training-scale evidence rests on one small model (Qwen-3-0.6B) and two real datasets (UltraFeedback k=4, Persona k=12); approximation-error claims (<5%) are only measured within embedding-distance buckets up to 25% (Tables 1, 5), and headline gains (43.7%/15.2%) are loosely specified as points vs relative. The assumed 'generated responses rank lower' heuristic is validated only empirically (81% below existing, none in top two) and flagged in Limitations. Generalizability within alignment is supported by error studies across five models up to 34B and an extension to Mallows models, but is bounded to single-turn settings and fixed k. Reproducibility is good: code URL given (Section 1), public datasets and model sources listed (Tables 10-11), hyperparameters reported.

primary_link.title: Learning Mixtures of Plackett-Luce Models for Multi-Objective Alignment

papers.summary: We consider the problem of learning a mixture of $k$ Plackett-Luce models given multi-way ranking responses from annotators that may represent heterogeneous underlying preferences. This problem has many applications in AI alignment and preference optimization. Prior work has studied mixtures of Bradley-Terry models from pairwise comparisons. However, uncovering mixture models is theoretically unidentifiable when $k$ exceeds $m/2$, where $m$ is the length of a ranking. We propose an efficient imp
papers.summary_zh: RLHF與偏好最佳化常假設單一排名模型，但偏好資料常來自異質子群體或多重評估準則，需要學習排名模型的混合。本文指出關鍵可識別性限制：混合k個排名模型時，若排名長度m≤2k−1，則存在產生相同排名分布的不同混合，真實分群無法辨識；合成實驗顯示成對比較在k=3、4時崩壞至隨機猜測。為此提出MoPLEx：先以基礎模型生成額外回應，將排名增廣至m′（實測逾81%生成回應排序低於既有回應），使混合模型可識別；再以輸入嵌入空間的一階梯度近似，僅對少量anchor回應計算完整前向與梯度，將每次迭代的成本自O(km)降至O(ka)；整體以期望最大化演算法交替估計分群後驗與更新參數。實驗顯示梯度近似在最多34B參數模型上誤差小於5%；在UltraFeedback與Persona資料集上，相較單一排名模型與Bradley-Terry混合基線，分群與排名準確率平均分別提升43.7%與15.2%，並節省最多3倍的GPU時間與記憶體。限制包括生成回應排序較低的近似假設與固定群集數。此方法為異質偏好下的語言模型對齊提供可擴充且理論上有據的路徑。

links.title: DeepRepoQA: Code Repository Question Answering with Deep Agent Exploration

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: MCTS-based agentic framework with Perception/Planning/Execution/Evaluation agents for repository QA; evaluated on SWE-QA (Section 4.3), a benchmark from the same first author (Peng et al., 2026).
Section 3.4.3: simulation is a single-step agent loop with LLM-assigned value replacing multi-step rollouts — a modest adaptation of existing MCTS-agent ideas rather than a new mechanism.

Table 2 (Section 5.1): DeepRepoQA overall 65.90 vs OpenHands 65.02 on GLM-4.6 (+0.88) but 68.71 vs 65.30 on Kimi K2 and 64.43 vs 62.33 on Qwen3-Coder; Conclusion's 'consistent 4-7% improvements over SOTA agent baselines' does not hold uniformly against OpenHands.
Table 3 (Section 5.2): ablations quantify component contributions (Evaluation Agent removal −3.50, MCTS removal −2.27, Perception −1.73, Semantic Search −1.07 on Qwen3-Coder backbone).

Section 5.3 text vs Table 4: 'Correctness increases from 8.27 to 11.57' matches the Overall column, and 'Reasoning from 8.81 to 12.88 (+0.07)' matches the Clarity column with an incorrect delta — internal reporting inconsistency.

Section 6.1 & Appendix C: judge reliability study (360 answers, 3 human experts vs 3 LLM judges) with Pearson r=0.972, Cohen's kappa=0.725, Krippendorff's alpha 0.82-0.91 on 4/5 dimensions (Clarity alpha 0.324-0.420), partially offsetting LLM-as-judge concerns; Section 6.1 reports rho_overall=1 among LLM judges without probing.
Section 6.3.2 & Appendix D: Java subset (30 QA pairs, 3 repositories) used for cross-language check; DeepRepoQA ranks first among open methods but trails Cursor by 1.81 points.

Data-Availability Statement: code and data at Zenodo DOI plus GitHub link; Section 4.5 and Appendix F give hyperparameters (voyage-code-3, max_expand=3, temperature 0.7/0, 15-iteration cap) and full prompts.
Appendix B (Table B1): token usage reported per model, but no statistical significance tests, confidence intervals, or multi-seed variance for any main comparison.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to agent/tool-use, code QA, and LLM reasoning preferences. The work is a competent systems paper: MCTS-guided multi-agent repository QA with a clear action space, four LLM backbones, RAG/agent/commercial baselines, component ablations, budget sweep, token-cost analysis, LLM-judge reliability study with human validation, and a Java generalization check. However, the core method (MCTS over agent actions with LLM value feedback, e.g., LATS/ToT-style search) is incremental; evaluation rests entirely on LLM-as-judge over the authors' own SWE-QA benchmark with no significance testing or variance/seed reporting; margins over OpenHands vary widely (+0.88 on GLM-4.6 to +5.84 on GPT-5.1) making the Conclusion's 'consistent 4-7% improvements' claim overstated; and the RQ3 text mislabels table dimensions (Overall reported as Correctness, Clarity as Reasoning, with a wrong +0.07 delta), indicating reporting sloppiness. Judge-panel perfect ranking agreement (rho=1) is asserted without adequate explanation. Code/data availability, prompts, and hyperparameters support reproducibility, though proprietary-API dependence raises cost barriers.

primary_link.title: DeepRepoQA: Code Repository Question Answering with Deep Agent Exploration

papers.summary: Answering developer questions about a software repository is a critical yet under-explored problem in software engineering. While existing repository understanding methods have advanced the field, they predominantly rely on surface-level code retrieval and lack the ability for deep reasoning over multiple files, complex software architectures, and grounding answers in long-range code dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose DeepRepoQA, a novel question answering (QA) framework for
papers.summary_zh: 回答開發者對軟體儲存庫的問題需跨檔案追蹤呼叫鏈、整合分散證據並理解架構意圖，但現有方法多停留在函式層級或扁平檢索，ReAct式單路徑代理也易因錯誤軌跡漏失證據。DeepRepoQA將儲存庫問答轉為以蒙地卡羅樹搜尋（MCTS）為骨架的規劃問題：四個專責代理協作——感知代理彙整搜尋狀態與兄弟分支，規劃代理提出候選動作，執行代理在以AST與語意索引為基礎的動作空間（FindClass、FindFunction、SemanticSearch、ViewCode等）上蒐集並篩選證據，評估代理給出效用分數並回傳，回饋沿樹傳播以引導探索，最終以含程式碼引用的證據合成答案。在擴充後的SWE-QA基準（15個儲存庫、720組問答）上，DeepRepoQA於四個LLM骨幹一致超越SWE-agent與OpenHands，最高領先7.08分，以GPT-5.1達70.06分，接近Cursor等商業工具；增益集中在正確性、完整性與推理。消融顯示MCTS貢獻2.27分，評估代理最關鍵（移除掉3.50分），語意搜尋與感知代理再添穩定與效率。限制包括資料污染只能緩解，開放式設計題受單一參考答案評分懲罰。此工作示範系統性樹搜尋對多跳儲存庫推理的價值。

links.title: Low-Rank Ternary Adaptation for Fine-Tuning Transformers

evidence: Abstract: proposes ternary multiplicative adaptation preserving the ternary domain with dequant-free merging; claims code available at github.com/alexmanoo/ternary_adaptation and evaluation on six models across language and vision.
Sec 1 / Table 1: positioning table claims only this method simultaneously supports ternary base weights, dequant-free merge, and a ternary merged model versus QLoRA and QA-LoRA.
Sec 4.1: zero-shot evaluation via lm-evaluation-harness v0.4.9.1; Alpaca fine-tuning with AdamW lr 1.5e-3, one epoch, single NVIDIA A40 (48GB); ~0.06% trainable parameters for Llama-3.2-1B (Table 5).

Table 4 / Sec 4.2: Llama-3.2-3B average accuracy 31.9 -> 38.3 and WikiText-2 PPL 45.6 -> 22.3 vs ternary SpinQuant; beats 2-bit SpinQuant on all nine benchmarks; for 1B, six of nine benchmarks improve with up to 0.8-point regressions on three.
Table 6 (Sec 4.3): merged ternary ours 38.3 avg / 22.3 PPL vs QLoRA requantized 37.5 / 22.9 on Llama-3.2-3B Alpaca fine-tuning.
Table 7 (Sec 4.4): GSM8K EM gains of +2.9 (BitNet 2B4T), +3.1 (Falcon-E-1B), +1.0 (Falcon-E-3B) over frozen ternary baselines, with no other adaptation baselines tested.
Table 8 (Sec 4.5): ternary ViT-B/16 ImageNet-100 Top-1: Full-FT 85.7, QLoRA 85.3, QLoRA requantized 78.9, ours 83.0.
Sec 4.6 / Tables 9-10 / S1: weight-transition analysis shows zero weights cannot be reactivated and ~49% of non-zero weights flip sign under Balanced init, supporting the mechanism claim.
Sec 5: acknowledged limitations - multiplicative update cannot reactivate zero weights and Kronecker structure may constrain update patterns for poorly factorable layer shapes.

S2 Table 11: initialization ablation (Balanced 35.3 avg/44.6 PPL; All-ones 35.1/45.7; Normalized 34.9/52.0); S3 reports 31.0GB peak VRAM and 1.43h per epoch vs QLoRA 31.2GB/1.83h; no seeds or variance reported anywhere.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology work: parameter-efficient fine-tuning of ternary-quantized LLMs (Llama-3.2, BitNet, Falcon-E) via a novel multiplicative Kronecker ternary adapter that merges without dequantization. Hits the LLM (2.5), Scaling & Efficiency, Training/PEFT, and Transformer clusters, with a small ViT experiment; no Japanese/agents/reasoning/RAG coverage, so preference relevance is solid but not top-tier. Novelty is genuine but combinational (LoKr-style Kronecker decomposition + multiplicative updates + STE). Rigor benefits from six models, multiple PTQ/PEFT baselines, initialization ablations, and a mechanism analysis (weight transitions), but is limited by single-run results with no variance, no QA-LoRA/other-PEFT empirical baselines on ternary backbones, and GSM8K-only evaluation for pre-trained ternary models. Evidence is specific and verifiable with released code, though comparisons like 1.58-bit-adapted vs 2-bit PTQ are somewhat asymmetric. Limitations (zero-locking, factor-shape constraints) are honestly stated. Reproducibility is strong: code, hyperparameters, harness version, VRAM/time figures.

primary_link.title: Low-Rank Ternary Adaptation for Fine-Tuning Transformers

papers.summary: Ternary transformers offer extreme memory and compute efficiency, but existing low-bit LoRA-based methods cannot directly fine-tune ternary weights. Current approaches either require dequantization, restoring low-bit base weights to higher precision to merge with adaptation weight, or update only quantization parameters, preventing a merged model that remains ternary. We propose ternary multiplicative adaptation, which represents discrete updates of ternary weights such as sign flips or zeroing
papers.summary_zh: 三元量化 Transformer 的記憶與算力成本極低,但現有低位元 LoRA 方法無法直接微調三元權重。本文提出三元乘性適配:以元素相乘的離散操作(保留、歸零、翻轉符號)描述三元權重更新,並將更新以 Kronecker 分解表示為兩個小型三元矩陣;訓練時最佳化實值代理,再以 straight-through estimator 傳遞梯度。此設計參數效率高、保持三元域,訓練後可直接合併回基底權重,無需去量化或重量化,推論時零額外開銷。在 Llama-3.2 1B/3B 與 ViT-B/16 等六個語言與視覺模型上,方法恢復大部分因三元化損失的效能:Llama-3.2-1B 平均準確率自 33.2 提升至 35.3,困惑度從 86.5 降至 44.6,並在多數任務上超越 2-bit 基線與重新量化的 QLoRA;預訓練三元模型於 GSM8K 亦獲 1 至 3 點提升。權重轉移分析顯示增益主要來自非零權重的符號重新分配。限制在於乘性更新無法重新激活已歸零權重(零鎖定),且 Kronecker 結構可能限制難以因式分解的層形。此工作為極低位元模型提供了可合併、零開銷的參數高效微調路徑。
papers.title: Low-Rank Ternary Adaptation for Fine-Tuning Transformers
papers.title_zh: 適用於 Transformer 微調的低秩三元適配

links.title: The Imperfective Paradox Is Not Necessarily in Large Language Models: A Benchmark Failure Before a Model Failure

evidence: Abstract: 'Under a strict NLI standard, 76% of Group A instances do not explicitly rule out culmination. In our native-speaker annotation, 38% of Group A examples and 29% of the Group C examples were judged to permit an alternative interpretation.'
Section 3: identifies three mis-specifications (Aspectual Reduction, Semantic Mis-specification, Relation Misassignments) with worked counterexamples (A_098, B_007, C_018, A_094, A_081).

Appendix B (Data): 'The Original dataset contains 400 examples... The VSS dataset removes 97 examples... resulting in 303 examples... The Minimal-Pair dataset contains 200 newly constructed examples, with 50 examples per group.'

Appendix C: 'Three native English-speaking annotators independently annotated all 400 premise-hypothesis pairs'; Table 10 reports 38%/2%/29%/1% alternative-label support and majority-vote reproduction of 71%/98%/71%/99%.

Section 4.2, Tables 2-3: completion probes and occurrence-to-completion experiment showing 'the largest decision shift occurs once event occurrence is established', supporting the Sufficiency Bias claim.
Section 4.3, Table 5 and DAPCoT ablation paragraph: 'The largest decline occurs when the mapping from semantic facts to simple-past truth conditions is removed.'
Section 5.1, Table 6: intermediate-output evaluation identifies 'the two bottlenecks are aspectual classification and final rule application.'
Section 5.3, Table 8: oracle-guided experiments introduce 'Surface-form Attraction' with semantic vs. opaque label representations.
Section 5.4, Table 9: Qwen2.5-72B and GPT-5.4 results; errors attributed 'primarily at the aspectual classification stage'.

Limitations and Future Work: acknowledges single background-informed annotation setting, controlled examples not capturing natural variation, simplified linguistic operationalization, and behavioral-only intermediate probes.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark-critique paper squarely in scope for LLM reasoning and evaluation research: it reexamines the ImperfectiveNLI benchmark, formulates event-semantic NLI as an eight-step reasoning problem, and diagnoses prompting-induced 'Decision Shift' versus genuine semantic improvement. Directly hits high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, prompting, evaluation). Rigor is solid: a 3-annotator human study over all 400 examples, lexically matched minimal pairs, VSS sensitivity analysis, prompt ablations (DAPCoT-n/-d/-p), intermediate-output probes, and oracle-guided experiments across four 7B-9B models plus Qwen2.5-72B and GPT-5.4. Evidence is credible but bounded: small annotator pool, single background-informed annotation protocol (acknowledged in Limitations), no significance testing, and headline claims about large models are framed as 'initial evidence'. Novelty is moderate-to-good: the Sufficiency Bias vs. Teleological Bias reframing and controlled minimal-pair construction are useful, but the reanalysis-plus-diagnostics template is familiar in NLP. Generalizability is limited by the narrow linguistic phenomenon, though methodological lessons (benchmark validity, surface-form attraction, prompt-induced label shifts) transfer. Reproducibility is aided by fully specified prompts, decoding parameters, and dataset construction details, but no explicit code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: The Imperfective Paradox Is Not Necessarily in Large Language Models: A Benchmark Failure Before a Model Failure

papers.summary: The imperfective paradox provides a useful test of compositional semantic analysis. Recent work constructs an NLI benchmark and reports that models frequently infer completed telic events from progressive descriptions, attributing this behavior to a Teleological Bias. It further argues that prompting interventions cause a Calibration Crisis. We reexamine the benchmark and conclusions and show that it is substantially affected by conceptual and evaluation mis-specifications. We identify three con
papers.summary_zh: 近期研究以自然語言推論(NLI)基準宣稱大型語言模型存在「目的論偏誤」,會從進行式描述推斷目的性事件已完成,並稱提示介入導致「校準危機」。本文重新檢視該基準,指出三項概念性錯置:層面化約(詞彙體貌應由完整述語決定,而非孤立動詞)、語意錯置(完成與否並非二元的脈絡無關條件)與關係誤配(中斷不等於未完成)。在嚴格 NLI 標準下,76% 的 A 組實例並未明確排除完成;母語者標註顯示 38% 的 A 組與 29% 的 C 組範例允許替代解讀。作者建構詞彙匹配最小對立組以控制詞彙變異,並將事件語意 NLI 形式化為多步推理問題,發現模型其實未必虛構完成,而是展現「充分性偏誤」:僅因事件發生便接受簡單過去式假設;提示介入多屬「決策位移」,改變標籤偏好而非真正改善理解。診斷另發現層面分類錯誤與表層形式吸引兩種失敗模式。GPT-5.4 與 Qwen2.5-72B 的表現接近人類標註者。此研究提醒:基準本身的失效可能先於模型失效,語意評估設計需更嚴謹。

links.title: Contrastive Branch Policy Optimization

evidence: Abstract: CBPO targets credit assignment for 'language models to learn multi-turn interaction with external tools' under RLVR, evaluated on 'ten benchmarks—five for mathematical reasoning and five for knowledge-intensive search'.

Section 4.2-4.3: entropy-guided full-response candidate discovery with path/node decay, and CBV defined as 'the population standard deviation of group rewards' within exact-prefix groups modulating advantages via Eq. (17).
Section 4.4: Properties 1-3 show entropy bounds attainable outcome information, CBV is an unbiased estimator of conditional outcome variance (Eq. 26), and bounded modulation preserves advantage sign.

Section 5.1 'Evaluation controls': 'All methods use the same system prompt, tool interfaces, decoding settings, and answer-extraction procedure'; matched 16 rollout slots; hyperparameters fully listed (w=20, K=10, d_min=64, J_max=3, eta=0.2, phi=2.0).
Table 1: CBPO achieves Math Avg 66.0 (1.7B) and 69.3 (4B) vs. ARPO 64.3/67.1, and Search Avg 53.2/57.5 vs. 51.4/55.7.
Section 5.4 / Table 2: removing CBV costs 3.0 (1.7B) and 2.9 (4B) macro points; removing both decay levels costs 2.2 points.
Section 5.3: trajectory analysis is 'qualitative mechanism checks, not population-level or causal evidence'; 'A controlled tool-boundary-only ablation remains necessary'.

Section 5.1: AIME 2024/2025 contain 30 problems each ('one additional correct answer changes accuracy by 3.3 percentage points'); no confidence intervals or seed variance reported anywhere in Tables 1-3.
Section 5.1 'Training setup': Qwen3-1.7B/4B backbones, training data from Tool-Star (5,000 math; 10,000 open-domain samples); no code or artifact release is mentioned in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM methodology paper: fine-grained credit assignment for RLVR-based tool-integrated agent training, directly matching the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, RL). Novelty is moderate: it recombines known ingredients (entropy-based branch selection from ARPO, GRPO-style group advantages, tree-based local comparison from Tree-GRPO/GIGPO) with a new variance-based CBV modulation and decay-balanced budgeting — an incremental but coherent disentangling of allocation from attribution. Rigor is solid: formal method specification (Sec. 4), simple but correct theoretical properties (Sec. 4.4), 13 baselines across two model scales under matched rollout budgets and shared tool/verifier controls (Sec. 5.1), and component ablations (Table 2) plus rollout-allocation sweep (Table 3). Evidence is weakened by absence of significance tests, error bars, or seed variance, and small evaluation sets (30 AIME problems, acknowledged in Sec. 5.1); gains of 1.7-2.2 macro points over the strongest baseline are plausible but single-run. Generalizability is limited to Qwen3 1.7B/4B and two tool-reasoning domains with 16 rollout slots. Reproducibility is supported by exhaustive hyperparameters and Algorithm 1, but no code release is stated. The authors honestly flag the missing tool-boundary-only ablation (Sec. 5.3, Conclusion).

primary_link.title: Contrastive Branch Policy Optimization

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enables language models to learn multi-turn interaction with external tools, yet its sparse outcome rewards provide no signal for identifying which intermediate decisions are responsible for success. Branch sampling induces local comparisons among alternative continuations, but existing methods tend to conflate two distinct problems: allocating a fixed rollout budget and translating branch outcomes into token-level credit. We introduce Contra
papers.summary_zh: 帶可驗證獎勵的強化學習(RLVR)僅提供稀疏結果獎勵,無法指出哪些中間決策造成成敗;分支取樣方法則常將固定的 rollout 預算分配與將分支結果轉為 token 級信用兩個問題混為一談。CBPO(Contrastive Branch Policy Optimization)將兩者拆解:以生成熵在整條回應中篩選候選分支位置,並以路徑層與節點層衰減分配固定預算,避免探索塌縮到少數路徑或相鄰 token;父軌跡與共享相同前綴的分支形成精確前綴群組,群組內獎勵變異定義對比分支價值(CBV),在不改變優勢符號的前提下重新縮放延續優勢;複製前綴不計梯度,多節點時軌跡被切分為不重疊的信用片段。方法只需結果獎勵、不需過程標註。在數學推理與知識密集搜尋各五項基準、兩種模型規模(Qwen3-1.7B/4B)上,CBPO 均超越 GRPO、GIGPO、Tree-GRPO、ARPO 等強基線,數學宏平均達 66.0% 與 69.3%,搜尋平均 53.2 與 57.5;消融證實雙層衰減與 CBV 各自貢獻,Pass@3/5 亦持續領先。作者坦承全回應掃描相對僅工具邊界的獨立消融仍待補足,分支取樣也增加訓練時的生成成本。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-based search-agent training paper squarely in scope: it hits high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RAG/hallucination, RL, DPO-style preference optimization, Training & Optimization) by coupling in-trajectory feedback requests (CFE reward, advantage shaping) with rollout-derived preference optimization (RDPO) in a shared-parameter Qwen2.5 backbone. Evaluation is broad: seven SearchQA benchmarks, six OOD transfers, 3B/7B scales, component and schedule ablations, agent-critic cross-play, hallucination analysis, and a task-update-preservation theorem. Strengths are the thorough ablation suite (Tables 2-3, 6; Figure 3 cross-play showing same-iteration critic alignment) and consistent internal numbers (SFT 40.8 EM -> GRPO 49.7 -> CAFE 52.5, Table 1). Weaknesses temper the score: margins over the strongest baseline are modest (2.1 EM over IGPO) with no significance testing or variance reporting on 500-example test sets; baseline protocols are mixed (Search-R1/R-Search numbers taken from original papers, IGPO reproduced initialized from the authors' own SFT checkpoint, Table 1 notes), which confounds comparisons; novelty is incremental over GRPO, DPO, and existing co-evolving-critic work (ECHO, cited in Section 5, already co-evolves policy and critic, differing mainly in post-hoc vs in-trajectory timing); and no code or checkpoint release is stated anywhere in the document, with reproducibility further burdened by an undocumented Kimi-K2.5 teacher bootstrap (Section 2.1). Evidence quality is solid but single-seed; generalizability is demonstrated within QA/search only.

primary_link.title: CAFE: Self-Improving Search Agents Need Co-Evolving Feedback

papers.summary: Outcome-supervised search agents learn when and how to retrieve evidence, but terminal rewards neither localize intermediate errors nor redirect an ongoing trajectory before those errors compound. Treating corrective feedback as a learned in-trajectory intervention couples the two roles: the agent must decide when to request and use feedback, while the critic must infer useful corrections from outcome-confounded rollouts whose failure patterns shift as the agent improves. We introduce CAFE (Coup
papers.summary_zh: 結果導向監督的搜尋代理學會何時檢索,但終端獎勵無法定位中間錯誤,更無法在錯誤累積前導正軌跡。CAFE 提出代理與回饋共同演化的框架:單一共享參數模型在搜尋代理與評論者角色間交替。初始化階段以基底代理自身的失敗軌跡建構復原示範——保留錯誤前綴、插入回饋請求、由教師模型生成修正性回饋並完成續寫。線上 RL 中,比較性回饋估計(CFE)以同提示下請求與否的成功差距塑造請求報酬,回饋感知的優勢整形則在回饋前後重新加權 token 優勢;離線階段以 rollout 衍生的偏好最佳化(RDPO)從前綴匹配的成功與失敗軌跡學習評論,並與線上更新交替迭代。在七項 SearchQA 基準上,CAFE 以 7B 骨幹達平均 EM 52.5、F1 60.7,優於最強 RL 基線 IGPO,且於六項域外資料集全面保留增益,答案層幻覺率自 17.6% 降至 12.6%。單側消融顯示僅改進代理或評論者終會飽和,交替更新持續提升;交叉對照證實增益來自與演化中策略的對齊,而非單純的評論者強度。限制包括對大型教師模型的依賴、訓練成本,以及提示設計可能影響標註協定的效度。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A consequence-aware LLM evaluation methodology instantiated in air traffic control: evaluates 8 LLMs (GPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama) across zero-shot/knowledge/few-shot/CoT prompting ablations and LoRA fine-tuning, introducing non-compensatory geometric scoring (AR-Geo) plus directional downgrade metrics (DDR/WDS). Strongly matches LLM, AI-safety, evaluation/benchmark, prompting, and NLP preferences; not agent-, code-, or Japanese-LLM-focused. Rigor is solid: expert weights from 40 controllers with reported ICC/kappa (Appendix H, Table 11), sensitivity analyses over epsilon, weights, and schema strictness (Appendix B), bootstrap CIs (Appendix D.4), and human-alignment validation (AR-Geo r=0.68 vs NER-F1 r=0.44, Table 3). Evidence for the central semantic-safety gap is quantitatively supported (e.g., qwen3-8b 0.308 NER-F1 vs 0.109 AR-Geo, Table 4; ninefold DDR split at similar AR-Geo, Section 6.3). Novelty is moderate since cost-sensitive and behavioral evaluation have precedents (CheckList, SEScore) and the paper itself extends the authors' prior safety-oriented ATC evaluation (Section 2, Chang et al. 2026); the geometric metric and downgrade metrics are sensible but incremental. Generalizability is limited: weights and taxonomy are ATC-specific and cross-domain transfer is only a recipe, not an experiment (Appendix J, Limitations), and fine-tuning uses a single 8B backbone. Reproducibility is good: code, data, prompts, adapters, hyperparameters, and inference dates are released, though API snapshot drift is acknowledged (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: Beyond Semantic Accuracy: Consequence-Aware Evaluation for Safety-Critical Language Understanding

papers.summary: Can language models be trusted in safety- critical operations? In such settings, strong per- formance on semantic metrics does not guaran- tee operational reliability: a misread altitude, a dropped execution condition, or a confused call- sign may score well under standard F1 yet carry sharply asymmetric operational consequences. We study this problem in air traffic control (ATC), where controller-pilot communication demands near-zero error tolerance, and use consequence-aware evaluation to test
papers.summary_zh: 語意準確度高的模型未必可信任於安全關鍵場景:誤讀高度、漏掉執行條件或混淆呼號,在標準 F1 下可能得分相近,操作後果卻天差地遠。本文以航管(ATC)為測試場,建立後果感知評估框架:依 ICAO 標準與來自三國四十位航管員的專家評分,定義動作與槽位風險權重,採用不可補償的幾何評分 AR-Geo,漏掉高權重欄位會使分數急遽崩落,並釋出雙任務診斷基準——任務一為結構化指令理解,任務二為覆誦安全性判斷,含方向性的危險降級率(DDR)與加權降級嚴重度(WDS)。評估八個模型後發現系統性的「語意—安全落差」:NER-F1 大幅高估操作可靠性,部分模型語意分數相近但降級率相差九倍;提示增強與風險感知微調(Risk-LoRA)可收窄但無法消除落差。限制在於槽位權重與分類屬 ATC 專屬、覆誦採受控擾動而非實際流量,離部署等級仍有距離。此框架原則上可轉移至醫療、自駕等能定義動作、關鍵欄位與嚴重度的領域,凸顯標準 NLP 指標不足以支撐安全部署宣稱。

Section 4.2: Removing QK-Norm increases mean collapse error from 2.3×10⁻³ to 5.2×10⁻³; additionally fixing RMSNorm gains increases it to 1.84×10⁻², ruling out static scale invariance as a sufficient explanation.
Section 6: Fitted on four non-Hyperball runs, elr-FSL achieves OOD Hyperball RMSE of 0.0212 vs lr-FSL 0.2508 (11.83× larger), demonstrating scaling-law transfer across norm-control regimes.

Appendix B: Training configurations specify batch size 128, sequence length 1024, optimizer hyperparameters (AdamW β₁=0.9 β₂=0.95), model architectures adapted from Modded-NanoGPT and Qwen3, and ELR-matching protocols with mathematical detail.
Appendix G: ELR collapse extends to ViT/ImageNet (Δ_coll ∈ [3.16, 3.19]×10⁻³), and the normalization dependence (QK-Norm, learnable gains) replicates in ViTs.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed empirical study of LLM pretraining dynamics establishing that the effective learning rate (ELR = LR / parameter norm) governs loss trajectories. Strongly relevant to the 'Large Language Models' (2.5) and 'Training & Optimization' (1.5) preferences, moderately to 'Scaling & Efficiency' (1.3), but does not touch Agents (2.5), Reasoning (2.5), Japanese LLM (2.5), Safety (2.0), Alignment (2.0), or Code (2.0). Novelty is solid: ELR was known under exact scale invariance, but demonstrating high-precision collapse (10⁻³) in non-scale-invariant transformers and identifying conditioning factors (QK-Norm, learnable gains, timescale) is a genuine advance. Rigor is high with paired controlled comparisons, seed-variation calibration, ablations, reverse-direction interventions, and cross-architecture (dense, MoE, linear attention, ViT), cross-optimizer (AdamW, Muon, Signum), cross-dataset, and cross-scale (100M–1B) validation. Evidence is strong with 26 quantitative comparisons (median 2.5×10⁻³) and FSL transfer achieving 11.83× RMSE improvement on OOD Hyperball runs. Generalizability is decent but explicitly limited to training-loss dynamics (not downstream performance, representations, or parameter trajectories), and the microscopic mechanism remains open. Reproducibility is supported by detailed protocols and public datasets, though no explicit code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Effective Learning Rate Governs Loss Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining

papers.summary: We uncover ELR collapse in language model pretraining: learning rate (LR) and parameter norm govern loss dynamics primarily through their ratio, the effective learning rate (ELR). When ELR is matched across runs, their loss trajectories collapse throughout training despite substantially different LRs and parameter norms. Across optimizers, architectures, datasets, and model scales, mean collapse errors are typically a few x 10^-3, below the seed-to-seed variation measured in a representative con
papers.summary_zh: 本文揭出 ELR 崩塌現象:學習率與參數範數主要透過兩者的比值——有效學習率(ELR)——主導語言模型預訓練的損失動態。當不同運行匹配相同的 ELR 排程時,儘管 LR 與範數軌跡差異巨大,整條損失曲線近乎重合,平均崩塌誤差僅數個 10^-3,低於種子間變異(約 10^-2)。此結論跨 AdamW、Muon、Signum 等最佳化器、密集與 MoE 架構、多種資料集與模型規模皆成立。消融顯示崩塌精度取決於 QK-Norm、可學習 RMSNorm 增益以及 LR–範數變化的時間尺度,顯示高精度崩塌並非源自靜態尺度不變性。研究進一步證明 weight decay 與 Hyperball 對損失的影響主要經由其誘導的 ELR 排程;以 ELR 參數化的函數式縮放律可跨範數控制方法遷移,於未見的 Hyperball 運行上誤差改善逾十倍,並解釋「延遲加速」現象:範數控制早期維持較大 ELR,增益先累積、後顯現。限制在於此為宏觀經驗律,微觀機制未明,且僅限損失動態,不保證表徵或下游表現一致。此結果建議先設計 ELR 排程,再選擇實現它的 LR 與範數控制機制。
papers.title: Effective Learning Rate Governs Loss Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
papers.title_zh: 有效學習率主導語言模型預訓練的損失動態

Table 1 caption: 'Baseline numbers are taken from Lu et al. (2026b)'

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-scope: multi-turn LLM agent RL (GRPO) with self-distillation credit assignment, matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RL, Reasoning). Novelty is moderate: the advantage-reweighting mechanism is explicitly adopted from RLSD ('Following RLSD (Yang et al., 2026), we convert the token-level self-distillation signal...' Sec 2.4); the contribution is step-aware PI construction (env feedback on all steps + LLM corrective hints on error steps) and failure-only filtering. Rigor is solid: three benchmarks, three model scales, nine baselines, one-component ablations (Table 2), analyzer-swap ablation (Table 3), and a mechanistic check (Appendix E.3: error-step |δ| AUROC 0.87). Weaknesses: main-table baselines are taken from Lu et al. (2026b) rather than re-run (Table 1 note), 128-task eval sets without variance/significance reporting, MuSiQue/Bamboogle regressions not discussed, and dependence on a proprietary frontier analyzer (Claude Opus 4.7), which the Limitations honestly flag as untested with small open models. Generalizability is bounded by environments with discrete, identifiable errors and binary rewards (Limitations). Reproducibility is good (Algorithm 1, Appendix F hyperparameters, Appendix G prompts, project page/model card) but partially hinge on a closed-source analyzer. primary_link.title: AHEAD: Adaptive Hindsight with Environment-Augmented Distillation for Agentic RL

papers.summary: Training multi-turn LLM agents with reinforcement learning typically relies on trajectory-level rewards, which assign a uniform advantage to every step and cannot identify which decisions led to success or failure. Self-distillation methods can provide finer-grained supervision by augmenting RL with privileged information. However, existing approaches usually apply the same type of privileged information to every step in an indistinguishable manner, ignoring a key asymmetry: routine steps need l
papers.summary_zh: 多輪 LLM 代理的強化學習通常依賴軌跡層獎勵,對每一步給予一致優勢,無法辨識關鍵決策;既有自蒸餾方法將同一類特權資訊(PI)均勻套用於所有步驟,忽略常規步驟只需確認、錯誤步驟需要矯正方向的不對稱性。AHEAD 提出步驟感知框架:教師在所有步驟獲得環境回饋作為接地訊號,並在由 LLM 分析器標定的錯誤步驟額外獲得 LLM 生成的矯正提示;兩者構成自適應監督,無需顯式閘控。方法僅對失敗軌跡施加 PI 重新加權,以有界乘性權重調整 GRPO 優勢且不改變符號,混合係數隨訓練線性衰減;推論時不需任何 PI。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 與搜尋問答三項基準、三種模型規模上,AHEAD 顯著超越 GRPO(7B 於 ALFWorld +13.3、WebShop +11.0)與 SDAR、Skill-SD、RLSD 等自蒸餾基線,收斂更快且在更緊的互動步數內完成任務;消融確認環境回饋、矯正提示、失敗限定與衰減排程各自必要,訊號亦確實集中於錯誤步驟(AUROC 0.87)。限制在於依賴前沿 LLM 分析器的成本,以及環境錯誤須可明確辨識的假設。

links.title: ACE: A Self-Correcting Agentic Canvas Editor for Multi-Slide Presentation Automation

evidence: Abstract & §5.4 Table 5: IF 4.23 vs 3.81 on 94-task benchmark, paired p=.010 (gpt-5.5) and p=.022 (gemini-3.5); VQ CIs include 0 (p=.56/.57).
§5.3 Tables 3, 15, 16: 26 raters, 935 blind judgments; judge-human agreement 78-80% on decided cases (p<=.003); self-corrected output preferred ~81% (binomial p<.001).
§5.5: self-correction adds +0.41 IF/+0.27 VQ; 35/53 halt at iteration 1; of 18 loop-entering tasks 13 improve, 3 regress <=1 point; strict-peak rollback removes all regressions (4.45->4.49 IF).
§5.6 Tables 6, 19: SG->OOXML ablation -0.64 to -0.78 IF across three backbones; CARE->full context up to -0.75 IF; specialized tools -0.55 to -1.00 IF with ~1.8x operation inflation.
§4 & Limitations: benchmark extends PPTArena (85/97 adapted, 41 verbatim, 12 novel, 9 no-PowerPoint-analogue); 3 tasks not automatically evaluable; judge circularity quantified but not eliminated.
Appendix I: inter-rater agreement Fleiss kappa 0.20-0.29 (fair), raw agreement 65-67%, reported plainly.
Appendix D Tables 9-10: costs recomputed from provider usage records ($0.134 gpt, $0.545 claude); PPTArena ~$0.04 is a deliberate lower bound since per-iteration usage is not logged.
Availability: code at github.com/BloomBerry/agentic-canvas-editor, dataset at hf.co/datasets/BloomBerry/figma-slide-benchmark; full agent and judge prompts in Appendix Q.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong match to Agents & Tool Use (agentic editor, 98-tool action space, tool calling, ReAct/Reflexion-style self-correction loop) plus LLMs, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and long-context routing; not out-of-scope since the methodology is language-agent architecture, not pure CV. Novelty is moderate: the scene-graph action space extends an existing 52-tool benchmark, CARE is a rule+LLM context router, and the benchmark is largely adapted from PPTArena (85/97 tasks, 41 verbatim); the main new idea is a ground-truth-free edit-diff IF judge as a verify signal for an unverifiable design task. Rigor is unusually high for a systems paper: paired bootstrap CIs and Wilcoxon tests, leave-one-out ablations at fixed backbone/judge, routing audit (52/53), loop-knob sensitivity, and honest reporting that VQ means are statistically indistinguishable and Fleiss kappa is only fair (0.20-0.29). Evidence is solid: IF gain significant at n=94 under two judges (p=.010/.022), 26-rater blind study (935 judgments) confirms both effects, and out-of-loop judges retain ~2/3 of the self-correction gain, bounding circularity; but the self-correction gain rests on only 18 loop-entering tasks, and the PPTArena cost comparison is an acknowledged lower bound. Generalizability is limited by Figma-Slides coupling, with OOXML transfer shown only as an ablation (0.6-0.8 IF cost) and platform re-binding deferred to future work. Reproducibility is good: released code and dataset, verbatim prompts (Appendix Q), algorithms, and cost breakdowns.

primary_link.title: ACE: A Self-Correcting Agentic Canvas Editor for Multi-Slide Presentation Automation

papers.summary: Commercial design platforms increasingly edit documents through large language model (LLM) agents, but two practical problems block reliable deployment: legacy document formats expose only \emph{flat}, absolutely positioned elements, so agents must recompute coordinates and routinely break layouts; and design has no unique ground truth, so diff-against-reference metrics penalize valid-but-different outputs. We present \textbf{ACE}, an agentic canvas editor over a \emph{hierarchical scene-graph}
papers.summary_zh: 商業設計平台日益仰賴 LLM 代理編輯文件,但面臨兩大難題:舊式格式(如 OOXML)僅揭露扁平、絕對定位的元素,代理常因重算座標而破壞版面;且設計沒有唯一正解,以單一參考稿做差異比對會懲罰「不同但有效」的編輯。ACE 是一個自我修正的代理式畫布編輯器,操作於階層式場景圖,配備 98 個簡報專用工具,並以內容感知路由器 CARE 只餵入相關內容切片(平均約 89% 的輸入 token 節省);自我修正迴圈由不需 ground truth 的指令遵循(IF)評審驅動,其自然語言評語成為下一輪指令,並輔以嚴格峰值回滾。在 94 項多頁編輯任務上,單輪場景圖編輯器已媲美同骨幹的代理式 HTML 管線;加入自我修正後,IF 分數 4.23 對 3.81(p=.010),速度快 1.75 倍、成本低約 44%;26 位盲測評分者整體偏好 ACE,並在 81% 的情況偏好自我修正輸出;迴圈外評審保留約三分之二增益,約束了循環性;66% 的案例一輪即停。消融證實場景圖表示、路由器、專用工具與自我修正各自獨立貢獻。限制包括評審循環性僅被約束而非消除、VQ 平均值無統計差異,以及新穎任務表現仍未飽和。

links.title: Diverse by Reasoning: Harnessing the Wisdom of LLM Crowds for Future Prediction

evidence: Abstract: 'a three-model medoid crowd based on K-means++ behavioral clustering outperforms conventional voting over all 25 models on both prediction benchmarks, while reducing model calls by 88% and inference cost by approximately 80%'

Table III: Medoid voting (KM) scores 0.302 on FutureX-Past (rank 1) and 0.810 on BTF-v3 (rank 2) vs all-model voting 0.296/0.800; hierarchical medoid takes BTF-v3 best cell (0.830) but falls to 8th (0.270) on FutureX-Past

Section IV-B1: K=2 has the highest silhouette (0.334) but 72 of 100 FutureX-Past questions are tie-decided; K=3 selected with SC 0.237 and stability 0.767, showing internal clustering quality is not a proxy for downstream crowd quality

Section IV-C: KM medoid line-up at 83rd-88th percentile of 1000 size-matched random line-ups, while k=4 dissimilar voting sits at the 5th-8th percentile on FutureX-Past, showing maximal diversity selection hurts

Appendix B-B: the alphabetical tie-break used for reported numbers scores 0.0222 below random and no deterministic strategy separates from the 300 arbitrary-rule null; tie convention spread is comparable to differences between crowd-construction strategies

Appendix A-D: selecting committees by behavioral disagreement does not reliably beat random same-size committees; diversity is 'established... as a property that accompanies stronger crowds rather than as a criterion one can select on directly'
Section IV-A3: temporal separation guaranteed by construction - all evaluation questions resolve after the latest model cutoff 2026-02-16 (FutureX-Past resolves 2026-03-07 to 2026-07-28)
Footnote 1 and Conclusion: 'source code and datasets will be released' (not yet available); stated limitation: only 25 LLMs and two future-prediction benchmarks with 100 sampled questions each
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly LLM-relevant work on behavior-aware crowd construction for LLM forecasting: it clusters 25 LLMs by reasoning-trace embeddings on 7 independent development benchmarks and selects medoid representatives, matching curator preferences for LLMs, reasoning, and LLM evaluation (weaker on agents/tool use and no Japanese/NLP component). The design is a reasonable extension of behavior-based human crowd selection (Bhatt et al.) to LLMs, with genuinely useful negative results (max-diversity and subcommittee voting fail), but is incremental relative to existing LLM aggregation work. Rigor is unusually strong: label-free crowd construction, cross-validation reserved for the label-consuming expert baseline, 1000 size-matched random line-ups, 500-replicate bootstrap cluster stability, K/k sweeps, measured USD costs, and a candid appendix showing the chosen tie-break convention was unlucky. Evidence strength is tempered by small headline margins (0.302 vs 0.296 FutureX-Past; 0.810 vs 0.800 BTF-v3), benchmark inconsistency (hierarchical medoid: best on BTF-v3, 8th on FutureX-Past), admitted tie-break sensitivity comparable to between-method differences, and only associational diversity-score correlations (+0.211) that the authors show cannot be used as a selection rule. Generalizability is limited by two 100-question forecasting benchmarks, a static crowd, and aggregation-rule-dependent effects. Reproducibility is decent (seeds, configs, model cutoffs, OpenRouter) but code/datasets are only promised ('will be released') and API responses may be nondeterministic.

primary_link.title: Diverse by Reasoning: Harnessing the Wisdom of LLM Crowds for Future Prediction

radar.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for future prediction, motivating the use of multiple models as a wisdom-of-the-crowd mechanism. However, simply increasing crowd size does not guarantee effective diversity, as different LLMs may exhibit redundant behaviors. We propose a behavior-aware framework for constructing diverse LLM crowds. The framework characterizes models using their reasoning traces on independent development tasks, clusters models by behavioral similarity, and sele
radar.summary_zh: LLM 日益被用於預測未來事件，但把大量模型湊成一個群眾未必更好：行為相似的模型會投出冗餘票，稀釋集體判斷。本文提出行為感知的群眾建構框架：先讓 25 個 LLM 在七個與預測無關的開發基準（共 350 題）上作答，將推理軌跡以 bge-m3 嵌入並平均成模型的「行為簽章」，再以 K-means++ 與階層式分群找出行為群組，從每群選出具代表性的 medoid 組成小委員會，最後依答案型別採用多數決、中位數或相似度中位數聚合。在 FutureX-Past 與 BTF-v3 兩個未來預測基準上，僅三個模型的 medoid 委員會同時優於全部 25 個模型的傳統投票（0.302 對 0.296、0.810 對 0.800），模型呼叫減少 88%，推論成本約省 80%，也勝過同規模隨機組合；但刻意最大化行為差異或改用叢集子委員會投票反而變差，顯示「具代表性的多樣性」比極端多樣性更重要。作者也坦承平票打破規則與委員會規模會左右分數，行為多樣性與表現僅呈中度正相關。研究限於 25 個模型與各 100 題，行為簽章以平均嵌入構成可能掩蓋任務相關模式。整體而言，本文證明群眾組成比規模更關鍵，為 LLM 集體預測提供低成本的設計原則。
radar.title: Diverse by Reasoning: Harnessing the Wisdom of LLM Crowds for Future Prediction

links.title: FARCA: Fact-Aligned Reliability-Aware Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning with Factual Supervision

evidence: Experiments, Table 1: FARCA achieves best results on all four hallucination benchmarks for Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (e.g., TruthfulQA 45.41 vs FaithRL 43.32) and reports average improvements of 1.75-2.21 pp over the strongest factual baseline
Ablation Studies, Table 2: w/o token provenance drops the average from 25.36 to 24.40; w/o reliability estimation also degrades, isolating contributions of localization and reliability weighting
Introduction, Figure 1(b): evidence-dependence proxy validated across three verifiers (HHEM, AlignScore, MiniCheck), with accuracy increasing monotonically with the Evidence quantile
Experimental Setup, Implementation Details: verl framework, 4 A6000 GPUs, LR 5e-7, KL 0.001, HHEM-2.1-Open verifier, K_rel=1, tau=0.2, mu=0.16; full extraction prompt given in Appendix A Table 3

Experimental Setup, Datasets and Metrics: GPT-4o is the judge for both hallucination and math benchmarks; AIME scores move in 3.33-point (single-question) increments (e.g., 6.67 vs 3.33), with no significance testing or variance reporting anywhere in the paper

Further Analysis, Figures 4-7: 98.3% fact-token matching rate, 36.3% of facts with Delta>mu, 48.8% mean normalized advantage shift, and 77.1%/75.6% contradiction-correction/support-rescue strengths support the mechanism claims

Generalizability limits: only Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct evaluated; training data (Appendix A) requires Wikipedia knowledge snippets provided per question, and fact extraction depends on GPT-4o; no code or checkpoint release is mentioned
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM RL training methodology paper (RLVR/GRPO) targeting factuality and hallucination in reasoning models, aligning with LLM, Reasoning, Alignment/RLHF, and RAG/Knowledge preferences. The contribution is a genuine but incremental advance over KnowRL/FSPO/FaithRL: token-level provenance routing of factual credit plus counterfactual evidence attribution as a reliability proxy. Rigor is moderately good — two backbones, three factual-RL baselines, three targeted component ablations, hyperparameter sensitivity, and training-dynamics analyses — but weakened by tiny AIME samples (single-question granularity of 3.33 points), no error bars or seeds, modest gains (~1.75-2.21 pp avg on hallucination), and GPT-4o serving as extractor and judge. Generalizability is limited to 3B models and knowledge-intensive QA where gold Wikipedia snippets are available; reproducibility is helped by detailed hyperparameters and full prompts in Appendix A but no code/data release is stated and GPT-4o dependence complicates replication.

primary_link.title: FARCA: Fact-Aligned Reliability-Aware Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning with Factual Supervision

radar.summary: To reduce the hallucination risk caused by outcome-driven rewards in large language models trained through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, existing mitigation approaches introduce process-level factual supervision. However, due to coarse-grained aggregation of factual signals and the lack of reliability assessment for these signals, they create a mismatch between fact verification and policy updates. We term this noisy factual credit assignment and decompose it into two aspects:
radar.summary_zh: 以可驗證獎勵進行強化學習（RLVR）訓練的 LLM，常為了答對而沿著事實有誤的路徑推理，反而放大幻覺。既有事實監督方法（KnowRL、FSPO、FaithRL）將驗證訊號粗粒度地聚合到整條軌跡或推理步驟，既無法定位哪些 token 應為內容負責，也未評估驗證器本身的可靠度，作者稱之為「雜訊事實信用分配」，並拆解為信用定位與信用可靠性兩種模糊性。FARCA 據此提出：以 GPT-4o 將推理文字拆成原子事實並追溯其來源 token 區間（token provenance），配合規則修正對齊驗證與更新粒度；以 NLI 驗證器輸出連續帶符號分數，保留支持強度；再透過反事實證據歸因，移除最相關證據後重新驗證，以分數變化估計可靠性權重，用於調節事實獎勵並對局部優勢做軟性插值。實驗顯示，在 Qwen2.5-3B 與 Llama-3.2-3B 上，FARCA 於 SimpleQA、TruthfulQA、HalluQA、HaluEval-QA 多數奪冠，平均較最強基線 FaithRL 提升 1.75 與 2.21 個百分點，且 AIME、MATH-500、GSM8K 同步最佳，表示事實性與推理能力可並進；消融實驗證實三個組件各有貢獻，訓練中約 98.3% 事實成功對齊 token，可靠性權重穩定不退化。限制在於依賴 GPT-4o 抽取與特定驗證器、僅驗證 3B 模型與知識密集問答情境。其價值在於指出事實監督的成敗取決於信用分配的精準度與可靠度。
radar.title: FARCA: Fact-Aligned Reliability-Aware Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning with Factual Supervision

links.title: FrontierChallenge: Evaluating Scientific Workflow Completion

evidence: Abstract: best configurations completed only 20 of 97 released tasks (Pass Rate 20.6%) despite highest Avg. Score of 87.9, establishing the partial-progress vs. full-delivery gap.
Sec 4.2: Pass Rate defined via f=1[s>=99.9] with GPT-5.6 Sol as Judge run three times per criterion; the Judge is also the top-scoring evaluated model, an unmitigated potential conflict of interest.
Sec 4.3: Pass Rate ranged 3.1%-20.6% while Avg. Score ranged 67.5-87.9 across twelve models and three scaffolds; eight configurations exceeded Avg. Score 80 yet none passed more than 20.6%.
Sec 4.4: analytical chemistry max Avg. Score 87.6 with only 4% Pass Rate; electrochemistry/environment max Avg. Score 94.9 with 0% Pass Rate for every configuration.

Sec 4.6: among 970 Claude Code trajectories, 641 of 849 non-passing runs (75.5%) ended with lexical completion language, showing self-reports do not indicate delivery; analysis restricted to Claude Code's common event schema.
Sec 3.2: only 97 of 300 tasks randomly selected (GPU-free subset) and publicly released; 203 retained as internal held-out set, limiting external verification of the full benchmark.
Sec 5 (limitations): findings limited to released task set, evaluated configurations, Claude Code trajectory scope, provider-specific resource accounting, and single runs.

Sec 2/Table 1: positioning against CORE-Bench, PaperBench, ScienceAgentBench, BLADE, AstaBench etc., claiming the combination of cross-domain coverage, multi-artifact contracts, and executable evaluation as the distinguishing design.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Agent-evaluation benchmark squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Evaluation with LLM-as-judge, code execution). The central finding - a persistent gap between partial scores (Avg. up to 87.9) and strict contract-level Pass Rate (max 20.6%), plus 75.5% of non-passing trajectories claiming completion - is a clear, useful contribution. Rigor is tempered by single-run experiments with no variance estimates, the LLM Judge (GPT-5.6 Sol) also being the top-scoring evaluated model, self-built task graders without reported human validation, small domain slices (e.g., 6 electrochemistry tasks), and 203 of 300 tasks withheld internally. Generalizability of the partial-vs-complete insight is plausible but domain composition is explicitly non-representative.

primary_link.title: FrontierChallenge: Evaluating Scientific Workflow Completion

In this paper, we release and evaluate 97 of these tasks, spanning quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, materials characterization, analytical chemistry, life science, and electrochemistry/environment. radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出 FrontierChallenge,一個橫跨量子化學、分子動力學、材料表徵、分析化學、生命科學與電化學/環境六大領域的科學工作流程基準,共 300 個端對端工作流程;本文公開並評測其中 97 項(74 個 Hard、23 個 Medium),其餘 203 項保留為內部 held-out 集合。每項任務提供固定輸入與明確的交付物契約,涵蓋報告、結構化表格、圖表、可執行程式與模擬產物,並以任務專屬的 Grader 執行可執行評測;主要指標為 Pass Rate(滿足完整契約),Avg.
