links.title: Can We Read the Mind of an Audio LLM? A Verbalizable, Multilingual Middle-Layer Workspace

evidence: Section 3 (Audio-swap control): real 40.0% vs silence 21.8% balanced accuracy (McNemar p=4.7e-5) and position-matched real 40.0% vs mismatch 32.2% (p=0.015), isolating audio-driven signal from text prior.
Section 4.4 (Causal tests): activation patching restores correct answers in 10/10 clips with a sensory-band patch (95.7% logit gap), 9/10 workspace-band (89.1%), 0/10 motor-band (4.8%).
Section 4.5 (Figure 7): deleting layer L0 costs 65 accuracy points over 40 clips while every interior layer costs at most 10; perception breaks only at L0-L1, delivery only at L47.
Section 4.4: band-localized audio-swap signature replicated on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B (sensory null, workspace p<1e-3), but this is the same model family, limiting generalizability.

Section 3 (Data) and Section 4.1: core controls use a curated 140-clip MMAU subset and the flagship 'mind reading' cases are seven hand-picked clips (Table 1), with the population-level claim explicitly placed on the waveform-swap and band statistics.

Section 5 (Conclusion): stated limitations — logit lens as cheap proxy vs Jacobian lens, one model family, small sound-dominated slice; no code or artifact availability is claimed anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In scope: this is interpretability of an LLM (Qwen3-Omni's 48-layer text Thinker) using logit lens, activation patching, and layer deletion, with chain-of-thought-monitoring and oversight motivation — not 'pure audio', since the methodology targets language-model internals over vocabulary space. Strong match to LLM, interpretability, reasoning/CoT-monitoring, and multimodal preferences. Novelty is a solid but incremental extension of Gurnee et al.'s verbalizable middle-layer workspace framework to audio; the waveform-swap control and workspace-band localization for audio are the genuinely new pieces (distinguished from Semantic Hub Hypothesis and AudioLens in Section 2). Rigor is unusually careful for a qualitative interpretability paper: a-priori band definitions, balanced accuracy for imbalanced options, paired McNemar tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, position-matched contrasts addressing the silence position-count confound, placebo words, CJK frequency controls, and a replication on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. Evidence is credible but bounded: modest readout accuracies (~40% balanced), small samples (140-clip core set, n=27 two-mind, n=10 patching), and hand-picked flagship cases (Section 4.1 explicitly flags seven curated clips), though the population-level claims rest on the swap/band statistics rather than anecdotes. Generalizability is limited to one model family (the second model is the same Qwen Omni line) and a curated English MMAU slice. Method, model, bands, statistics, and public datasets (MMAU, TriviaQA) are well specified, but no code or artifact release is stated. Scoped honestly in the abstract and conclusion; the paper does not overclaim.

primary_link.title: Can We Read the Mind of an Audio LLM? A Verbalizable, Multilingual Middle-Layer Workspace

radar.summary: An audio language model is a black box in a specific way: we see what it says, never what it works out on the way there, and chain-of-thought monitoring helps only if the model writes its reasoning down. Reading a base Qwen3-Omni with a logit lens at the audio-token positions, we find that the answer to a spoken question becomes legible - in words - in the model's middle layers, before it emits any token. Five findings follow. (1) The readout carries concepts in neither the question, the options
radar.summary_zh: 音訊語言模型回答口語問題時並不寫下推理,chain-of-thought 監控因此失效;本文追問:模型開口之前,內部是否已形成可讀取的答案?作者以 logit lens 對 base Qwen3-Omni-30B 的 48 層 Thinker,在 audio token 位置將中介殘差狀態投影至詞彙空間,並設計波形置換控制——問題與選項完全不變,僅把音訊換成真實片段、錯配片段或靜音——以分離真正由聲音驅動的訊號與對印出選項的文字先驗。五項發現:(1)在逐字轉錄近乎空白雜訊的片段上,中介層讀出依序重構 Watergate、scandal、president,最終指向 Nixon,形成無需 chain-of-thought 的隱藏多跳鏈;(2)思考空間是多語的,輸入全為英文時仍有 38.5% 的 top-1 讀出為中文;(3)超語言學內容(音源、說話者角色、情緒)只存在於音訊心智:同一片段以音訊輸入比以模型自身的無情緒 caption 輸入答得更準;(4)音訊訊號在輸入層不存在,約 12% 深度開啟,在 35–80% 深度的工作空間帶與文字先驗分離最乾淨,activation patching 顯示其於最後五分之一層之前已被因果地使用;(5)逐層刪除顯示聽入(L0)與輸出(L47)不可取代、檢索分散於內部,而文字模式的幻覺多在早期(中位數約 12% 深度)形成且不再修正。限制:使用較廉價的 logit lens 而非更忠實的 Jacobian lens、僅單一模型家族、樣本小且偏聲音主導,屬定性分析而非基準分數。意義在於為語音 agent 提供鏈式思考監控無法觸及的可解釋監督槓桿,未來可作為訓練訊號或近乎免費的即時監視器。
radar.title: Can We Read the Mind of an Audio LLM? A Verbalizable, Multilingual Middle-Layer Workspace
radar.title_zh: 我們能讀出音訊 LLM 的心思嗎?可言說化的多語中介層工作空間

links.title: OPDSearch+: On-Policy Distillation with RL Refinement for Search-Augmented Reasoning

evidence: Abstract/Sec.1: claims the first distillation paradigm requiring no teacher fine-tuning for search-augmented reasoning; reports mean EM 0.4402 across seven QA benchmarks with +13.1% HotpotQA and +8.5% 2WikiMultihopQA over the best 3B baseline.
Table 1 (Sec.4): per-benchmark EM for the 3B student; baselines carry the note 'numbers cited from prior work'; margin over GiGPO-Instruct is 0.4402 vs 0.421.

Sec.4.1: student Qwen2.5-3B (base), frozen teacher Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, E5-base-v2 over Dec-2018 Wikipedia top-3, veRL on 4xH200, lr 1e-6, G=8, Tmax=4; 'Full hyperparameters in Appendix A of the supplementary material' (appendix not included in the document).

Table 2/Sec.4.4: matched-hyperparameter objective ablation — forward-KL stable 400+ steps (best val EM 0.493) vs JSD and Log-Ratio collapsing at ~20 steps; text admits reverse-KL collapses 'may be mitigable with objective-specific tuning.'

Table 3 (Sec.4.5/5.1): ablations — reproduced pure RL 0.3524, Offline SFT→RL 0.4185, OPD only 0.3655, 7B-teacher OPD→RL 0.4205 vs 14B-teacher 0.4402; same table shows direct teacher eval EM 0.3985, below the 0.4402 student, supporting the 'exceeds the teacher' claim.
Sec.4.6: OPD-initialized entropy 1.35 vs base 0.82; KL drift ~0.2 vs >0.8 for pure RL; search turns reduced 3.5→2.7; gradient norms 1.1→0.7 over 418 steps.
Sec.4.1: RL stage 'initialized from the best OPD checkpoint (step 150)' and run 'until training collapse was observed'; no multi-seed or significance analysis is reported anywhere in the document.

Sec.4.3 vs Table 2: minor internal inconsistency — text claims OPD training stable 'throughout 501 steps' while Table 2 reports 'Stable (400+ steps)' and Sec.4.1 says the OPD stage is 'over 420 updates.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope LLM post-training methodology: on-policy distillation (frozen off-the-shelf 14B teacher) followed by GRPO RL for search-augmented multi-hop QA agents, strongly matching LLM, Reasoning, RAG, Agents & Tool Use, and RL preferences. Novelty is a meaningful but incremental delta over cited SD-Search, Agent Distillation, TT-OPD, and KDRL/SPOT (frozen cross-model teacher + per-position forward-KL in an interactive retrieval loop); the three formal propositions are elementary (pointwise clipped bound, standard TV inequality). Evidence is comparatively strong: matched-hyperparameter objective ablation (Table 2), teacher-scale/two-stage ablations (Table 3), a reproduced pure-RL baseline (0.3524), training-dynamics measurements (entropy 1.35 vs 0.82), and the notable result that the 3B student (0.4402) exceeds the direct 14B teacher evaluation (0.3985). Caveats: headline 'outperforms all 3B baselines' relies partly on numbers cited from prior work with a modest margin (0.4402 vs GiGPO 0.421), no seed variance or significance testing anywhere, and the RL stage run 'until training collapse was observed' with best-checkpoint selection may favor peak results. Generalizability is limited to one student/teacher pair plus one 7B-teacher variant and a single Wikipedia/E5 retrieval environment within QA. No code or data release is claimed, and full hyperparameters are deferred to an appendix not present in the document.

primary_link.title: OPDSearch+: On-Policy Distillation with RL Refinement for Search-Augmented Reasoning

radar.summary: Search-augmented reasoning remains difficult for small language models. On-policy distillation (OPD) from trained teachers offers a promising direction, but suffers from two issues: (1) high-quality multi-turn search trajectories depend on dynamic retriever responses, making SFT data prohibitively expensive to collect at scale; (2) task-specifically trained teachers incur substantial training cost, while directly applying OPD with an off-the-shelf teacher without task-specific fine-tuning constr
radar.summary_zh: 搜尋增強推理對小型語言模型仍是一大難題。既有同策略蒸餾面臨兩項瓶頸：高品質多輪搜尋軌跡依賴動態檢索器回應，使 SFT 資料蒐集成本高昂；任務專用教師訓練昂貴，直接以現成教師蒸餾則使學生受限於教師上限且訓練不穩。OPDSearch+ 提出首個免教師 fine-tuning 的蒸餾框架：以凍結的 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 為教師，第一階段讓 3B 學生與即時搜尋引擎互動，在學生自產軌跡上以逐位置 forward-KL 目標（含 clipped 重要性加權）蒸餾推理分解與證據整合能力；第二階段再以 GRPO 精煉。核心洞見是教師並非提供模仿上限，而是重塑學生的策略分佈，使後續 RL 收斂到單靠 RL 無法達成的更優解。在七個問答基準上平均 EM 達 0.4402，超越所有 3B 基線（先前最佳為 0.421），HotpotQA 與 2WikiMultihopQA 分別提升 13.1% 與 8.5%；forward-KL 亦比 reverse-KL 變體穩定，且能提高策略熵、把平均搜尋輪數由 3.5 降至 2.7。限制在於蒸餾訊號反映教師偏好而非任務結果，須靠 RL 階段補足；聯合訓練（0.3660）明顯遜於兩階段流程，RL 階段最終仍會崩潰而須提前停止。此研究顯示免教師訓練的兩階段流程約只需 48 GPU 小時即可讓小模型習得多跳搜尋推理，深具實務部署價值。
radar.title: OPDSearch+: On-Policy Distillation with RL Refinement for Search-Augmented Reasoning
radar.title_zh: OPDSearch+：以同策略蒸餾搭配 RL 精煉的搜尋增強推理

links.title: SHIFT-LLM: Distribution Shift Correction in Depth-Pruned LLMs

evidence: Abstract: claims training-free correction across 'five model families, six layer-selection criteria, and seven zero-shot benchmarks' with 'gains up to +15.7 points on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct' using 'only a few hundred calibration samples and no gradient computation'.

Table 1 (Sec 4.1): +15.74 (Reverse-order*) and +15.71 (Taylor) on Llama-3.1-8B-It, but negative gains on Vicuna-7B under Reverse-order* (-0.51) and PPL (-4.43), showing configuration-dependent effectiveness.

Sec 4.3, Table 6: Generic Affine ablation on Qwen2-1.5B shows LRA beats an equal-capacity affine map (e.g., BI 46.85 vs 36.96), supporting the identity-preserving residual parameterization as a real design choice.
Appendix B.8, Table 15: direct comparison with ReplaceMe (L2) under the same 256-sample C4 budget; SHIFT-LLM wins all eight model-criterion pairs, e.g., Llama-3.1-8B BI 61.62 vs 59.46.
Appendix B.3, Table 12: LRA degrades accuracy 38.22 to 36.07 under random layer removal, a documented failure mode bounding the method's applicability.
Sec 4.4, Table 7: rank-64 LRA costs <0.25% of a removed block's FLOPs; latency 46.0 ms vs 44.7 ms pruned-only (1.27x speedup retained) on a single V100.

Appendix A.1: full hyperparameters given (256 C4 calibration samples, rank-64 LRAs, LoRA lr 3e-5, seq len 512, V100 GPUs, likelihood-based eval with length normalization), but no code or artifact release is mentioned.

Sec 2: related work concedes concurrent ReplaceMe fits linear transformations training-free and Siddiqui et al. trained low-rank linear adapters, indicating limited conceptual novelty beyond formulation and closed-form estimation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solid LLM-efficiency paper squarely matching high-weight LLM, Transformer-architecture, and Scaling & Efficiency preferences: a training-free Linear Residual Adapter fitted by closed-form ridge regression to correct hidden-state shift after depth pruning. Rigor is strong (5 models up to 14B, 6 pruning criteria, 7 benchmarks, ablations on calibration size/domain/seed, low-rank ranks, sequential calibration, runtime) and negative results (Vicuna-7B, random pruning) are honestly reported. Novelty is only moderate: the idea is incremental over concurrent ReplaceMe, Siddiqui et al.'s trained linear adapters, and LLM-Streamline's replacement modules, with the distinct contribution being identity-preserving local residual correction plus exact merging. Evidence is internally consistent but some headline gains (+15.7) come from unusually weak pruning baselines, and the Navigation LLM comparison reuses numbers from that paper. No code release is stated, though the closed-form method is simple to reimplement.

primary_link.title: SHIFT-LLM: Distribution Shift Correction in Depth-Pruned LLMs

radar.summary: Depth pruning removes entire Transformer blocks to reduce the inference cost of large language models, but disrupts the hidden-state distributions expected by downstream layers, leading to significant accuracy loss. We introduce SHIFT-LLM, a training-free post-pruning correction framework that inserts a Linear Residual Adapter (LRA) at each pruning site. Each LRA preserves the identity pathway of the original residual block and adds a lightweight affine residual correction. This correction is ca
radar.summary_zh: 深度剪枝透過移除整個 Transformer 區塊來降低 LLM 推理成本，但會破壞下游層所預期的隱藏狀態分佈，造成顯著準確率損失。SHIFT-LLM 提出免訓練的剪枝後校正框架：在每個剪枝位置插入線性殘差轉接器（LRA），保留原殘差區塊的恆等路徑，並以輕量仿射殘差校正近似被移除區塊的缺失殘差更新。校正參數在約 256 筆校正樣本上以閉式最小平方法（脊迴歸）求解，全程不需梯度計算；LRA 亦支援低秩分解與連續剪枝層的精確合併，並可與 LoRA 等參數高效 fine-tuning 疊加以進一步恢復效能。實驗涵蓋五個模型家族、六種層選擇準則與七個 zero-shot 基準：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在 Reverse-order* 與 Taylor 剪枝下最多提升 15.7 點，WikiText-2 困惑度大幅下降（Llama 於 Reverse* 下降低逾千點），rank-64 LRA 計算量不及原區塊的 0.25%，在 25% 剪枝下仍保住約 1.27 倍加速，方法亦可擴展至 Qwen2.5-14B。限制在於 Vicuna-7B 在部分準則下增益為負，顯示當缺失殘差更新含較強非線性或跨 token 結構時，逐 token 仿射校正能力有限；隨機剪枝下甚至使表現變差。整體而言，此工作以極低成本填補剪枝造成的分佈偏移，為深度剪枝提供了實用的免訓練恢復方案。
radar.title: SHIFT-LLM: Distribution Shift Correction in Depth-Pruned LLMs
radar.title_zh: SHIFT-LLM：深度剪枝 LLM 的分佈偏移校正

links.title: From State to Action: OODA-Tool for Reliable Multi-Turn Tool Use

evidence: Table 1 (Experiments): Specialized OODA Task Success 85.10/85.46/87.30/89.52/94.90 vs Direct-LoRA 78.24/78.67/80.31/83.58/90.42 at 0.6B-14B; stated margins 6.86, 6.79, 6.99, 5.94, 4.48 points reconcile with these values.

Experimental Setup / Systems and training: all systems share Qwen3-Instruct backbone, 8192-token limit, enable_thinking=false; LoRA r=32, alpha=64, dropout 0.05, all-linear targets, backbone/embeddings/lm_head frozen, BF16, FlashAttention 2.

RQ4 / Efficiency trade-off: Specialized OODA at 1.7B uses four sequential calls with 2.36x normalized latency vs Direct-LoRA; Direct-SC@4 uses the same number of model calls but stays below OODA variants.

RQ5 / State-action alignment: State-Action Contradiction Rate falls from 7.8% (Joint) and 5.6% (Shared) to 3.9% (Specialized) and rises to 10.7% without the Decide-Act split, measured on turns where all variants recover correct state and Orient mode.

RQ3 / Ablation sensitivity: ablations use a mechanism set of 1,250 turns from 600 dialogues, and execution-grounding errors use a fixed 500-turn sample from rare-error pools (Figure 4); w/o Orient causes the largest degradation.
RQ4 / Zero-shot readiness transfer: the paper states FAIL-TaLMs results 'are not official FAIL-TaLMs leaderboard scores' and that the margin over alpha-UMi becomes negligible at larger scales.

End matter: 'See pages - of appendix_content.pdf' indicates the appendix pages are missing, so supplement-referenced tables (Hard/OOD Capacity Results, MTU-Bench Transfer Results, BFCL, Efficiency Trade-off, Gradient Analysis Protocol) cannot be verified from the document.

Experimental Setup / Data, splits, and supervision: official ToolDial split of 11,111 multi-turn sessions, trajectories split before label construction, sessions kept intact across partitions; typed targets exclude future user turns and post-action observations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent/tool-use methodology paper with a direct match to the highest-weight preferences (multi-turn tool use, function calling, agentic policies, reasoning stages). The typed Observe-Orient-Decide-Act decomposition with controller-checked handoffs is a sensible, well-motivated framing, but it is incremental over existing modular designs (α-UMi's planner/caller/summarizer split, Plan-and-Act, StateFlow); the main novelty is the typed-interface constraint plus the state-action competition framing. Rigor is above average: five model scales (0.6B-14B), controlled same-trajectory training views for all baselines, a call-count-matched baseline (Direct-SC@4) and a modular baseline (α-UMi), five component ablations, a typed-state bottleneck test, and three transfer benchmarks. Evidence is solid for the main ToolDial table (abstract gains 6.86/6.79/6.99/5.94/4.48 points reconcile exactly with Table 1), but many key results (Hard/OOD slices, MTU-Bench and BFCL tables, efficiency details, gradient analysis) are deferred to a supplement whose appendix pages are absent from the document, and no statistical significance testing is reported; several metrics (Tool Exact, Ask-Act) are near saturation, leaving Task Success as the main signal. Generalizability is tempered by a single backbone family (Qwen3) and the need for gold turn-level annotations to construct typed targets. Reproducibility is mixed: detailed LoRA/optimization settings are given, but the ConstraintPolicy target formats and prompts live in the missing appendix and no code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: From State to Action: OODA-Tool for Reliable Multi-Turn Tool Use

radar.summary: Reliable multi-turn tool use requires an agent to preserve an evolving task state and ensure that each action remains consistent with it. However, direct function-calling and ReAct-style policies learn state tracking and action generation within the same autoregressive trajectory. This coupling creates state-action competition: the pressure to produce the next call can overwrite or ignore information accumulated earlier in the interaction. Inspired by Boyd's Observe-Orient-Decide-Act cycle, we i
radar.summary_zh: 多輪工具使用要求代理在任務推進時持續維護演化的任務狀態，並確保每個行動與之一致。然而直接 function-calling 與 ReAct 式策略把狀態追蹤與行動生成耦合在同一自迴歸軌跡內，產生「狀態—行動競爭」：急於產出下一個呼叫的壓力會覆寫或忽略先前累積的資訊。受 Boyd 的 Observe–Orient–Decide–Act 循環啟發，OODA-Tool 提出型別化閉迴路策略：Observe 重建具來源可追溯性的任務狀態，Orient 判斷執行就緒條件（涵蓋釐清、恢復、直接回應、結束等模式），Decide 形成可准許的行動結構，Act 落地為符合 schema 的工具呼叫，並由中央控制器在每次交接時驗證。作者比較 Joint、Shared 與 Specialized（四階段各自 LoRA）三種變體，於 Qwen3 0.6B–14B 在 ToolDial 等基準評測。Specialized OODA 在各規模的 Task Success 皆最佳，較 Direct-LoRA 提升 4.48 至 6.99 點，小模型與狀態密集任務（長歷史、資訊缺失、狀態變更、深度依賴）增益最大，過早呼叫率與陳舊或無依據參數率最低，狀態—行動矛盾率由 7.8% 降至 3.9%，轉移到 FAIL-TaLMs、MTU-Bench 與 BFCL 亦見一致優勢。限制包括四階段序列推論帶來約 2.36 倍延遲，平行呼叫的展開與跨呼叫參數綁定仍是弱點，且骨幹越大優勢越窄。此框架為小模型的有狀態工具使用提供了明確的架構性解方。
radar.title: From State to Action: OODA-Tool for Reliable Multi-Turn Tool Use

links.title: Retrieved But Not Reliable: A Survey on Attacks, and Defenses in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

evidence: Abstract: 'We formalize threat models over the corpus, retriever, and generator, and organize attacks into three main objectives: accuracy, privacy, and fairness' and commits to 'actively update a public repository at https://github.com/coutMinh/A-Survey-on-RAG-Robustness'.

§1 Table 1: comparison matrix claims the survey is the only one covering attack taxonomy, defense taxonomy, pipeline-aware analysis, variants of RAG, benchmark, and explainability simultaneously versus Zhou et al. (2026), Ni et al. (2025), Wang et al. (2025a), Vonderhaar et al. (2025), Cui et al. (2024).

§Survey Methodology: identifies seed papers (PoisonedRAG, TrojanRAG, Neural Exec, The Good and the Bad), database keyword search on 'retrieval, retrieval-augmented generation, attack, defense, security, privacy, robustness', manual screening, and backward snowballing; no inclusion counts reported.
§3.3.1 Privacy Extraction Attacks: cites Peng et al. (2025) backdoor-based leakage 'achieving leakage success rates of up to 94%' — a secondhand quantitative claim without independent verification.

§4: defense taxonomy organized into retrieval-stage (robust retrieval, robust training), rerank-stage (e.g., GRADA similarity-graph reranking), generation-stage (proactive filtering/detection vs passive robust reasoning/robust training), and traceback (context/document/dataset-level attribution).
§5 Robustness Benchmarks: Table 3 summarizes failure modes, datasets (NQ, HotpotQA, SQuAD, MS-MARCO), and metrics (F1, ASR, Recall@k) across SafeRAG, KnowShiftQA, URAG, etc.

Appendix C: formalizes agentic RAG as a four-function loop (decision policy, retriever, integration, memory update) and covers AgentPoison, MINJA query-only memory injection, ToolHijacker, InjecAgent, AgentDojo, plus GraphRAG poisoning and multimodal RAG membership inference.

§7 and Appendix E Challenges: identifies lack of transferability of white-box attacks, stealthiness trade-offs, underexplored privacy risks in GraphRAG/multimodal RAG, and traceback being 'largely diagnostic rather than preventive'.
Limitations: acknowledges coverage gaps (web-search RAG, embodied RAG, code RAG, domain deployments), multi-objective attacks, and defenses that span multiple pipeline stages.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: the survey targets RAG robustness for LLMs, intersecting multiple high-weight preferences (RAG & Knowledge, AI Safety, Agents via agentic RAG/AgentPoison/ToolHijacker, prompt injection, benchmarks). Its contribution is a unified pipeline-aware taxonomy (attacks by accuracy/privacy/fairness objectives; defenses by retrieval/rerank/generation/traceback stages) plus benchmark and explainability coverage, which is genuinely more comprehensive than prior RAG-security surveys per its own Table 1 comparison. However, as a survey it offers no original empirical results; all quantitative claims are secondhand citations, survey methodology is described only qualitatively (seed papers, snowballing, keyword search) without inclusion counts or systematic protocol, and the continuously-updated repository is only promised in the abstract. Limitations (multi-objective attacks, stage-spanning defenses, coverage gaps) are candidly acknowledged, which supports the taxonomy's generalizability but caps evidential weight.

primary_link.title: Retrieved But Not Reliable: A Survey on Attacks, and Defenses in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

radar.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models by grounding outputs in external knowledge, improving factuality and reducing hallucinations. At the same time, the retrieval-augmented pipeline introduces new robustness and security risks, including corpus poisoning, backdoor attacks, privacy leakage, and fairness violations. Despite rapid progress in this area, existing surveys remain limited in their treatment of attacker objectives, threat models, and stage-specific defense
radar.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）透過外部知識提升 LLM 的事實性並減少幻覺，但檢索管線也帶來語料庫毒化、後門攻擊、隱私外洩與公平性侵害等新風險。既有調查對攻擊者目標、威脅模型與各階段防禦的整理零散，本文提出統一且管線感知的 RAG 穩健性總覽。作者將威脅模型形式化於語料庫、檢索器與生成器三個元件（插入式、黑箱、白箱存取），並依目標將攻擊分為三類：準確性（定向的語料毒化、後門與提示注入，以及非定向攻擊）、公平性（放大人口群體偏見）與隱私（成員推論、隱私擷取、confused-deputy 行為）。防禦則按管線階段組織：檢索階段的語料清消與穩健訓練、重排階段的圖形化重排（如 GRADA）、生成階段的主動過濾與偵測，以及被動式穩健推理與對抗訓練，最後是事後溯源歸因（ContextCite、RAGForensics、浮水印法）。文中亦整理穩健性基準（如 SafeRAG、URAG）、可解釋性研究，並討論 GraphRAG、多模態 RAG 與 Agentic RAG 的安全議題。綜整文獻指出：多數攻擊依賴白箱存取、毒化常犧牲隱蔽性、溯源防禦多屬診斷而非預防。限制是領域演化快速、部分攻擊目標多重且防禦可能橫跨多階段。本調查為建構可信賴 RAG 系統提供了攻防對照的實用路線圖。

links.title: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward

evidence: Abstract: proposes OPDVR 'a simple yet effective method that seamlessly combines OPD and RLVR without adding any hyperparameters' with code link https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/OPDVR

Section 5.2 claims 'OPDVR consistently outperforms standard sampled-token OPD and top-64 OPD across all six benchmarks in both distillation settings,' but Table 1 reports MATH500: OPDVR 84.7 vs Sampled-Token OPD 85.5 (and Top-64 OPD 85.0), contradicting the claim in the same-architecture setting
Table 1 (same-architecture, Qwen3-4B <- Qwen3-4B-RL): averages Student 42.0, Teacher 50.4, Sampled-Token OPD 47.8, Top-64 OPD 47.4, OPDVR 49.1
Table 2 (cross-architecture, Qwen3-1.7B-Base <- Qwen3-4B-Base-RL): averages Student 17.3, Sampled-Token OPD 20.9, Top-64 OPD 21.7, OPDVR 22.8, with 5.5-point gain on AMC
Section 5.4/Table 4: inverse-gated ablation averages 44.6 vs OPD 47.8 and OPDVR 49.1, supporting the gating mechanism's causal role
Section 5.3/Table 3: GRPD vs GRPO gains of 6.5 on AIME24 and 10.9 on AIME25, but the comparison set (GRPO, OPD) omits the cited competing OPD+RLVR methods of Section 2
Appendix A: Propositions A.1 (verifier alignment) and A.2 (conflict-removal decomposition) with proofs; A.3 uses a simplified single-token decision model
Appendix B: hyperparameters (lr 1e-6, batch 256, max response 8192, eval temp 0.7); Appendix C: all experiments on NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPUs; no error bars or multiple seeds reported anywhere
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology paper combining on-policy distillation with RLVR for mathematical reasoning, squarely matching LLM/reasoning/RL preferences. The technical contribution is a minimal ReLU gate on sampled-token OPD's implicit reward plus a GRPO-style extension (GRPD); the reformulation and Proposition A.1/A.2 analysis are clean but the mechanism is simple and several concurrent works target the same OPD+RLVR integration problem (cited in Section 2), limiting novelty. Experimental design is reasonable: two distillation settings, six benchmarks, an informative inverse-gated ablation, and training-dynamics analysis. However, Section 5.2 claims improvement 'across all six benchmarks' while Table 1 shows OPDVR (84.7) below Sampled-Token OPD (85.5) on MATH500, no variance/significance is reported despite avg@16 evaluation, models are small (1.7B/4B Qwen3), only math tasks are tested despite claims of generality to any verifiable reward, and no head-to-head comparison against the cited competing OPD+RLVR integrations is provided. Reproducibility is decent: code link, named datasets (DeepMath 57k subset, DAPO-Math-17k), full hyperparameters (Appendix B), and hardware (Appendix C).

primary_link.title: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward

radar.summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have become two widely adopted paradigms for post-training large language models. However, RLVR suffers from sparse task-level feedback, while OPD provides dense token-level guidance but ignores trajectory correctness, limiting its performance to that of the teacher. Combining them is a promising direction: OPD supplies dense supervisory signals, while RLVR provides task-level correctness. Nevertheless, existi
radar.summary_zh: 可驗證獎勵強化學習(RLVR)與同策略蒸餾是大型語言模型後訓練的兩大主流範式,但前者獎勵稀疏、難以歸因,後者雖提供密集的 token 級引導,卻只追求模仿教師分佈,性能受限於教師本身。既有結合方法多半加權混合或啟發式切換,引入額外超參數。本文提出 OPDVR,先從 RLVR 角度重新推導抽樣 token 蒸餾的隱含獎勵,指出其符號由師生機率比決定、可能與軌跡正確性衝突,再以極簡的 ReLU 閘門確保正確軌跡獲得非負獎勵、錯誤軌跡獲得非正獎勵,且不新增任何超參數。此修正使抽樣 token 蒸餾成為正規的 RLVR 方法,可直接與 GRPO 等策略梯度演算法結合,衍生出 GRPD 變體。在 AIME、AMC、MATH500 等六項數學推理基準上,於同架構與跨架構蒸餾設定中,OPDVR 與 GRPD 均一致優於標準 OPD,GRPD 在 AIME24 較 GRPO 提升 6.5 分,消融實驗中的反向閘門版本表現最差,驗證了閘門方向的重要性。限制在於實驗聚焦數學推理,且同架構下仍未完全超越教師。此研究提供了一個無超參數、可泛化地融合密集蒸餾訊號與任務正確性的簡潔配方。

links.title: Confident at the moment of action: belief miscalibration in LLM play under hidden information

evidence: Abstract/§4.1: captures at >=0.5 stated confidence correct in 1 of 62 cases across two independent batches; capture-time Brier 0.1445 vs 0.0203 uniform, paired-bootstrap ratio CI 3.8x-15.9x; 99.3%/98.7% of Brier gap concentrated in high-confidence events (original/replication).

§4.3/Table 1: five-seat ordering spans two labs but only S1 vs S5 clears pairwise significance; S7 forced to temperature 1.0 by API; S6 vs S6B (same model, same leaderboard score) differ 10.8 points from a max_tokens change alone.

§4.5: control (standard chess, no Crown Shift) declines 20.1 points vs 37.8 for Regent Chess; difference-in-declines 17.7 points, significant only in the ply 26-50 bucket (p=1.6e-6), explicitly scoped to that bucket.

§4.6: capture square was a named candidate only 26.4% (24/91), statistically indistinguishable from a pre-registered permutation null of 29.2%; rank-inversion claim withdrawn; top-k elicitation caveat stated live.

§5: only S1 received the full calibration battery; no transfer validation ('every number here should be read as domain-internal'); provider rejects fixed seeds so games are not exactly replayable; single fixed opponent.

§6: oracle-vs-public analysis finds shift target 83.1% top-3 predictable from public features but shift timing near-random, so no tested predictor including a privileged reference tracker beats uniform past the rule-determined window.
Disclosure section: all figures produced by version-controlled analysis code from a canonical numbers document, but no public artifact release or repository URL is stated anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic for LLM agent evaluation: measures verbalized-confidence calibration of LLMs (Gemini, GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek) at the moment of action in a hidden-information chess variant, directly engaging Agents, LLM, Evaluation, and AI-Safety preferences. Rigor is unusually careful for an unreviewed single-author paper: pre-registered expectations with falsifiers (§3, §4.8), an independent replication batch with agreeing direction and magnitude, paired bootstrap CIs, a no-crown control condition separating hidden-state-specific decline from general context growth (§4.5), and unusually honest scoping (concurrent work [13] is credited for the action-belief gap; the cross-seat ordering is explicitly not claimed to show capability predicts calibration). However, the core finding rests on n=62 pooled high-confidence capture events from one seat (S1) that alone received the full battery (§5); cross-seat samples of 8-24 yield only one distinguishable pairwise gap and carry a forced-temperature confound (Table 1, §4.3); the 'second pillar' dissociation in §4.4 is from an earlier unscored smoke-pilot; all results are against one fixed opponent with no transfer validation (§5). Novelty is moderate: verbalized miscalibration and action-confidence divergence are established/concurrent, with the endogenous-hidden-state instrument, concentration result (99.3% of Brier gap in high-confidence events), and oracle-vs-public tractability bound (§6) as the genuinely new contributions. No code or data release is stated, and the provider's rejection of seeds prevents exact replay (§5), limiting reproducibility despite full ruleset and parameter documentation.

Across two inde
radar.summary_zh: 代理系統常依模型自行陳述的信心來決定是否採取關鍵行動,本文檢驗此假設在隱藏資訊情境下是否成立。作者設計一種國際象棋變體 Regent Chess:王權狀態可被秘密、反覆轉移至其他棋子,且每回合都要求模型在選步之外,另行陳述對手隱藏 Regent 位置的機率分佈,遊戲結束後可比對內部記錄還原真值。結果發現:在兩個獨立批次中,模型於信心≥0.5 時發動的吃子僅 1/62 次正確,且 99.3%(複製批次 98.7%)的 Brier 誤差差距集中於這些高信心事件;自規則允許推論的首個 ply 起,其信念就顯著差於均勻先驗。此現象以較弱形式在兩個實驗室共五個座位組態中呈單調排序,但樣本量不足以宣稱能力可預測校準。作者另示範:關閉推理模式的組態在合法率、成本、延遲等傳統指標全面獲勝,信念品質卻最差;而僅依結果的評測無法偵測此問題,因為模型仍可能贏下對局。限制包括完整校準測試僅於單一座位進行、對手固定、且無下游任務遷移驗證。此文凸顯了在行動當點分離測量信念與行動的必要性。

links.title: Towards Reliable, Generalizable, and Specific In-Context Knowledge Editing via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Section 5.2 Table 1: MO-IKE reaches ES 92.0 vs DR-IKE 85.0 and RR 57.7 vs 34.7 on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, with S 73.5 vs 54.9
Section 4.2 Eq. 5 and surrounding text: composite reward r = R - sum(lambda_k * C_k) with fixed hyperparameters; authors state 'we therefore do not solve a constrained program'
Abstract vs Section 5.2: abstract claims ES 91.1/RR 63.4/S 75.7 'averaged over five seeds' while Table 1 reports ES 92.0/RR 57.7/S 73.5, an unresolved discrepancy
Appendix D Table 6: Learning Rate 1e-5, Epochs 3, Group Size 8, Random Seed 42, clipping 0.1, KL 0.001, penalty weights 1, contradicting the five-seed abstract claim
Section 5.3 Table 4: reward ablation shows All Constraints S 73.5/RR 57.7 vs No Constraint S 65.5/RR 50.0, supporting the retention penalty claim
Section 5.1: evaluation on only 300 held-out CounterFact samples and 100 each for ZsRE and WikiData-Counterfact, limiting statistical power
Appendix G Table 8: on UniEdit (311K examples) MO-IKE S 24.5, RR 14.3 vs IKE S 19.6, showing much lower absolute scores at scale
Limitations section: retention rate remains low (around 60%), fixed lambda impact unexplored, and generalization to other ICL tasks like reasoning is left unclear
Appendix C Table 5: RAG-RL baseline on Qwen-2.5-7B collapses to RR 8.0 while MO-IKE reaches RR 60.0, but only one such external-baseline comparison
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: in-context knowledge editing for frozen LLMs (Llama-3.1/3.2, Mistral, Qwen2.5/3) trained via a multi-objective GRPO retriever, squarely matching LLM, prompting/ICL, knowledge, and RL preferences. The contribution is incremental but real: extending DR-IKE from a reliability-only objective to a Lagrangian-shaped multi-objective reward and expanding the action space to all demonstration categories plus a learnable STOP action. Empirical support is broad (CounterFact, ZsRE, Wiki-Counterfact, 311K UniEdit, five-seed abstract claims, reward/action-space ablations, hyperparameter sensitivity, zero-shot cross-model transfer, natural baselines, latency). Rigor is dampened by small evaluation sets (300/100 samples), no variance or significance reporting in tables, figure-only ablations, and numeric inconsistencies: the abstract reports ES 91.1/RR 63.4/S 75.7 averaged over five seeds while Section 5.2 Table 1 reports ES 92.0/RR 57.7/S 73.5, and Appendix D Table 6 lists a single Random Seed 42. Novelty is limited by the textbook Constrained-MDP/Lagrangian derivation and direct lineage from DR-IKE. Reproducibility is decent (full hyperparameters, pseudocode, public datasets, hardware specified) but no code release is stated and the seed story is contradictory.

primary_link.title: Towards Reliable, Generalizable, and Specific In-Context Knowledge Editing via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning

radar.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful but limited by static parametric knowledge that becomes outdated once pretraining ends. Knowledge editing addresses this problem by updating model behavior on target facts without full retraining. In particular, in-context knowledge editing has gained attention because it is training-free and readily applicable to black-box LLMs. Recent reinforcement learning (RL)-based approaches improve over fixed retrieval strategies by adapting prompt construction to
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的參數化知識在預訓練後即靜態化,知識編輯可在不重訓的情況下更新特定事實,其中情境知識編輯因免訓練且適用黑箱模型而受矚目。然而既有 RL 方法(如 DR-IKE)只最佳化編輯可靠性,導致檢索器丟棄保護鄰近事實的 RETAIN 範例,犧牲了特定性。本文提出 MO-IKE,將提示建構視為對 COPY、UPDATE、RETAIN 與 STOP 動作的序列決策過程,形式化為受限馬可夫決策過程,以 GRPO 訓練 BERT 動態檢索器,並用結合改寫一致性與保留率懲罰的多目標塑形獎勵進行最佳化。在 Llama-3.2-3B 上五個種子平均,相較最強 RL 基準,MO-IKE 將編輯成功率(可靠性)由 87.1% 提升至 91.1%,保留率(特定性)由 41.0% 提升至 63.4%,改寫一致性(泛化性)約略持平,調和平均分由 61.7 升至 75.7。成果在五個凍結 LLM 與四個資料集(含 31 萬例的 UniEdit)上均成立,且於 Llama-3.2 訓練的檢索器可零樣本遷移至 Mistral-7B 而幾無效能損失。限制包括資料規模仍小、固定懲罰權重的影響未充分探索,且保留率絕對值約六成仍低於其他指標。此工作示範了多目標約束如何緩解編輯成功率與知識保留之間的衝突。

evidence: Abstract vs Table 6/Table 17: claims 'three orders of magnitude lower' overhead, but profiler numbers show RDA 81.5 GFLOPs (0.63x) vs GxAct 18.77 TFLOPs (144.29x), i.e., ~229x (~2.4 orders), a mild overstatement.
Table 2 (Code domain, k=5, Qwen3-4B-it): RACE MLP ISI 2.91 vs internal ablation Emp. Mean 2.79 and Emp. SNR 0.00; ATTN results weak (RACE ISI 1.62 vs AttnLRP 2.00).
Table 3 (OLMo-3.1-32B-it, top-1%/5%): RACE MLP MATH-500 56.80/6.72 with ISI 1.65/1.73 vs Emp. Mean 73.95/21.43 with ISI 1.35/1.50; all ATTN methods ISI ~0.00.
Table 4 (Distributional verification, RSF): suppressing RACE-selected MLP neurons gives +77.31% MBPP+ PPL and D_KL 0.58 vs only +2.76%/-0.02 on WikiText-2, supporting domain specificity.

Table 5 (Fine-grained steering): PyComp-1K-selected suppression cuts comprehension Records -70.9% on MBPP+ and -61.1% on HumanEval+ while Pass% stays 87.50/85.71, evidence of steering rather than destruction.

Limitations section: authors concede RACE and baselines 'demonstrate limited effectiveness in identifying functionally consistent neurons within attention modules' and that linear projections may miss non-linear synergies.

Appendix K: top-1% selections stable (Jaccard >=0.98) across priors lambda0,beta0 in [1e-3,1e3] and alpha0 in [0.5,50]; tightening gamma to 0.001 shrinks positive-CAM pool from 81.75% to 62.24% at N=10.

Section 3.1 + Table 1: baselines GxAct (Captum) and AttnLRP averaged over T_c with identical per-layer budgets; three-run averaging stated ('All reported scores are averaged over three runs') but no standard deviations reported.

Appendix F (Tables 10-15): full eval stack (EvalScope 1.5.0, vLLM 0.15.1), decoding settings, benchmark splits, and PyComp-1K construction from The Stack (Appendix I) support reproducibility; however, no code or artifact release is mentioned anywhere in the paper.

Figure 3 / Section 3.5: ISI vs scoring-set size is non-monotonic and RACE's advantage over Emp. Mean comes only from the CAM uncertainty penalty since the posterior mean is a monotonic rescaling of the empirical mean under the default prior.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope mechanistic interpretability work on decoder LLMs (Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B, OLMo-3.1-32B): forward-pass residual decomposition plus NIG-Bayesian aggregation to rank domain-consistent neurons, with suppression-based causal validation and fine-grained behavioral steering. Strongly matches LLM (2.5) and Interpretability (1.8) preferences; code/math appear only as evaluation domains. Novelty is moderate: task/skill neuron localization is established; the population-level posterior (CAM credible bound) and reference-set filtering are the main new ingredients, and Appendix B's completeness identity is a nice formal touch. Rigor is solid on design (external baselines GxAct/AttnLRP, internal ablations Emp. Mean/Emp. SNR/Neg. CAM, prior-robustness in Appendix K, profiler protocol in Appendix H) but weakened by mixed results: RACE beats the trivial Emp. Mean ablation only modestly (e.g., ISI 2.91 vs 2.79 in Table 2 MLP; 1.65 vs 1.35 on OLMo-32B in Table 3), attention-module interventions largely fail (admitted in Limitations), and no variance/significance is reported despite 3-run averaging. Evidence is supportive for MLP domain specificity (Table 4: +77.31% target PPL vs ~+2.76% on WikiText-2; Table 5: -70.9% comprehension usage with Pass% 87.50) but the abstract's 'three orders of magnitude' efficiency claim overstates the measured ~229x (144.29x vs 0.63x in Tables 6/17). Generalizability is decent across 4B-32B and three behaviors but untested beyond standard decoder Transformers. Reproducibility is good on hyperparameters, eval stack (EvalScope 1.5.0/vLLM 0.15.1, Appendix F) and dataset construction (Appendix I), but no code release is stated.

Existing methods often rely on instance-level point estimates or computationally expensive procedures, which either obscure population-level variability or limit scalable domain-wide analysis. We present RACE (Residual Alignment for Consistency Estimation), a forward-pass statistical framework that evaluates the domain-wide functional consistency of Transformer neurons. Perturbation expe
radar.summary_zh: 機制可解釋性研究多依賴實例層的點估計或昂貴的梯度計算,難以進行涵蓋整個領域的族群級分析,而模型能力稽核、領域特定剪枝與行為導引等應用正需要跨輸入穩定的任務相關神經元排名。本文提出 RACE,一個以前向傳播為基礎的統計框架,評估 Transformer 神經元對目標領域的功能一致性。其分兩階段:第一階段以殘差方向對齊(RDA)將每個模組對殘差流的更新分解為各神經元貢獻,以單次前向傳播計算帶號對齊證據;第二階段透過 Normal-Inverse-Gamma 共軛模型進行貝葉斯聚合,得到後驗均值與方差校準的 CAM 分數,兼顧貢獻強度與穩定性,並以參考集過濾(RSF)區分領域特定與泛用神經元。在 Qwen3-4B、OLMo-3.1-32B、Llama-3.1-8B 上,針對程式生成與數學推理的定向抑制實驗顯示,RACE 選出的神經元能選擇性破壞目標能力而保留其他行為,領域特異性優於 GxAct、AttnLRP 等梯度法,運算開銷低三個數量級;亦可精細抑制 Python 推導式生成而不損功能正確性。限制在於線性投影無法捕捉非線性協同,且注意力模組的識別效果有限。此框架為模型稽核與行為控制提供了可擴展的族群級工具。

links.title: Prompt Structure Redistributes, Not Reduces: An Empirical Analysis of Security-Weaknesses in LLM-Generated Python Code

evidence: Abstract: structured prompting reduces GPT-4o invalid outputs from 338 of 424 to 37-52; high-severity findings fall 20.8%→13.6% while low-severity rise 32%→43.5%.
Sec III-D: single generation per prompt-model-task configuration, temperature 0.7 and top-p 0.2, LLaMA 3.1-8B via Ollama Q4_K_M quantization.
Sec IV-A: LLaMA invalid outputs fluctuate across Prompts 1.0-4.0 (51, 115, 89, 150), showing model-dependent compliance effects.
Sec III-F and Sec IV-C / Table II: task-relevance and semantic-drift audit based on 15 randomly sampled problems; GPT-4o drift 3/15 (20%) to 9-10/15 (60-67%).
Sec IV-B2 / Table I: CWE-78 rises 43.9%→49.7% for GPT-4o while CWE-94 falls 10.1%→4.1%; CWE-209/CWE-497 and CWE-489/CWE-215 rows report identical values across all conditions.
Sec V Threats to Validity: static-analysis false positives/negatives, single Python dataset, model-dependent prompt effects, single output per configuration limiting variance estimation.
Contribution 5 and Ref [6]: publicly available replication package (Zenodo) containing prompts, generated outputs, and static-analysis results.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope empirical LLM study: prompt engineering for secure code generation with GPT-4o and LLaMA 3.1-8B, touching high-weight preferences (LLMs, prompting, code generation, AI safety/evaluation). The central reframing—prompt structure redistributes severity rather than reducing weakness counts—and the semantic-drift audit are genuinely novel against prior aggregate-count evaluations. Rigor is mixed: controlled variables, two static analyzers, and a two-stage compliance/security design are sound, but there is no statistical significance testing, only one generation per configuration, a 15-task manual audit underpinning the drift claim, and LLaMA Stage-2 conditioning on tasks valid under all prompts (selection bias); Table I also contains rows with identical values across all conditions (e.g., CWE-209/CWE-497), suggesting reporting carelessness. Evidence for headline numbers (338→37-52 refusals; 20.8%→13.6% high severity) is concrete but untested and Bandit-centric. Generalizability is limited to two models, one synthetic Python dataset, zero-shot prompting, and effects are explicitly model-dependent. A Zenodo replication package with prompts, outputs, and analyses is claimed, supporting decent reproducibility despite API nondeterminism.

primary_link.title: Prompt Structure Redistributes, Not Reduces: An Empirical Analysis of Security-Weaknesses in LLM-Generated Python Code

radar.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly generate code from natural-language prompts, making prompt engineering a key mechanism for shaping the security of generated software. Structured and security-oriented prompts are widely used to encourage safer code, yet their effects extend beyond whether detected weaknesses are simply present or absent. Using 424 security-sensitive Python tasks, we generate solutions with GPT-4o and LLaMA 3.1-8B under five prompt variants that progressively add structu
radar.summary_zh: 結構化與安全導向提示被廣泛用來促使 LLM 產出更安全的程式碼,但既有研究多以靜態分析的總量減少論證成效,忽略風險可能只是被重新分配。本文以 424 個安全敏感的 Python 任務,使用 GPT-4o 與 LLaMA 3.1-8B 在五種遞進式提示變體下生成程式,並以 Bandit 與 CodeQL 從生成合規性,以及弱點流行率、嚴重度、CWE 分佈兩軸評估。結果顯示:結構化提示大幅降低拒答(GPT-4o 無效輸出由 338 降至 37-52),為大規模分析開啟可能,但安全導向細化並未一致降低整體弱點流行率;對 GPT-4o 而言,更強的提示主要是重新分配風險——高嚴重度發現由 20.8% 降至 13.6%,低嚴重度由 32% 升至 43.5%;LLaMA 3.1-8B 的變化較弱且不一致。作者並觀察到安全驅動的語義漂移:更嚴格的提示會悄悄移除或改寫明確要求的不安全建構(如以 AST 評估取代 eval()),在滿足靜態分析的同時可能違背功能需求。限制包括僅依賴靜態分析、單一語言與資料集、效果高度依賴模型,且每組態僅單次生成。此文提醒:提示工程是合規槓桿,但不能取代後續的安全分析與驗證,評測宜採嚴重度分層指標。
radar.title: Prompt Structure Redistributes, Not Reduces: An Empirical Analysis of Security-Weaknesses in LLM-Generated Python Code
radar.title_zh: 提示結構是重新分配而非減少:LLM 生成 Python 程式碼安全弱點之實證分析

links.title: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for GUI Reward Modeling

evidence: Section 5.1 / Table 1: AdaptRubric mean overall Acc 86.7 / F1 86.6 vs ZeroGUI mean F1 84.9 and OS-Themis mean F1 81.1 under the matched ten-screenshot budget; recall rises to 86.5 vs 80.2 baseline average.
Section 5.4 / Table 4: ablation on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B shows F1 drops of 2.0 without the Fine rubric, 2.0 without the Coarse rubric, and 5.9 without both, supporting the two-component design.

Section 5.2 / Table 2: online GRPO on MobileWorld lifts MAI-UI-8B success from 19.70% to 23.93±0.85% (+4.23); error bars are reported only for AdaptRubric, and the no-agent baseline is cited from Tang et al. (2026).

Section 5.1 vs Appendix D / Table 9: the ZeroGUI Qwen3.5-122B-A10B row (85.8/86.5 ... overall 84.8 F1) is identical in the last-10-budget Table 1 and the original last-2-context Table 9, an internal inconsistency suggesting a copied row.

Appendix B and Appendix H: rubric bank induced from 116+116 AndroidWorld/MobileWorld trajectories using Claude Opus 4.6, with full prompts and rubric sections provided; no code or data release is stated anywhere in the document.
Section 5.5 / Table 5: AdaptRubric uses 3.0 calls and 19.1K tokens per trajectory at 1.56 s/trajectory with 84.2 F1, versus OS-Themis at 15.25 calls and 76.5 F1, supporting the quality-cost claim.

Appendix F / Table 12: heterogeneous candidate pool raises mixed tasks to 46.0% and oracle headroom to +20.00, a careful control showing the test-time-scaling comparison is informative rather than pool-dominated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent-methodology paper: task-adaptive rubric construction for GUI outcome reward modeling, evaluated as an LLM/VLM-as-judge reward verifier and as an RL reward signal (GRPO). Strongly matches Agents & Tool Use, Alignment/Reward Modeling, and Evaluation preferences. Method is an incremental but sensible coarse-to-fine rubric scheme (category-level retrieval + at most two instruction-grounded cues) over existing rubrics-as-rewards and dynamic-criteria work. Experimental coverage is broad (1,409 OGRBench trajectories, 5 platforms, 8 judge backbones, matched image budgets, ablations, efficiency, online RL, controlled test-time-scaling pool with oracle analysis), but gains over the best baseline are modest (~1.7 F1 over ZeroGUI; the 3.6-point headline is vs. baseline average), no significance tests are reported, variance is given only for AdaptRubric in the RL table, and one ZeroGUI row is duplicated across mismatched budget settings, weakening evidence. Reproducibility is aided by full prompts, rubric bank contents, and hyperparameters, but the rubric bank is induced from only 232 dev trajectories with a specific model and no code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for GUI Reward Modeling

radar.summary: Recent studies on GUI agents have increasingly focused on outcome reward modeling, which assigns outcome rewards by judging whether an executed trajectory satisfies the success criteria implied by the user instruction. Existing GUI reward verifiers, however, often under-specify how these criteria should be constructed for each task instance. Whether using generic rubric structures or implicit model reasoning, their judging criteria are not sufficiently task-adaptive: they can transfer checks acr
radar.summary_zh: GUI 代理的結果獎勵建模需判斷軌跡是否滿足指令隱含的成功條件,但現有獎勵驗證器對如何為每個任務實例建構判斷準則著墨不足:靜態模板過於通用,可能跨任務套用檢查而忽略指令中的具體約束;依賴模型隱式推理則可能遺漏細節或施加未陳述的要求。本文提出 AdaptRubric,一個粗到細的評分準則框架:粗階段將指令路由至八個 GUI 任務類別之一,從離線建立的類別級準則庫檢索可重用的驗證步驟、常見陷阱與特殊規則;細階段依當前指令生成至多兩條緊扣指令明確語句、數值或約束的實例級準則線索,必要時可棄權;最後融合兩者供 VLM 驗證器判定結果獎勵。在跨平台離線獎勵基準 OGRBench 上,AdaptRubric 達 86.7% 準確率與 86.6 F1,在相同截圖預算下 F1 較基準平均提升 3.6 分;作為線上強化學習(MAI-UI-8B 搭配 GRPO)的獎勵驗證器時,任務成功率較無外部獎勵代理提升 4.23 分,並在測試時擴展實驗中取得最佳表現,效率亦優於 OS-Themis 與 ZeroGUI。限制在於環境與指令樣式未窮盡,且準則庫為離線固定建構,可能無法涵蓋新興應用。此工作凸顯了顯式、任務自適應準則建構對可靠 GUI 獎勵的價值。

links.title: Compression Trinity: Exploring Sparsity, Quantization, and Low-Rank Approximations for LLM Compression

evidence: Abstract (Page 2): 'MKOR approximates curvature via block-diagonal sparsity and low-rank inversion... accelerating convergence by up to 1.85× over KFAC'; 'SLIM... improving accuracy by up to 5.66% over state-of-the-art methods and outperforming uncompressed dense models at equal parameter budgets by 0.6%'

Table 1.2 (Page 4): 'Single-Pillar Compression (8x Ratio): 2-bit Quantization 31.81%, 87.5% Unstructured Sparsity 31.24%... Multi-Pillar Compression (8x Ratio): 4-bit Quantization + 50% Unstructured Sparsity 52.38%' on LLaMA-2-7B
Table 4.1 (Page 40): SLOPE training speedup 1.20-1.25x vs FST 1.06-1.11x; inference speedup 1.31-1.54x vs FST 1.00x on OPT models

Table 5.2-5.7 (Pages 60-65): OPTIMA consistently improves zero-shot accuracy across LLaMA-3.1/3.2, Gemma-2/3, Qwen-2.5 (0.5B-14B) at 50%, 60% unstructured and 2:4 sparsity; e.g., Wanda+OPTIMA 53.12% vs Wanda 52.38% on LLaMA-3.1-8B at 2:4
Table 7.7 (Page 97): SLIM layer-wise speedups up to 3.99x (up-projection, LLaMA-2-70B, batch 16, RTX-3060, INT4)

Section 8.3 (Page 101): 'Our methods... are currently tightly coupled to the NVIDIA Sparse Tensor Core architecture (2:4 sparsity)... fairness audit... is an important direction that lies outside the scope'

Section 3.4 (Page 24): 'Our code base is publicly available at https://github.com/Mohammad-Mozaffari/mkor'; Section 1.4 (Page 6): 'code, pre-trained checkpoints, and interactive visualizations... centralized at our research hub'

Section 4.4 (Page 39): 'our accuracy evaluation is primarily focused on smaller-scale LLMs up to 774M parameters. However, the speedup and memory reduction results extend to... 2.6B up to 66B parameters'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A PhD thesis unifying sparsity, quantization, and low-rank approximation for LLM compression across training and inference. Directly relevant to LLM preferences (weight 2.5) and Scaling & Efficiency keywords (quantization, pruning, compression, inference optimization), plus Training & Optimization and Inference & Serving; however it does not engage the highest-weight preferences of agents, reasoning, or Japanese LLMs, capping relevance at ~0.72. Novelty is moderate: the unifying 'Trinity' framing is largely rhetorical packaging of already-published components (MKOR NeurIPS 2023, SLOPE ICLR 2025, SLIM ICML 2025), though OPTIMA's shared-Hessian column-wise QP reformulation and SLIM's saliency-based one-shot SVD adapters are genuinely new methods in the compression space. Rigor is strong: formal proofs (MKOR convergence/stability lemmas, double-pruning analysis), extensive ablations (tile size, adapter rank, calibration sensitivity), multi-family evaluations (OPT, LLaMA-2/3, Gemma, Qwen-2.5 spanning 125M-70B), and an unusually candid limitations section covering hardware coupling, fairness, and scale. Evidence is well-supported by dozens of quantitative tables (e.g., Table 1.2 showing 8x multi-pillar compression retaining 52.38% vs ~31% single-pillar on LLaMA-2-7B; Table 7.7 layer-wise speedups to 3.99x), though pretraining accuracy is only evaluated on models ≤774M while speedups extend to 66B, and adapter overhead complicates iso-parameter comparisons. Generalizability is solid across model families but explicitly coupled to NVIDIA 2:4 sparse tensor cores. Reproducibility is aided by public code (MKOR GitHub), a research hub, detailed hyperparameter tables, and pseudocode, though PATCH depends on the external STOICC compiler.

primary_link.title: Compression Trinity: Exploring Sparsity, Quantization, and Low-Rank Approximations for LLM Compression

radar.summary: Prohibitive computational and environmental costs impede the scalable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). Traditional compression techniques (sparsity, quantization, low-rank approximations) are typically applied in isolation, and each hits an accuracy-efficiency wall. This thesis proposes the "Compression Trinity," a unified framework that applies the three pillars jointly: sparsity to reduce computation, quantization to minimize memory bandwidth, and low-rank approximations to recover
radar.summary_zh: 這是一篇博士論文,主張稀疏、量化與低秩近似三種模型壓縮技術不應各自孤立使用,而應聯合應用於 LLM 生命週期各階段,以突破單一技術的精度—效率瓶頸。在預訓練階段,MKOR 以塊對角稀疏與秩 1 低秩反演近似曲率資訊,將二階更新複雜度由 O(d³) 降至 O(d²),相較 KFAC 收斂加速最多 1.85 倍;SLOPE 透過雙重剪枝反向傳遞實現 N:M 稀疏的前向與反向加速,並在最後 1% 迭代引入「懶惰」低秩適配器恢復精度,端對端訓練加速達 1.25 倍。在後訓練階段,OPTIMA 將剪枝後的權重重建形式化為共享 Hessian 的逐欄二次規劃,零樣本精度最多提升 3.97%;PATCH 以可學習的瓦片級混合稀疏(稠密或 2:4)實現 0% 至 50% 的連續稀疏比,加速達 1.38 倍;SLIM 則一次性聯合應用量化、稀疏與數學推導的低秩適配器以恢復聯合壓縮誤差,較最先進方法精度最多提升 5.66%,並在同等參數預算下超越未壓縮稠密模型 0.6%。限制包括與 NVIDIA 2:4 稀疏硬體的緊耦合、管線複雜度,以及對弱勢族群的潛在不均影響尚未稽核。此論文為永續且高效率的 LLM 部署提供了系統性框架。
radar.title: Compression Trinity: Exploring Sparsity, Quantization, and Low-Rank Approximations for LLM Compression
radar.title_zh: 壓縮三位一體:探索稀疏性、量化與低秩近似於 LLM 壓縮

links.title: Trust the Mass: Forced Weights in KV-Cache Eviction

evidence: §2.2: exact enumeration on 168,192 attention rows shows the best subset closes only a median 2-5% of the top-mass-to-dense gap (median ĉ of 0.021-0.047 over eight families).
Appendix A.2: NP-completeness of deciding ES(s)=0 via reduction from BalancedPartition, with inapproximability below additive N^-2 proven using Lemma A.5's gap {0} ∪ [2N^-2, ∞).

§4: in the needle runs the five per-head methods including KVzip hold the full cache at every length and budget because the kvpress pipeline stores selection as a mask; enforcement on one fixed selection lowers scores in 140 of 157 paired conditions (up to 62.2 points on RULER s=128).
Table 3: with budget enforced, ContourKV beats KVzip in 93/160 conditions, loses 22, and ties Compactor 24/96/40, which §2.2's low selection ceiling predicts.

§4 (Table 5): an 87.6-point retrieval margin decomposes to rankings computed while the question is visible; restricting ranking to document rows costs 88.2 points, difference between the two conditions +0.6.

App. E: on Qwen3 scales the dropped-mass map keeps 55/15/31% of the all-cell balancing gain and no cell ranking beat a random set on Qwen3-1.7B; App. D.2 reports the reconstruction score costs 7.744s vs 0.605s dense prefill on Llama-3.1-8B.

App. B: bitwise reproduction of committed records on the first three documents, certification via 25x cap-widening (median gap moves <1%) and a SCIP MISOCP solver confirming 37% of argmins with improvements on 4.9% of solved instances; no code-release statement appears anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM inference-efficiency methodology (KV-cache eviction, sparse attention, long-context serving), squarely in scope. The 'forced weights' operator framing is genuinely novel: it separates deployed eviction (softmax renormalized over kept keys) from classical coreset selection with re-solved weights, proves NP-completeness (App. A.2 reduction from BalancedPartition), and audits memory accounting to show per-head methods like KVzip hold the full cache as masks (§4). Rigor is exceptionally high: registered bounds before capture (§2.3), certified enumeration with MISOCP solver and cap-widening sweeps (App. B.2, B.4), cluster-bootstrap intervals, bitwise-verified CompressKV port (§4), and honest negative results (Qwen3 map keeps only 55/15/31% of gain, App. E; rank-16 probe recovers ≤5%, §2.4). Evidence is dense and quantitative across ten model arms and 160 paired comparisons (Tables 3-5), though all figures are self-reported with no external replication. Generalizability is solid across 0.6B-14B models and content types but caveated (two audited families at deployed budgets, one lineage failure). Reproducibility is moderate: detailed protocol and configurations, but no explicit code-release statement. ContourKV's own reconstruction score costs 8.7-13.6x dense prefill (App. D.2), limiting practical deployment value.

primary_link.title: Trust the Mass: Forced Weights in KV-Cache Eviction

radar.summary: Every deployed sparse-attention or KV-cache-eviction rule keeps a subset of the keys, discards the rest, and renormalizes the attention weights over the kept set. Enumerating the exact best subset under that constraint on $168{,}192$ attention rows from five models shows that keeping the largest weights is already near-optimal, since the best subset closes only a median $2$ to $5\%$ of the remaining gap to full attention. If selection closes this little, published margins between eviction method
radar.summary_zh: 所有已部署的稀疏注意力或 KV 快取驅逐規則,都是保留部分鍵、丟棄其餘、再對保留集合重新正規化注意力權重。本文對五個模型的 168,192 條注意力列窮舉該約束下的精確最佳子集,發現保留最大權重已近乎最佳:最佳子集僅能縮小到全注意力剩餘差距的中位數 2 至 5%,貪心交換規則即可完全補回。既然選擇的增益如此有限,已發表方法間的差距必來自他處,作者遂測量各方法實際持有的位元組:在共享評測管線中,最強的查詢無關方法將每層選擇儲存為遮罩,因而持有完整快取,只有逐頭不規則儲存才能釋放記憶體;對單一固定選擇強制執行名義預算會損失 14.1 至 62.2 個基準點;而 87.6 點的檢索差距可追溯到問題可見時才進行的排序。基於被丟棄質量統計,作者提出免訓練的分配器 ContourKV,在與 KVzip 的 160 場配對比較中贏得 93 場、輸 22 場,位元組數等同強制預算的基準,並在最強的預算基準處打平。限制在於尚未證明任何在問題到達前行動的規則能觸及值側殘差,且部分結論依賴特定對手與模型。此研究的核心貢獻是測量與記帳:驅逐方法的比較需要強制預算與實測記憶體。
radar.title: Trust the Mass: Forced Weights in KV-Cache Eviction
radar.title_zh: 相信質量:KV-Cache 驅逐中的強制權重

links.title: FuzzingBrain-Bench V1: Evaluating Open-Ended Bug Discovery by LLMs

evidence: Abstract/Section 4: 'Claude Opus 4.8 performs best, triggering crashes in 60 of 77 challenges and achieving a score of 196 out of 579'; Sonnet 156/579 (50/77 crashed), Haiku 58/579 (35/77 crashed).

Section 2.4/Table 3: difficulty tiers D1-D5 are computed from the fixed three-model panel; authors state the scale 'is circular: the coefficients are derived from the panel's results and then used to score that same panel.'
Section 3: corpus of 77 challenges from 43 projects (36 C, 32 C++, 9 Java/JVM), graded under AddressSanitizer (53), Jazzer (9), libFuzzer (8), UBSan (4), LSan (3); turn budget 100, 1800s per episode.
Section 2.4: 'Each experiment would be repeated' is stated as future work, implying reported results are single runs without variance reporting.
Section 4/Tables 5-7: detailed cost ($193.11 Opus, $253.34 Sonnet, $43.42 Haiku), token (input:output ratios 84:1 to 188:1) and episode-duration measurements per difficulty tier.
Section 4: claim that results are 'in line with these models' performances reported in publicly available LLM leaderboards' is stated without any supporting citation or correlation analysis.

Appendices A-C: full MCP tool schemas, model-facing system prompts, and a step-by-step reproduction tutorial (fb-bench run commands, output artifacts) are provided; Section 1 states the corpus and harnesses are publicly available on GitHub.

Appendix D: flaky-crash case study showing same input yielding different signatures (flaky_location) is documented, demonstrating honest treatment of a known failure mode of signature-based deduplication.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic LLM benchmark for open-ended bug discovery, strongly aligned with LLM, agent/tool-use (MCP tools, agent loop), code/security, and benchmark-evaluation preferences. The 'generation 4' reframing—crediting any distinct reproducible crash signature through a harness rather than a predefined target—is a genuine but incremental contribution over CyberGym/SEC-bench. Methodology is carefully specified (3x PoC verification, signature dedup, capping, difficulty tiers, full prompts and tool schemas), and results tables are internally consistent. Weaknesses: difficulty coefficients are circular (derived from and applied to the same three-model panel, acknowledged by authors), evaluation uses only one vendor's three Claude models in apparently single runs with no variance estimates, corpus is small (77 challenges), and the claim that results are 'in line with publicly available LLM leaderboards' is unsupported. Reproducibility is good (public GitHub, tutorial, environment, cost/token budgets) but depends on proprietary API models.

primary_link.title: FuzzingBrain-Bench V1: Evaluating Open-Ended Bug Discovery by LLMs

radar.summary:
Evaluating the ability of large language models (LLMs) to discover software bugs is increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate this capability by asking the model to generate a proof-of-concept input that triggers a predefined target vulnerability. However, this setup may overlook valid crashes discovered by the model when they do not match the predefined target. As a result, the evaluation may not reflect the model's real capability.
  We present FuzzingBrain-Bench, a benchm
radar.summary_zh: 評估 LLM 漏洞發現能力的既有基準,多要求模型重現預設的目標漏洞,若模型觸發的當機不在目標範圍內便遭忽略,可能低估其真實能力。本文提出 FuzzingBrain-Bench(FB-Bench),改採開放式探索:模型在自包含的 Docker 映像中取得開源專案原始碼與以 sanitizer 檢測建置的 harness,須產生觸發越多相異當機簽章越好的輸入;每題得分由相異簽章數(上限三個)乘以難度係數(1 至 5,依三個參考模型的實測結果訂定)。V1 版含 77 道挑戰,來自 43 個開源專案(36 個 C、32 個 C++、9 個 Java),漏洞類別橫跨記憶體安全與阻斷服務等 14 類;每個輸入執行三次以確保可重現,並以正規化錯誤類別與堆疊函式名稱組成簽章、判定重複。實驗中 Claude Opus 4.8 表現最佳,於 77 題中的 60 題觸發當機,得分 196/579(33.85%);Sonnet 4.6 得 156 分,Haiku 4.5 僅 58 分;另有 13 題已確認漏洞三個模型皆無法觸發,顯示現有模型仍有進步空間。結果也指出 Opus 常提前結束回合而未用盡預算,且高難度題佔分較重拉低整體分數。限制包括語料規模偏小、sanitizer 種類有限,以及難度係數具循環性(由受測模型自身結果推得);作者規劃擴充至 1000 題並以更廣的模型面板重新計算係數。此基準不依賴修補檔的正確性,提供更貼近真實資安工作的動態評估方式。
radar.title: FuzzingBrain-Bench V1: Evaluating Open-Ended Bug Discovery by LLMs
radar.title_zh: FuzzingBrain-Bench V1:評估 LLM 的開放式漏洞挖掘能力

links.title: Rubrics as Visual-Repair Context for Self-Evolving UI-to-Code Generation

evidence: Abstract: 'Evaluations across six VLMs and three UI-to-code benchmarks demonstrate that RubSE substantially outperforms naïve self-evolution in final-round and best-round settings'
Section 4.2: 'RubSE improves over naïve self-evolution by an average of +1.20 overall score and +0.11 aspect-mean score across the 18 model–benchmark settings'; best-round wins in '14/18 settings'
Section 3.2: preliminary study with GPT-5.2/GPT-5.4 over N=15 rounds; 'on Design2Code: all 15/15 GPT-5.2 refined rounds are below round 0, ending at −2.73'
Table 1 (Section 4.2): per-model final-round and best-round overall/aspect scores for Direct, Self-Evolve, and RubSE on UI2Code-Real, Design2Code, and Design2Code-HARD
Appendix B.1 Table 6: human pairwise evaluation on 60 UI2Code-Real samples with two-sided exact sign tests, p=0.0046 (GPT-5.2) and p=0.0066 (GPT-5.4)
Appendix B.2 Table 7: round-10 improvement mean ± std over three additional judge runs; 'Standard deviations range from 0.09 to 0.82 points'; ordering matches Table 1 except two Qwen3-VL-32B settings
Section 5.1/Figure 4: ablation on UI2Code-Real with GPT-5.2 comparing full RubSE, all-rubrics, random selection, and no-history variants
Section 5.2 Table 2: 'For Qwen executors, the effect is mixed: average collapse increases from 14.8% to 18.1%, while average recovery improves from 23.5% to 30.2%'
Section 5.3 Table 3: content analysis showing GPT rubrics contain 'more global-structure cues across all datasets (89–91% vs. 68–71%)'
Appendix B.3 Tables 8-9: RubSE costs '1.60× the API cost' with GPT-5.4 and '2.5% higher inference latency' with Qwen3.5-9B on vLLM/H200

Limitations: 'our experiments primarily evaluate three leading frontier models and three representative open-source variants on HTML/CSS webpage generation'; 'RubSE does not explicitly guarantee code correctness'
Appendix D Tables 13-16: complete prompts for naive self-evolution, rubric generation, rubric selection, and rubric-guided improvement; Appendix E documents artifact licensing
llm_evaluation.rationale: A test-time self-evolution framework for VLM-based UI-to-code generation that structures visual feedback as typed rubrics (Evolve-Select-History). In scope (not pure CV/diffusion): centrally involves frontier LLM/VLMs (GPT-5.2/5.4, Claude-Sonnet-4.5, Qwen variants), code generation, test-time agentic refinement, and LLM-as-judge evaluation, matching several high-weight preferences, though it does not touch reasoning, alignment, safety, or Japanese NLP, and the average gains are modest (+1.20 overall judge points). Novelty is moderate: generate-critique-revise loops and rubrics-as-rewards are prior art (acknowledged in Related Work), so the contribution is the rubrics-as-repair-context framing plus the empirically characterized 'visual repair coupling' failure mode. Rigor is above average: 6 models x 3 benchmarks with final- and best-round reporting (Table 1), ablations on selection/history and Evolve-Select separation (Fig. 4; Appendix B.3), collapse/recovery analysis (Table 2), judge-variability re-runs (Table 7), cost analysis (Tables 8-9), and honest reporting of negative results (Qwen3-VL-32B exception, Appendix B.4). Evidence is solid but not airtight: primary metrics are GPT-5.2-judge scores with ~1-2 point margins and std up to 0.82, the judge is also an evaluated model (self-preference risk), and human validation covers only 60 samples rated by two authors (Table 6, p<0.01). Generalizability is constrained to HTML/CSS web UI per the Limitations section, though the GPT-rubrics-to-Qwen transfer experiment (Fig. 5, Table 3) supports model-agnostic use. Reproducibility is good: full prompts (Appendix D), protocol, hyperparameters, licenses, and public benchmarks, but no explicit code release and replication depends on proprietary APIs.

primary_link.title: Rubrics as Visual-Repair Context for Self-Evolving UI-to-Code Generation

radar.summary: Large vision-language models have shown strong progress in UI-to-code generation, yet their test-time self-evolution remains unstable. We first identify a fundamental obstacle, termed visual repair coupling: a local code edit may propagate through layout, style, and component dependencies, correcting one visual mismatch while degrading regions that were previously faithful. To address this issue, we present RubSE, a Rubric-guided Self-Evolution framework that uses rubrics to represent visual feedback as a structured visual-repair context. At each refinement round, RubSE generates typed candidate rubrics, selects one prioritized repair target, and stores previously selected rubrics as history, thereby steering each revision toward a well-scoped visual repair while discouraging repeated or over-broad changes. Evaluations across six VLMs and three UI-to-code benchmarks demonstrate that RubSE substantially outperforms naïve self-evolution in final-round and best-round settings, achieving more stable refinement trajectories and a higher trajectory-level performance ceiling. Further analysis shows that RubSE mitigates trajectory collapse by improving recovery from severe visual regressions, and that stronger rubric generators can transfer effective visual-repair guidance to weaker code improvers.
radar.summary_zh: 大型視覺語言模型在 UI-to-code(介面截圖轉程式碼)生成上進展迅速,但測試時的自我演化常不穩定。作者指出核心障礙為「視覺修復耦合」(visual repair coupling):局部程式碼修改會透過版面、樣式與元件依賴向外擴散,修正一處視覺不一致時反而破壞原本正確的區域,導致 naive 自我演化在後期輪次退化,甚至低於初始生成。本文提出 RubSE,將視覺回饋轉為結構化修復脈絡:每輪先由 Evolve 產生涵蓋五種面向(版面幾何、間距密度、字型排版、樣式視覺、完整性)的候選 rubric,再由 Select 挑出單一優先修復目標,並以 History 累積已選 rubric 作為避免清單,抑制重複或過度寬泛的修改。在六個模型(GPT-5.4、GPT-5.2、Claude-Sonnet-4.5 及三個 Qwen 開源模型)與三個基準(UI2Code-Real、Design2Code 與其 HARD 子集)上,RubSE 在 15/18 個最終輪設定優於 naive 自我演化,平均提升 1.20 分;最佳輪表現則在 14/18 個設定勝出,顯示更穩定的軌跡與更高的上限。分析顯示 rubric 有助於從嚴重的視覺回歸中恢復並減少軌跡崩壞;GPT 生成的 rubric 亦能轉移給較弱的 Qwen 模型。代價是 GPT-5.4 的 API 成本約 1.6 倍。限制包括僅評估 HTML/CSS、效果隨模型而異(Qwen3-VL-32B 的 rubric 生成類型偏斜),且未內建除錯迴圈保證程式正確性。
radar.title: Rubrics as Visual-Repair Context for Self-Evolving UI-to-Code Generation
radar.title_zh: 以 Rubric 作為視覺修復脈絡,實現自我演化的 UI-to-Code 生成

links.title: The RAT: A Unified Bayesian Model for RAG Evaluation

evidence: Abstract/Introduction: applies framework to 27 RAG configurations (3 retrievers × 3 generators × 3 datasets) and claims conditional decomposition reveals differences hidden by marginal metrics; code released at github.com/vodezhaw/rat (Section 1, footnote 1).

Section 3: defines factorization P(R,A,T)=P(R)P(A|R)P(T|A,R), deterministic generator success G, five interpretable parameters, and a judge extension adding 18 degrees of freedom; inference via Stan NUTS, 5 chains, 2,000 warmup, 10,000 samples.
Section 5.2: NQ dense-retrieval example—task success Apertus 0.239, Gemma3 0.242, Qwen 0.243 vs. policy adherence 0.164, 0.414, 0.496—supporting the central 'marginals conceal behavior' claim.

Section 5.3 and Table 3(b): All-R information gain 0.345 (Qwen) / 0.284 (Apertus) vs. All-T 0.154 / 0.200; structural explanation that 3 of 4 (R,A) cells resolve G, with the Qwen All-R > All-Joint discrepancy explained via θ_T+ saturation (Appendix F).
Section 5.4, Tables 4–5: gpt-4o-mini judge has TPR 0.77–0.94 but FPR 0.17–0.43; adding 5,000 judge annotations reduces CI width only 0.094→0.080 with MAE essentially unchanged.

Limitations section: binary judgments, fixed abstention policy, only 3 datasets and 8–12B generators, minimal retrieve-then-generate pipeline, single-turn, exact-string abstention detection; footnote 2 notes the controlled 1,720,160-paragraph knowledge base makes retrieval rates optimistic.

Appendices A–D: full retrieval/generation/judge hyperparameters and prompts provided, but no annotator count or inter-annotator agreement for the human gold labels is reported anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM/RAG evaluation-methodology paper squarely within scope: it targets RAG pipeline evaluation (weighted preference), LLM-as-a-judge calibration, and uses three open-weight LLM generators plus GPT-4o-mini as judge. The core contribution—a Bayesian factorization P(R)P(A|R)P(T|A,R) with a deterministic generator-success policy, plus an information-theoretic annotation-allocation analysis—is a genuinely useful reframing relative to prior independent-dimension frameworks (RAGAs, ARES, BERGEN), though the underlying model is simple (five Bernoulli parameters + Dirichlet judge extension). Rigor is solid: Stan/NUTS with specified chain settings, 500-subsample allocation experiments, calibrated credible-interval coverage (Appendix E), and a candid limitations section; however, the human annotation protocol (annotator count, agreement) is not reported, judge/allocation experiments are confined to HotpotQA, and only one judge model is tested. Evidence is concrete and internally consistent (e.g., NQ-dense near-identical task success 0.239/0.242/0.243 vs. policy adherence 0.164/0.414/0.496; judge annotations yield only marginal CI narrowing 0.094→0.080 due to FPR 0.32–0.43). Generalizability is limited by three English KILT datasets, 8–12B generators, binary outcomes, single-turn, and a controlled 1.72M-paragraph knowledge base that inflates retrieval rates. Reproducibility is aided by a public code link, full hyperparameters, and prompts, but the gold-annotation pipeline is underspecified. No unsupported claims or instruction-following in the paper text were detected.

primary_link.title: The RAT: A Unified Bayesian Model for RAG Evaluation

radar.summary: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems requires assessing not only end-to-end correctness but also how individual components interact and how errors propagate through the pipeline. We introduce a Bayesian evaluation framework that jointly models retrieval success, abstention behavior, and answer correctness, factorized according to the pipeline's information flow. The model distinguishes task success. Whether the user received a correct answer (from generator success) and whethe
radar.summary_zh: 評估檢索增強生成(RAG)系統時,僅看最終答案是否正確,會混淆兩種不同的成功:任務成功(使用者取得正確答案)與生成器成功(生成器在給定檢索結果下行為得當,即檢索成功時作答、檢索失敗時適當棄答)。本文提出統一的貝氏評估模型,依 RAG 資訊流將聯合分布分解為 P(R)P(A|R)P(T|A,R),其中 R 為檢索成功、A 為棄答、T 為任務成功,並以確定性函數定義生成器成功 G,用以衡量政策遵循度。模型以 Stan 實作,透過 NUTS 進行後驗推論,並可將 LLM-as-a-judge 標註作為校準後的雜訊觀測納入同一機率框架。實驗涵蓋 27 種組合:三資料集(FEVER、HotpotQA、Natural Questions)× 三種檢索器 × 三個生成器(Apertus 8B、Gemma3 12B、Qwen3.5 9B)。條件分解揭露邊際指標掩蓋的差異:在 NQ 上三個生成器的任務成功率幾近相同(0.239 至 0.243),政策遵循度卻懸殊(0.164 至 0.496),主因是棄答策略不同。標註分配分析顯示,估計政策遵循度時,檢索標註比任務標註更具資訊量;作者以資訊理論解釋:觀察 R 可在四個 (R,A) 格中直接判定三格的 G,觀察 T 僅能判定一格。此外,當 judge 偽陽性率高時,加入 5000 筆自動標註對估計的改善仍有限,凸顯校準品質的關鍵性。限制包括二元判斷簡化、政策定義固定、生成器規模有限(8 至 12B)與單輪、簡單管線的設定。
radar.title: The RAT: A Unified Bayesian Model for RAG Evaluation

links.title: Benchmarking AI Agents for Hardware Design Automation via MCP Tool Calling

evidence: Abstract: builds an MCP server reproducing a proprietary hardware design tool and evaluates seven open-source locally deployed models across prompt, tool-description, context, and architecture choices.
Section 3.5: defines Expected Call Coverage, Extraneous Valid Call Ratio, Tool Failure Rate, and No-Call Accuracy with explicit formulas and matching conventions.
Section 4.2 and Appendix D.1 (Table 8): few-shot prompting causes inaction collapse for Gemma 4 31B (ECC 0.956->0.571) and Gemma 4 E4B (0.731->0.179) with EVCR and TFR falling together.
Appendix D.2 (Table 9): minimal tool descriptions raise TFR for every model relative to comprehensive descriptions.
Section 4.1: Table 2 reports 'best-observed performance under configuration search, not out-of-the-box model performance', indicating post-hoc configuration selection.
Section 3.4 and Table 3: noisy multi-server suites evaluated on only three models, with several missing (—) entries in the noise comparison.

Section 4.3 and Appendix C (Tables 5-7): temperature sweep across 0/0.5/default preserves rankings; run-to-run variance estimated from 2 repeats per configuration plus a 10-repeat subset for best/worst.
Section 6 (Limitations): neither the MCP server implementation nor the benchmark tasks can be released due to proprietary specifications; EVCR is unweighted for severity; no latency measurement.
Section 2: claims novelty in that 'prior work does not evaluate MCP-style agents for hardware design workflows involving persistent cross-task state, invalid requests, or multi-server tool contexts.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference relevance: the paper's core subject is LLM agent reliability for stateful tool calling (MCP servers, ReAct vs Plan-and-Act, system-prompt and few-shot ablations, tool-description detail, context scope, multi-agent decomposition), directly matching Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences; it is not a pure domain application because agent-configuration methodology, not hardware design itself, is the object of study. Novelty is moderate: the call-level metrics adapt tau-bench/MCP-RADAR-style evaluation, and the claimed novelty is the first MCP benchmark for hardware design plus the combined configuration study rather than new methods. Rigor is solid: four formally defined metrics (Section 3.5), 7 models, 6+2 task suites, full prompt/description/history ablations (Appendix D), temperature sweeps and run-to-run variance (Appendix C), and an honest Limitations section; deductions for post-hoc best-configuration selection (acknowledged in Section 4.1), only 2-repeat variance estimation, 4-bit-only quantization, and a single planner model in the Plan-and-Act comparison. Evidence strength is good for main claims (e.g., Table 9 shows minimal descriptions raise TFR for every model; Table 8 shows few-shot inaction collapse 0.956->0.571 and 0.731->0.179 with EVCR/TFR co-declining), but the multi-server/noise analysis covers only three of seven models with missing cells in Table 3, and headline numbers are best-observed rather than out-of-the-box. Generalizability is limited by a proprietary 14-tool replica server and one domain, though findings echo known general agent-configuration effects. Reproducibility is materially constrained: neither the server nor the full benchmark can be released (Section 6), partially offset by verbatim prompts (Appendix F), task examples (Appendix B), and public Ollama models.

primary_link.title: Benchmarking AI Agents for Hardware Design Automation via MCP Tool Calling

radar.summary: We ask whether AI agents powered by locally deployed large language models can reliably automate expert-defined hardware design workflows in an industry-realistic tool-calling setting. In these environments, engineers issue repetitive, dependency-ordered operations---such as creating components, adding ports, and wiring connections---through specialised tools. Confidentiality constraints on component specifications and naming conventions often preclude hosted proprietary APIs, motivating the use
radar.summary_zh: 硬體設計中建立元件、加入埠與連接線路等操作重複且須按依賴順序執行,加上機密性限制常禁止使用託管的商業 API,本文因此探討本地部署的開源 LLM 代理能否透過 MCP(Model Context Protocol)工具呼叫,可靠地自動化專家定義的硬體設計工作流程。作者實作含 14 個工具的 MCP 伺服器,重現某專利硬體設計工具的狀態與依賴邏輯,並建立八套任務:獨立任務 Easy/Medium/Hard、需跨任務狀態恢復的 History、含錯誤拼字與無效請求的 Errors、綜合情境 Cross,以及夾雜 GDB 與 Git 伺服器的兩套雜訊情境,涵蓋單步編輯、依賴鏈與多伺服器路由。研究以七個 4-bit 量化開源模型(Llama 3.1 8B、Gemma 4 系列、Qwen 3.5/3.6、GPT-OSS 20B)評估 ReAct 與 Plan-and-Act 架構、系統提示、工具描述詳盡度與歷史範圍,採預期呼叫覆蓋率(ECC)、多餘有效呼叫比例(EVCR)、工具失敗率(TFR)與正確不呼叫率(NCA)四項指標。結果顯示 Gemma 4 31B 於最佳配置下平均 ECC 達 0.990,但效能強烈取決於任務結構與配置:Llama 3.1 8B 在跨任務情境衰退 82%;few-shot 提示使部分 Gemma 模型嚴重不動作;完整工具描述一致降低失敗率;累積歷史傷害受限模型;Plan-and-Act 僅對弱工作代理或長工作階段有幫助。限制包括僅測試二元歷史範圍、EVCR 未衡量嚴重度,且基於專利考量無法公開基準。
